title: Deep neural network-based coastal region sea fog visibility forecasting method
abstract: The invention discloses a shore area sea fog visibility forecasting method based on a deep neural network. Establishing a visibility label set according to data of a meteorological observation station in a shore area, acquiring a plurality of forecast factor data sets from reanalysis data, and matching the forecast factor data sets with the visibility label set to establish a forecast factor and visibility sample set; establishing a deep neural network structure, and training a nonlinear relation model of the sea fog visibility in the shore area and a plurality of related forecast factors; sea fog visibility forecasting is realized through a plurality of forecasting factor data forecasted in a numerical mode. According to the method, the advantages of the deep neural network method in solving the complex nonlinear problem are utilized, the nonlinear complex relationship between a plurality of forecasting factors and visibility is fully established based on observation data and reanalysis data, and the method is applied on the basis of numerical mode forecasting, so that the method has a wide application prospect. The invention provides a new algorithm and technology for forecasting the sea fog visibility in the shore area, so as to further improve the sea fog visibility forecasting level in the shore area.

title: Remote sensing image retrieval method fusing multi-scale cavity convolution and triple attention
abstract: The invention discloses a remote sensing image retrieval method fusing multi-scale cavity convolution and triple attention. The remote sensing image retrieval method comprises the following steps: A) constructing a reference network based on a residual structure; b) replacing a convolution module in the residual structure with a multi-scale cavity convolution module, and enhancing image features; c) embedding a triple attention module in a residual structure formed by adopting the multi-scale cavity convolution module, wherein the triple attention module is embedded behind the last convolution layer of each residual block of the residual structure; d) constructing an online label smooth loss function, inputting the remote sensing image data into the residual structure for training, and dynamically generating a smooth weight matrix in the training process; e) extracting a feature vector of the remote sensing image; and (F) matching the features of the remote sensing image with the features of the database image, and retrieving the most similar image. The method can extract the significant semantic features of the remote sensing image, and can effectively improve the retrieval precision.

title: CT image marking method and system, medium and equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the field of image processing, in particular to a CT image marking method and system, a medium and equipment. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, acquiring a first 2D segmentation mask image set of ribs and a second 2D segmentation mask image set of vertebrae; step 2, performing adhesion removal processing on the first 2D segmentation mask image set of the rib to obtain a first segmentation image set; step 3, grouping the first segmented image set to obtain an image data set of n groups of ribs; 4, judging an image data set belonging to the same rib from the image data sets of the n groups of ribs to obtain a judgment result; and step 5, determining a 3D center line of the vertebra according to the second 2D segmentation mask image set of the vertebra, and completing the marking of the rib image based on the 3D center line and the judgment result. According to the invention, accurate image data marking can be carried out on the premise that a large number of models and manpower cost are not needed.

title: Method and device for determining prompt information, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention relates to a method and device for determining prompt information, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a road image shot by image acquisition equipment; in a preset detection period, taking a first frame of road image shot by image acquisition equipment as a detection image, and identifying a detection frame of the target vehicle; taking other frames of road images shot by the image acquisition equipment in the detection period as tracking images, and for each frame of tracking image, determining a detection frame and wheel grounding line parameters of the target vehicle in the frame of tracking image based on the detection frame of the target vehicle identified before the frame of tracking image and the frame of tracking image; and determining whether to remind the guide vehicle to pay attention to the target vehicle or not based on the ground equation of the road in front of the guide vehicle determined in the detection period, the detection frame of the target vehicle corresponding to the tracking image in the detection period and the wheel ground line parameter of the target vehicle, thereby reducing the possibility of accident occurrence and achieving the purpose of assisting a driver in driving.

title: Distributed model prediction method
abstract: The invention discloses a distributed model prediction method, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a local model with different neuron distributions, and training the constructed local model through employing data with different distributions; similar neurons of different local models are matched by adopting joint probabilistic nerve matching, and neurons are screened by adopting a penalty function; constructing a global model according to the screened neurons, and determining parameters of the neurons of the global model; a preset training set is adopted, and Bayesian deep learning is utilized to complete estimation of parameter distribution of the global model; and completing the prediction process of the global model according to the estimation of parameter distribution. Parameters of the global model are estimated by adopting probability distribution, and the stability of the parameters is improved, so that the convergence speed of model training is improved, and the model prediction speed is improved.

title: Textile fabric surface defect detection method based on artificial intelligence and Gaussian mixture model
abstract: The invention relates to a textile fabric surface defect detection method based on artificial intelligence and a Gaussian mixture model, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a gray-scale map of a textile fabric image, and segmenting the gray-scale map into a plurality of block images; obtaining a plurality of Gaussian mixture sub-models according to pixel point position distribution and gray value change characteristics of the block image; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a defect ratio of Gaussian mixture sub-models which may have defects according to the Gaussian mixture sub-models, acquiring a training image set according to the defect ratio, training a constructed defect detection network model according to the training image set, and detecting a to-be-detected textile image by using the trained defect detection network model. According to the method, the to-be-detected textile fabric image is detected through the trained defect detection network model, the detection efficiency is improved, meanwhile, the defect detection accuracy is improved, the practicability is high, and the method is worthy of popularization.

title: Character interaction detection method based on bidirectional attention mechanism under knowledge guidance
abstract: The invention discloses a character interaction detection method based on a bidirectional attention mechanism under knowledge guidance. The character interaction detection method comprises the following five steps of target detection, grouping, bottom-up encoder, top-down encoder and binary classification. The key of character interaction detection on multiple person and object instances existing in a complex scene is that relation modeling analysis is effectively carried out on objects in the scene, and a knowledge-guided top-down attention mechanism is introduced into a character interaction detection task. The model can adaptively search related information in a scene for a given human-object pair so as to carry out interaction behavior discrimination, so that human interaction detection is realized; the method provided by the invention has better detection performance (mAP) and better interpretability.

title: Method and system for detecting concentration abnormity of various indoor harmful gases based on target detection
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of harmful gas anomaly detection, and particularly discloses a method and a system for detecting concentration anomaly of various indoor harmful gases based on target detection. According to the method, the infrared image of the common indoor harmful gas is firstly shot, the infrared image is standardized and labeled, the gas name and concentration are included, the YOLO V5 model is trained through a data set by using a deep learning target detection method and based on a Pytorch deep learning framework, the YOLO V5 model is high in speed, easy to operate and small in required sample number, and the detection accuracy is high. And harmful gas concentration detection based on target detection is realized. According to the invention, a deep learning method is utilized to carry out target detection, so that the problems that existing indoor harmful gas concentration anomaly detection is not timely in response and the model is not robust are solved.

title: Crop leaf disease image generation model training method, crop leaf disease identification method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a crop leaf disease image generation model training method, a crop leaf disease identification method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of image enhancement. A hierarchical SwinT network is used as a feature extraction network of a leaf region extraction module, a multi-stage overlapped embedding and hierarchical feature down-sampling module is designed to optimize an image embedding mode and a progressive hierarchical structure of SwinT, a saliency map is generated according to a reconstructed feature map, and a leaf region is extracted. A leaf region extraction module is integrated into an image generation model, and the image generation model is guided to generate disease spots only in a leaf region by designing a background loss function, so that effective enhancement of a leaf disease image data set is realized. According to the method, the generation efficiency and quality of the crop leaf disease image can be improved, the accuracy and robustness of the crop leaf disease recognition model are remarkably improved, and the method has the characteristics of low calculation cost, small required training data volume, rapid convergence, stability and the like.

title: Method and system for increasing difficult sample data, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a method and system for increasing difficult sample data, computer equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining an original training set with a plurality of simple sample images and difficult sample images, training an initial segmentation model through the original training set, and obtaining a target segmentation model; screening the original training set to obtain a difficult sample image, and training a target segmentation model by using the difficult sample image to obtain an optimized target segmentation model; inputting the target image into the optimized target segmentation model for identification, and judging whether the identification result is a difficult sample image; and if the identification result is a difficult sample image, storing the target image as a new difficult sample image in the original training set. title: Data processing device and method for image data
abstract: The invention provides a data processing apparatus and method for image data. Image data may have forms of different digits in a memory, such as 8-bit, 10-bit, 12-bit or 14-bit forms, while accelerator hardware is designed based on a fixed data form, and the data is uniformly processed into a data form required by the accelerator hardware by using a decoding module. Data output by the image sensor may have different channel numbers, and the neural network model uniformly adopts a format of A2 channels. By means of the data processing device for the image data, the image data of the first format with the A1 channels can be processed into the third data of the second format with the A2 channels. For some image data, when a certain channel contains a large amount of data, demosaicing, raw domain noise reduction and other processing are generally carried out on data of a target channel firstly, and the data of the target channel is extracted by using an extraction module, so that accelerator hardware can carry out independent processing on individual channels.

title: Emotion triple extraction method and emotion triple extraction model
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of computer natural language processing, and provides an emotion triple extraction method which comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of word vectors; obtaining a plurality of reference attributes according to each word vector; obtaining a plurality of alternative viewpoints according to each word vector; obtaining a plurality of reference emotion triples according to each reference attribute and the enhanced context vector; obtaining a plurality of alternative emotion triples according to the alternative viewpoints and the enhanced context vectors; the enhanced context vector is used for representing the enhancement degree of the word vector on the context on the emotional field; and extracting an emotion triple according to each reference emotion triple and each alternative emotion triple. Due to the fact that the mutual influence among the attributes, the viewpoints and the emotion vertical sites is fully considered when the reference emotion triads and the alternative emotion triads are obtained, the accuracy of the emotion triads extracted according to the reference emotion triads and the alternative emotion triads is higher. The invention further provides an emotion triple model.

title: Aircraft sensor signal fusion method based on deep belief network and extended Kalman filtering
abstract: The invention discloses an aircraft sensor signal fusion method based on a deep belief network and extended Kalman filtering, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the signal preprocessing of time-space alignment according to different measurement signal features of an infrared sensor and a radar sensor; then, performing compression fusion on the information of the two by using an optimal data compression algorithm to form a new observed quantity, and realizing state estimation of the aircraft by using an EKF (Extended Kalman Filter); and finally, estimating and adjusting the actual observation noise suffered by the system in real time by using a DBN algorithm according to the received estimation value and observation value, and improving the tracking precision of the EKF. Through the method, the problem that state estimation is difficult due to sensor signal fusion of infrared and radar and uncertainty of environmental noise in the flight process of the aircraft is effectively solved.

title: Monitoring method, monitoring device and monitoring camera
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of security and protection, and provides a monitoring method, a monitoring device and a monitoring camera, and the monitoring method comprises the steps: obtaining a to-be-detected image of a target scene; the to-be-detected image is recognized, a first target object and a second target object are obtained, and the second target object is an object supported on the first target object; under the condition that the vertical projection of the second target object is located in the first target object and the second target object is adjacent to any side of the first target object, determining a dangerous area based on the second target object; and sending first prompt information to a target terminal to prompt that the target scene has the dangerous area. title: Lightweight malicious traffic detection method and device based on width learning
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a lightweight malicious traffic detection method and device based on width learning. According to the method, the initial flow detection classification model is trained by adopting the target training data X with the linear feature data and the nonlinear feature data, so that the width of a neural network adopted during model training is wider, and a multi-layer connected neural network is not needed during model training; therefore, the calculation amount in the training process of the initial flow detection classification model is smaller, the training speed is higher, the requirement on equipment is lower, and the method is more suitable for Internet of Things equipment with limited resources. Meanwhile, the target traffic detection classification model obtained through training in the scheme is higher in malicious traffic detection speed, and the real-time requirement of malicious traffic detection can be met. And because the scheme is applied to the edge gateway equipment which is closer to each piece of Internet of Things equipment for executing the service in the Internet of Things, the Internet of Things equipment can be notified to block the malicious traffic more timely.

title: Nationwide highway transportation capacity distribution prediction method based on space-time diagram convolutional network
abstract: The invention discloses a national highway transportation capacity distribution prediction method based on a space-time diagram convolutional network. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical highway transportation capacity data of all cities in the whole country and performing preprocessing; performing singular spectrum decomposition on the historical data of the road transport capacity, and extracting tendency, volatility and noise signals of time series data of the road transport capacity; determining a causal matrix of the highway transport capacity among the cities by calculating the transfer entropy; constructing an adjacent matrix by using a causal matrix, and performing learning prediction on trend data and fluctuation data of the road transport capacity by using a space-time diagram convolutional network; and finally, fusing the trend prediction value and the volatility prediction value to obtain a prediction value of the highway transport capacity of each city. According to the method, trend characteristics of highway transport capacity changes are fully utilized, spatial causal characteristics of transport capacity distribution are considered, the method has good prediction capability for highway transport capacity distribution of cities in China, and an effective and stable solution is provided for time sequence prediction of traffic transport capacity distribution in China.

title: Multi-vehicle task allocation and path optimization simulation platform and implementation method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-vehicle task allocation and path optimization simulation platform, and the platform comprises a business application layer which comprises an order input system and a path planning simulation system; the technical layer comprises an algorithm matching module; the data layer comprises a system configuration database, and various system built-in algorithms are stored in the system configuration database; the order input system can interact with an operator, the algorithm matching module can select an optimal algorithm of a vehicle path problem matched with the algorithm matching module from built-in algorithms of the system according to data information input by the operator, and the path planning simulation system can demonstrate the logistics scheme distribution process in real time according to the optimal algorithm. The invention further discloses an implementation method of the simulation platform. Through the simulation platform, the system can match the optimal algorithm of the corresponding problem according to the problem, and the logistics scheme distribution process of the vehicle is demonstrated in real time, so that the time complexity of the algorithm is remarkably reduced, and a visual verification platform can be provided for various algorithms with the shortest distance as the optimization target.

title: Breast focus training method and device and computer readable medium
abstract: The invention discloses a training method and device for a breast focus and a computer readable medium, and the method comprises the steps: firstly taking breast data with a malignant label and breast data with a benign label as training samples, and obtaining training sample data; wherein the mammary gland data at least comprises a mammary gland ultrasonic image and an influence factor quantized value of a corresponding case; secondly, for any training sample in the training sample data, performing image feature extraction on the breast ultrasound image in the training sample to obtain breast image features; carrying out fusion processing on the influence factor quantized values in the training samples and the mammary gland image features to obtain focus fusion features; and finally, carrying out supervised classification learning on the focus fusion features to generate a focus classification model. abstract: The invention discloses a face image clustering method, system and device and a computer readable medium, and the method comprises the steps: firstly carrying out the preliminary clustering of a preset number of face images, obtaining N clustered image sets and M non-clustered isolated images, then determining the representative element of each image set, and carrying out the clustering of the N clustered image sets and M non-clustered isolated images; the representative elements are elements representing image features of all the face images in the image set, determining a first similarity between each representative element and other representative elements, taking the first similarity with the maximum value as a maximum threshold value, and for any isolated image, determining a second similarity between each representative element and other representative elements; and determining a second similarity between the image feature of the isolated image and the image feature of each representative element, and if the second similarity is greater than the maximum threshold, adding the isolated image into the image set corresponding to the representative element with the maximum second similarity. title: Human hand trajectory prediction and intention recognition method based on multi-feature fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a human hand trajectory prediction and intention recognition method based on multi-feature fusion. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring face and shoulder key point data of a person; acquiring palm track data; inputting the face and shoulder key point data of the person into a support vector machine to obtain face orientation modal information; inputting the palm trajectory data sequence into an SG filter, and eliminating trajectory data fluctuation to obtain smooth trajectory data; carrying out parallel fusion on the two types of modal information to obtain multi-modal fusion information; and inputting into the LSTM network, and outputting a predicted trajectory of the palm. According to the method, the face orientation features are extracted by using part of the face key points, the face orientation features are further fused with the human arm trajectory data, the moving trajectory of the human arm in the space and the final arrival position of the human arm are predicted, and the moving trajectory is efficiently and accurately predicted.

title: Super-long-distance optical transmission method and system based on population evolution iteration
abstract: The invention relates to an ultra-long-distance optical transmission method and system based on population evolution iteration, and the method comprises the following steps: 1, converting an input bit signal into parallel data with the width of N subcarriers through serial-to-parallel conversion, and mapping every 4 bits of data into a QAM signal through 16 QAM coding; 2, performing population evolution iteration to generate a QAM (Quadrature Amplitude Modulation) signal with the length of N, and performing encryption operation on data on different subcarriers; and step 3, the newly generated QAM signal is subjected to inverse Fourier transform to form a time domain signal, and the time domain signal is processed by companding operation to serve as an electric signal finally modulated to the optical transmitter. According to the method, a great key space can be provided, the difficulty of exhaustive attacks is improved, and the security of the system is ensured. The non-linear companding function is introduced into the CO-OFDM physical layer for encryption, so that the PAPR in the encryption transmission process can be reduced.

abstract: The invention discloses an equipment priority-based multi-task processing method in a photovoltaic 5G base station system, which comprises the following steps of: after acquiring state information of terminal layer equipment, forming a data packet sending task with priority information of the terminal layer equipment; the task received by the edge layer equipment is temporarily stored in an edge buffer area, whether state information data is abnormal or not is judged according to the priority sequence of the terminal layer equipment, if the occurrence frequency of abnormal data of the same type in a period of time is higher than a set threshold value, the task is uploaded to the cloud layer equipment to be processed, otherwise, the task enters the edge layer equipment to be processed; the task is cleared in an edge buffer area; a software defined network (SDN) controller allocates server resources of edge layer equipment according to priority information in the data packet to process the task to be processed; a processing result is fed back to the terminal layer equipment; and repeating the steps until the task in the edge buffer area is emptied. abstract: The invention provides an ion trap quantum gate fidelity optimization method and device, electronic equipment, a computer readable storage medium and a computer program product, and relates to the field of quantum computers, in particular to the technical field of ion traps. title: SDAE-DNN-based low signal-to-noise ratio direction of arrival estimation method
abstract: The invention provides a low signal to noise ratio direction of arrival estimation method based on SDAE-DNN. The SDAE-DNN comprises two neural networks, the SDAE is used for realizing signal noise reduction, and the DNN is used for realizing DOA estimation. Firstly, a sparse noise reduction auto-encoder SDAE is used to analyze a lossy signal so as to recover the lossy signal to an original signal, after the encoding weight of the SDAE is obtained, a deep neural network DNN is endowed with an initial weight based on a transfer learning strategy, encoding of the DNN from the lossy signal to the original signal is realized, and the anti-noise capability of the DNN is improved. title: Water pollution early warning method, system and equipment based on deep learning and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a water pollution early warning method, system and device based on deep learning and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: setting a plurality of monitoring points in a river channel, and obtaining the water quality data information of each monitoring point; extracting a plurality of pollution characteristic indexes from the water quality data information; constructing an RNN feature fusion model, and inputting the pollution feature indexes into the RNN feature fusion model to generate fusion feature indexes; constructing a water quality monitoring convolutional neural network model, and training the convolutional neural network model; converting the fusion feature index into a fusion feature vector, inputting the fusion feature vector into the trained water quality monitoring convolutional neural network model, and outputting a probability value corresponding to the fusion feature vector; comparing a difference value between the binary probability value and a preset threshold value to judge whether the water quality of the corresponding monitoring point is polluted or not; and the monitoring point module which monitors the water quality pollution carries out early warning. The water pollution monitoring efficiency can be effectively improved, and early warning can be performed in time.

abstract: The invention relates to a near-field vehicle plugging behavior prediction method based on image input, and the method comprises the steps: (1) collecting image sequence information based on a forward panoramic image in a real structured road scene, and marking the position and behavior information of a vehicle target in an image sequence through a manual method; (2) constructing a near-field vehicle detection and tracking model suitable for near-field vehicle detection and tracking in the structured road; (3) constructing a lane line detection network suitable for lane line detection in a structured road and a corresponding loss function; and (4) based on the vehicle ID obtained by the near-field vehicle detection and tracking model established in the step (2) and the bounding box position data of the corresponding target, and the lane line obtained by the lane line detection network established in the step (3), obtaining the relative position deviation of the target and the lane line, and obtaining the prediction result of the jam behavior of the near-field vehicle according to the formulation of a prior rule. title: Client-driven cloud network access system and method
abstract: Embodiments of systems and methods for client-driven cloud network access systems and methods are described. In an illustrative non-limiting embodiment, an IHS may include computer executable instructions to receive a request from an application to perform an operation provided by a cloud service, and generate an aggregated data packet, the aggregated data packet includes the request, a requested performance level to be provided by the service, and application telemetry data associated with a measured performance level of the application. The aggregated data packet is then transmitted to a plurality of servers each configured to provide the cloud service. Each of the servers generates a response to the aggregated data packet and sends the response, the response including an announced performance level at which the server can provide the cloud service. The IHS may then select one of the servers according to the declared performance level and communicate with the selected server to provide the requested operation.

title: Traffic scene semantic segmentation method based on boundary-guided context aggregation
abstract: The invention discloses a traffic scene semantic segmentation method based on boundary-guided context aggregation. According to the implementation scheme, the traffic scene semantic segmentation method comprises the steps of 1) obtaining a data set and a segmentation label; 2) data processing; 3) constructing a segmentation model; 4) constructing a loss function; 5) training a segmentation model; and 6) segmenting the traffic scene image. According to the traffic scene segmentation model with the boundary refining module, high-level semantic boundary information is reserved while low-level contour texture information is removed, the boundary of an object can be effectively detected, context information is aggregated along the boundary of the object, the consistency of pixels of the same kind is enhanced, and the segmentation efficiency is improved. title: Method for creating store on online retail platform
abstract: A method for creating a virtual store on an online retail platform is disclosed that automatically identifies the type of file being uploaded by a merchant from any media file, such as images and videos, 3D scan files, and computer-aided design (CAD) files. The method then registers certain parameters of the uploaded store and finds a set of stores of the plurality of stored files that have parameters sufficiently close to the uploaded store. The method then generates a dataset of information from a set of stores that may be related to the uploaded store, and displays it to the merchant. This allows merchants to select information from this dataset that they wish to apply to the uploaded stores, thereby saving time and workload in creating virtual stores.

abstract: The invention discloses a local strain monitoring and alarming system of an airborne radome based on a fiber bragg grating, belongs to the technical field of local health nondestructive testing of radomes, and aims to solve the problems that damage is not found in time in local health detection of an existing radome, the detection operation process is complex, meanwhile, the internal structure of the radome is easily damaged, and the detection cost is low. title: Image anomaly detection method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of image processing, and relates to an image anomaly detection method and device, a storage medium and electronic equipment. title: Breast feature extraction and detection model training method and device
abstract: The invention relates to a breast feature extraction and detection model training method and device. The method comprises the following steps: dividing an original mammary gland image into a plurality of areas; determining at least one to-be-replaced area and a target area from the plurality of areas, and replacing an image of the to-be-replaced area with an image of the target area to obtain a plurality of replaced images; wherein the region attributes of the target region and the region to be replaced are different, and the region attributes are determined by the proportion of the interested image contained in the region; performing feature extraction on the replacement image by using an encoder model, and performing image restoration according to a feature extraction result by using a decoder model to obtain a restored image; determining a first difference according to the difference between the restored image and the original mammary gland image; adjusting the initial feature model by taking reduction of the first difference as a target; and obtaining a mammary gland feature extraction model based on the encoder model in the initial feature model after training. The method can provide a large number of samples for training, ensure the training precision and save the training time.

title: Multi-label remote sensing image classification method with adaptive semantic information
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-label remote sensing image classification method with self-adaptive semantic information aiming at a multi-label aerial image classification problem, and the method consists of three modules, namely a label correlation extractor, an image feature extractor and a multi-label classifier. The method comprises the following steps: 1) a label correlation extractor learns dependency features of different labels from a label set; the method comprises the following steps: modeling label correlation based on a volume and a neural network, and outputting semantic label features; 2) an image feature extractor constructs an SPC layer to learn information from the aerial image and output image features; and 3) the multi-label classifier takes the semantic label features and the visual image features as inputs, and integrates the two representations to generate a plurality of predictions for a given image. Experimental verification shows that due to fine-grained learning of image features and extraction of label correlation, the adaptive semantic information can be explored to assist fine-grained perception of the images, and the method is used for the classification problem of the multi-label aerial images.

title: Method and device for anomaly detection and parameter filling of time series data
abstract: The invention relates to a method and a device for anomaly detection and deletion filling of time series data. The method for training the model for anomaly detection and missing filling of time series data comprises the steps that the time series data of a user are acquired, and the time series data comprise abnormal parameters and missing parameters; the time sequence data is preprocessed to obtain preprocessed time sequence data, a first mark matrix, a second mark matrix and an area label, the first mark matrix is configured to mark the positions of abnormal parameters and missing parameters in the time sequence data, and the second mark matrix is configured to mark the positions of the missing parameters in the time sequence data; the second mark matrix is configured to mark the positions of abnormal parameters and missing parameters in the preprocessed time series data, and the area label is configured to mark an area where a user is located; and training the model based on the preprocessed time sequence data, the first tag matrix, the second tag matrix and the region tag.

title: Micro-seismic multi-time-window intelligent P-wave arrival time pickup method based on deep learning
abstract: A micro-seismic multi-time window intelligent P-wave arrival time pickup method based on deep learning comprises the following steps: 1) collecting a data set for model training and testing, and dividing a micro-seismic waveform into different types of micro-time windows according to arrival time labels; 2) building a P wave arrival time pickup deep learning model of the CGAS, and training the model; 3) testing and evaluating the model by using a test set; 4) performing P wave arrival time pickup on the waveform by using a CGAS model; 5) when the plurality of stations monitor a micro-seismic event, performing multi-time-window P-wave arrival time pickup on the seismic waveform data monitored by the plurality of stations by using the CGAS model; and 6) recording the microseismic event and the arrival time information of each station. By means of the method, the problems that in the prior art, picking precision is low, and micro-seismic events are missed or falsely detected are solved, and the micro-seismic multi-time-window intelligent P-wave arrival time picking method with high robustness and high precision is provided.

title: Priori driving bidirectional compensation panoramic image registration method for virtual reality
abstract: The invention discloses a virtual reality-oriented panoramic image registration method for priori-driven bidirectional compensation. The method comprises the following steps of: performing moving target extraction on two images to be registered, performing self-adaptive deformation pixel correction on an image foreground set from which a moving target is extracted, extracting image features, and completing moving target matching; detecting the motion direction and speed of the successfully matched motion target, calculating the speed of the motion target according to the difference value of the physical time of the two cameras, and compensating the respective motion target; and carrying out image registration on the image with failed target extraction, the image with failed target matching and the image subjected to bidirectional compensation. According to the invention, the technical problems of low image registration efficiency, poor effect and the like during foreground movement caused by images due to asynchronous camera clocks in the existing VR monitoring scene can be solved.

title: Dual-channel satellite attitude estimation network based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a dual-channel satellite attitude estimation network based on deep learning. The network process comprises the steps of constructing a satellite attitude estimation data set and dividing the satellite attitude estimation data set, preprocessing data, extracting image features by a ResNet model, learning spatial position information by using an improved Vision Transformer model, learning rotation information by using a Hurglass network, respectively outputting position information and attitude information of a satellite, calculating an output value and a label distance, and outputting the output value and the label distance. And carrying out back propagation on the model to carry out iterative training to obtain an optimal model, and evaluating the model by using a test set. A self-attention mechanism of a core module of the Vision Transform model is improved, so that the position of a satellite in an image can be focused, and key points of a satellite contour can be effectively deduced through repeated up-sampling and down-sampling processing means of Hurglass network learning. According to the method, the spatial position information and the attitude information of the satellite are respectively learned by using the two-channel network, so that the mutual influence between the two kinds of information is effectively avoided, the satellite attitude estimation accuracy is improved, and a new intelligent means is provided for spatial non-cooperative target detection.

title: Airport scene track prediction method based on multi-head attention mechanism
abstract: The invention provides an airport scene track prediction method based on a multi-head attention mechanism, and relates to the field of aircraft air traffic management. According to the method, a multivariable time sequence self-attention mechanism model of a self-attention mechanism and a feedforward neural network framework structure is adopted, aircraft taxiing track characteristics are extracted through the self-attention mechanism, a rule is learned, and a track in a period of time in the future is predicted. Meanwhile, the method utilizes a multi-head attention mechanism to carry out parallel operation, so that the operation efficiency is improved. According to the method, the future trajectory of the aircrafts during taxiing is predicted, the flight safety between the aircrafts during taxiing in an airport scene is ensured, and a reference is provided for an aviation taxiing trajectory prediction algorithm.

title: Novel sampling strategy for plant core germplasm
abstract: The invention relates to a novel sampling strategy for plant core germplasm by using molecular markers as means, and belongs to the field of life science. Comprising the following steps: (1) determining types of specific polymorphic sites of all germplasm resources; (2) finding out individuals containing specific polymorphic sites and calculating the frequency of the polymorphic sites; (3) determining candidates according to the number of core germplasm; and (4) removing redundant individuals according to the classification of candidates in group structure analysis software and a genetic relationship clustering graph. And obtaining a core germplasm sample for a sampling strategy according to a germplasm resource population genetic structure classification result, a genetic relationship clustering result, a specific polymorphic site and a proportion of the specific polymorphic site. The new sampling strategy of the plant core germplasm with the molecular marker as the means is more scientific than a random sampling method mostly used at home and abroad at present, the genetic diversity of germplasm resources can be stored to the maximum extent, redundancy is the lowest, and the method is scientific, simple and rapid in design and suitable for large-scale popularization and application. The method is suitable for the preservation of various plant core germplasm resources, and also has important reference value for the preservation of core germplasm resources of other species.

title: Node management method and system for batch processing of data tasks
abstract: The invention provides a node management method and system for batch processing of data tasks, which is specifically applied to the field of data processing, and comprises a master control node and a plurality of slave nodes, obtaining a to-be-processed data file; inputting the to-be-processed data file into the BP neural network model for classification; dividing a to-be-processed data file into multi-line data files, packaging the multi-line data files into multi-line tasks, and forming a plurality of batch task lists in a task buffer queue of the master control node; matching the target parameter with the to-be-processed parameter to obtain a matching degree; acquiring the priority of any batch of task list; marking any batch of task list according to the priority and the matching degree; sequentially distributing the plurality of batch task lists to each slave node; each slave node stores the received tasks of the batch task list to a task buffer queue of the slave node; and obtaining and processing tasks of any batch of task lists distributed to the slave nodes. Through the method, the processing speed is increased, and resource consumption is reduced.

abstract: The invention provides a distributed photovoltaic operation and maintenance scheduling system based on a low-voltage acquisition device, which comprises an auxiliary operation and maintenance scheduling platform arranged in a photovoltaic power station and a main operation and maintenance scheduling platform arranged in an operation and maintenance scheduling center, and is characterized in that the auxiliary operation and maintenance scheduling platform comprises a photovoltaic equipment module, a data acquisition module and a side end control module; the data acquisition module and the side end control module comprise low-voltage acquisition devices, the data acquisition module comprises an intelligent instrumented electric energy meter, the side end control module comprises an electricity utilization information acquisition device, and the main operation and maintenance scheduling platform comprises an intelligent scheduling module, a function service module and a main control module. title: Film and television animation evaluation method based on spatial layout and deep learning
abstract: The invention provides a movie and television animation evaluation method based on spatial layout and deep learning in the technical field of computers, and the method comprises the steps: S10, obtaining an animation image, extracting spatial features, and constructing an undirected fully connected graph based on the spatial features; step S20, constructing a content similarity network, and reasoning the undirected fully connected graph through graph convolution; s30, mapping spatial nodes in the content similarity network to a potential space to construct a spatial relationship fully connected graph; step S40, constructing a spatial relationship network, reasoning the spatial relationship fully-connected graph through graph convolution to obtain potential features, and mapping the potential features back to an original space; s50, calculating a composition score based on the output of the spatial relationship network and the content similarity network; step S60, extracting color features of the animation image and inputting the color features into a color evaluation model to obtain a color score; and S70, calculating a comprehensive score based on the composition score and the color score. The method has the advantage that the interpretability of movie and television animation evaluation is greatly improved.

abstract: The invention discloses a traffic jam detection method based on deep learning, a medium and equipment, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a pavement image, and inputting the pavement image into a pre-trained traffic jam integrated model which comprises a first sub-model, a second sub-model and a third sub-model; the first sub-model, the second sub-model and the third sub-model respectively output corresponding results according to the road surface image; fusing results output by the first sub-model, the second sub-model and the third sub-model according to a voting method, and taking a fusion result as a traffic jam detection result corresponding to the road surface image; the traffic jam can be effectively judged, the traffic jam judgment accuracy is improved, and meanwhile manpower and material resources consumed by traffic jam judgment are reduced.

title: Satellite-ground network caching method based on CCN
abstract: The invention discloses a satellite-ground network caching method based on a CCN, and the method comprises the following steps: carrying out the initial division of a caching community through employing a Louvain algorithm based on a ground CCN network node; obtaining the similarity between the nodes in the network and the current cache community, and updating the current cache community based on the similarity between the nodes in the network and the current cache community; constructing a three-layer topology cache model of a satellite-CCN node-control center; content distribution is determined on the three-layer topology cache model, and a corresponding income model is constructed; and solving by adopting a genetic algorithm to obtain a satellite-ground network caching scheme based on the CCN. According to the CCN-based cache community division method provided by the invention, the ground CCN is divided into small cache communities with similar content demand characteristics, and the cache homogeneity among the ground nodes of the CCN is reduced and the storage space of the ground nodes is saved through display association among the nodes.

title: Method for acquiring urban development level based on neural network and noctilucent remote sensing technology
abstract: The invention discloses a method for acquiring a city development level based on a neural network and a noctilucent remote sensing technology, and the method comprises the steps: comprehensively considering multiple factors and indexes of city development except geographic factors, and collecting 12 types of data, such as network indexes, the distance with a super city, and the score of a Forbs commercial ranking list. title: Tumor driver gene differential expression detection algorithm based on pathological image features
abstract: The invention discloses an algorithm for detecting tumor driver gene differential expression based on pathological image features. The algorithm comprises the following steps: 1) segmenting and filtering a pathological image: selecting tissue slices in a cancer genome atlas TCGA data set; detecting whether tissue cells exist in the selected area by using an Ostu algorithm so as to distinguish a background area; then, the tissue slice slide is segmented into a plurality of patches which can be calculated by the model; 2) pre-training based on comparative learning: using ResNet50 as a block encoder, performing pre-training under a comparative learning framework, and aggregating patch-level features after calculation to obtain slide-level features; and 3) prediction: predicting a prediction task by using a full connection layer, and predicting the differential expression level of the tumor driver gene through a mean square error loss function.

title: Tire pattern classification method and device based on attention mechanism and transfer learning
abstract: The invention discloses a tire pattern classification method based on an attention mechanism and transfer learning, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the processing of an original tire image through histogram equalization and data enhancement, obtaining a training sample set, building a training model which comprises a ResNet 50 network, a channel space attention mechanism, a pooling layer and a full connection layer, and training through a cross entropy loss function of the category label to obtain a tire pattern classification model. The invention further provides a method for compressing the tire pattern classification model, the tire pattern classification model is used as a teacher network for training to obtain a student network through a knowledge distillation method, and the compressed tire pattern classification model is trained through a cross entropy loss function. title: Intelligent image cutting method based on lightweight portrait detection
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent image cutting method based on lightweight portrait detection. The method comprises the following steps: S1, constructing a lightweight portrait detection network based on an anchor-free first-stage detection idea; s2, carrying out portrait detection on an input image according to the constructed lightweight portrait detection network, and obtaining position information of a portrait; and S3, according to the position information of the portrait, constraining the overall composition of the image by adopting a photographic composition principle, meanwhile, determining boundary information of the portrait, retaining complete information of a key figure, and realizing rapid cutting of the portrait picture without laying anchors. According to the automatic cutting algorithm designed according to the characteristics of the portrait picture, the difference between the portrait picture and the scenery picture is considered, and portrait detection and the photographic principle are combined, so that the portrait picture can be quickly and effectively processed, and the complete information of the key portrait can be reserved.

abstract: The invention discloses a disease prediction system based on a heterogeneous information network, and the system comprises an obtaining module which is configured to obtain a current electronic medical record of a to-be-predicted patient; the disease prediction module is configured to input the current electronic medical record of the patient to be predicted into the trained disease prediction model and output a disease prediction result; wherein the working principle of the disease prediction model is as follows: performing data expansion on the current electronic medical record of a patient to be predicted, and constructing an electronic medical record heterogeneous graph based on the expanded data; on the heterogeneous graph of the electronic medical record, embedded representation of the electronic medical record is carried out based on learning representation of the meta-path, and aggregation of neighbor nodes of the meta-path is carried out through an attention mechanism; and finally, disease prediction of the to-be-predicted patient is realized. abstract: The invention discloses a ventricular premature beat recognition method based on improved ShuffleNetV2, and provides a ventricular premature beat recognition model based on an improved ShuffleNetV2 model. title: Rolling bearing fault type identification method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a rolling bearing fault type identification method based on deep reinforcement learning. The method comprises the following steps: 1, acquiring one-dimensional time sequence fault data of a rolling bearing; 2, preprocessing fault data by a continuous wavelet transform algorithm; 3, manually marking and carrying out normalized position coding; 4, establishing a dual-branch heterogeneous network and a reinforcement learning network based on the improved Transform-LSTM (Long Short Term Memory); 5, training the network to obtain a reinforcement learning optimal training model; and 6, inputting the test set to the optimal training model to obtain an optimal fault diagnosis classification recognition effect. Through the reinforcement learning method, the accuracy of rolling bearing fault classification and recognition is improved, and meanwhile, the model has better anti-noise performance.

abstract: Neural network-based systems, methods, and apparatus may be used to remove motion artifacts from magnetic resonance (MR) images. title: Unsupervised social media abstracting method based on de-noised graph auto-encoder
abstract: The invention discloses an unsupervised social media abstracting method based on a de-noised graph auto-encoder, which comprises the following steps: constructing a post-level social relation network according to a sociology theory, and obtaining a content code of a post by using a pre-trained BERT model as an initial content representation of the post; defining two noise relation types and setting corresponding noise functions, and constructing a pseudo social relation network with a noise relation; taking the sampled pseudo social relation network instance and the initial content representation of the post as the input of a residual image attention network encoder at the same time, and encoding the post by the residual image attention network encoder according to the initial content representation of the post and the social relation to obtain the vector representation of the post; according to the method, a residual image attention network encoder is constructed, a decoder is constructed, the residual image attention network encoder and the decoder jointly form a de-noising image auto-encoder structure, the de-noising image auto-encoder can learn and remove a noise relation in a post-level social relation network, and finally an accurate post representation is obtained; and selecting a final abstract by adopting an abstract extractor based on sparse reconstruction.

title: Method and device for constructing Tibetan phrase structure recognition model based on deep learning
abstract: The invention relates to a deep learning-based Tibetan phrase structure recognition model construction method and device, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a plurality of Tibetan sentences from an original corpus by taking a single drooping character or a double drooping character as a mark, and extracting a part of the plurality of Tibetan sentences as a processing text; phrase structure division and labeling are conducted on the processed text, the labeled processed text is analyzed, and a phrase structure tree is formed; and taking the phrase structure in the phrase structure tree as a training text, training a nonlinear neural network language model until the model converges, and obtaining a Tibetan phrase structure recognition model. According to the model established according to the tree bank, the accuracy of automatic syntactic analysis and machine translation is improved, and the pace of understanding a natural language by a machine is promoted. The construction of the Tibetan phrase structure tree library not only can quickly and effectively process a large amount of related data, but also can comprehensively improve the recognition performance.

title: Reconfigurable nonvolatile integrated three-dimensional optical diffraction neural network chip
abstract: The invention discloses a reconfigurable non-volatile integrated three-dimensional optical diffraction neural network chip, and belongs to the technical field of optical computing, the reconfigurable non-volatile integrated three-dimensional optical diffraction neural network chip comprises an optical diffraction structure and a feedback control structure, and each plane diffraction unit in the optical diffraction structure comprises an electric control phase change array. The electric control phase change array is sequentially provided with a first transparent electrode, a nonvolatile phase change material and a second transparent electrode; and the loading voltage between the first transparent electrode and the second transparent electrode is controlled to adjust the optical state of the nonvolatile phase change material, so that each plane diffraction unit performs reconfigurable modulation on the input light to obtain modulated light. And the feedback control structure adjusts the loading voltage according to the light intensity space distribution information of the modulated light, and further adjusts the optical state of the nonvolatile phase change material, so that the optical diffraction structure can identify the current input signal. The problems that an existing integrated optical neural network matrix is too small in scale and high in static power consumption can be solved.

title: Power station fan fault early warning method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention provides a power station fan fault early warning method based on deep learning, and the method employs a deviation degree function to measure the difference between an actual measurement value and a model estimation value, constructs a fan state health index sequence according to the frequency distribution of the deviation degree, quantitatively represents the evolution process of a fan fault, and achieves the early fault detection of a fan. The power station fan formation corresponding method based on the LSTM neural network and the Bayesian optimization is characterized in that the method is composed of an offline modeling part and an online monitoring part; according to the method, an LSTM-BO (Bayesian optimized long-short term neural network) model is utilized to establish a fan normal operation state prediction model, and normal data and fault data are respectively taken to compare and verify the prediction precision of the model; and then predicting frequency distribution of the deviation degree according to the model, constructing a health index in combination with a sliding time window technology, representing a real-time operation state of the fan, and identifying normal, fault and serious fault states of the fan by determining a reasonable health index threshold.

title: CNN-BiGRU-based ultra-short-term power load prediction method
abstract: The invention provides an ultra-short-term power load prediction method based on CNN-BiGRU. The ultra-short-term power load prediction method based on CNN-BiGRU comprises the following steps: step S01, preprocessing sample data; s02, converting the load influence factors and the historical load data into a matrix form; step S03, inputting the extracted data features into a BiGRU network to learn the data distribution and change rule of the BiGRU network; step S04, training a neural network; a step; and S05, prediction is carried out through the trained CNN-BiGRU network. According to the short-term load prediction method based on the CNN and the BiGRU, the influence of load influence factors in the historical period and the future period on the current prediction load is fully considered, meanwhile, feature extraction is carried out on the power load influence factors such as temperature, humidity and air pressure through the convolutional neural network, the feature extraction and the historical load are used as network input data together, and the current prediction load is predicted. And the prediction precision is improved.

title: Marine pollution area identification method and system based on image identification
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of marine pollution identification, and particularly discloses a marine pollution area identification method and system based on image identification, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the space coordinates of an unmanned plane end in real time, and generating an operation flow table according to the space coordinates; determining a risk time period in the operation flow table, and reading a sea image of the risk time period; carrying out fine identification on the ocean image, and determining a pollution type; the unmanned aerial vehicle terminal performs coarse identification on the acquired ocean images and adjusts the number of acquired images; the recognition quality of the fine recognition is greater than that of the coarse recognition. According to the invention, some rough recognition technologies with extremely low energy consumption ratio are integrated at the unmanned aerial vehicle end, the image acquisition number of the unmanned aerial vehicle end is adjusted according to the rough recognition result, the motion characteristics of the unmanned aerial vehicle end are further changed, the processing end only needs to analyze the motion characteristics of the unmanned aerial vehicle end, and the area where pollution possibly exists can be easily positioned. And the utilization rate of identification resources is greatly improved.

title: Ship navigation accident cause analysis method based on rooting theory and affair atlas
abstract: A ship navigation accident cause analysis method based on a rooting theory and a case atlas comprises the steps that firstly, various ship navigation accident reports are obtained, and a ship navigation accident field ontology core concept is constructed through a self-defined core concept based on the rooting theory; then, event entities are classified, labeled and subjected to event extraction according to the constructed ontology core concept; based on an event extraction result, labeling and extracting an event relationship; importing the obtained results of ship navigation accident event extraction and event relation extraction into a Neo4j database to complete construction of a ship navigation accident event atlas; and performing ship navigation accident cause analysis based on the constructed ship navigation accident affair map. According to the invention, based on a root-taking theory and in combination with ship navigation accident field characteristics, ship navigation accident cause factors are extracted, a ship navigation accident cause model is constructed, each cause of a ship navigation accident is systematically analyzed, and the method has theoretical and practical significance for ship navigation safety management.

title: Cooling and heating equipment data model
abstract: The invention discloses a heating, cooling and ventilation equipment data model, which comprises the following steps of inputting basic information of a refrigeration house, collecting and storing energy consumption data of the refrigeration house, operation parameters of refrigeration equipment and sensor data into a database, and performing data coding, data cleaning and data processing according to characteristics and relationships of various data so as to facilitate subsequent use. And comprehensive analysis and visualization processing are carried out on the data, operation parameters of the refrigeration system are imported into the mathematical model, abnormity diagnosis is carried out, and a work order is generated. title: Method for predicting activity of blast furnace hearth based on BP network model
abstract: The invention discloses a method for predicting the activity of a blast furnace hearth based on a BP network model, and the method comprises the steps: 1, quantifying the activity of the hearth as an output parameter, determining an input parameter, and collecting historical data of a blast furnace stable operation database to construct a data set; 2, preprocessing the input parameters; 3, analyzing the correlation between each parameter and the blast furnace air volume in different time periods by adopting Pearson correlation, and selecting the lag time corresponding to the maximum correlation with the blast furnace standard state blast volume as the lag time of the current parameter participating in the operation; 4, normalizing the activity data of the blast furnace hearth by using a min-max method; 5, establishing a BP network initial model, and training to obtain a hearth activity prediction model; and 6, collecting blast furnace operation data, inputting the collected input parameters into the hearth activity prediction model, and obtaining the output of the hearth activity prediction model as the prediction value of the hearth activity. By means of the method, a good hearth activity prediction effect can be achieved.

title: Method and device for monitoring operating characteristics of industrial gas plant complex
abstract: A method of monitoring an operating characteristic of an industrial gas plant complex comprising a plurality of industrial gas plants is provided. The method is executed by at least one hardware processor and includes: assigning a machine learning model to each of the industrial gas plants forming the industrial gas plant complex; based on the received historical time related operation characteristic data of the corresponding industrial gas equipment, training a corresponding machine learning model for each industrial gas equipment; executing a trained machine learning model on each industrial gas plant to predict an operating characteristic of each respective industrial gas plant over a predetermined future period of time; and comparing the predicted operating characteristic data for each respective industrial gas plant over a predetermined future period of time with the measured operating characteristic data over the respective period of time to identify a deviation in industrial gas plant performance.

title: Unfavorable geological condition identification and prediction method based on TBM operation data
abstract: The invention discloses an unfavorable geological condition identification and prediction method based on TBM operation data, and the method is characterized in that the method comprises the following steps: 1, obtaining TBM operation data and geological exploration data; 2, preprocessing the TBM operation data and geological exploration data to obtain preprocessed data; 3, characteristic variable design is carried out based on the preprocessed data, and variables related to a target are screened out; step 4, based on variables related to the target, establishing an unfavorable geological condition identification model based on genetic programming, and obtaining a division function H (X) of good geology and unfavorable geology; and 5, judging the geological condition of the current position of the TBM according to the H (X). According to the method, a large amount of operation data can be efficiently processed, the geological conditions of the current position of the TBM are identified on line, the problems of high uncertainty, high delay, high cost and the like of a traditional identification and detection method are solved, and a guarantee is added to safe construction of the TBM.

title: Micro-expression feature extraction algorithm based on random cuboid sampling
abstract: The invention discloses a micro-expression feature extraction algorithm based on random cuboid sampling, and aims to solve the problems that a whole micro-expression video is used, micro-expression features are easy to lose in a relatively fixed space-time region, an identification result is easy to be influenced by noise and the like. The micro-expression feature extraction algorithm comprises the following steps: aligning and normalizing a face of each frame of image in the video; using a space block generation module to detect feature points of the clipped face and using a block size factor to generate a random block set according to the feature points, and capturing a local area of the micro-expression; a time domain fragment generation module is used to generate a unit random interval through a time domain length factor, and the unit random interval is mapped to micro-expression fragments of different frame numbers; and combining the space block set and the time domain fragments into a plurality of random cuboids, extracting spatial-temporal features of the micro-expressions on the generated random cuboids, and finally performing micro-expression recognition. According to the invention, the recognition rate of micro-expressions is improved; meanwhile, the key area of the micro-expression in the time dimension is well found.

title: Fusion sequence and network embedded virus host protein-protein interaction prediction method
abstract: The invention discloses a fusion sequence and network embedded virus host protein-protein interaction prediction method. The method comprises the following steps: 1, preprocessing data; 2, extracting virus and host protein sequence characteristics by using a Doc2vec method, and vectorizing the protein sequence; 3, constructing a host protein-protein interaction network and a virus protein sequence similarity network; 4, extracting the features of the two networks by using a Node2vec algorithm, vectorizing the networks, and performing quantitative product on the vectorized networks and sequence features; and step 5, according to the obtained matrix fusing the two features, constructing a long-short-term memory network for training, and using the trained model for prediction. According to the method, the network characteristics of protein-protein interaction are considered, the Node2vec model is used for modeling the network characteristics of the protein-protein interaction, the network characteristics and the sequence characteristics are fused, and the accuracy of virus host protein-protein interaction prediction is better improved.

title: Log anomaly detection method based on adversarial transfer learning
abstract: The invention discloses a log anomaly detection method based on adversarial transfer learning. The method comprises the steps of 1, obtaining source domain log data, and performing data cleaning, noise removal and positive anomaly division on the source domain log data; 2, inputting the processed source domain log data into an anomaly detection neural network model for supervised training, and performing multiple times of training to obtain a specific structure of a source domain depth anomaly detection neural network; step 3, obtaining target domain unmarked log data, and performing data cleaning and noise removal on the target domain unmarked log data to obtain processed target domain unmarked log data; 4, inputting the processed target domain unmarked log data into the source domain depth anomaly detection neural network, and training by using an adversarial transfer learning model to obtain a target domain anomaly detection neural network; and step 5, inputting to-be-detected data into the target domain anomaly detection neural network, judging whether a detection result is greater than a given threshold, if so, judging that the data is abnormal, and if not, judging that the data is normal.

title: Power big data query method and device
abstract: The invention provides an electric power big data query method and device, and relates to the technical field of electric power data. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring database table names of all power business systems, and obtaining all database tables according to the database table names; and indexing the databases by using the database name information to obtain all databases corresponding to the database table. And configuring an analysis template at the data calling interface of each database, and analyzing all the data objects of each database through the analysis template to obtain the analyzed data value of each data object. When a user inputs a data query condition according to an actual demand, traversal query is performed on all the databases according to the data query condition by utilizing the trained data query model to obtain a query result in each database, and the data object of each database is analyzed through the analysis template, so that the consistency of data formats is ensured, and the user experience is improved. title: Channel scene classification method and system based on deep learning, and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a channel scene classification method and system based on deep learning and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining channel data, the channel data comprising an I-path signal, a Q-path signal and a pilot signal corresponding to a channel, and a channel impulse response obtained through estimation based on the obtained pilot signal; constructing a channel scene classification model, wherein the channel scene classification model comprises an input layer, a bidirectional long and short time memory network layer, a full connection layer, a softmax layer and an output layer; inputting the obtained channel data into a bidirectional long-short time memory network layer to obtain feature data of a channel; inputting the feature data into a full connection layer to obtain a target feature vector; inputting the target feature vector into a softmax layer to obtain probability distribution of various channel scenes; and obtaining a channel scene classification result based on the probability distribution. abstract: The invention relates to a single reservoir intelligent flood control scheduling method based on a DQN deep reinforcement learning algorithm, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a reservoir scheduling "unsupervised deep learning" model based on artificial intelligence, and building the reward feedback of DRL based on the reservoir power generation scheduling, and establishing a scheduling artificial intelligence expert for a certain reservoir based on the actually measured reservoir inflow runoff process of the reservoir. title: Speech recognition model training method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a speech recognition model training method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: respectively inputting voice data in each training sample into a teacher model and a to-be-trained voice recognition model, and obtaining Embedding data output by the teacher model and coded data output by the to-be-trained voice recognition model; performing multi-codebook quantization processing on the Embedding data to obtain codebook quantization data; calculating a loss value based on the coded data, the codebook quantized data and the text data in the training sample; and when the loss value is smaller than or equal to a preset loss value threshold value and/or the number of training times is greater than a preset number of training times, stopping training the to-be-trained speech recognition model, and obtaining a trained speech recognition model. title: Wind power plant combined control method
abstract: The invention provides a wind power plant combined control method, which can effectively reduce the influence caused by the uncertainty of a model, enhance the overall generated power of a wind power plant, reduce the fatigue of a fan and prolong the service life.
