title: Library book classification method based on content keywords and neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a library book classification method based on content keywords and a neural network, and the method comprises the steps: 1, building eight layers of models based on a bidirectional long-short-term memory neural network, comprising an embedded layer, a spatial random inactivation layer, a long-short-term memory layer, a first random inactivation layer, a full connection layer, a second random inactivation layer, a full connection layer and an activation function layer which are connected in sequence, step 2, randomly extracting one page of a book to be classified to perform text recognition, and performing data preprocessing on the recognized text to obtain vector data; and 3, inputting the vector data into the model to obtain a prediction classification result. title: Chinese overlapping event extraction system based on BiLSTM in combination with multi-head attention
abstract: The invention relates to a Chinese overlapping event extraction system based on BiLSTM in combination with multi-head attention, and belongs to the field of natural language processing. A Bert encoder is used as a text encoder to generate text representation taking a marked context as a condition, and rich text information is contained; the event type detection decoder classifies events based on a Bert text classification model; a trigger word extraction decoder extracts a trigger word according to the obtained event type through a conditional dependency relationship between event type detection and trigger word extraction; the event element extraction decoder extracts event elements by adopting multi-head attention in combination with a two-way LSTM (Long Short Term Memory) layer; the loss weight adjustment module dynamically allocates a weight for each task by using the same variance uncertainty of a plurality of targets in combination with a plurality of loss functions.

title: Intelligent music score turning device with autonomous learning ability
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent music score turning device with an autonomous learning ability. The music score loose-leaf book mainly comprises a programmable host, two sets of steering engines, a magnetic page turning arm, a music score loose-leaf book with an iron sheet, a battery unit, a voice recognition unit, two touch buttons, a switching button, a liquid crystal display screen and the like. The programmable host can intelligently recognize voice or button instructions of a player to control the steering engine to rotate, further drives the magnetic page turning arm connected with the host to turn left and right, can attract a music score loose-leaf book with an iron sheet to turn forwards and backwards, and completes front and back page turning of a paper music score. The programmable host can learn and record the manual music score turning process, the recorded music score turning data is used for learning and controlling the steering engine to rotate so as to drive the magnetic page turning arm connected with the steering engine to automatically and repeatedly turn the music score, and meanwhile playing time and music score turning state information are displayed on the liquid crystal display screen. The automatic music score turning device has the advantages that paper music scores can be intelligently and automatically turned forwards and backwards during piano practicing, the device can be used in a playing meeting where the music scores need to be turned, the music scores can be accurately turned forwards and backwards according to the requirements of a player through the automatic music score turning function of autonomous learning, and playing continuity is guaranteed.

title: Chicken breast quality detection method based on vibration signal characteristics and classification device
abstract: The invention discloses a chicken breast quality detection method based on vibration signal characteristics and a classification device. The classification device is mainly composed of a hardware module, a vibration parameter extraction module and a chicken breast quality classification module. Firstly, chicken breast is placed in the center of a vibration test bed in a hardware module, the position of the chicken breast is calibrated, and a three-axis acceleration vibration sensor is placed at the calibrated position and used for receiving vibration acceleration parameters; secondly, the industrial personal computer controls the vibration device to apply vertical vibration force to the center below the vibration test bed; and finally, transmitting the obtained vibration acceleration parameters, namely, the parameters of the axial acceleration, the radial acceleration and the vertical acceleration, to terminal equipment through a data acquisition card, and carrying out chicken breast quality classification through a BP neural network prediction model obtained by training sample data. According to the invention, stable, accurate, low-cost, high-efficiency and objective lossless grading detection of the quality grade of the chicken breast is realized, and online lossless detection of the quality grade of the chicken breast in poultry meat processing can be implemented in the future.

title: Data writing method and device
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a data writing method and device, and relates to the field of data storage. The method comprises the steps that the storage device obtains a first IO reading request and determines at least one second IO request having a continuously read association relationship with the first IO reading request according to a feature value of the first IO reading request and a data feature analysis model, and the second IO request is stored in a memory of the storage device; and further, the storage device writes the first read IO request and the at least one second IO request into a mechanical hard disk of the storage device together. In the embodiment of the invention, aiming at the storage equipment comprising various storage media (such as HDD and SSD), the storage equipment writes the first IO reading request and all the second IO requests into the HDD together, so that the storage equipment writes a plurality of IO requests with a continuous reading association relationship into the HDD, the IO with strong randomness is prevented from being written into the HDD, the data reading and writing speed of the HDD is improved, and the data reading and writing efficiency of the HDD is improved. And the data read-write speed of the storage equipment is increased.

title: Energy efficiency evaluation model construction method and device, terminal and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of energy, in particular to an energy efficiency evaluation model construction method and device, a terminal and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: firstly obtaining the classification of an evaluation target, then determining the related factors of the evaluation target according to the classification, and then obtaining a plurality of data samples according to the related factors. And then, inputting the plurality of data samples into the initial model, and training the initial model until the deviation between the output of the initial model and the energy efficiency is smaller than a threshold value. And finally, fixing parameters of the initial model as an energy efficiency evaluation model. According to the whole method, the classification of the target main body is firstly determined, and the related factors are determined based on the classification, so that parameters with low correlation do not need to be obtained, the complexity of model construction is reduced, the influence of irrelevant factors on model construction is reduced, the model is constructed and trained through existing data, the construction mode is simple, and the energy efficiency accuracy of model output is high.

title: Information transmission for managing wireless communications
abstract: Various embodiments include methods for managing information transmissions between a base station and a wireless device. A base station may apply an encoder neural network to assistance information that may assist a wireless device in communicating with the base station to generate encoded assistance information. The base station may transmit the encoded assistance information to the wireless device via a control channel or a data channel. The wireless device may update one or more behaviors of the wireless device using the encoded assistance information without decoding the encoded assistance information. The wireless device may include different neural networks configured to learn how one or more behaviors of the wireless device are updated using the encoded assistance information.

title: Neural network structure searching method and related device
abstract: The invention discloses a neural network structure searching method and a related device. In the neural network structure search method, an electronic device determines a distribution space of a first performance index and a second performance index of each model in a search space, and the first performance index and the second performance index are expressive force indexes of each model on a terminal device; and the electronic equipment initializes a population of an evolutionary algorithm in neural network structure search by using a set of models with optimal and/or suboptimal second performance indexes under the condition that the first performance index in the distribution space is not changed. According to the method, the population of the evolutionary algorithm in the neural network structure search can be initialized on the basis of the set of the models with the optimal and/or suboptimal second performance indexes under the condition that the first performance index in the distribution space is not changed, so that the search space is optimized.

title: Risk management method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to an artificial intelligence technology, and discloses a risk management method, which comprises the following steps of: analyzing a multi-dimensional risk level of user behavior data by utilizing a preset risk identification model; generating a user risk portrait according to the user basic data, the user historical consultation question and the multi-dimensional risk level; when text information input by a user is received, utilizing a preset natural language understanding model to extract entities and intentions of the text information; when the text information is not the query risk type text information, mapping the entity and the intention to a pre-constructed question and answer knowledge graph to obtain a solution corresponding to the text information; and when the text information is query risk type text information, querying a user risk portrait according to an entity and an intention to obtain a user dynamic risk result graph. In addition, the invention also relates to a block chain technology, and the user risk portrait can be stored in a node of a block chain. abstract: The invention discloses a near-infrared two-region fluorescence wide-field microscopy method based on machine learning. title: Method and related device for generating database query statement
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a method for generating a database query statement and a related device, which are applied to artificial intelligence, and the method comprises the following steps: inputting a to-be-processed natural language statement and a database mode of a to-be-queried database into an encoder for generating a model, and outputting a first encoding vector of the to-be-processed natural language statement and the database mode; after the first coding vector is input into the generation model to generate t-1 actions, a first syntax tree-action bigraph of the t-1 actions is constructed, and t is a positive integer and is larger than or equal to 2; inputting the first coding vector and the first syntax tree-action bipartite graph into a bipartite graph-based decoder for generating a model, and outputting the tth action until a complete candidate action sequence is generated; and converting the candidate action sequence into a to-be-processed database query statement corresponding to the to-be-processed natural language statement. title: Crowd evacuation congestion propagation prediction method and system based on knowledge graph
abstract: The invention provides a crowd evacuation congestion propagation prediction method and system based on a knowledge graph, and relates to the technical field of crowd evacuation computer emulation.The crowd evacuation knowledge graph is constructed, and path subgraphs at all moments and observation information of all nodes are extracted; performing multilayer graph convolution processing on the path subgraph and observation information of each node to obtain spatial correlation characteristics of congestion propagation; obtaining dynamic time characteristics of congestion propagation by using an LSTM network; fusing the spatial correlation features and the dynamic time features to obtain the crowd density of the future time slice of the road section; and determining a congestion propagation graph according to the crowd density of the road sections and the connectivity of each road section in time and space. Therefore, under the condition that the current crowd congestion state is considered, which road sections are affected in the future can be predicted in real time, corresponding congestion relieving strategies can be formulated in time, and crowd evacuation efficiency is improved.

title: Content processing method and related equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a content processing method and related equipment. Related embodiments can be applied to various scenes such as cloud technology, artificial intelligence and intelligent traffic. The method comprises the steps of obtaining current to-be-searched target search content of a target object and a heterogeneous search graph; performing feature information transmission processing on the associated object and the historical search result according to the heterogeneous search graph to obtain search interest feature information of the target object and interaction feature information of the historical search result; obtaining a target search result for the target search content, and calculating the association strength of the target search result based on the interaction feature information; and sorting the target search results according to the target search content, the association strength and the search interest feature information, and outputting the sorted search results. According to the method, the search results can be sorted by deeply mining the heterogeneous search graph of the target object, so that the sorting accuracy of the search results can be improved, the target object can conveniently and quickly search the required result, and the search efficiency is improved.

title: Genetic algorithm and clustering algorithm composite nested abnormal sound detection algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a genetic algorithm and clustering algorithm composite nested abnormal sound detection algorithm, which comprises a genetic algorithm, an enhanced incremental principal factor analysis method and a density-based spatial clustering calculation method. The method comprises the following specific steps: S1, reducing the dimensionality of a data set converted from an audio file to a number by adopting an enhanced incremental principal factor analysis method, and obtaining a dimensionality-reduced data set; s2, performing effective clustering by using a dimension reduction data set obtained from an enhanced incremental principal factor analysis method and applying a density-based spatial clustering calculation method; s3, performing calculation training on the clustered data set through a genetic algorithm to obtain optimal parameter configuration; according to the method, sample data can be effectively balanced, so that the universality of supervised learning is improved, noise interference is reduced, the overall operation performance is improved, a transport operation model is established locally, complexity and dependency of manual parameter adjustment can be reduced with low operation cost, and the adaptive capacity of an algorithm to environment change is enhanced.

title: Matching statistical wavelet-based photovoltaic power prediction method and device
abstract: The invention provides a photovoltaic power prediction method and device based on matched statistical wavelets. The method comprises the following steps: S1, machine learning prediction: establishing a conversion model from meteorological features to actual power; performing reasoning through the conversion model to obtain an initial prediction actual power curve of a prediction time period; s2, anomaly detection: detecting whether an abnormal time window exists in each day of the prediction time period, obtaining maximum power values corresponding to starting and ending time points, and taking a mean value of the maximum power values; s3, statistical wavelet generation: generating a statistical wavelet of each signal channel, matching an optimal statistical wavelet frequency conversion coefficient, and generating an optimal statistical wavelet; and S4, replacing the initial prediction actual power curve by using each optimal statistical wavelet curve corresponding to the abnormal time window, and repeating and correcting all the abnormal time windows. The method effectively solves the problem that the power prediction precision is affected by low data quality, data non-identical distribution, season conversion and the like.

title: Bidirectional green wave band optimization system based on improved genetic algorithm and optimization method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a bidirectional green wave band optimization system based on an improved genetic algorithm and an optimization method thereof. The system comprises a control parameter optimization module, an algorithm improvement module and an objective function optimization module. The control parameter optimization module is used for optimizing parameters such as green light duration and queuing clearing time and sending the parameters to the target function optimization module; the algorithm improvement module is used for improving genetic algorithm initialization and sending the improved genetic algorithm initialization to the objective function optimization module; and the target function optimization module is used for modeling a vehicle delay target according to the received control parameters and optimizing the vehicle delay target by using an improved genetic algorithm. According to the method, the arrival rate and the departure rate of the vehicles are combined, the queuing condition of the vehicles is analyzed, the genetic algorithm and chaotic search are combined, the limitation of premature genetic algorithm is solved, and the efficiency of traffic artery bidirectional green wave band optimization is improved.

abstract: The invention discloses a model training data updating method and device, and relates to the technical field of computers. title: Filter design method and device for neural network assisted implicit space mapping
abstract: The invention discloses a filter design method and device for neural network-assisted implicit space mapping. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a rough model; the design parameters and the auxiliary parameters are sent into the rough model to obtain responses; forming a training sample by taking each group of design parameters and corresponding responses as neural network input vectors and taking the auxiliary variables as neural network output vectors; training a neural network by using the training sample; a design parameter Xc1 is selected when the rough model is optimized to be optimal; establishing a fine model, and designing a variable Xf1 = Xc1 to obtain a response Rf (Xf1); inputting the response Rf (Xf1) and the design variable Xf1 into the trained neural network to obtain an auxiliary variable; the auxiliary variables are sent into the rough model, and the design parameter is Xc2 when the auxiliary variables are optimized to be optimal; enabling Xf2 to be equal to Xc2 to obtain response Rf (Xf2); and if the requirements are not met, returning to the auxiliary variable acquisition step with the response of the new accurate model and the design variable to continue execution. The parameter extraction process in implicit space mapping is simplified through the neural network, and the design efficiency and precision are improved.

title: Nuclear magnetic resonance rapid imaging method, device and equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a nuclear magnetic resonance rapid imaging method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of nuclear magnetic resonance imaging. According to the application, data is acquired in parallel through multiple coils, part of sampling points are sacrificed during data acquisition based on undersampling scanning, and phase encoding step number information corresponding to the sampling points is reduced, so that the scanning time is shortened, and the purpose of accelerating data acquisition is achieved. In the data reconstruction process, reconstruction imaging is carried out based on the under-sampling data of each coil data set, and the full-sampling data of the K space of each receiving coil is obtained. And the reconstructed data are arranged to obtain the full-sampling data of the K space corresponding to the to-be-reconstructed image, and the imaging time can be shortened through respective imaging. According to the rapid nuclear magnetic resonance imaging method provided by the invention, the imaging time is shortened in the data acquisition process and the imaging process, so that the rate of the whole nuclear magnetic resonance imaging is accelerated, and the application value is improved.

title: Target qubit decoupling in echo cross-resonance gates
abstract: Systems, computer-implemented methods, and/or computer program products are provided that may assist in target qubit decoupling in echo cross-resonance gates. In accordance with an embodiment, a computer-implemented method may include receiving, by a system operatively coupled to a processor, both cross-resonant pulses and decoupling pulses at a target qubit. The cross-resonant pulse propagates to the target qubit via the control qubit. abstract: The invention discloses a real-time communication RTC media stream real-time application identification method based on encrypted traffic analysis. abstract: A distributed energy storage configuration method considering vulnerability of an active power distribution network is characterized in that the vulnerability of each node of the active power distribution network is evaluated from the two aspects of structure and state by constructing an efficiency Gini coefficient change rate index and a voltage change rate Tele entropy index, and vulnerable nodes are screened as installation nodes of distributed energy storage. abstract: The invention relates to a vehicle target identification method, device and equipment fusing multi-scale semantic information. title: Residual charging time prediction method and device, storage medium and vehicle
abstract: The invention provides a residual charging time prediction method and device, a storage medium and a vehicle, and belongs to the technical field of batteries. title: METHOD AND SYSTEM FOR DIAGNOSTIC MESSAGES
abstract: The invention relates to a method and a system for diagnosing messages (M1, M2,...) generated during the operation of a technical installation (1) in which a process (2) of a process operating in the installation (1) is controlled by means of a process control system (3), and a data set characterizing the operation of the installation having values of process variables (L, T, F,...) is detected and stored in a data memory (15). A diagnostic specification relating to the operation of the installation (1) is determined on the basis of the data set and at least one predefined so-called self-organizing diagram. An n-tuple corresponding to the data set of preset values of process variables (L, T, F,...) for error-free operation of the facility is stored at nodes of the ad-hoc graph. The invention is characterized in that, after the occurrence of a message (M1) of a current and/or historical time interval within which the message (M1) occurs, a minimum spacing between a data set of the current time interval (takt) and a data set of nodes (K) of the self-organizing graph is determined, and one or more corresponding nodes (Kres) are selected. Then, the symptom is determined by forming differences from the data set of the time interval and the previously determined one or more nodes (Kres), in which only the differences of the process variables exceeding the preset threshold (SSym) are taken into account. A process variable (L, T, F,...) relating to a previously determined symptom is output. In this manner, a facility operator is supported in diagnosing a process message.

title: Picture classification method and system based on high-confidence local feature and global feature learning
abstract: The invention discloses a picture classification method and system for high-confidence local feature and global feature learning, and the method comprises the steps: nesting a down-sampling layer in a stacking manner of a deep separation convolution layer, and carrying out the feature extraction; extracting multi-scale features to form a feature tensor; removing redundant regions by adopting sliding windows with different synchronization lengths and a non-maximum suppression method, and generating candidate local regions of interest; calculating the probability that the local candidate region of interest belongs to the generic tag as a confidence value, constructing a sorting consistency loss function training network according to the confidence value, sorting the candidate local regions of interest, and judging a high-confidence region of interest; aggregating the high-confidence local region-of-interest features with the global features to obtain a feature splicing tensor; and performing final picture classification according to the aggregated features. title: Executing complex optimization tasks with improved efficiency by neuronal optimization of experts
abstract: An example system performs complex optimization tasks with improved efficiency through neuronal optimization of an expert. In particular, a machine learning framework is provided in which a meta-optimized neural network can learn a set of fused experts to provide a predicted solution. In particular, a meta-optimization neural network may learn an output of a predictive complex optimization process that optimizes an output of a set of experts to produce an optimized output. abstract: The invention discloses an industrial wireless edge gateway optimization layout scheme based on machine learning, and the scheme comprises the specific steps: obtaining the position layout of a production line and a sensor in a workshop, and obtaining the data size, needing to be uploaded at different moments, of different sensors through a sensor data sampler; calculating the expectation of the total energy consumed by the sensor during data transmission through Monte Carlo stochastic simulation; according to the uploaded data obtained by the sampler and the energy expectation calculated by Monte Carlo stochastic simulation, training a neural network to predict the energy expectation corresponding to the position of any group of wireless edge gateways; and searching the position of the wireless edge gateway by adopting a heuristic algorithm, and embedding the heuristic algorithm based on the trained neural network to accelerate the search process. abstract: The invention discloses a point cloud geometric compression method based on an asymmetric auto-encoder structure, and belongs to the technical field of point cloud compression. abstract: The invention provides a data representation method, a tensor quantification method and a multiplication and addition calculation device. title: Cancer type prediction system
abstract: A system for cancer type prediction includes a trained neural network (NN), a patient feature set extractor (PFE), and an associated feature set searcher (FSS). The trained NN receives a patient input vector from a patient record and generates a cancer type prediction. When passing through the trained NN, the PFE extracts a set of known cancer features from patient input vectors from patient records with known cancer types and extracts a set of unknown cancer features from patient input vectors from patient records without known cancer types. The FSS stores a set of known cancer features in a first portion of a column and metadata in a second portion of the column and finds K nearest neighbors of a set of unknown cancer features from the stored set of known cancer features.

abstract: The invention discloses a vending machine goods channel configuration method based on artificial intelligence. abstract: The invention provides a handwritten numeral detection method based on an improved Faster-RCNN. abstract: The invention discloses a knowledge graph fusion method based on entity merging, which comprises the following steps of: firstly, acquiring data of two or more knowledge graphs to be fused, then extracting all attributes of entities, calculating word embedding vectors of the attributes, inputting the word embedding vectors into a recurrent neural network, acquiring final hidden layer output, and outputting the final hidden layer output. abstract: The invention discloses a space-frequency joint channel feedback method based on deep learning. abstract: The invention provides an ore target detection method in a weak contrast scene. title: Improved particle filter positioning and mapping method based on harmony search algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses an improved particle filtering positioning and mapping method based on a harmony search algorithm. The method comprises the following steps: initializing particles and particle weights; obtaining a particle set at the current moment according to the proposal distribution and calculating particle weights; optimizing particle poses by using a harmony search algorithm; performing further optimization by using a niche algorithm; the optimized particle weight is calculated and normalized; the number of effective particles is calculated, and self-adaptive optimization combination resampling is carried out based on an EWA optimization algorithm of deviation correction; and based on the motion trails of the particles, updating map information of the particles, and establishing an actual map. According to the particle filtering method provided by the invention, more accurate filtering estimation can be obtained while fewer particles are used; the resampling improvement strategy ensures the diversity of particles and solves the problem of particle depletion caused by traditional resampling at the same time. title: Method for non-contact estimation of surface physical attribute value based on generative adversarial network
abstract: The invention provides a method for non-contact estimation of a surface physical attribute value based on a generative adversarial network. The method comprises the following steps: 1, design of a coding and decoding network: designing a sequence coding and decoding network based on a Gramer summation angle field; and 2, model design: based on an image generation task, combining a network architecture of a generative adversarial network to carry out network design. 3, acquiring a data set, wherein the experimental data set comprises multi-angle visual images of 418 materials and 15 surface tactile physical characteristics; and 4, network training: inputting a training data set into the model for training, and optimizing parameters of the generation network and the discrimination network in combination with WGAN-GP and feature matching loss. And 5, testing the model: inputting the test set into the network model, and decoding a generated result to obtain a final physical tactile attribute predicted value. According to the method, based on the coding and decoding network and the generative adversarial network structure, the surface physical tactile attribute value can be accurately estimated directly from material images at different angles.

title: Mobile robot positioning method based on inertial measurement unit and deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a mobile robot positioning method based on an inertial measurement unit and deep learning, and the method comprises the steps: inputting the original data of the inertial measurement unit into a trained deep learning model, and obtaining an error calibration parameter of the inertial measurement unit and a noise parameter of an invariant Kalman filter; and obtaining the calibrated acceleration and angular velocity by using an error calibration model of the inertial measurement unit, and inputting the calibrated acceleration and angular velocity into an invariant Kalman filter to obtain a positioning result of the mobile robot. The method can adapt to the motion characteristics of different mobile robots, obtains a higher-precision mobile robot positioning result, facilitates the reduction of the positioning cost of the mobile robot, and is not liable to be interfered by the environment.

title: Visualization-based geometric problem solving thinking analysis method
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of geometry education, and particularly relates to a visualization-based geometric question solving thinking analysis method, which comprises the following steps: S1, decomposing multiple sets of real questions into different training factors, each training factor comprising a question solving thinking module and a question solving method label; s2, training a pre-trained geometric problem solving thinking visualization model by using the decomposed training factors to enable the model to have the functions of identification, decomposition and visualization conversion; and S3, identifying the type of the geometric question through the trained model, automatically analyzing and converting the geometric question into a visual graphical interface. The method can summarize and conclude propositional rules and general problem solving thinking rules of the plane geometry axial compression questions through analysis of a large number of propositions of the plane geometry axial compression questions, and then analyzes other geometric questions and outputs problem solving thinking changes and problem solving changes through building a model. Therefore, the self-learning ability of students is improved and the teaching difficulty of teachers is reduced.

title: Lightweight pedestrian segmentation method based on content awareness
abstract: The invention discloses a lightweight pedestrian segmentation method based on content awareness. The lightweight pedestrian segmentation method comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring a training picture from a pedestrian segmentation data set; performing feature extraction and fusion on the high-resolution and low-resolution pictures through a feature extraction module in the teacher network to obtain a teacher network feature map; inputting the teacher network feature map obtained in the step S2 into a pedestrian segmentation module of the teacher network for training; generating a teacher network feature map by using the trained teacher network, and guiding a student network taking a low-resolution picture as input to perform feature extraction so as to obtain a student network feature map; inputting the student network feature map obtained in the step S4 into a pedestrian segmentation module of the student network for training; and finally, obtaining a pedestrian image from a monitoring camera, and segmenting the pedestrian image through the trained student network to generate a segmentation result graph. According to the scheme, good pedestrian sensing and positioning capabilities are achieved, and balance between pedestrian segmentation precision and speed is achieved.

title: New UFMC system peak-to-average ratio inhibition scheme
abstract: The invention discloses a novel UFMC system peak-to-average power ratio suppression scheme, and belongs to the technical field of wireless mobile communication. The scheme comprises the following steps: obtaining a signal sequence Xo (k), carrying out orthogonal amplitude modulation, constructing an immune programming genetic algorithm, and searching to obtain an optimal phase rotation vector factor alpha * (k); and carrying out point multiplication, zero insertion and IFFT and FFT operations on the alpha * (k) and the frequency domain sample value X (k) to obtain a time domain vector xb (n), processing the xb (n) through a filter fb (n) with the length of Lf, and then carrying out accumulation to obtain a final signal s (n) of the transmitting end. According to the method, cloning operation is adopted, and robust search is carried out in the whole solution space, so that local optimum is effectively prevented, and premature convergence is avoided; the population screening operation is adopted, and some non-excellent particles are reserved and continuously optimized to further increase the diversity of the population, so that the purpose of reducing the PAPR is achieved.

abstract: A method (200), and a device (100) for determining a presence of tumor is provided. In one aspect, the method (200) includes receiving a medical image associated with the patient, wherein the medical image comprises a region of interest associated with the patient. Further, the method (200) includes identifying one or more blood vessels associated with the region of interest in the medical image. Additionally, the method (200) includes determining a set of characteristics associated with the blood vessels, using a trained machine learning model. title: Method for improved binarized neural networks
abstract: A method of training a machine learning model is disclosed, such as training a binarized convolutional neural network to analyse or capture images. The machine learning model comprises convolutional layers, each layer comprising expert binary filters. A gating function of each layer is trained to select one of the expert binary filters based on data input to the model. Each expert binary filter may be trained to specialise in a subset of training data. Each expert binary filter may be trained to learn real-value weights and generate an intermediate trained model. The intermediate trained model may then be trained to learn binary-value weights. The real-value weight may be learned by training one expert binary filter and applying that real-value weight to all remaining expert binary filters. The convolutional layers may be grouped, and the expert binary filters in each group may be trained together. Also disclosed is a method of analysing data using the trained machine learning model. The expert binary filters may be selected to perform image classification, gesture recognition, emotion recognition, action recognition, to identify an image matching a query, or to determine when to capture an image.

abstract: Recognition of a transmitter device from signals received at a receiver device is improved by decreasing the interference of the receiver RF fingerprint on the received transmitter RF fingerprint. The RF fingerprint signal processing device includes a receiver-feature determination circuit and a classifying determination circuit. The receiver-feature determination circuit is configured to compute on the plurality of input signals in a neural network. The classifying determination circuit is coupled with the receiver-feature determination circuit, and the classifying determination circuit is configured to send feedback information of a receiver-feature component to the receiver-feature determination circuit. The receiver-feature determination circuit decreases the receiver-feature weight of the neural network. The receiver-feature weight is associated with the receiver-feature component, and the receiver-feature weight which is decreased is applied tor computing an output value of the neural network.

title: Artificial intelligence based steganographic systems and methods for analyzing pixel data of a product to detect product counterfeiting
abstract: A trained artificial intelligence, such as a neural network (NN) (Fig.4A) that detects the presence of a steganographic feature 500d1af in an image 500d1a of a product 500d1ap, thus classifying the product as authentic or counterfeit goods. The NN is implemented through a computer application. NN training data comprises images with and without the steganographic features. Authentic steganographic features may be hidden in: barcodes; QR codes; data matrix codes; scannable codes; alphanumeric characters; printed symbols; textual characters; fonts; graphical alterations; or packaging alterations (Figs.5A-5G). Steganographic feature authenticity may depend on alignment of the steganographic feature to a two-dimensional data matrix. The training images may be synthetic; created by augmenting, altering, deleting, or annotating steganographic features of a known image. The training images may be an original image that has been cropped and have a reduced pixel count. Training images may comprise multiple angles or perspectives of the product. Training images may comprise a third subset of images depicting real counterfeit features. The steganographic app may display, on a screen, an indication of whether the product is authentic or counterfeit 210. The steganographic app may select a set of authentic steganographic features for printing (130,Fig.1) on a different version of the product.

title: Class prediction based on multiple items of feature data
abstract: In learning phase 30, training data 31 with known classification are used as inputs and for each event of the training data multiple items of feature data are mapped to encodings, where a range of values for each feature input are mapped to a given encoding. A concatenated encoding for the event forms a joint feature item and class counters are used to count class known to be associated with the training event for the joint feature item in a table. At the conclusion of the training phase the class‑counter values enable a predicted class to be associated with each joint feature item in table 33. In inference phase 40, table 33 is used for class prediction generation for new data events based on largest membership values. The inference phase is in hardware with significantly less data handling capability compared to the learning phase. For hardware implementations, mapping each feature value to a fuzzy region makes computing joint memberships tractable and table size manageable because of fewer fuzzy values or regions. Encodings are Hamming distance based. Entry coalescing is also performed where bit positions at which dominant entries and recessive entries differ are stored in the table.

title: ANNOTATING UNLABELED IMAGES USING CONVOLUTIONAL NEURAL NETWORKS
abstract: A method and information storage media having instructions stored thereon for supervised Deep Learning (DL) systems to learn directly from unlabeled data without any user annotation. The annotation-free solutions incorporate a new learning module, the Localization, Synthesis and Teacher/Annotation Network (LSTN) module, which features a data synthesis and generation engine as well as a Teacher network for object detection and segmentation that feeds the processing loop with new annotated objects detected from images captured at the field. The first step in the LSTN module learns how to localize and segment the objects within a given image/scene following an unsupervised approach as no annotations about the objects' segmentation mask or bounding box are provided. The exemplary LSTN module also features significant properties that automate the continuous development and integration of deep learning models by (1) learning to synthesize annotated data given only a few samples of the target objects, (2) continuously increasing the object set by adding newly detected objects via an annotation network and (3) supporting the training of the end-model to be released at edge devices via knowledge transfer using a distillation approach by following a Teacher-Student scheme. The overall approach is related with life-long learning, continuous learning and incremental learning approaches that learn how to improve their performance or augment their knowledge by utilizing data observed during deployment or provided as input by the user.

abstract: A dialogue state tracking method according to an embodiment of the present application comprises: a step of obtaining a dialogue state tracking model which has been trained; a step of obtaining target dialogue data; a step of obtaining dialogue summary data from the target dialogue data by using the dialogue state tracking model; and a step of generating a dialogue state template from the dialogue summary data. title: Scene Text Detection Method and System based on Sequential Deformation
abstract: Disclosed are a scene text detection method and system based on sequential deformation, which can be applied to various text area deformations. According to the present invention, a feature extraction module extracts a first feature map from an input scene image on the basis of a convolutional neural network to transmit the first feature map to a sequential transformation module. The sequential transformation module repeatedly samples the first feature map to acquire a feature map corresponding to a sampling position, performs a splicing operation of the first feature map and the feature map acquired by sampling in deep learning according to a channel dimension to acquire and transmit a second feature map to an auxiliary character count network. The sequential transformation module performs feature aggregation on the second feature map in a channel dimension to acquire and transmit a third feature map to an object detection criterion network. The object detection criterion network extracts a candidate text area box for the third feature map to acquire a text area prediction result as a scene text detection result through regression fitting.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR IMAGE ANALYSIS
abstract: Provided are a system and method for image analysis, which are able to recognize an act of an actor from an image. According to the present invention, the system for image analysis is able to prevent the act recognition performance from being lowered even when a part of the body of the actor is hidden or when the position of the camera is moved. title: Event-based classification of features in a reconfigurable and temporally coded convolutional spiking neural network
abstract: Embodiments of the present invention provides a system and method of learning and classifying features to identify objects in images using a temporally coded deep spiking neural network, a classifying method by using a reconfigurable spiking neural network device or software comprising configuration logic, a plurality of reconfigurable spiking neurons and a second plurality of synapses. The spiking neural network device or software further comprises a plurality of user-selectable convolution and pooling engines. Each fully connected and convolution engine is capable of learning features, thus producing a plurality of feature map layers corresponding to a plurality of regions respectively, each of the convolution engines being used for obtaining a response of a neuron in the corresponding region. The neurons are modeled as Integrate and Fire neurons with a non-linear time constant, forming individual integrating threshold units with a spike output, eliminating the need for multiplication and addition of floating-point numbers.

abstract: Certain aspects and features of the present disclosure relate to systems and methods for automatically classifying hosts in real-time. title: Methods and systems for detecting photograph replacement in a photo identity document
abstract: Disclosed are computer-implemented methods, non-transitory computer-readable media, and systems for detecting identity document photograph replacement. One computer-implemented method includes receiving image data of a cropped photograph region of an identity document (ID), where the ID comprises a photograph, and where the cropped photograph region comprises at least the photograph. Using a multiclass classification model and as a predicted ID category, an ID category is predicted based on the image data of the cropped photograph region, where the predicted ID category corresponds to a predefined class of a set of predefined classes in the multiclass classification model. title: Dynamic quantum data output post-processing
abstract: Techniques for managing and compressing quantum output data (QOD) associated with quantum computing are presented. One or more tiles perform computations where each tile receives input neurons, offsets and synapses, and where each input neuron has an associated offset. Each tile generates output neurons, and there is also an activation memory for storing neurons in communication with the tiles via a dispatcher and an encoder. The dispatcher reads neurons from the activation memory and communicates the neurons to the tiles and reads synapses from a memory and communicates the synapses to the tiles. title: Toroidal Systolic Array Processor for General Matrix Multiplication (GEMM) With Local Dot Product Output Accumulation
abstract: A toroidal systolic array processor for GEMM with local dot-product output comprises an array of processing elements (PEs) arranged in rows and columns. User input circuitry provides input arrays A and B (and optionally G) as initial first values and second values before the array operation begins. Then, for each step of the array operation, first values and second values are received from other PEs in the array in a toroidal fashion. Each PE performs a fused multiply-add (FMA) operation based upon first values and second values received, whether from the input circuitry or from other PEs. At the end of the array process, each PE provides and output, for example a0,1b1,0+a0,0b0,0 for the upper left hand PE in a 2×2 array. Depending upon user input, the array processor can compute A*B+G, A*B+C*D, etc.

title: PROTECTION AGAINST UNINTENDED CONTENT CHANGE IN DRAM DURING STANDBY MODE
abstract: Systems, methods, and apparatus related to protecting data stored in volatile memory of a computing system during a standby mode. In one approach, a first signature is generated for data stored in volatile memory. In some cases, the stored data may include sensor data obtained from one or more sensors of a vehicle, mobile device or other electronic device. The first signature is stored in a non-volatile memory device, and then the computing system enters the standby mode. Subsequently, after exiting the standby mode, a second signature is generated for the data stored in the volatile memory. The first signature is read from the non-volatile memory device and compared to the second signature. A signature mismatch indicates that an unintended change has occurred in the stored data during the standby mode. One or more remedial actions are performed by the computing system in response to this signature mismatch.

title: REINFORCEMENT LEARNING-BASED RECLOSER CONTROL FOR DISTRIBUTION CABLES WITH DEGRADED INSULATION LEVEL
abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL)-based recloser control for distribution cables with degraded insulation level is provided. Utilities continuously observe cable failures on aged cables that have an unknown degraded basic insulation level (BIL). One of the root causes is the transient overvoltage (TOV) associated with circuit breaker reclosing. Since it is hard to model TOV due to its complexity, embodiments described herein provide a model-free stochastic control method for reclosers under the existence of uncertainty and noise. Concretely, to capture high-dimensional dynamics patterns, the recloser control problem is formulated herein by incorporating the temporal sequence reward mechanism into a deep Q-network (DQN). Meanwhile, physical understanding of the problem is embedded into the action probability allocation to develop an infeasible-action-space-elimination algorithm. The learning efficiency is proved to be outstanding due to the proposed time sequence reward mechanism and infeasible action elimination method.

abstract: A computer-implemented method for detecting one or more three-dimensional structures in a proximity of a vehicle at runtime includes generating, by a processor, a birds-eye-view (BEV) camera image of the proximity of the vehicle, the BEV camera image comprising two-dimensional coordinates of one or more structures in the proximity. The method further includes generating models of the three-dimensional structures by plane-fitting based on the edges of the one or more three-dimensional structures. In one embodiment, a method for a real-time video conference comprises, during the real-time video conference, receiving a media stream including audio and video from a remote computing system over a network, acquiring, video and audio of a user, detecting an event with a machine learning model in at least one of the video and the audio of the user, and transmitting an event detection message indicating the detected event and/or audio and video of the user to the remote computing system over the network. In this way, natural audience reactions may be automatically detected and shared.

title: SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR PERFORMANCE AND HEALTH MONITORING TO OPTIMIZE OPERATION OF A PULVERIZER MILL
abstract: Pulverizers are very critical equipment in overall functioning of a plant. They need to be controlled and monitored properly for the optimized operation of the pulverizers. A system and method for performance and health monitoring to optimize operation of a pulverizer is provided. The system comprises a digital twin that can mimic the performance of the pulverizer in real-time and assist the operators in decision making related to operation, maintenance and scheduling. The digital twin is configured to receives real-time sensor data from a plurality of data sources and provides real-time soft sensing of key health and performance parameters of the pulverizer. One more key aspect of the solution is the advisory system that alerts and recommends corrective actions in terms of parameters controlled through other equipment or changes in operation or design or changes in cleaning schedule.

title: Method, system, and sensor device for monitoring foam in vessel
abstract: A foam sensor device is used for monitoring foam within a vessel. The sensor (e.g. accelerometer) is encapsulated inside a water-tight, sterilizable, shell, which floats on a liquid contained. In one example, the foam sensor device includes an accelerometer for detecting and measuring rotation and movement of the foam sensor device and generates movement data based on the detected movement. During a learning or calibration process, sensor data (e.g., movement data) from the foam sensor device is analyzed and classified using machine learning and/or signal processing methods to extract features indicative of different possible foam statuses, including varying levels of foam, or no foam and generate models for the different statuses. During normal operation, the foam sensor device transmits sensor data to an analyzer containing the pre-calibrated models, which determines whether there is foam or not. Based on the foam status, a pump controller adds anti-foam solution.

title: CREATING MAJORANA ZERO MODES IN QUANTUM ANOMALOUS HALL INSULATOR/SUPERCONDUCTOR HETEROSTRUCTURES
abstract: The technologies described herein are generally directed to generating, detecting, and manipulating Majorana zero-energy modes which can be utilized to achieve the topological quantum computation, in accordance with one or more embodiments. One or more embodiments described include a platform based on a quantum anomalous Hall insulator/superconductor heterostructure. Specifically, the method can include making a cut in the quantum anomalous Hall insulator material to form a topologically protected helical channel with counter-propagating electron modes. When superconductivity is induced on the helical channel, Majorana zero-energy modes are formed. Furthermore, controllable gates and quantum dots can be integrated to the system such that the braiding of Majorana zero-energy modes can be achieved. This method provides a potential realization of the scalable fault-tolerant quantum computation.

title: Reinforcement Learning Method For Incentive Policy Based On Historic Data Trajectory Construction
abstract: A system and method to optimize the distribution of incentives for a transportation hailing service is disclosed. A database stores state data and action data received from a client devices and transportation devices. The state data is associated with the utilization of the transportation hailing service and the action data is associated with different incentives to passengers to engage the transportation hailing service. A Q-value determination engine is trained to determine rewards associated with incentive actions from a set of virtual trajectories of states, incentive actions, and rewards, based on a history of the action data and associated state data from the database. Passengers are ordered according to V-values. An incentive policy including selected incentive actions based on the determined rewards and passengers is created. An incentive server communicates selected incentives to at least some of the client devices according to the determined incentive policy.

title: ADAPTIVE TURBO TOGGLING
abstract: A method of operating a computing device for processing data is provided. The method includes (a) monitoring a set of performance characteristics of the processing of the data; (b) periodically calculating, using a predefined set of coefficients, a linear combination of the monitored set of performance characteristics to yield a combined metric; and (c) upon detecting that the combined metric exceeds a threshold while operating in a first processing mode, transitioning from operating in the first processing mode to operating in a second processing mode. (1) The second processing mode has a higher bandwidth than the first processing mode, and (2) processing of data in the second processing mode is less robust than processing of data in the first processing mode. An apparatus, system, and computer program product for performing a similar method are also provided.

title: MACHINE LEARNING SYSTEM FOR AUTOMATED RECOMMENDATIONS OF EVIDENCE DURING DISPUTE RESOLUTION
abstract: There are provided systems and methods for a machine learning system for automated recommendations of evidence during dispute resolution. A service provider, such as an electronic transaction processor for digital transactions, may provide a dispute resolution system, which allows adjudication of disputes between merchants and customers. The dispute resolution system may employ a machine learning engine that performs evidence classification and recommendation using one or more machine learning models. A first model may be trained to classify evidence based on text and evidence categories. Using the classified evidence, a second model may be trained to recommend evidence that has a highest probability of winning a dispute from past dispute resolutions and those evidence categories submitted to the dispute. The second model may provide one or more evidence categories for a dispute party to submit via a user interface and may rank or otherwise suggest evidence by the user interface.

title: NEURAL NETWORK LAYER FOLDING
abstract: The present disclosure describes neural network reduction techniques for decreasing the number of neurons or layers in a neural network. Embodiments of the method, apparatus, non-transitory computer readable medium, and system are configured to receive a trained neural network and replace certain non-linear activation units with an identity function. Next, linear blocks may then be folded to form a single block in places where the non-linear activation units were replaced by an identity function. abstract: Described in detail herein are systems and methods for network environment for a dynamic learning system for object matching and substitution using hand-held electronic devices. In exemplary embodiments, a hand-held electronic device may receive a request for physical objects of which a first physical object may be unavailable. The hand-held electronic device may transmit an identifier of the first physical object to a central computing system. The central computing system may query the database to retrieve data associated with the first physical object. The centrally computing system may attempt to match the first physical object to an available physical object based on dynamically learned matching behavior using the retrieved data. In response to matching data associated with one of the available physical objects to the data associated with the first physical object the central computing system may learn to replace the first physical object on the list with the one of the available physical objects based on dynamically learned matching behavior.

The memory circuit is configured to output the first input data and the second input data to the MAC circuit in response to a read control signal and is configured to store the result data in response to a write control signal. title: USER GUIDANCE FROM GAZE INFORMATION DURING A COMMUNICATION SESSION WHILE VIEWING A WEBPAGE
abstract: The technology disclosed herein enables user guidance from gaze information obtained while viewing a webpage. In a particular embodiment, a method includes, during a communication session between a first endpoint operated by a first user and a second endpoint operated by a second user, receiving gaze information indicating a location where the second user is looking relative to a webpage being presented to the second user at the second endpoint. The method further includes determining that the second user has been looking at the location for longer than a threshold amount of time. In response to determining that the second user has been looking at the location for longer than the threshold amount of time, the method includes notifying the first user about the location. Notifying the first user includes a suggestion of a resolution from a previous communication session that achieved positive results.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR GAUGING DIFFERENCES BETWEEN NETWORK CONFIGURATIONS
abstract: Presented herein are embodiments that use a language model to embed or encode configuration elements (e.g., commands, prompts, etc.) into dense, latent representations that incorporate semantic and contextual information. Using a trained language model, a configuration for a network device may be converted into a set of configuration path sentences. Given a first set of encoded configuration path sentences for a first configuration and a second set of encoded configuration path sentences for a second configuration, these two sets may be compared to gauge a degree of difference between the two sets. In one or more embodiments, an Optimal Transport method with Wasserstein distance metric may be used to obtain a comparison value that gauges difference between the two configurations. In one or more embodiments, the comparison valuation may be labeled or classified by comparing the comparison value to one or more pre-defined thresholds.

title: MACHINE-LEARNED MODEL SCORING TECHNIQUE FOR REDUCING MODEL INVOCATIONS
abstract: Machine-learned model scoring techniques for reducing model invocations are provided. In one technique, first values for non-pair-specific interaction features that are associated with a first entity are identified. Second values for pair-specific interaction features that are associated with (a) the first entity and (b) a second entity that is different than the first entity are identified. A machine-learned model that has been trained based on the non-pair-specific interaction features and the pair-specific interaction features generates a first score based on the first values. The machine-learned model also generates a second score based on the first values and the second values. A final score for the first entity-second entity pair is computed based on the first score and the second score. Based on the final score, data about the first entity is transmitted over a computer network to a computing device associated with the second entity.

A mobile device and a charging device are also specified.

title: Using machine learning model to make action recommendation to improve performance of client application
abstract: A system and a method are disclosed for recommending a set of actions to be performed to improve a target performance metric of a client application. An action recommendation system receives the target performance metric from a user associated with the client application. The action recommendation system determines features of the client application describing characteristics and performance history of the client application. title: Detection method using fusion network based on attention mechanism, and terminal device
abstract: A lane line detection method using a fusion network based on an attention mechanism, and a terminal device are provided. The method includes: synchronously acquiring natural images and point cloud data of a road surface; and inputting the natural images and the point cloud data into a pre-built and trained fusion network to output a lane line detection result. Time series frames and an attention mechanism are added to the fusion network to perform information fusing on the point cloud data and the natural images. Specifically, continuous frames are used to improve detection network performance to deal with complex situations such as label loss and vehicle being blocked; low-dimensional features are stitched with high-dimensional features by Skip Connection to make up for image detail information that is continuously lost as the network goes deeper, and the Decoder module is used to restore image dimensions to obtain a final result.

title: Universal, proactive, and dynamic scaling of computing resources
abstract: A proactive autoscaling system can use heuristics and machine learning to proactively, dynamically and automatically scale computing resources allocated to applications up and down, prior to scaling events that cause changes in load levels. The proactive autoscaling system may be stateless, and may be agnostic to use case, platform, field of endeavor, or communication protocol used by the applications. The proactive autoscaling system gleans metrics in real-time. The gleaned metrics are indicative of load levels concerning one or more applications. These gleaned metrics may be in a variety of formats, and may be from different sources, both internal or external to the applications. The proactive autoscaling system automatically predicts scaling events based on gleaned metrics. Prior to the occurrence of a predicted scaling event, the proactive autoscaling system can automatically scale computing resources available to one or more target applications, in response to the predicting of the scaling event.

abstract: Disclosed herein are embodiments of systems, methods, and products comprises a server, which provides trigger-based personalized sales outreach based on a user's request. title: Solid-state drive error recovery based on machine learning
abstract: Systems and methods for selecting an optimal error recovery procedure for correcting a read error in a solid-state drive are provided. A machine learning model is trained to forecast which error recovery procedure of a plurality of error recovery procedures is most likely to achieve a predetermined goal given a state of a solid-state drive. The predetermined goal is based on at least one of a read latency and a failure rate of the solid-state drive. A current state of the solid-state drive is determined. An error recovery procedure is selected from among the plurality of error recovery procedures by inputting the current state of the solid-state drive into the trained machine learning model, thereby triggering the trained machine learning model to output the selected error recovery procedure. title: Deep neural networks via physical electromagnetics simulator
abstract: A system for physically simulating a neural network is described herein. The system includes a plurality of physical voxels configurable to represent nodes of the neural network operating in response to electromagnetic radiation. Each of the physical voxels includes an impedance adjuster, a field detector, and a signal adjuster. The impedance adjuster adjusts impedance to the electromagnetic radiation within a corresponding one of the physical voxels. Weights between nodes of the neural network are based on the adjusted impedance. The field detector measures local field response within the corresponding one of the physical voxels. The local field response is representative of the electromagnetic radiation with the adjusted impedance. The signal adjuster is coupled to receive the local field response and apply an adjustment to the received local field response. The adjustment corresponds to an activation function of the neural network at the corresponding one of the physical voxels.

title: Systems and methods for optimizing quantum computers
abstract: Computer systems and methods for constructing a model of the noise afflicting a quantum computer comprising a plurality of qubits are provided. A graph G that describes a conditional independence structure of the noise is obtained. The graph G includes a node for each qubit in the plurality of qubits. The noise afflicting the quantum computer is logically reduced to Pauli noise. The graph G is broken into a plurality of sets. Each respective set Cj in the plurality of sets (i) corresponds a respective qubit j in the plurality of qubits and (ii) comprises a representation of the respective qubit j and the parent qubits ∂+j in the graph G. For each respective set Cj in the plurality of sets, a corresponding local conditional probability distribution Pr(ej|e∂+j) is characterized in which ejϵj is a Pauli error on the jth qubit. The characterization is performed by a procedure that comprises estimating a local Pauli fidelity for the respective set Cj, thereby learning the model of the noise afflicting the quantum computer.

abstract: A computing apparatus that does not need quantum coherence or a cryogenic cooling apparatus is provided for assignments that need an exhaustive search. A system is led to the ground state of the system where a problem is set, wherein spin sjz that is a variable follows a local effective magnetic field Bjz. The spin state at t=0 is initialized with a transverse field (in the x-direction). This corresponds to sjz=0. With time t, the magnetic field in the z-axis direction and the inter-spin interactions are gradually added, and finally the spin is directed to the +z- or −z-direction. The z component of the spin sj is sjz=+1 or −1. Here, in the process where the orientation of the spin sjz follows that of the effective magnetic field Bjz, correction parameters originating in quantum-mechanical effects are introduced and ground-state-maintaining performance is improved.

title: Localization error handling
abstract: Localization error handling using output is described. A computing system associated with a vehicle can receive sensor data from a sensor associated with vehicle. The computing system can determine, based at least partly on the sensor data, a first instruction for controlling the vehicle during a first period of time and a difference in pose information associated with a pose of the vehicle. Based at least partly on determining the difference, the computing system can retrieve a second instruction for controlling the vehicle during a second period of time prior to the first period of time and, based at least partly on comparing the first instruction and the second instruction, the computing system can determine whether the vehicle is to follow the first instruction or perform an alternate operation.

title: Machine learning for optimizing tool path planning in autonomous earth moving vehicles
abstract: An autonomous earth moving system can select an action for an earth moving vehicle (EMV) to autonomously perform using a tool (such as an excavator bucket). The system then generates a set of candidate tool paths, each illustrating a potential path for the tool to trace as the earth moving vehicle performs the action. In some cases, the system uses an online learning model iteratively trained to determine which candidate tool path best satisfies one or more metrics measuring the success of the action. The earth moving vehicle the executes the earth moving action using the selected tool path and measures the results of the action. In some implementations, the autonomous earth moving system updates the machine learning model based on the result of the executed action.

title: System and method to facilitate welding software as a service
abstract: A weld production knowledge system for processing welding data collected from one of a plurality of welding systems, the weld production knowledge system comprising a communication interface communicatively coupled with a plurality of welding systems situated at one or more physical locations. The communication interface may be configured to receive, from one of said plurality of welding systems, welding data associated with a weld. The weld production knowledge system may comprise an analytics computing platform operatively coupled with the communication interface and a weld data store. The weld data store employs a dataset comprising (1) welding process data associated with said one or more physical locations, and/or (2) weld quality data associated with said one or more physical locations. The analytics computing platform may employ a weld production knowledge machine learning algorithm to analyze the welding data vis-à-vis the weld data store to identify a defect in said weld.

title: Method for unsupervised sorting in real time of action potentials of a plurality of biological neurons
abstract: A method for unsupervised sorting, in real time, of action potentials of biological neurons by a network of artificial neurons including input, intermediate and output layers, the method according to which: the input layer receives an electrical signal measuring an electrical activity of biological neurons, the electrical signal having a variable amplitude as a function of action potentials emitted by the plurality of biological neurons over time; the input layer converts the amplitude of the electrical signal into a train of first spikes; the input layer transmits the train of first spikes to the intermediate layer; the intermediate layer converts the train of first spikes into a train of second spikes; the intermediate layer transmits the train of second spikes to the output layer; as a function of the train of second spikes, the output layer sorts each occurrence of each type of action potential present in the electrical signal.

abstract: In embodiments, a sentiment analyzer identifies a first event and accesses a first set of messages. The sentiment analyzer associates the first set of messages with the first event and analyzes the messages to identify a set of sentiment features. The set of sentiment features is used to analyze a second set of messages to form a prediction associated with a second event. The prediction may be used to facilitate an event-related service.

abstract: A method, system, and computer-usable medium are disclosed for classifying audio detected during operation of a hard disk drive to determine the status of the hard disk drive. One general aspect of the disclosure is directed to a system in which digital audio corresponding to audio detected by an audio transducer in proximity to moving mechanical components of a hard disk drive is recorded. The recorded digital audio is classified, using a trained machine learning model, to provide a health status of the hard disk drive based on the classification.

title: Online machine learning for calibration of autonomous earth moving vehicles
abstract: In some implementations, the EMV uses a calibration to inform autonomous control over the EMV. To calibrate an EMV, the system first selects a calibration action comprising a control signal for actuating a control surface of the EMV. Then, using a calibration model comprising a machine learning model trained based on one or more previous calibration actions taken by the EMV, the system predicts a response of the control surface to the control signal of the calibration action. After the EMV executes the control signal to perform the calibration action, the EMV system monitors the actual response of the control signal and uses that to update the calibration model based on a comparison between the predicted and monitored states of the control surface.

title: Machine learning-based software application modernization assessments
abstract: Techniques are described for enabling a software modernization assessment service to train and use ML models to automatically generate modernization assessment recommendations for users' software applications and systems. A modernization assessment service collects historical assessment data reflecting past modernization processes and assessments (e.g., application profile information and associated modernization strategies and tools used in past modernization projects). The modernization assessment service uses the historical assessment data to train one or more ML models (e.g., classifiers) that can be used to automatically identify relevant modernization strategies, services, and tools for given software application or system. Responsive to user requests to generate modernization assessment recommendations, the modernization assessment service can use the trained models to automatically generate modernization recommendations and reports.
