title: Selecting a node dedicated to transactions of a particular work group for executing a target transaction of another work group
abstract: A computing network includes nodes of different work groups. Nodes of a work group are dedicated to transactions of the work group. If a node of a first work group is predicted to have an idleness window, a second work group may borrow the node to execute a transaction of the second work group. At least a subset of steps of the transaction may be categorized into a step group. Trees of a transaction may be categorized into one or more tree groups. A node is selected for executing a transaction, if the predicted idleness duration of the node is sufficient relative to the predicted runtime of the transaction, the step group, and/or tree group. A credit system is maintained. A first work group transfers a credit to a second work group when borrowing a node of the second work group for executing a transaction of the first work group.

title: Sensor compensation using backpropagation
abstract: An embodiment includes training a first convolutional neural network (CNN) using a plurality of training images to generate first and second trained CNNs, and then adding an interface layer to the second trained CNN. The embodiment processes a first and second images in a sequence of images using the first trained CNN to generate a first and second result vectors. The embodiment also processes the second image using the second trained CNN and sensor data input to the interface layer to generate a third result vector. The embodiment modifies the sensor data using a compensation value. The embodiment compares the third result vector to the second result vector to generate an error value, and then calculates a modified compensation value using the error value. The embodiment then generates a sensor-compensated trained CNN based on the second trained CNN with the modified compensation value.

title: Controlling a Tunable Floating Coupler Device in a Superconducting Quantum Processing Unit
abstract: In a general aspect, a superconducting quantum processing unit includes a first qubit device, a second qubit device, and a tunable floating coupler device coupled between the first and second qubit devices. Values of a coupling strength of the first and second qubit devices at a plurality of operating points of the tunable floating coupler device are measured. The operating points correspond to respective values of a magnetic flux applied to the tunable floating coupler device. Based on the measured values of the coupling strength, a parking value of the magnetic flux is identified. The parking value of the magnetic flux corresponds to a magnitude of the coupling strength being less than or equal to a threshold value; the threshold value is associated with a target gate fidelity for the superconducting quantum processing unit.

abstract: Embodiments described herein provide for receiving a second image comprising an overlay depicting an organ-at-risk (OAR) segmentations. title: ACTIVE HEAVE COMPENSATION CONTROL METHOD FOR MARINE WINCH DRIVEN BY SWITCHED RELUCTANCE ELECTRIC MOTOR
abstract: Disclosed is an active heave compensation control method for a marine winch driven by a switched reluctance electric motor. The method comprises: calculating a rotation speed deviation of a switched reluctance electric motor according to the heave motion speed of a marine winch and the actual rotation speed of the switched reluctance electric motor; obtaining a given torque from the rotation speed deviation by means of a gradual steady state error control (GSSEC) algorithm, and obtaining a torque deviation in conjunction of the actual torque; according to a given flux linkage of the switched reluctance electric motor, measuring the actual flux linkage thereof at the same time, so as to obtain a flux linkage deviation; and sending a control signal to a power conversion circuit according to the torque deviation and the flux linkage deviation, so as to control the turning-on and turning-off of a power switch in the power conversion circuit. According to the control method of the present invention, when a GSSEC control method is used to realize control regarding the actual rotation speed of the switched reluctance electric motor tracking a given rotation speed thereof, the tracking control precision is closely related to the selection of GSSEC control parameters, that is, the better the selection of the control parameters is, the higher the tracking control precision is; and a fruit fly optimization algorithm is used to optimize the control parameters, so as to obtain an optimal control effect.

title: A SYSTEM AND METHOD FOR DECISION DRIVEN HYBRID TEXT CLUSTERING
abstract: The present invention discloses a method and a system for clustering of short and long text documents. The documents are input through an input module and a pre-processing module overtakes the documents from the input module. The pre-processing module refines the documents and removes unwanted text from the documents. Then a decision driven hybrid text clustering algorithm is applied via different modules to achieve clustering of the documents. Firstly, a context module computes a moment value of a feature signifying at least one feature importance value of the feature for the documents. The moment value is used by a decision module to calculate a decision score. Basis the decision score the documents are split into two sets. A clustering module then forms clusters of the two sets of documents basis n-tuple word distribution. Finally, a convergence module congregates the clusters in a final set of documents.

The method comprises: obtaining a plurality of audio signals collected by a microphone array; determining a cross-correlation function matrix between every two audio signals of the plurality of audio signals; inputting each cross-correlation function matrix into a preset sound event classification model to obtain a category matrix of a sound event, the preset sound event classification model being a pre-trained neural network model; performing Fourier transform on each audio signal to obtain a spectrogram of each audio signal, and determining a sound source orientation matrix of the sound event according to spectral data of each audio signal; and inputting the category matrix and the sound source orientation matrix into a preset matching network for matching to obtain a category of each sound event in the audio signals and a sound source orientation matched with the category. In the present application, detection and localization of a sound event are accurately and quickly realized.

abstract: A follicle tracking method and system. The method comprises: acquiring ultrasound images of an ovarian tissue of a subject under test, the ultrasonic images being obtained at at least three different examination times, wherein the ovarian tissue comprises a target follicle (201); respectively determining follicle regions, on the ultrasound images obtained at at least three different examination times, corresponding to the target follicle to obtain at least three follicle regions, wherein the at least three follicle regions are follicle regions corresponding to the same target follicle (202); respectively determining growth parameters of the target follicle according to the at least three follicle regions (203); obtaining a growth trend chart of the target follicle according to the at least three growth parameters of the target follicle (204); and displaying the growth trend chart (205). abstract: Prediction of Service Completion Time for Vehicle Service A method for facilitating vehicle servicing is provided. A first plurality of feature values corresponding to a first plurality of features are determined, for each of a plurality of vehicles. A second plurality of feature values corresponding to a second plurality of features are determined, for each of a plurality of service centers at which the plurality of vehicles were serviced. Based on the first and second pluralities of feature values, a machine learning model is trained to predict service completion times for servicing vehicles. For determining a service completion time for servicing a first vehicle at a first service center, a vehicular dataset of the first vehicle is provided as input to the machine learning model. The first vehicle is serviced at the first service center in compliance with the predicted service completion time.

title: METHOD AND DEVICE FOR NATURAL LANGUAGE PROCESSING
abstract: A method and device for natural language processing, for use in the field of artificial intelligence. The method comprises: acquiring an input sequence (1201), which comprises an initial vector expression corresponding to at least one word in a first corpus; and producing an output sequence with the input sequence serving as an input for a self-attention model (1202), the output sequence expressing semantic information of each word in the first corpus. The self-attention model comprises multiple layers of networks, each layer of network comprises multiple self-attention modules, used for calculating degrees of relevance on the basis of an input vector, that is, the degrees of relevance between each word and neighboring words in the first corpus, and merging the degrees of relevance with the input vector to produce first sequences; the first sequences outputted by the multiple self-attention modules and outputs of the multiple self-attention modules in the preceding layer of network are merged to produce outputs of the current layer of network. The method allows, during natural language processing, the efficient interpretation of improved sematic information for each word in the corpus thereof.

title: NEURAL NETWORK FOR MU-MIMO USER SELECTION
abstract: A method is disclosed of training a neural network to select users for multi user multiple-input multiple-output (MU-MIMO) communication from a set of potential users. title: SEMI-SUPERVISED TRANSLATION OF SOURCE CODE PROGRAMS USING NEURAL TRANSFORMERS
abstract: An automated system for translating source code written in one programming language into a different programming language utilizes a neural transformer with attention trained on semi-supervised data. title: INTERFEROMETRIC SYSTEM WITH DEEP LEARNING ALGORITHM TO PROCESS TWO INTERFEROGRAMS
abstract: Methods, devices and systems for measuring surface roughness and surface shape of an object are described. An example interferometric system includes a collimator and a first and a second light sources with different spectral ranges and different coherence lengths. The system selectively allows light from one of the light sources to reach the collimator, and also includes a beamsplitter, and a Mirau type microscope having an objective lens, a plate with a central reflective spot and a beamsplitter plate to produce a reference beam and a test beam. An imaging lens receives the test and reference beams that form a plurality of interferograms. A neural network receives two of the interferograms for measuring the surface shape and another two interferograms for measuring the surface roughness of the object. The interferometric systems have a compact form, making them suitable for on-machine measurements and other applications.

title: USER LOAD BALANCING
abstract: The present disclosure describes systems configured to minimize physical stress sustained by users by predicting ultrasound exam complexities and assigning exams to users in view of the same. The systems include processors configured to predict ultrasound exam complexity levels based on expected scanning hand usage, non-scanning hand usage, and user skill level. title: Multi-modal data multi-view sleep staging method
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-modal data multi-view sleep staging method. The method comprises the following steps of: firstly, processing and analyzing EEG (electroencephalogram) channel data, EOG (electro-oculogram) channel data and EMG (electromyography) channel data of a PSG (polysomnogram), and processing original multi-modal PSG data into three kinds of signals with different visual angles, namely a one-dimensional signal, a two-dimensional time-frequency diagram and a diagram topological structure; then taking the combination of the signals as an independent variable, taking a sleep staging interpretation result as a dependent variable, testing a model performance index through a leaving-one verification method, and constructing a multi-view fusion model; and finally, inputting the whole night PSG data of the individual into the multi-dimensional fusion model learning model to obtain a sleep staging interpretation result. The automatic sleep staging method is efficient, suitable for clinical application and robust in result.

title: System and method for processing data subject permission requests with biometric data matching
abstract: Systems and methods for processing data subject permission requests with biometric data matching are disclosed. The system and method advantageously enable a data controller to train a machine learning model on unaltered data with PII while maintaining privacy of the unaltered data and to enable compliance with data subject permission requests relative to the data. The systems and methods incorporate a biometric database that stores biometric data extracted from unaltered data with PII. To identify data related to a data subject permission request, biometric data is received from a data subject and matched against biometric data stored in a biometric database. Based on the matched biometric data, original unaltered source data with a PII may be identified for purposes of performing one or more data subject permissions, such as erasure, access, and denial processing.

title: Comparative learning model generation method, article recommendation method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a generation method of a comparative learning model and an article recommendation method and device thereof, and the generation method comprises the following steps: obtaining a plurality of interaction sequences, each interaction sequence comprising a user and a plurality of articles interacting with the user; acquiring a set E of codes corresponding to all articles in each interaction sequence; and preprocessing the plurality of interaction sequences, creating a contrast learning model, and training the contrast learning model by using the plurality of interaction sequences. In conclusion, the comparative learning model can be used for recommending a plurality of items most likely to interact in the future, so that the possibility that the user purchases the item is greatly improved.

title: Medical image zero watermark generation and detection method based on feature fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image zero watermark generation and detection method based on feature fusion. The zero-watermark generation method comprises the following specific steps: constructing a convolutional neural network with 512 channels, generating two training sets of the network, training the convolutional neural network, and obtaining a zero-watermark image. The zero-watermark detection method comprises the specific steps of generating a detection training set, training a detector and detecting watermark information. The problems that in the prior art, medical image position information features cannot be fully reserved, features are lost, and watermark information cannot be correctly detected when a zero-watermark image is generated are solved, so that the medical image features are extracted more comprehensively, the zero-watermark information loss probability is reduced, and the detection accuracy is improved. The method has the advantages of strong attack resistance of zero watermark generation and clear watermark detection, and can be applied to copyright protection of medical images.

title: Unsupervised federated learning magnetic resonance imaging method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of image processing, in particular to an unsupervised federated learning magnetic resonance imaging method, which comprises the following steps of: firstly, performing self-supervised training on a local model, and updating parameters of the local model; the local model comprises a plurality of local client models participating in federated learning; next, performing weighted aggregation on the local model after parameter updating to obtain a global model; then, on the basis of the global model, carrying out personalized processing on the local model to obtain an internal personalized model; the internal personalized model is interpolation among a local model of a local client, personalized models of other clients and a global client; and finally, carrying out personalized processing on the external client. The external client side is an external client side with invisible data distribution. According to the unsupervised federated learning magnetic resonance imaging method provided by the invention, a personalized model can be provided for internal and external clients which are lack of full sampling reference data and have different data distributions.

title: Fine adjustment method of vehicle classification model, vehicle classification method, device and equipment
abstract: The invention provides a fine adjustment method of a vehicle classification model, a vehicle classification method, a device and equipment, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the technical field of image processing and deep learning, and can be used for a vehicle recognition scene. The specific implementation scheme is as follows: respectively determining parameter contribution degrees of network parameters in at least two candidate network layers; the at least two candidate network layers belong to a pre-classification model; determining a target network layer from the at least two candidate network layers according to the parameter contribution degrees of the network parameters in the at least two candidate network layers; and training a pre-classification model according to the vehicle training data, and performing parameter updating on the target network layer in the training process to obtain a vehicle classification model. title: Cross-modal video time period retrieval method based on weak supervision
abstract: The invention discloses a cross-modal video time period retrieval method based on weak supervision. According to the method, a candidate time period generation module is introduced, the module can effectively utilize the time relation of videos, more accurate variable-length candidate proposals are generated, and multitask losses including keyword reconstruction losses, sorting losses and accurate selection losses are designed, so that more accurate starting points and ending points are positioned. According to the method, an end-to-end mode is adopted, and a large number of experimental results on two reference data sets prove the effectiveness of the method. The accurate selection loss provided by the invention enables the model to preferentially consider a relatively short time period close to the target time period, improves the candidate time period generation mode, and enables the similarity between the optimal solution of the generated candidate time period and the real time period to reach 99%. Finally, the reconstruction mode of reconstruction loss is improved, the reconstruction pressure is reduced, meanwhile, non-keywords are eliminated, impurities are reduced, and therefore the performance of the model is improved.

title: Method for constructing dynamic model and energy consumption model of joint surface of milling tool
abstract: The invention discloses a method for constructing a dynamic model and an energy consumption model of a joint surface of a milling tool. The method comprises the following steps: S1, constructing a dynamic model of a joint surface of a milling tool system by utilizing a dynamic model of a tool system; s2, providing a dynamic stability analysis method for the joint surface of the milling tool system; s3, calculating the dynamic energy consumption of the joint surface of the milling tool system, researching the transmission and distribution of the energy consumption of the joint surface of the tool system, and proposing an identification method for the transmission and distribution of the dynamic energy consumption of the joint surface of the milling tool system; and S4, further representing the overall relative position offset of the milling tool system, and proposing a prediction method for the relative position offset of the milling tool system. According to the modeling method for optimizing milling tool system junction surface dynamics, the dynamic stability of the milling tool system junction surface is analyzed, and the stability of the tool system junction surface is improved.

title: Community detection method and system based on network representation learning
abstract: The invention provides a community detection method and system based on network representation learning, and relates to the field of community detection, and the method comprises the steps: capturing a multi-order similarity matrix of a complex network through image convolution, and integrating the multi-order similarity matrix to obtain a total similarity matrix; performing non-negative matrix factorization on the total similarity matrix to obtain a node low-dimensional vector of the complex network; based on the obtained node low-dimensional vector, performing node clustering through a Bayesian information criterion BIC and a Gaussian mixture model GMM to complete community detection; the invention provides an innovative strategy for capturing multi-order similarity based on graph convolution, enhances a community structure by integrating the multi-order similarity, realizes low-dimensional vector representation of nodes by using non-negative matrix factorization (NMF), predicts the number of communities based on a Bayesian information criterion (BIC) and a Gaussian mixture model (GMM), and realizes community detection. The community detection precision is effectively improved, and the defect that most community detection algorithms need to specify the number of communities in advance is overcome.

title: Multi-channel promotion method and system based on imitation learning
abstract: The invention provides a multi-channel promotion method and system based on imitation learning. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, constructing a Markov decision process MDP; 2, selecting an advertisement and a time period, determining the sampling frequency of data, and generating a plurality of operation tracks as a training data set by using the selected operation record according to the sampling frequency; step 3, training to obtain a return function R0 (s); step 4, acquiring a basic bidding strategy model pi0; 5, an operation track of the current advertisement alpha is screened out from the data set to serve as a new training data set, a return function R1 is trained, and a return function R alpha (s) of the advertisement alpha is defined; step 6, acquiring a special bidding strategy pi alpha; and 7, updating the user historical data set, and updating the MDP. According to the method, the uncertainty caused by factors such as personal feeling of operation personnel in operation is reduced, and meanwhile, a visual basis is provided for rapid learning of new personnel.

abstract: The invention relates to a mimicry redis database synchronization method, system and device and a storage medium, a mimicry redis database comprises a proxy redis server and at least three dynamically heterogeneous redis servers, and the synchronization method comprises the steps of obtaining to-be-synchronized storage data in the mimicry redis database; packaging to-be-synchronized storage data, and inputting the packaged to-be-synchronized storage data into the trained machine learning model; according to an output result of the machine learning model, executing a synchronization operation on the plurality of redis servers; the input of the machine learning model is the to-be-synchronized storage data of the plurality of packaged redis servers, and the output of the machine learning model is the data reliability of each redis server. title: Multi-agent variable speed limit control method based on behavior trend clustering and feature mapping
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-agent variable speed limit control method based on behavior trend clustering and feature mapping, and the method comprises the following steps: designing an agent reward function which considers efficiency and safety at the same time, and then designing a global reward function of a whole road; collecting traffic flow data of continuous multi-bottleneck road sections; adopting a multi-agent deep reinforcement learning algorithm combined with parameter regradient to train a variable speed limit control agent; designing a neural network capable of persistently memorizing and exchanging information to calculate the running trend of the traffic flow, carrying out trend clustering by using a Gaussian mixture model, and grouping intelligent agents; transverse feature mapping is carried out between the source agents and the shared agents in the same group, and the learning process is accelerated; the intelligent agents in the same group synchronously update the neural network until convergence; and finally, controlling the speed limit of the road. Results show that the provided variable speed limit control method has the advantages of being good in coordination performance and high in convergence speed, effectively improving the road traffic efficiency and improving the traffic safety.

title: Task-independent brain grain recognition method based on feature decorrelation decoupling
abstract: The invention discloses a task-independent brain grain recognition method based on feature decorrelation decoupling. An existing method lacks mining of inherent identity information of a brain, so that the robustness of brain pattern recognition in a cross-task scene is poor, and the brain pattern recognition is difficult to popularize in practical application. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, performing coarse-grained decomposition on identity information and task-related information in electroencephalogram by adopting two branch networks; secondly, considering the influence of a task state on the identity information, and enabling the identity information and task related information to be independent as far as possible by adopting a decorrelation method; and finally, brain grain features in the electroencephalogram are fully utilized for classification in an anti-self-supervision mode. The method is good in performance, can realize efficient task-independent brain grain recognition, and is a brain grain recognition method which can be robustly used in real life.

title: Lightweight Internet of Things equipment identification method and device in smart home
abstract: The method comprises the following steps: acquiring traffic generated by equipment in the smart home at a gateway, preprocessing traffic data, and identifying the type and model of each piece of equipment; aggregating the flow data packets according to a fixed time window to obtain a network flow of each device; calculating statistical information of the size of a data packet in the network flow to obtain a feature vector of the network flow; the obtained feature vectors and the corresponding device types and model labels are sent to a three-stage classifier for training, and a multi-stage fine-grained Internet of Things device identification model is obtained; and sending the traffic of the to-be-identified equipment into the trained Internet of Things equipment identification model, and obtaining the type and model of the to-be-identified equipment through a three-stage classifier. According to the invention, rapid and accurate fine-grained Internet of Things equipment identification can be realized on the premise of protecting user data privacy. The invention further provides a corresponding lightweight Internet of Things equipment identification device in the smart home.

title: Magnetic measurement satellite abnormal state intelligent detection and identification method
abstract: The invention discloses a magnetic measurement satellite abnormal state intelligent detection and identification method, and relates to the field of magnetic measurement satellite abnormal state detection. Firstly, simulation software is used for simulating various possible error types and distribution rules of a magnetic measurement satellite, then a deep learning network is constructed, and a neural network is trained to automatically extract time sequence data features of the magnetic measurement satellite for error type classification. Finally, errors corresponding to the abnormal state are distributed on time sequence data point-by-point correlation visual display through the attention network, and a data processing team is assisted in data processing of the magnetic measurement satellite. According to the method, the artificial intelligence algorithm is applied to the engineering practice of monitoring and identifying the abnormal state of the magnetic measurement satellite, the data processing efficiency of the magnetic measurement satellite can be greatly improved, and the method can be applied to data processing of other satellites and has better universality.

title: Medical lung image lesion classification method and classification device
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical image processing, in particular to a medical lung image lesion classification method and device. According to the method, firstly, a lung medical image is preprocessed to remove invalid information, then, a lung area image is segmented from the lung medical image, finally, a classification result can be obtained by applying a neural network model to the lung area image, and the classification result comprises a mark position in the image and the probability of possible lesion at the position. According to the method, the neural network model is adopted to identify the lesion information of the lung image without manual participation, so that the accuracy of the classification result is improved. In addition, the neural network model is applied to the small-size lung area image instead of the whole large-size lung medical image, so that the image recognition speed of the neural network model is improved.

title: Sign language recognition method, device and system based on vision and skeleton information fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a sign language recognition method, device and system based on vision and skeleton information fusion. Inputting the obtained sign language video image data and sign language skeleton heat map data into a sampling layer formed by 3D convolution to obtain feature map data; inputting the feature map data into a preset 3D residual convolutional neural network based on multi-dimensional attention enhancement to obtain spatial-temporal features of the sign language video image and spatial-temporal features of the sign language skeleton heat map; and performing multi-mode sign language action prediction based on the video image features and the skeleton heat map features, and performing late fusion on prediction outputs of the two modes to complete sign language recognition based on vision and skeleton information fusion. According to the sign language recognition method, the spatial and temporal features of the video image and the skeleton heat map can be represented by using the 3D residual convolutional neural network based on multi-dimensional attention enhancement, late fusion is performed on prediction outputs of the two modes, and the robustness and the accuracy of a sign language recognition result are improved.

title: Method and device for global pruning of target detection model based on mean perception sparsity
abstract: According to the target detection model global pruning method and device based on mean value perception sparseness, L2 regularization sparseness and mean value perception sparseness items are applied to all prunable convolution kernel weights of a target detection model, and L1 norm sorting coupled with an association layer pruning processing mode in a residual block is used to carry out pruning processing on all the prunable convolution kernel weights. Determining an optimal pruning rate under a sparse factor through a greedy algorithm; obtaining a mask of a pruning convolution kernel under the optimal pruning rate; increasing regularization is carried out according to the obtained two-dimensional pruning convolution kernel mask and the effective mask row index and column index, and after increasing regularization, reordering is carried out according to the optimal pruning rate or pruning is carried out directly according to the obtained effective mask row index and column index; and after pruning, carrying out fine adjustment on the compressed model, and finally obtaining a pruned and compressed target detection model after fine adjustment. According to the method, the parameter quantity, the calculation quantity and the memory occupation of the model are greatly reduced under the condition that the detection precision is not reduced.

title: Abnormity detection algorithm for detecting industrial defects based on metric learning
abstract: The invention discloses an anomaly detection algorithm for detecting industrial defects based on metric learning. The algorithm comprises the following steps: model training: constructing a training data set, and respectively inputting at least three selected sample graphs into a same CNN (Convolutional Neural Network) sharing parameter weights for feature extraction; distance calculation is carried out on the features extracted from the sample images; inputting the calculated distance into a full connection layer, and outputting a similarity score; to-be-detected anomaly detection: inputting a to-be-detected anomaly sample graph and at least two selected normal sample graphs into the metric learning network model, and outputting similarity scores; and comparing the similarity score with a preset threshold value, and judging whether the to-be-detected abnormal sample graph is an abnormal sample or not. The anomaly detection algorithm is very wide in applicability, has a stable detection effect on difficult scenes and simple scenes, and accelerates the anomaly detection efficiency and speed.

title: Driving fatigue detection and early warning control method and device for man-machine co-driving
abstract: The invention discloses a driving fatigue detection and early warning control method and device for man-machine co-driving. The method comprises the steps that facial features and a heart rate value are obtained through recognition according to images in a cab, the facial features comprise the eye state, the mouth state and the head pitching angle, the images in the cab and the extracted facial features and the heart rate value are input into a preset time sequence neural network at the same time to be processed, and first fatigue information is obtained; inputting the image of the road surface outside the cab into a YOLOP model, obtaining lane line information of the road surface, extracting line pressing driving time, and obtaining second fatigue information based on the line pressing driving time; calculating steering wheel shaking characteristics according to the steering wheel angle information, and obtaining third fatigue information based on the steering wheel shaking characteristics; and calculating the fatigue degree based on the first, second and third fatigue information, and when the fatigue degree exceeds a preset early warning value, sending out a sound/light alarm and starting an expert database system. Defects caused by a single detection method are eliminated, and the reliability of an early warning system is improved.

title: Two-stage neural network test method and device based on neuron coverage rate guidance
abstract: The invention discloses a two-stage neural network test method and device based on neuron coverage rate guidance. The two-stage neural network test method based on neuron coverage rate guidance comprises the following steps: acquiring at least one original test case; performing first disturbance processing on the test cases according to a gradient ascending method and based on a dynamic step length adjustment strategy, so as to generate at least one first disturbance test case for each original test case; each first disturbance test case is input into the to-be-tested DNN for testing, so that a DNN result corresponding to each first disturbance test case is obtained, and the DNN results comprise error results; and obtaining a first disturbance test case of which the DNN result is an error result. According to the method and the device, the antagonism test cases which are improved in the aspects of neuron coverage rate, trigger error diversity and quantity are generated through targeted disturbance, and the reliability and the robustness in a neural network test are improved.

title: Equipment fault diagnosis and prediction method based on transfer learning
abstract: The invention discloses an equipment fault diagnosis and prediction method based on transfer learning, which belongs to the technical field of fault diagnosis and comprises a prediction model and a diagnosis model. The prediction model is composed of four layers of CNN, two layers of LSTM and three layers of full connection layers; the diagnosis model is formed by superposing four layers of CNN, two layers of LSTM and three layers of full connection layers; based on a field adaptive technology in transfer learning, a reference model provides a method for measuring sample feature difference based on working conditions in two modes, the difference is taken as one item of a loss function, and the feature distribution difference of samples with the same working condition of a training set and a test set is continuously reduced in the training process; the generalization of the fault prediction model is improved; experimental results on a commercial modular aviation propulsion system simulation data set prove the effectiveness and reliability of the model and the correctness of a corresponding parameter exploration strategy.

title: Asynchronous adaptive federal learning method and device
abstract: The invention provides an asynchronous adaptive federated learning method and device, the method is applied to a working node, and the method comprises the steps: receiving global model parameters from a parameter server, and executing local SGD iteration from a local training data set; after local SGD iteration of specified times is completed, local model parameters and control parameters are sent to the parameter server, so that the parameter server calculates to obtain new global model parameters by using the local model parameters, and calculates to obtain a set of optimal SGD iteration times on all working nodes by using the control parameters; receiving a set of optimal SGD iteration times, a global model parameter and a cycle index sent by the parameter server; and repeating the steps until the optimal global model parameters are obtained. According to the method, the number of local SGD iterations is dynamically determined on different working nodes, so that the fast working nodes and the slow working nodes are balanced under the time resource budget, and stable performance is obtained.

title: Underground traffic facility evacuation path decision-making method, system and equipment in flood environment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency evacuation, in particular to an underground traffic facility evacuation path decision-making method, system and equipment in a flood environment, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, building a node passing time prediction model through a BP neural network algorithm, and calculating the time when passengers pass through gates, stairs and/or escalator nodes; s2, based on the time prediction model in the S1, calculating the total evacuation time, total evacuation risk and total congestion degree of passengers in the flood environment by using an objective function, constructing a passenger evacuation path multi-objective optimization model, and determining a passenger evacuation recommendation route; and S3, building an underground traffic facility evacuation simulation system in a flood environment by using simulation software for really simulating pedestrian movement, fusing the passenger evacuation path multi-target optimization model in the S2, simulating the evacuation escape behavior of passengers, and evaluating the safety of an evacuation optimization strategy. Compared with the prior art, the time prediction result is more accurate and rapid, and a data basis is provided for calculation of the total evacuation time.

title: Method and system for judging running state of energy storage salt cavern and readable storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a method and system for judging the running state of a salt cavern and a readable storage medium. The method comprises the following steps that 101, key parameters of the running state of the salt cavern are determined according to compressed air energy storage salt cavern running mechanism analysis, and historical data of the key parameters are collected; step 201, pre-judging historical data to obtain training data sets under different working conditions; step 301, based on the training data set under different working conditions, establishing a salt cavern operation state evaluation model under different working conditions; and step 401, acquiring key parameters of the running state of the salt cavern under the current working condition and the current moment, pre-judging the data to obtain the running state of the salt cavern, and adding the identification result into the training data set under the corresponding working condition. According to the method, the running state of the salt cavern can be obtained in advance, and a safety guarantee is provided for the running of the compressed air energy storage power station.

title: Transformer oil leakage detection method based on improved YOLOv5
abstract: The invention discloses a transformer oil leakage detection method based on improved YOLOv5. The method comprises the following steps: S1, constructing a transformer oil leakage image data set; s2, constructing an improved YOLOv5 network model; s3, training the improved YOLOv5 network model by adopting the transformer oil leakage image data set to obtain a trained YOLOv5 network model; and S4, the trained YOLOv5 network model is adopted to identify the target transformer image, and an output result of the trained YOLOv5 network model is adopted as an identification result to complete transformer oil leakage detection. An up-sampling module and a down-sampling module are added on the basis of a basic YOLOv5 network model FPN structure, so that the network can perform cross-layer fusion on feature information of different layers in related images of the transformer, the network can better learn the features, and the detection accuracy of the model on oil leakage of the transformer is improved.

abstract: The invention discloses a device for predicting cognitive impairment of Parkinson's disease and a storage medium. title: Event reasoning task processing method and device and medium
abstract: The invention discloses an event reasoning task processing method and device and a medium, belongs to the technical field of natural language processing, and is used for solving the technical problem that an existing event reasoning task is low in prediction accuracy. title: Method and apparatus for dynamically normalizing data in neural network
abstract: Methods, apparatus, systems, and articles of manufacture to dynamically normalize data in neural networks are disclosed. An apparatus for use with a machine learning model includes at least one normalization calculator to generate a plurality of alternative normalization outputs associated with input data of the machine learning model. title: HTTP traffic clustering method and device based on self-learning parameter measurement
abstract: The method disclosed by the invention comprises the following steps: step 1, giving an HTTP message flow data set T, the HTTP message flow data set T comprising a plurality of pieces of message flow data, and setting a class label attribute in message header attributes of each piece of message flow data as L; step 2, training distance parameters in the distance metric function; step 3, setting a clustering threshold value, wherein the clustering threshold value comprises a neighborhood density threshold value and a radius parameter; and step 4, aggregating the flow data set T based on the neighborhood density threshold value and the radius parameter, and obtaining the same class label attribute L of each cluster of data after aggregation. According to the invention, based on the dist metric function, the DBSCAN clustering algorithm is adopted to carry out traffic data clustering, and the clustering precision of HTTP traffic data clustering is improved.

abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a data use ownership control method and system based on privacy calculation of a block chain, and the method comprises the steps: generating public keys and private keys corresponding to all nodes in the same block chain through employing a cryptographic algorithm, and sharing the public key of each node on the block chain; sending a data query request to a participant node, obtaining data set key description information encrypted by the participant node by using a local public key, and decrypting the encrypted data set key description information by using a local private key; judging whether a data set authorization request is sent to a participant node or not according to the data set key information, and if the data set authorization request is sent to the participant node and authorization is passed, respectively starting federated learning algorithms of the local party and the participant node; and obtaining a final operation result according to the operation result of the local party and the operation result of the participant. title: Prediction model with decomposable hierarchy configured to generate interpretable results
abstract: A computer-implemented method for providing interpretable predictions from a machine learning model includes receiving a data structure representing a hierarchical structure of a set (X) of features used by one or more prediction models to generate a predicted set (Y). An interpretability model corresponding to the prediction model is constructed by assigning interpretability to each prediction Yi based on the hierarchical structure. Allocation interpretability includes decomposing X into a plurality of partitions Xj using a hierarchical structure, where N is the number of partitions. Further, each partition is decomposed into a plurality of sub-partitions using a hierarchical structure until atomic sub-partitions are obtained. A score is calculated for each partition from a predicted score for the sub-partitions, where the predicted score represents an interaction between the sub-partitions. Further, an interpretation of the prediction is output.

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of resource management, and discloses a resource scheduling method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: predicting a target workload corresponding to each micro-service based on the workload data of each micro-service in a micro-service framework; determining a horizontal scaling strategy corresponding to each micro-service based on the target workload and a preset strategy gradient model, wherein a Critic network, a plurality of Actor networks and a Global network are arranged in the preset strategy gradient model; and adjusting the working replica of each micro-service through a horizontal scaling strategy and a working replica controller. title: Modeling method of deep venous thrombosis risk prediction model for patient after lower limb fracture operation
abstract: The invention relates to the field of intelligent medical treatment, in particular to a modeling method of a deep venous thrombosis risk prediction model for a patient after a lower limb fracture operation. title: Image background blurring method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses an image background blurring method and device, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of collecting an image; performing image segmentation on the image to obtain an image segmentation mask; the image segmentation mask is used for dividing the image into a foreground part and a background part; performing depth prediction on the image to obtain a first depth image of the image; re-segmenting the foreground part and the background part of the image based on the image segmentation mask and the first depth image to obtain a non-fuzzy part and a fuzzy part of the image; and performing background blurring processing on the blurred part of the image to obtain a background blurred image of the image. Thus, based on the image segmentation mask of the image and the first depth image, accurate segmentation is performed on the image, and a non-fuzzy part (namely a real foreground part) and a fuzzy part (namely a real background part) determined after segmentation are closer to a real scene of the image, so that the background blurring effect of the image is improved.

title: Learning type index recommendation method combining space occupation and scanning line number
abstract: The invention discloses a learning type index recommendation method combining space occupation and the number of scanning lines. The method mainly comprises the following steps that 1, a work load is analyzed into a syntax tree structure through a syntax analysis library; 2, candidate indexes are selected by analyzing a where condition, a gropby condition and an orderby condition in the syntax tree, and a candidate index space of the whole load is formed; 3, the load features serve as environment vectors, the candidate indexes serve as action vectors, the agents interact with the environment, actions are evaluated, and rewards are returned to the agents to make a next round of decision; and 4, estimating the cost of the load and the size of the storage space of the index after the index is created, and training the model until convergence. title: Fair competition examination method based on cascade deep learning model
abstract: The invention discloses a cascade deep learning model-based fair competition examination method, which comprises the following steps of: acquiring a large number of measure scheme texts, carrying out data preprocessing on the measure scheme texts, replacing related vocabularies marked in the measure scheme texts, constructing a Bert language model, extracting measure scheme text features pre-trained by the Bert language model, and carrying out fair competition examination on the extracted measure scheme text features. A deep learning algorithm is adopted to design a market subject judgment model, a file type model and a violation judgment model, and the market subject judgment model, the file type model and the violation judgment model are cascaded and combined to form a complete measure scheme text fair competition review model. According to the method, a multi-task cascade deep learning algorithm is applied to measure scheme text fair competition examination tasks, multiple models are used in a cascade mode, the overall fair competition examination performance of measure scheme files is improved, the fair competition examination problem of the measure scheme files is effectively solved, and healthy development of market economy can be guaranteed.

title: Cross-domain recommendation method based on federated learning and privacy protection
abstract: The invention relates to a cross-domain recommendation method based on federated learning and privacy protection, and belongs to the technical field of cross-domain recommendation. The method comprises the following steps: S1, aligning common users in different fields: searching similar users of cold start users in a source domain and a target domain according to a similarity threshold value; s2, constructing a heterogeneous information network according to the meta-path and a random walk strategy, inputting similar users into the heterogeneous information network, extracting potential features of a cold start user source domain, and obtaining a user-project interaction feature matrix by using the features; s3, locally constructing and training a federated learning model, specifically, recognizing a user-project interaction feature matrix by adopting a CNN (Convolutional Neural Network), then encrypting and exchanging an intermediate result by adopting federated learning in combination with homomorphic encryption, and optimizing an encrypted target by adopting a gradient descent algorithm; and finally updating the gradient and loss function of the model. And S4, utilizing the trained local federal learning model to generate an accurate recommendation result for the user.

title: Method and device for acquiring wind speed predicted value, terminal equipment and computer medium
abstract: The invention discloses a wind speed predicted value obtaining method and device, terminal equipment and a computer medium, and relates to the technical field of wind power generation, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a to-be-measured wind speed sequence, and carrying out the mode decomposition of the to-be-measured wind speed sequence, and obtaining all sub-wind speed sequences; determining an eigenmode function contained in each sub-wind speed sequence, obtaining each stationary sub-wind speed sequence based on each eigenmode function, and calculating each stationary sub-wind speed sequence through a wind speed regression model to obtain a first prediction result corresponding to each sub-wind speed sequence; determining a residual error sequence contained in each sub-wind speed sequence, extracting effective information contained in each residual error sequence through a least square support vector machine model, and obtaining a second prediction result corresponding to each sub-wind speed sequence based on each effective information; and integrating the first prediction results and the second prediction results corresponding to the sub-wind speed sequences to obtain sub-prediction results, and integrating the sub-prediction results to obtain a target wind speed prediction value.

title: Image deblurring method based on multi-scale cross attention and related device
abstract: The invention provides an image deblurring method based on multi-scale cross attention and a related device, and the method comprises the steps: taking a fuzzy APS image and a corresponding event image as the input of a multi-scale cross attention network, and carrying out the feature extraction and fusion through employing a plurality of feature extraction and fusion networks of different scales in sequence; performing up-sampling on APS feature maps respectively output by the deepest feature extraction and fusion network and the adjacent feature extraction and fusion network, and then performing up-sampling on APS feature maps respectively output by the up-sampling module of the next scale and the feature extraction and fusion network of the previous scale by using the up-sampling module of the middle scale; and performing up-sampling on the fuzzy APS image and the APS feature map output by the up-sampling module of the next scale by using the up-sampling module of the shallowest layer, and outputting a clear APS image. According to the method, the EVS image information is adopted to guide the deblurring processing of the APS image, the EVS image can provide richer motion information, and the deblurring processing effect of the APS image can be effectively improved.

abstract: The invention provides an online graphic homework automatic correction method based on an intelligent algorithm, and the method comprises the steps: enabling a student to complete and submit an online graphic homework, and enabling a system to arrange the homework according to the submission time sequence; based on computer vision, original analysis is carried out on the work, and based on the computer vision, original analysis is carried out on the work; if the homework does not have the plagiarism possibility, performing intelligent scoring on the homework based on a deep neural network model; if the homework has plagiarism possibility, judging original homework and plagiarism homework; adjusting the deep neural network model, and performing score adjustment on the plagiarism work and the original work; and respectively sending targeted reminding information to the original creator and the plagiarism person. abstract: The invention provides a receipt image information extraction method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium. title: New energy partition layout optimization method considering space-time characteristics
abstract: The invention relates to a new energy partition layout optimization method considering space-time characteristics, and the method comprises the steps: building a space-time characteristic representation model of each partition, and taking a photovoltaic output average value in each time period of a typical month as an integral point equivalent output; establishing a new energy partition layout optimization model considering time-space characteristics, wherein constraint conditions comprise a new energy scale constraint, a power abandoning rate constraint, a power balance constraint, an inter-partition tie line power constraint and a unit output constraint; the objective function is that the equivalent annual investment return rate of the newly added wind power and photovoltaic power generation installed capacity is maximum; and solving the new energy partition layout optimization model considering the space-time characteristics by adopting a genetic algorithm, and outputting a newly-added partition photovoltaic capacity, a newly-added partition wind power capacity and a newly-added wind and light space layout. title: Signal lightweight automatic modulation identification method and system based on deep learning
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of signal processing, in particular to a signal lightweight automatic modulation identification method and system based on deep learning, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a sample data set comprising a plurality of digital modulation modes and a plurality of analog modulation modes through simulating a real communication environment modulation information sequence; constructing a lightweight dense convolutional long-short term memory network structure based on a lightweight convolutional network, and training and optimizing the lightweight dense convolutional long-short term memory network structure by using a sample data set; establishing a signal modulation identification model based on the trained and optimized lightweight dense convolution long-short term memory network structure; and inputting a to-be-identified target signal into the signal modulation identification model, and obtaining a modulation mode of the to-be-identified target signal by using the signal modulation identification model. abstract: The invention discloses a semi-supervised short video classification method based on semantic consistency, and the method comprises the steps: respectively extracting key frames from labeled data and unlabeled data at equal time intervals T by taking t0 and t0 + tau frames as starting points through the correlation of adjacent frames of a video, obtaining two frame sequences, and respectively carrying out the strong data enhancement and standard data enhancement; building a neural network composed of a spatial feature learning module, a time attention fusion module and a classifier module; splicing the same number of labeled samples and unlabeled samples after standard data enhancement, inputting the spliced samples into a neural network, and calculating classification loss of labeled parts; splicing the same number of labeled samples and unlabeled samples after strong data enhancement, inputting the spliced samples into a neural network to obtain prediction output, and performing enhancement processing on two different data of the same sample, inputting the data into the network to obtain prediction distribution, and calculating consistency loss; the classification loss and the consistency loss are jointly used for optimization training of the neural network; and inputting a video sample into the optimized neural network, and outputting a corresponding prediction score to obtain a final video classification result.

title: Computer vision-based hoisting safety monitoring method for large prefabricated parts of full-fabricated subway station
abstract: The invention provides a computer vision-based hoisting safety monitoring method for large prefabricated parts of a full-fabricated subway station, and belongs to the technical field of hoisting of subway parts. The problems that when an existing subway prefabricated part is installed, if the placing position is incorrect or a hoisted target falls off, buckling or collapse of the assembled prefabricated part is easily caused, and a hoisting monitoring method is lacked to reduce the safety risk are solved. According to the method, computer vision and artificial intelligence technologies are utilized, a technical means is divided into three parts, namely, weight identification, weight tracking and division of an assembled prefabricated part area, and according to multiple test results, the average accuracy rate of the weight identification part is up to 98.15%; the influence of complex background factors is overcome in the aspects of heavy object tracking and area division of the assembled prefabricated parts, and accurate tracking and recognition effects are achieved; the lifting position of the material can be judged, and once safety risks exist, a tower crane operator can be reminded to timely stop operation before the material falls to the ground, so that safety is guaranteed.

abstract: The invention discloses an abnormal data identification method and device of a generator set, and electronic equipment. title: Sensor optimization arrangement method and system considering damage degree of metal structure
abstract: The invention discloses a sensor optimization arrangement method and system considering the damage degree of a metal structure, and the method comprises the steps: comparing the difference between dynamic response physical data and dynamic response simulation data, and updating the parameters of an original finite element model through employing a Markov chain Monte Carlo Bayesian updating method, when the difference between the dynamic response physical data and the dynamic response simulation data is smaller than a set value, obtaining an updated first finite element model; analyzing the first finite element model to extract a node modal formation result, setting a sensor distribution scheme by using an effective independence method, and screening an optimal arrangement scheme in combination with a deep neural network algorithm and a modal confidence theory; and analyzing the rationality of sensor optimization arrangement according to the constructed comprehensive evaluation index. abstract: The invention discloses a quantum random number generation system and method based on amplified spontaneous emission, and relates to the field of quantum random numbers, the system comprises a light sending module and a light acquisition module, the light sending module comprises a light preparation unit and a connection unit, and the light acquisition module comprises a signal acquisition unit and a data processing unit. title: Undercarriage load prediction method based on test flight data
abstract: The invention discloses an undercarriage load prediction method based on test flight data, and relates to the technical field of machine learning, and the method comprises the following steps: collecting a plurality of pieces of test flight data; performing transverse analysis on the plurality of test flight data to obtain low-credibility data and high-credibility data; performing longitudinal analysis on the low-credibility data and the high-credibility data to obtain optimized low-credibility data and optimized high-credibility data; constructing a low-credibility neural network prediction model according to the optimized low-credibility data; migrating network parameters of the low-credibility neural network prediction model based on a parameter migration method; constructing a high-credibility neural network prediction model according to the optimized high-credibility data and the migrated network parameters; and predicting the aircraft landing gear load in the actual flight process according to the high-credibility neural network prediction model. title: Gaussian plume gas concentration prediction method based on particle swarm optimization
abstract: The invention discloses a Gaussian plume gas concentration prediction method based on a particle swarm algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of pollution gas diffusion simulation and concentration prediction. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a Gaussian diffusion model, inputting ground condition data of a to-be-detected position, obtaining a default value of a diffusion coefficient, and calculating a simulated gas concentration; operating the artificial wind field and the source emission equipment, and acquiring the actually measured gas concentration through the field monitoring equipment; comparing the actually measured gas concentration with the simulated gas concentration, and solving an optimal diffusion coefficient parameter through an ion swarm algorithm; and updating the diffusion coefficient, and performing gas concentration prediction on the to-be-detected position. According to the method, on the practical application level, real-time actual measurement data are obtained, the default diffusion parameters of the model are further calibrated, the calibrated gas diffusion parameters are used for predicting the gas concentration of the wind field, and the obtained prediction result is more accurate and reliable; meanwhile, the particle swarm optimization is used for parameter calibration and data calibration, and the whole process is more automatic and convenient.

title: Double-line personalized recommendation method based on data center
abstract: The invention discloses a double-line personalized recommendation method based on a data center. The method comprises the following steps: collecting user data; collecting personal initial information and preference initial information of a user; acquiring user browsing information; acquiring an offline activity range of the user as mutual complementation of dynamic information and static information; the basic information of the user is collected and classified, and a decision tree model is utilized to obtain group features of the user information; the user preference is judged by recording the activity track, the staying duration and the route of the offline user; acquiring online browsing records of the user as preference tendencies of the user; a GCN4RS graph convolution recommendation algorithm is adopted to realize recommendation; obtaining a prediction result; making a user analysis report through the embedding vector of the user and the commodity; and description and prediction of a recommendation result are made through a user demand analysis report. abstract: The invention discloses an ultra-wavelet-based bearing fault diagnosis method and system, and a storage medium. title: Construction method of WiFi gesture increment recognition system based on continuous learning

title: Work performance evaluation method, system and device based on intelligent algorithm
abstract: The invention provides a work performance evaluation method, system and device based on an intelligent algorithm. The method comprises the steps of collecting historical work efficiency data of employees; training the working efficiency data by using the model to count the working efficiency of the employees under the influence of different environments as an evaluation reference; obtaining current to-be-evaluated working efficiency data of the employee, hiding performance data included in the working efficiency data, and inputting the hidden working efficiency data into the model to predict performance data of the employee under the influence of the corresponding environment, and taking the performance data as an observation value; and recovering performance data included in the working efficiency data to serve as an actual value, comparing the observed value with the actual value, and taking a difference value as an adjustment reference to adjust the actual value, thereby finally obtaining a performance evaluation result of the employee. title: Space-time deep learning for behavioral bioassays
abstract: A behavioral biometric deep learning (BBDL) pipeline is provided that includes a plurality of stages of a machine learning computer model that operates to provide a behavioral biometric-based authenticator that operates based on spatio-temporal input data. The BBDL pipeline receives spatio-temporal input data over a plurality of time intervals, each time interval having a corresponding subset of spatio-temporal input data. For each time interval, a machine learning computer model of a corresponding stage processes a subset of the spatio-temporal input data corresponding to that time interval to generate an output vector having a value indicative of an internal representation of spatio-temporal characteristics of an entity. The output vectors are accumulated across the plurality of stages of the BBDL pipeline to generate a final output vector indicating spatio-temporal characteristics of entities represented in the spatio-temporal input data. The entity is authenticated based on the final output vector.

title: Visual Transform model integrity verification method based on fragile fingerprints

title: Method and device for evaluating rotary table measurement rotation reference angle swing error based on deep belief network
abstract: The invention discloses a deep belief network-based rotary table measurement rotary reference angle swing error evaluation method and device, belongs to the field of rotary table error measurement of an aero-engine single-column ultra-precision measurement instrument, and solves the problem that the rotary table measurement precision is not high due to the influence of a rotary reference angle swing error. The method comprises the following steps: initializing processing error prediction network parameters to obtain a training sample; carrying out independent training on each RBM, and stacking all the trained RBMs together to obtain a pre-trained DBN structure and a pre-trained DBN-DNN structure; supervised fine tuning is carried out; the weight threshold values of the DBN structure and the BP network are continuously updated until the maximum number of iterations is reached, and a processed training sample is obtained; and predicting the test sample, and completing the evaluation of the rotary table measurement rotation reference angle swing error based on the deep belief network. The method is used for evaluating the rotary table measurement rotation reference angle swing error, and the rotary table measurement precision is improved.

title: Tourism package recommendation method and device based on multi-objective group optimization and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a tourism package recommendation method and device based on multi-objective group optimization and a storage medium. According to the method, the economic loss caused by package return due to the fact that inventory resources cannot be reserved is avoided by achieving supplier inventory grading. In the invention, the fixed reserved inventory is used as the highest priority, namely, the weight can be adjusted, and the inventory is used as a label parameter and is endowed with a high weight. And performing multi-factor optimization modeling by using an intelligent optimization algorithm and taking loss minimization as an optimization target. Meanwhile, an artificial intelligence method is adopted to correct the weight of each parameter of the cross-business products, and finally the sorting result of the packaged products is optimized.

title: Four-dimensional CT image reconstruction method and device, medical equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of imaging, in particular to a four-dimensional CT image reconstruction method and device, medical equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining projection data of to-be-reconstructed four-dimensional electronic computed tomography (CT); extracting time coordinates and space coordinates of a target in the projection data of the to-be-reconstructed four-dimensional CT; the time coordinates and the space coordinates are input into a pre-constructed reconstruction model, a reconstruction image of the to-be-reconstructed four-dimensional CT is output, the reconstruction model comprises a motion field INR composed of implicit neural representation INR and a static template image INR, the motion field INR generates deformation motion offset and space-time coupling features according to the time coordinates and the space coordinates, and the static template image INR generates the deformation motion offset and the space-time coupling features according to the deformation motion offset and the space-time coupling features. And performing image reconstruction on the static template image INR according to the space coordinates and/or the space-time coupling characteristics after deformation motion offset to obtain a reconstructed image of the to-be-reconstructed four-dimensional CT. Therefore, the problems that a reconstruction model is poor in learning ability for high-resolution data, finite angle reconstruction is ill-conditioned, the application scene of the reconstruction model is narrow and the like are solved.

title: Goods self-identification automatic delivery control method
abstract: The invention discloses a cargo self-identification automatic delivery control method, which comprises the steps of obtaining user order information, and determining the number of order products based on the user order information; whether the shipped product is correct or not is determined based on a code scanning device arranged on the holder device, and if yes, the product is automatically controlled to be taken to the holder device; when the order information comprises at least two products, the holder equipment sequentially moves to the positions of the remaining products of the order, and the remaining products are taken; and the holder equipment stops taking the goods and moves towards the goods outlet until the products are unloaded at the goods outlet. According to the technical scheme, the code scanning device is used for checking the shipment products, it is guaranteed that the products on the order are consistent with the shipment products, when multiple products exist in the order, all the products can be directly taken out to the holder device, after the products are taken out, all the products in the order are transported to the shipment port in a unified mode through the holder device, and the shipment efficiency is improved.

title: Central air conditioner non-inductive automatic decision-making method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a central air conditioner non-inductive automatic decision-making method based on deep reinforcement learning, and belongs to the technical field of power system demand response, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a central air conditioner user participation demand response willingness model influenced by multiple factors; according to the willingness of the user, the real-time non-inductive comfort degree range of the corresponding user and the actual electricity price of the user are determined in combination with a central air conditioner user participation demand response willingness model; and in combination with the non-inductive comfort degree range and the actual electricity price of the user, an intelligent decision-making model of the central air conditioner system user based on the Markov decision-making process is constructed, neural network training is carried out, and the intelligent decision-making model outputs an intelligent decision of the central air conditioner. Therefore, the equipment control problem of user-side distributed resource local consumption can be well solved, the willingness of different users participating in demand response is considered, the user non-inductive range is determined, and the defects that the automation degree of demand-side central air conditioner resource decision making is not high, and the enthusiasm of the users participating in the demand response is not enough are effectively overcome.

title: Log pre-analysis and transaction management method for relieving lock conflict
abstract: A log pre-analysis and transaction management method for relieving lock conflicts comprises the steps that logic analysis is conducted on transactions based on offline transaction logs, and a transaction construction prediction model of all transactions in a database is determined; determining hot data information based on the heat statistical information of the data required to be called during transaction execution, wherein the hot data information is the information of the data of which the database calling frequency reaches a preset threshold value; and based on the hot data information and the transaction, constructing a prediction model, and determining a scheduling strategy of a current transaction data lock. Data tuples to be accessed by subsequent operations are predicted by constructing a prediction map based on a Markov model. Then, the graph information is combined with algorithms such as the shortest path, the topological sorting and the critical path of the graph theory and combined with a used transaction scheduling strategy to judge whether the transaction needs to be delayed to obtain a lock to schedule the transaction, so that the performance loss caused by a large number of lock conflicts is avoided.
