abstract: The invention provides an auditing method and system based on a big language generative model and an auditing robot, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the index storage of obtained auditing knowledge data, and obtaining an es retrieval library; based on the es retrieval library, performing retrieval analysis on a retrieval problem to obtain prompt information; performing data identification on the prompt information by utilizing a pre-trained auditing big language model to obtain an answer corresponding to the retrieval question; wherein the auditing big language model is constructed on the basis of a BLOOM-7B model; according to the method, a neural network-based generative model is adopted, so that information in multiple aspects such as financial data, audit reports and company management activities can be analyzed and processed, and real-time and accurate suggestions and solutions are provided for auditing personnel.

title: Failure evaluation method, system and equipment for spiking neural network circuit
abstract: The invention discloses a failure assessment method, system and equipment for a spiking neural network circuit, and relates to the technical field of spiking neural network circuits, and the method comprises the steps: injecting a preset fault into a spiking neural network unit of the spiking neural network circuit, changing the stability of the spiking neural network circuit, and obtaining a fault spiking neural network circuit, according to a preset sample set, calculating first accuracy of a spiking neural network of a spiking neural network circuit deployed before the injection fault and second accuracy of a spiking neural network of a fault spiking neural network circuit after the injection fault; and finally, optimizing the spiking neural network circuit based on the first accuracy, the second accuracy and a preset optimization strategy. title: Fusion prediction method and device for short-term wind speed of wind power plant
abstract: The invention provides a short-term wind speed fusion prediction method and device for a wind power plant. The method comprises the following steps: making an ensemble forecast data set ENS0 for wind energy meteorology; selecting a medium time window W0 according to an atmospheric convection state index I0 of the ensemble forecast data set ENS0; traversing and optimizing to obtain a historical data set D100 corresponding to the medium time window W0; and utilizing the historical data set D100 to optimize and correct wind energy meteorological data of future forecast and performing power prediction. According to the method, the numerical prediction correction effect in extreme weather scenes such as severe convection can be effectively optimized, and the precision of photovoltaic or wind power prediction taking a corrected meteorological source as input is further improved.

title: Hydrological element evolution characteristic and runoff change attribution analysis method in changing environment
abstract: The invention discloses a hydrological element evolution characteristic and runoff change attribution analysis method in a changing environment, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, selecting a monitoring region, and collecting actually measured hydrological data in the region; s2, rainfall data are acquired, and precision evaluation and correction are carried out by using actually measured hydrological data; s3, analyzing evolution characteristics of precipitation and runoff by using a fusion algorithm method; and S4, performing attribution analysis on the runoff change of the monitoring area according to an analysis result. According to the method, the trend and the mutation point of the hydrological sequence are comprehensively determined by utilizing various trend test methods and mutation test methods by relying on the test of the trend and the mutation point of the hydrological sequence, so that the reliability of a test result is improved; and meanwhile, climate factors causing runoff changes are analyzed from multiple angles, so that the hydrological prediction efficiency is improved.

title: Flexible puncture needle path planning method based on improved Bi-RRT algorithm
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent medical auxiliary robot control, in particular to a flexible puncture needle path planning method based on an improved Bi-RRT algorithm, and the algorithm comprises the following steps: obtaining environment information of a focus part through medical imaging equipment; establishing a puncture path model of the flexible needle; the radius of an obstacle in the environment is enlarged to be 1.5 times of the original radius, and a safe distance is reserved; a target bias strategy is introduced, and a confluence point is searched based on the target bias strategy; pre-growing to shorten the tree building distance; rapidly expanding from a starting point and a target point to a convergence point direction, and simultaneously avoiding obstacles; when the distance between the newest extension node and the convergence point is smaller than a threshold value, the convergence point is considered to be reached, and tree building is completed; removing redundant nodes on the path; carrying out smoothing processing on the new path; the target bias strategy and the rapid expansion strategy are introduced, the calculation amount and calculation complexity are reduced, the convergence speed is increased, the path planning efficiency is improved, and the planning path capable of being applied to flexible needle puncture is obtained according to the constraint condition of the puncture path model.

title: Method, device and equipment for putting robot role in game and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a robot role putting method and device in a game, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of games. The method comprises the following steps: determining a target game role; obtaining a first game starting position of the target game role in the game scene, and determining at least one second game starting position in the game scene based on the first game starting position; based on the first game starting position and a pre-trained path decision model, calculating a first game route of the target game role in the game scene; predicting at least one second game route in the game scene based on the at least one second game starting position and a path decision model; and determining at least one putting position from the at least one second game starting position based on the first game route and the second game route so as to put the at least one robot role at the putting position. title: Network planning method based on knowledge graph and graph neural network and related equipment thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a network planning method and device based on a knowledge graph and a graph neural network, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: determining a plurality of site selection schemes of candidate sites; determining a network planning knowledge graph of a target evaluation area corresponding to the plurality of site selection schemes; and obtaining semantic information and structural information in a preset area corresponding to a candidate site, performing completion processing on the network planning knowledge graph based on the semantic information and the structural information by using a preset graph neural network model, and determining a target candidate site from the plurality of site selection schemes. title: Frank-Wolfe-based image confrontation sample defense method and system
abstract: The invention discloses an image confrontation sample defense method and system based on Frank-Wolfe. The method comprises the following steps: (1) data collection and cleaning; (2) constructing a neural network model; (3) based on the original image, using Frank-Wolfe and a dichotomy algorithm to generate an initial confrontation sample; (4) finely searching a confrontation sample boundary by using a Frank-Wolfe algorithm; and (5) training the generated adversarial sample to the model to improve the robustness of the model. The invention designs an image confrontation sample defense method based on Frank-Wolfe. According to the core idea of the technology, the number of iterations needing to initialize a small adversarial sample is reduced through a dichotomy algorithm and a Frank-Wolfe algorithm, and further search is carried out on the generated adversarial sample based on the Frank-Wolfe algorithm to achieve the effect of reducing the norm of the adversarial sample, so that the number of times and efficiency of generating the adversarial sample are optimized. According to the method, the norm of the generative adversarial sample is small, the generation efficiency is high, and a good foundation is laid for constructing a more robust image classification system.

title: Rumor detection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the field of data processing, and discloses a rumor detection method, which comprises the following steps of: performing vector extraction on first sub-data of an event to be identified by utilizing a first module to obtain a text vector, and performing vector extraction on a timestamp to obtain a time vector; splicing the text vector and the time vector to obtain a time text vector sequence of the first sub-data, and inputting the time text vector sequence into a long and short term memory layer for processing to obtain a first state sequence vector; calculating a first implicit vector of the first state sequence vector by using a second module to obtain a classification value of the first sub-data; and if the classification value is judged to be a first preset numerical value, inputting the first state sequence vector into a third module for classification to obtain a classification result. The invention further provides a rumor detection device, electronic equipment and a storage medium. In the financial science and technology field, the propagation event in the early propagation stage can be effectively identified.

title: Multitask neural network model performance prediction method based on Gaussian process
abstract: According to the Gaussian process-based multi-task neural network model performance prediction method provided by the invention, the model performance of the neural network can be accurately and quickly evaluated without training the neural network to be tested. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, extracting main parameters influencing performance of a neural network model: network depth, the number of self-attention heads, an expansion coefficient of a forward calculation network and a change range; quantizing the parameters, splicing the quantized parameters into a vector, and adding a position code representing position information into the vector to obtain a neural network coding vector; selecting a Gaussian process as a regression model, and performing iterative optimization on the Gaussian process regression model according to a designed kernel function for accurately representing the distance between different neural network models; for multiple tasks, integrating a single-task Gaussian process into a multi-task Gaussian process model to obtain a multi-task model; and calculating a combination mode of different multi-task models, and carrying out integrated learning on the models with the performance ranked in the first three to obtain a final model for predicting the performance.

title: High-order PAM signal pre-distortion method based on neural network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of optical communication systems and high-speed optical signal processing, in particular to a high-order PAM (Pulse Amplitude Modulation) signal pre-distortion method based on a neural network. A neural network is utilized to learn a complex function relationship between a distortion value and a mode from a sample, and a complete mode error space can be constructed only by using a small number of samples. A sending symbol sequence is firstly selected by a sliding window with the length of 2 + 1 and serves as input of a neural network, output of the neural network is a corresponding mode error, and pre-distortion operation is completed by subtracting the error from a center symbol, namely the (l + 1) th symbol. According to the invention, a sample-based training method is adopted, so that the transceiver does not need to be accurately modeled; the mode length is expanded at the cost of a small amount of calculation so as to obtain greater performance improvement; in the training process, the errors of all modes do not need to be counted firstly, only part of samples are needed, and the training difficulty is reduced.

title: Multi-operation mode of neural engine circuit
abstract: Embodiments relate to a neural engine circuit of a neural network processor circuit that performs convolution operations on input data in a first mode and parallel ordering operations on the input data in a second mode. The neural engine circuit includes a plurality of operational circuits and an accumulator circuit coupled to the plurality of operational circuits. The plurality of operational circuits receive input data. In the first mode, the plurality of operational circuits perform a convolutional multiply-add operation on the input data using a kernel. In the second mode, the plurality of operational circuits perform a portion of a parallel sorting operation on the input data. In the first mode, the accumulator circuit receives and stores a first result of the multiply-add operation. In the second mode, the accumulator circuit receives and stores a second result of the parallel sorting operation.

title: Virtual sample generation method based on fault mechanism of wind turbine generator
abstract: The invention relates to a virtual sample generation method based on a wind turbine generator fault mechanism, and the method comprises the steps: collecting a wind power gear box fault signal when a wind power gear box has a fault, and generating a wind power gear box fault mechanism feature; performing signal decomposition on the fault mechanism characteristics of the wind power gear box, and performing decoupling to generate sub-signals of different scales; generating virtual sub-signals according to the sub-signals of different scales; and reconstructing the virtual sub-signal into a virtual sample. According to the method, the multi-source and multi-scale fault signals with different physical meanings and time scales in the state signals of the wind power gear box are collected, the adaptive signal decomposition technology is used, interference signals in the fault signals are effectively separated, the generated virtual sample can effectively represent the fault state of the fan from multiple dimensions, and the fault detection accuracy is improved. And then multi-dimensional information is fused again to generate a virtual sample, a virtual training sample is generated from a given small-scale real training sample, and the problems of lack of coverage of multiple working conditions, shortage and incomplete samples in a parameter modeling process are solved.

title: Image processing method and device and related equipment
abstract: The invention provides an image processing method and device and related equipment, and relates to the technical field of image processing. title: Video coding method, device and system
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a video coding method. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target video file; detecting scene switching in the target video file, and segmenting the target video file into a plurality of scene segments of single scenes according to a detection result; a pre-trained first neural network model is utilized to predict the optimal first coding resolution and the optimal first coding parameter of each scene segment, and the first coding parameter corresponds to the first coding resolution; the first neural network model is used for predicting the first coding resolution and the first coding parameter according to the image quality and the code rate of the scene fragment coding; and coding the corresponding scene segment according to the first coding resolution and the first coding parameter corresponding to each scene segment. title: Air pollution monitoring system based on atmospheric diffusion mechanism and monitoring method thereof
abstract: The invention provides an air pollution monitoring system based on an atmospheric diffusion mechanism and a monitoring method thereof. abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of information processing and communication, and particularly relates to an unmanned aerial vehicle navigation algorithm based on an NARX neural network assisted NASRUKF algorithm. The algorithm comprehensively considers the rules of speed change and position change in the flight process of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the problems possibly encountered when the algorithm is applied to actual engineering, and when a BDS signal fails, the NARX network predicts the speed and position increment information of the BDS through the calculation information of an inertial navigation system (INS). title: Dynamic SLAM dense map construction method based on pyramid L-K optical flow and multi-view geometric constraint
abstract: The invention discloses a dynamic SLAM dense map construction method based on pyramid L-K optical flow and multi-view geometric constraints. abstract: The invention discloses a picture recognition method based on a brain-like learning algorithm, which comprises the following steps of: training a picture encoder by using a brain-like learning algorithm combined with frequency induction, converting a picture into a pulse sequence by using the trained picture encoder, training a recognition layer by using a brain-like supervised learning algorithm, and outputting a recognition result by the recognition layer. abstract: The invention discloses an infrared image noise reduction method and system based on a time-space domain. title: Construction method of high-accuracy straw enzymolysis polysaccharide yield prediction model
abstract: The invention discloses a construction method of a high-accuracy straw enzymolysis polysaccharide yield prediction model, which comprises the following steps: collecting a data set, and preprocessing the data set to obtain a machine data set; constructing an extreme gradient boosting model, and inputting the data set into the extreme gradient boosting model for training to obtain a prediction model; constructing a neural network model, and inputting the deep neural network data set into the neural network model for training to obtain a deep neural network enzymolysis polysaccharide yield prediction model; and predicting the yield of the straw enzymolysis polysaccharide based on the prediction model. abstract: The invention discloses a semi-supervised medical volume segmentation method based on a cyclic variation pseudo tag, and the algorithm adopted in the method gives a brand new semi-supervised medical volume segmentation architecture: taking a segmentation threshold as a hidden variable, constructing a deep Bayesian network to carry out the variation inference; potential information in the label-free data is mined to obtain a more reliable variational pseudo label; according to the low-entropy prediction method, two parallel heterogeneous segmentation networks are utilized to provide model-level disturbance to construct an additional correction signal, cyclic supervision is performed by utilizing variational pseudo labels generated by each other in one iteration, respective cognitive deviations are corrected, and the two networks are guided to make consistent low-entropy prediction, so that the low-entropy prediction method has the advantages that only a very small amount of annotation data is needed, and the low-entropy prediction efficiency is improved. title: COVID-19 focus prediction system based on smart contract and self-attention
abstract: The invention discloses a COVID-19 focus prediction system based on contract sharing and self-attention. The system comprises a medical record encryption module, a focus segmentation module based on an attention mechanism, a focus prediction module, a combined scoring module and an authority control module. The focus segmentation and prediction module is composed of a convolution operation unit, an attention calculation unit, a pooling unit, a pixel fusion unit and a small classification module. In order to realize a high-precision segmentation task of an image, the system adopts a U-Net deep learning network architecture based on a SwinT block. The SwinT block is a multi-scale window interactive attention mechanism, image features are segmented into different windows, and interaction is carried out among the windows by using a self-attention mechanism, so that features of different scales in an image are modeled better. According to the framework, the characteristics of the U-Net and the Swin Transform are combined, so that a more accurate result can be obtained during image segmentation and prediction, and the accuracy of predicting a COVID-19 focus by a system is improved.

abstract: The invention discloses a method for analyzing an influence mechanism of a mercury exposure health risk on an economic system, and the method comprises the steps: S1, collecting related data, including a food mercury concentration, per capita food consumption, and an urbanization rate; s2, evaluating the mercury exposure health risk according to the collected data; s3, constructing an intermediary effect model; s4, constructing a network for transmitting the mercury exposure health risk in the economic system based on the intermediary effect model; and S5, analyzing an influence mechanism of the mercury exposure health risk on the economic system by using the constructed network. abstract: The invention provides a wire ingot quality control method, device and equipment based on a knowledge graph. title: Poison gas sensor arrangement method based on mutual information
abstract: The invention discloses a poison gas sensor arrangement method based on mutual information, and belongs to the technical field of sensor arrangement for gas detection. According to the invention, mutual information is used as a measurement tool to measure the correlation between the concentration captured by a sensor at a certain place and a leakage source under the condition of leakage, the sensor is arranged at the place with the largest correlation, and on the premise, an improved gradient search algorithm is used to quickly search all sensor candidate positions. title: Method for training pruning based on target detection model
abstract: The invention discloses a training pruning method based on a target detection model. Two pruning modes are divided according to whether a training model exists or not. When a training model exists, a pruning form, namely a pruning unit, is selected according to set presetting to meet preset requirements. When the training model does not exist, training is carried out from the pruning form with the finest granularity, whether the requirement is met or not is judged, if not, pruning is carried out by continuously selecting the pruning form with the granularity larger than that of previous pruning, and pruning is stopped until the requirement is met. According to the method, the most suitable pruning form can be selected for the trained model to achieve effective pruning, pruning can be carried out on a network without a training model in the training process, and iteration pruning is carried out in a finer-grained pruning mode according to whether the set preset precision and the model size are achieved or not to obtain a fine pruned model. Different fine-grained pruning forms can be dynamically and selectively selected according to different application scenes and hardware requirements, so that the flexibility of model hardware deployment and higher pruning efficiency can be realized.

title: Method for constructing BPAs based on FME for bridge construction risk D-S evidence fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a method for constructing BPAs based on FME for bridge construction risk D-S evidence fusion. The method specifically comprises the following steps: S1, constructing BPAs based on FME; s11, collecting multi-source heterogeneous data information in bridge engineering construction; s12, storing and processing data in a building information model BIM, and identifying an influence factor C = {C1, C2,..., CN}; s13, constructing BPAs m (A) = {m1 (A), m2 (A),..., mN (A)} based on the fuzzification and membership function of FME; wherein m (A) is a value in an uncertain influence factor state and reflects the support degree of the evidence body to A; s2, fusing multi-source evidences; s3, evaluating the risk based on the BIM; s31, inputting the data subjected to multi-source data fusion into a BIM program for checking, and judging whether all evidences are fused or not; s32, if it is judged that all evidences are fused, fusion is finished, and a result is output; and if it is judged that all the evidences are not fused, returning to the step S2 to re-establish the evidence set, and performing secondary fusion until all the evidences are fused.

title: Small target identification method for overhead transmission line
abstract: The invention discloses an overhead transmission line small target identification method. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a wire target model based on a MobD-Yolov4 algorithm; acquiring a real-time to-be-detected image shot by the unmanned aerial vehicle; inputting a to-be-detected image into the target monitoring model to obtain a detection frame of the insulator in the image, and if the insulator target does not exist in the image, re-obtaining the real-time to-be-detected image for identification; performing overhead transmission line identification on the real-time image to obtain an overhead transmission line detection frame, and if no overhead transmission line target exists in the image, re-obtaining the real-time to-be-detected image for identification; and calculating a distance index between the overhead transmission line detection frame and the insulator detection frame, and if the distance index exceeds an index threshold value, re-acquiring the real-time to-be-detected image for identification. According to the method, the overhead transmission line can be accurately and rapidly identified, the calculated amount is small, and the purpose of rapidly and accurately identifying the overhead transmission line target on small mobile equipment and under the background of a complex environment condition can be achieved.

title: Selectively masking query content to be provided to secondary digital assistant
abstract: Systems and methods for obfuscating and/or omitting potentially sensitive information in spoken queries prior to providing the queries to an auxiliary automated assistant. The generic automated assistant may then be invoked by the user by the query. The audio data may be processed to omit and/or obfuscate potentially sensitive information prior to providing one or more processed queries to the secondary automation assistants based on trust metrics associated with each of the secondary automation assistants. A trust metric assisting the automation assistant represents trust for the provided sensitive information. In response, the automated assistant may generate a response, which may be filtered to provide the response to the user.

title: Memristor neural network weight training method
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of memristor neural network calculation, and particularly relates to a memristor neural network weight training method. After a neural network weight parameter is written into a memristor array, the conductivity value of the memristor is increased by delta G1 by applying a forward pulse to the memristor, and if the loss value of the inference process after modification is reduced compared with that before modification, the modification is stored; if the loss value generated in the reasoning process after the conductance value of the memristor is increased is increased compared with the loss value generated before modification, applying a reverse pulse to the memristor, so that the conductance value of the memristor is reduced by 2 delta G2; through such circulation, the weight precision obtained by training the target memristor is close to an ideal value in a successive approximation manner. According to the memristor neural network weight training method, the defect that the performance of the neural network is reduced after the neural network is transplanted to the memristor in an offline training mode in the prior art is effectively overcome, and the memristor neural network weight training rule provided by the invention is simple and easy to realize automation.

abstract: The invention proposes a surface defect image generative data enhancement method, and the method comprises the steps: building two confrontation models, namely a generative model and a discrimination model, enabling the two models to achieve the data distribution learning and alternate training of a surface defect image through a competition mechanism, and finally achieving the generative data enhancement of the surface defect image. Through surface defect image generation type data enhancement, the sample size of a training data set is increased, the feature expression of data is enriched, the problem of insufficient data size can be relieved for other subsequent deep learning tasks, and the generalization ability of the model is improved. title: Driver expression recognition method based on white whale optimization algorithm and transfer learning
abstract: The invention discloses a driver expression recognition method based on a white whale optimization algorithm and transfer learning. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a driver expression data set; performing image preprocessing on the driver expression data set; constructing a driver expression recognition model; pre-training an expression recognition model; performing fine adjustment on the driver expression recognition network after hyper-parameter optimization; wherein hyper-parameters of the expression recognition model are optimized by using a white whale optimization algorithm. According to the method, the hyper-parameter value suitable for driver expression recognition can be obtained in a relatively short time, the defects of reduced accuracy, slow training, even non-convergence of the model and the like caused by improper hyper-parameter selection of the convolutional neural network are effectively overcome, the performance of the driver expression recognition model is improved, and the driver expression recognition efficiency is improved. Therefore, safe and intelligent driving is guaranteed.

abstract: The invention discloses a system and a method for identifying foreign matters in a giant panda house, and relates to the technical field of mechanical image identification. title: Compressed domain multi-rate computer vision task neural network
abstract: In some examples, an apparatus for image/video processing includes processing circuitry. The processing circuit determines a value of a parameter for adjusting a compression ratio of a compressed image according to an encoded bitstream carrying the compressed image. A neural network-based encoder generates a compressed image from the value of the parameter. The processing circuitry inputs the values of the parameter into a multi-rate compressed domain computer vision task decoder, the multi-rate compressed domain computer vision task decoder comprising one or more neural networks for performing a computer vision task from a plurality of compressed images according to the respective values of the parameter, respective values of the parameter are used to generate a compressed image. abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of fault diagnosis, and discloses a bearing fault diagnosis method and system based on a multi-scale graph convolutional neural network, and the method comprises the steps: firstly extracting features of an original vibration signal under different scales, obtaining signal information with different receptive field ranges, then carrying out the composition under different scales, carrying out the single-scale graph convolution iteration, and carrying out the calculation of the single-scale graph convolution iteration; enhanced feature representation is obtained; secondly, splicing the signal information under each single scale to obtain a cross-scale graph model, and obtaining enhanced feature representation through a graph convolutional network; and finally, different features are forcibly used as priori by using Bayesian cross fusion to obtain final result information, and the final result information is input to a full connection layer for classification to obtain a fault classification result. abstract: The invention relates to a project scheme evaluation method and device, computer equipment and a storage medium. The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence. abstract: The invention discloses an integrated energy system fault diagnosis method and system based on a complex network model, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a power grid graph theory model and a gas network graph theory model based on a graph theory, constructing a coupling node model for a source-load type coupling node based on a dependent network, and connecting the power grid graph theory model with the gas network graph theory model through the coupling node model to form an integrated model; based on the comprehensive model, according to a topological structure of the coupled electrical comprehensive energy system, when the coupled electrical comprehensive energy system simultaneously meets a small world characteristic index and a scale-free characteristic index, a cascade failure process of the system is decomposed into a power grid failure process and a gas network failure process which are associated based on a coupled node model; and the cascade failure fault of the coupling electrical integrated energy system is diagnosed and positioned by alternately analyzing the power grid failure process and the gas grid failure process. According to the method, the complexity of the integrated energy system is fully considered, and accurate cascade failure fault diagnosis is carried out on the integrated energy system based on multiple characteristic criteria of the complex network model.

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of convolutional neural networks, in particular to an automatic pruning method based on dynamic sparse training, which comprises the following steps of: adopting a conventional convolutional neural network as an initialization network of electrocardiogram classification, and changing the final classification into 8; randomly initializing the network; random rarefaction with the sparse ratio of 0.5 is carried out on the network; preparing a training set, a verification set and a test set, and setting related parameters of training; updating the weight every 5 epochs by adopting an importance standard of a weight absolute value; the automatic pruning method based on dynamic sparse training provided by the invention has the beneficial effects that the electrocardiogram monitoring equipment is designed into small edge equipment, so that real-time monitoring and data analysis can be carried out beside a patient. title: Multi-temporal accumulated snow remote sensing image matching method and system based on image conversion
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-temporal snow remote sensing image matching method and system based on an image conversion technology. The method relates to the technical field of image processing, and comprises the following steps: firstly, converting a remote sensing image covered by accumulated snow into a remote sensing image without accumulated snow by using an image conversion technology; secondly, performing feature detection and feature extraction on the two pictures without snow coverage through a trained network; then, carrying out a corresponding matching task; and finally, mapping a matched coordinate result to the remote sensing image with snow and the remote sensing image without snow. According to the method, the influence of large-area accumulated snow on the image matching task is solved, and the feature difference between the two images to be matched is reduced by converting and generating the remote sensing image without accumulated snow, so that the matching effect is improved.

title: Urban road congestion space-time prediction method based on graph process neural network
abstract: The invention discloses an urban road congestion space-time prediction method based on a graph process neural network. Road network diagram structure information is embedded into a time point process model to form a scale value space-time diagram process neural network model, so that the time point process model not only can capture dependency of events on time, but also can capture remote space correlation information between urban road network congestion events, and therefore, the time point process model can be applied to urban road network congestion events. The urban road congestion prediction method has the advantages of improving the accuracy, stability and prediction efficiency of urban road congestion prediction.

title: Document conversion method and system fusing super-resolution reconstruction and deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a document conversion method and system fusing super-resolution reconstruction and deep learning, and relates to the field of pattern recognition. The method comprises the following steps: respectively extracting a sample PDF file and a picture in a PDF to be converted, and carrying out super-resolution reconstruction on the picture; marking noise information in the sample PDF picture, constructing a target detection data set, and training a deep learning model by using the data set; predicting and reasoning the picture of the to-be-converted PDF file by using the deep learning model, and removing noise information; and processing the picture of the to-be-converted PDF file based on the inference acceleration technology of the deep neural network, performing ORC mode recognition, extracting character and table features, and obtaining a format conversion result. abstract: The invention provides a camera occlusion determination method capable of quantitative calculation, and the method comprises the steps: converting a color image into a gray image, segmenting the gray image into a plurality of sub-images, respectively calculating the mean value and mean square error of each sub-image, and carrying out the normalization, on one hand, enabling a user-defined operator to act on each normalized sub-image, obtaining the edge image of each sub-image, and calculating the mean value of each sub-image; on the other hand, the optimized two-dimensional entropy of each normalized sub-graph is solved, a consistency index is obtained by combining the normalized sub-graphs with the optimized two-dimensional entropy, and a small-size index matrix is obtained according to the consistency index. title: Method for generating predicted performance data for controlling or monitoring production process
abstract: The invention relates to a method for generating predicted performance data for controlling or monitoring a production process. Contextual data associated with an operation of the production process is obtained. Metrology/testing is performed on the product of the production process, thereby obtaining performance data. A context-to-performance model is provided to generate predicted performance data based on tagging the context data with performance data. This is an example of semi-supervised learning. abstract: The invention discloses a method and a system for generating a data model search analysis text. The method comprises retraining the pre-trained object classifier with at least some of the annotated instances of the tracked object.

title: Image upsampling using one or more neural networks
abstract: Apparatuses, systems, and techniques are presented to reconstruct one or more images. In at least one embodiment, one or more neural networks are used to upsample one or more images based, at least in part, on one or more brightness values. The brightness values may include one or more exposure values calculated for at least a current input image of the one or more images. The one or more exposure values may be used to reduce a colour range of the current input image and a prior upsampled image of the one or more images. title: ALARMING METHOD FOR MICRO-SERVICE INDEX PREDICTION BASED ON CAUSALITY TEST
abstract: The present invention relates to an alarming method for micro-service index prediction based on a causality test, including causality discovery of service indexes based on a Granger causality test and multi-index prediction based on Attention Long Short-Term Memory (Attention LSTM). Indexes with causality with indexes to be predicted are found through the Granger causality test for jointly participating in the prediction, thus improving accuracy of the prediction. For relatively long index sequences in a micro-service scenario, there are often problems of partial causality between indexes and weak overall causality. The Granger causality test is improved, and the causality is incrementally calculated in segments. In practical applications, when new values are added to time sequences, only incremented causality is required to be calculated, and historical data are not required to be recalculated, thus reducing calculation amount, and improving efficiency of the causality discovery in the micro-service scenario.

title: Method and system for inspecting and scoring of vehicle transportation
abstract: The present invention is a method and a system for inspecting and scoring of a vehicle transportation. The system includes a cloud server for performing an intersection analysis, a speed analysis, and a smoothness analysis to generate key features, such as a non-stop rate at intersections, times of non-stop intersections, an average of minimum cornering speeds, a sharp deceleration duration, a rapid acceleration duration, an overspeed duration, an overspeed ratio, an average of maximum overspeeds, a rate of heavy accelerator pedaling, times of vehicle body tilting forward, times of vehicle body tilting backward, times of vehicle body rolling, and times of vehicle body vibrations. The cloud server further performs a supervised learning scoring process based on the key features to generate an audit score. Therefore, the present invention can provide a verified reference for a vehicle transport industry to manage drivers, for avoiding human subjective judgments, and auditing and evaluating drivers' driving behavior in an objective and efficient manner.

title: Dynamically optimizing decision tree inferences
abstract: A method of dynamically optimizing decision tree inference is provided. The method, which is performed at the computerized system, repeatedly executes one or more decision trees for inference purposes and repeatedly performs an optimization procedure according to two-phase cycles. Each cycle includes two alternating phases, i.e., a first phase followed by a second phase. The decision trees are executed based on a reference data structure, whereby attributes of nodes of the decision trees are repeatedly accessed from the reference data structure during the first phase of each of the cycles. First, the accessed attributes are monitored during the first phase of each cycle, which leads to update statistical characteristics of the nodes. Second, a substitute data structure is configured during the second phase of each cycle based on the updated statistical characteristics. Third, the reference data structure is updated in accordance with the substitute data structure.

title: Method for detecting if a machine learning model has been copied using intermediate outputs of the machine learning model
abstract: A method is provided for detecting copying of a machine learning model. In the method, the first machine learning model is divided into a plurality of portions. Intermediate outputs from a hidden layer of a selected one of the plurality of portions is compared to corresponding outputs from a second machine learning model to detect the copying. Alternately, a first seal may be generated using the plurality of inputs and the intermediate outputs from nodes of the selected portion. A second seal from a suspected copy that has been generated the same way is compared to the first seal to detect the copying. If the first and second seals are the same, then there is a high likelihood that the suspected copy is an actual copy. By using the method, only the intermediate outputs of the machine learning model outputs have to be disclosed to others, thus protecting the confidentiality of the model.

In certain embodiments, the method includes representing a clinical concern as a module of the knowledge graph. In some examples, the method includes associating at least one section node with the module, wherein each section node of the at least one section node corresponds to a clinical concept relevant to the clinical concern and associating at least one topic node with the at least one section node, wherein each topic node of the at least one topic node corresponds to a clinical topic relevant to the clinical concept. And, in certain embodiments the method includes outputting the knowledge graph of clinical information to semantically represent the relevant information from a clinical encounter associated with the clinical concern.

title: Preparation of qunaught states for a surface GKP code using a three (or higher) level ancilla system
abstract: A fault tolerant quantum error correction protocol is implemented for a surface code comprising Gottesman Kitaev Preskill (GKP) qubits. Analog information is determined when measuring position or momentum shifts, wherein the analog information indicates a closeness of the shift to a decision boundary. The analog information is further used to determine confidence values for error corrected measurements from the GKP qubits of the surface code. These confidence values are used to dynamically determine edge weights in a matching graph used to decode syndrome measurements of the surface code, wherein the confidence values are obtained using a maximum-likelihood decoding protocol for two-qubit gates. Also, a three-level ancilla is used to more reliably squeeze the GKP qunaught states.

abstract: Systems and methods for automatically detecting, classifying, and processing objects captured in an images or videos are provided. title: Abstract meaning representation parsing with graph translation
abstract: A computer-implemented method for generating an abstract meaning representation (“AMR”) of a sentence, comprising receiving, by a computing device, an input sentence and parsing the input sentence into one or more syntactic and/or semantic graphs. An input graph including a node set and an edge set is formed from the one or more syntactic and/or semantic graphs. Node representations are generated by natural language processing. The input graph is provided to a first neural network to provide an output graph having learned node representations aligned with the node representations in the input graph. The method further includes predicting via a second neural network, node label and predicting, via a third neural network, edge labels in the output graph. The AMR is generated based on the predicted node labels and predicted edge labels. A system and a non-transitory computer readable storage medium are also disclosed.

abstract: A video generation system is described that extracts one or more characters or other objects from a video, re-animates the character, and generates a new video in which the extracted characters. abstract: A system and method for automatically updating biometric data for a user by preferably retaining an ongoing digital collection of images/biometric captures/IOT (“Internet of Things”) captures taken over the life of the user. Changes in appearance of the user due to age, health, facial hair, hair color, hair length and many other evolutionary changes are automatically captured and contribute to the learning set. Preferably, with each new capture the oldest capture in the ongoing digital collection is automatically deleted by the system.

title: Silicon quantum device structures defined by metallic structures
abstract: A silicon-based quantum device is provided. The device comprises: a first metallic structure (501); a second metallic structure (502) laterally separated from the first metallic structure; and an L-shaped elongate channel (520) defined by the separation between the first and second metallic structures; wherein the elongate channel has a vertex (505) connecting two elongate parts of the elongate channel. The device further comprises: a third metallic structure (518), mediator gate, positioned in the elongate channel; a fourth metallic structure (531) forming a first barrier gate, arranged at a first end of the third metallic structure; and a fifth metallic structure (532) forming a second barrier gate arranged at a second end of the third metallic structure. The first, second, third, fourth and fifth metallic structures are configured for connection to first, second, third, fourth and fifth electric potentials respectively. The first, second, fourth and fifth electric potentials are controllable to define an electrical potential well to confine quantum charge carriers in an elongate quantum dot beneath the elongate channel. The fourth and fifth electric potentials and the position of the fourth and fifth metallic structures define first and second ends of the elongate channel respectively. The width of the electrical potential well is defined by the position of the first and second metallic structures and their corresponding electric potentials; and the length of the electrical potential well is defined by the position of the fourth and fifth metallic structures and their corresponding electric potentials. The third electric potential is controllable to adjust quantum charge carrier energy levels in the electrical potential well.

abstract: A system and method for facilitating DBS electrode trajectory planning using a machine learning (ML)-based feature identification scheme configured to identify and distinguish between various regions of interest (ROIs) and regions of avoidance (ROAs) in a patient's brain scan image. title: Real-time microseismic magnitude calculation method and device based on deep learning
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a real-time microseismic magnitude calculation method based on deep learning and a corresponding device. The method includes: constructing a DAS-based horizontal well microseismic monitoring system; constructing a training data set; constructing a magnitude calculation module, wherein the magnitude calculation module comprises two input branches of frequency spectrum and time waveform, the two input branches use a 3-layer convolution structure to extract frequency characteristic and waveform characteristic of a microseismic event, and then a model fusion is performed, and then 2 fully connected layers are used, and finally a calculated magnitude is outputted; training the magnitude calculation module; and analyzing and processing field data. The microseismic magnitude calculation method in the present disclosure improves the ability to quickly estimate the microseismic magnitude, without the need for converting the strain data, and improves the accuracy of the microseismic magnitude estimation.

title: Image analysis system and image analysis method for obtaining object range
abstract: An image analysis method is provided. In the image analysis method, a to-be analyzed image is inputted into a region-based convolutional neural network (RCNN) model to obtain a masked image outputted from the RCNN. The center of a masked object in the masked image is calculated. The center is regarded as an origin of coordinate and the farthest coordinate point from the origin of coordinate in each of the four quadrants relative to the origin of coordinate are searched. The image analysis block is generated for each of the farthest coordinate points. The post-processing is performed on the image analysis blocks to obtain an object range.

title: Data valuation using reinforcement learning
abstract: A method includes obtaining a set of training samples. During each of a plurality of training iterations, the method also includes sampling a batch of training samples from the set of training samples. The method includes, for each training sample in the batch of training samples, determining, using a data value estimator, a selection probability. title: Dynamic cloud anti-pattern detection for a modernization assessment service
abstract: Techniques are described for enabling an application modernization system to efficiently identify various types of software development “anti-patterns” (including cloud anti-patterns) associated with software applications. title: Method for assessing facility risks with natural language processing
abstract: The present technology pertains to a method and system for assessing risks associated with facilities, based on using natural language processing. For example, a method can include receiving a natural language input comprising at least one raw text document associated with a facility and generating a plurality of segmented sentences from the raw text documents. The plurality of segmented sentences can be provided as inputs to a machine learning model trained to classify an input segmented sentence over a pre-defined lexicon of pharmaceutical terminology. Each segmented sentence can be classified into one or more classes given by the pre-defined lexicon of pharmaceutical terminology. A secondary classification can be performed for each classified segmented sentence to generate a production issue label based on an analysis of the classified segmented sentence. From the secondary classifications for the classified segmented sentences, at least one production category score for the facility can be generated.

title: Adaptable filtering for edge-based deep learning models
abstract: Techniques for utilizing adaptable filters for edge-based deep learning models are described. Filters may be utilized by an edge electronic device to filter elements of an input data stream so that only a subset of the elements are used as inputs to a machine learning model run by the electronic device, enabling successful operation despite the input data stream potentially being generated at a higher rate than a rate in which the ML model can be executed. The filter can be a differential-type filter that generates difference representations between consecutive elements of the data stream to determine which elements are to be passed on for the ML model, a “smart” filter such as a neural network trained using outputs from the ML model allowing the filter to “learn” which elements are the most likely to be of value to be passed on, or a combination of both.

abstract: Computer systems and associated methods are disclosed to implement a decision model auditing system that allows clients of a machine learning decision system to audit the decision-making process the decision system. title: Intelligently adaptive log level management of a service mesh
abstract: Systems, methods and/or computer program products dynamically managing log levels of microservices in a service mesh based on predicted error rates of calls made to the service mesh. A first AI module predicts health, status and/or failures of microservices individually or as part of microservice chains with a particular confidence level. Using health status mapped to the microservices and historical information inputted into a knowledge base (including error rates), the first AI module predicts error rates of the API call for each user profile or generally by the service mesh. title: Deep multi-channel acoustic modeling using multiple microphone array geometries
abstract: Techniques for speech processing using a deep neural network (DNN) based acoustic model front-end are described. A new modeling approach directly models multi-channel audio data received from a microphone array using a first model (e.g., multi-geometry/multi-channel DNN) that is trained using a plurality of microphone array geometries. Thus, the first model may receive a variable number of microphone channels, generate multiple outputs using multiple microphone array geometries, and select the best output as a first feature vector that may be used similarly to beamformed features generated by an acoustic beamformer. A second model (e.g., feature extraction DNN) processes the first feature vector and transforms it to a second feature vector having a lower dimensional representation. A third model (e.g., classification DNN) processes the second feature vector to perform acoustic unit classification and generate text data. The DNN front-end enables improved performance despite a reduction in microphones.

title: Machine learning based detection of fraudulent acquirer transactions
abstract: Examples described herein relate to apparatuses and methods of detecting fraudulent activity at an automated teller machine (ATM) using a machine learning model. A method includes receiving ATM activity data indicative of one or more withdrawal transactions at one or more ATMs using a transaction card, receiving transaction data and ATM data, ingesting the transaction data and the ATM data, analyzing the ingested transaction data and the ingested ATM data using a machine learning model, determining that the ingested transaction data and the ingested ATM data indicate a likelihood of fraudulent activity using the machine learning model, and performing, using the machine learning model, one or more remedial actions based on the determined likelihood of fraudulent activity.

title: Method and system for training model by using training data
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a method and system for training a model by using training data. The training data includes a plurality of samples, each sample includes N features, and features in the plurality of samples form N feature columns, and the method includes: determining an importance value of each of the N feature columns; determining whether the importance value of each of the N feature columns satisfies a threshold condition; performing a dimension reduction on M feature columns to generate P feature columns in response to the determination that the importance values of the M feature columns do not satisfy the threshold condition, wherein M<N and P<M; merging (N−M) feature columns having importance values that satisfy the threshold condition and the generated P feature columns to obtain (N−M+P) feature columns; and training the model based on the training data including the (N−M+P) feature columns.

abstract: An apparatus includes a sensor module. The sensor module includes an electromagnetic radiation sensor configured to provide electromagnetic radiation sensor data. title: Multi-factor integrated compliance determination and enforcement platform
abstract: A compliance determination and enforcement platform is described. A plurality of factors are stored in association with each of a plurality of accounts. A factor entering module enters factors from each user account into a compliance score model. The compliance score model determines a compliance score for each one of the accounts based on the respective factors associated with the respective account. A comparator compares the compliance score for each account with a compliance reference score to determine a subset of the accounts that fail compliance and a subset of the accounts that meet compliance. A flagging unit flags the user accounts that fail compliance to indicate non-compliant accounts. A corrective action system allows for determining, for each one of the accounts that is flagged as non-compliant, whether the account is bad or good, entering the determination into a feedback system and closing the account.

title: Method and system for recognizing mine microseismic event
abstract: Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a method and system for recognizing a mine microseismic event, and belong to the field of mine data processing. The method includes: converting historical microseismic data monitored by a mine microseismic monitoring system into a microseismic waveform image, and then, converting the microseismic waveform image into a four-neighborhood microseismic waveform graph structure; performing area defining on the microseismic waveform graph structure, and extracting a similar feature layer of any node in the microseismic waveform graph structure based on the defined area; and taking the microseismic waveform image as an input layer of an improved convolutional neural network model, and sequentially connecting the input layer with the similar feature layer as well as a convolutional layer, a pooling layer, a fully connected layer and an output layer which are pre-configured for the improved convolutional neural network model to form a recognition model for recognizing the mine microseismic event. By using the recognition model designed in the present disclosure, the similar feature layer can be extracted, so that the mine microseismic event is effectively recognized.

For each of the memory sub-systems, a first buffer receives and stores a read-modify-write request (with a read address, a write address and a first operand), a second operand is read from the memory bank at the location specified by the read address, a combiner circuit combines the first operand with the second operand, an activation circuit transforms the output of the combiner circuit, and the output of the activation circuit is stored in the memory bank at the location specified by the write address. The first operand and the write address may be stored in a second buffer while the second operand is read from the memory bank. Further, the output of the activation circuit may be first stored in the first buffer before being stored in the memory bank.

title: Constraint-based dynamic quantization adjustment for fixed-point processing
abstract: Aspects of the present disclosure address systems and methods for fixed-point quantization using a dynamic quantization level adjustment scheme. Consistent with some embodiments, a method comprises accessing a neural network comprising floating-point representations of filter weights corresponding to one or more convolution layers. The method further includes determining a peak value of interest from the filter weights and determining a quantization level for the filter weights based on a number of bits in a quantization scheme. The method further includes dynamically adjusting the quantization level based on one or more constraints. The method further includes determining a quantization scale of the filter weights based on the peak value of interest and the adjusted quantization level. The method further includes quantizing the floating-point representations of the filter weights using the quantization scale to generate fixed-point representations of the filter weights.

title: Identifying and ranking potentially privileged documents using a machine learning topic model
abstract: A method for identifying and ranking potentially privileged documents using a machine learning topic model may include receiving a set of documents. The method may also include, for each of two or more documents in the set of documents, extracting a set of spans from the document, generating, using a machine learning topic model, a set of topics and a subset of legal topics for the set of spans, generating a vector of probabilities for each span with a probability being assigned to each topic in the set of topics for the span, assigning a score to one or more spans in the set of spans by summing the probabilities in the vector that are assigned to a topic in the subset of legal topics, and assigning a score to the document. The method may further include ranking the two or more documents by their assigned scores.

title: Systems and methods for utilizing a tiered processing scheme
abstract: A tiered processing scheme for processing image data is provided. A method can include obtaining image data indicative of one or more court judgment(s) with a number of features. The method can include obtaining judgment information from the image data by applying a number of image processing techniques in accordance with a processing hierarchy tailored to the image data. The image data can be classified by a machine-learning model and the processing hierarchy can be determined based on the classification. The processing hierarchy balances the computing resources used by a respective technique with the accuracy afforded by the technique when applied to image data with a respective classification. A computing system can utilize the processing hierarchy to leverage different image processing techniques in a tiered processing scheme tailored to image data.

title: Slit aperture image capturing device with depth of field compensation
abstract: An electronic device, method and computer program product provide an image capturing device having a lens assembly including a lens and lens housing that supports the lens. The lens housing has an opening that exposes the lens. A planar exterior surface of the electronic device extends across the lens assembly and includes a slit aperture that is smaller than the opening in the lens housing of the image capturing device. The slit aperture directs only a corresponding portion of light from in front of the planar exterior surface through the opening to the lens. The slit aperture enables at least one of: (i) reducing noticeability of the image capturing device; and (ii) use of an adjacent portion of the planar exterior surface for an aesthetic or functional component. An image from the image capturing device is sharpened along a longer dimension of the slit aperture to remove asymmetric blur.

title: System and method to manage power to a desired power profile
abstract: A system includes a power profile engine, a power measurement engine, and a power throttling signal generator. The power profile engine receives a desired power profile, e.g., a first profile current average associated with a first time duration and a second profile current average associated with a second time duration. The power measurement engine measures current being drawn and generates a first running average for the measured currents for the first time duration and generates a second running average for the measured currents for the second time duration. The power throttling signal generator generates a first power throttling signal to throttle power in response to the first running average for the measured currents being greater than the first profile current average and generates a second power throttling signal to throttle power in response to the second running average for the measured currents being greater than the second profile current average.

title: Differentiable set to increase the memory capacity of recurrent neural net works
abstract: According to embodiments, a recurrent neural network (RNN) is equipped with a set data structure whose operations are differentiable, which data structure can be used to store information for a long period of time. This differentiable set data structure can “remember” an event in the sequence of sequential data that may impact another event much later in the sequence, thereby allowing the RNN to classify the sequence based on many kinds of long dependencies. An RNN that is equipped with the differentiable set data structure can be properly trained with backpropagation and gradient descent optimizations. According to embodiments, a differentiable set data structure can be used to store and retrieve information with a simple set-like interface. According to further embodiments, the RNN can be extended to support several add operations, which can make the differentiable set data structure behave like a Bloom filter.

title: Composite car image generator
abstract: The present disclosure relates generally to artificial intelligence (AI), machine learning (ML), and deep learning technologies. More specifically, the disclosure relates to a vehicle image composite system that employs computer vision (CV) along with a Generative Adversarial Network (GAN) to generate realistic composite car images. title: Multimode coupler to control interaction between quantum bits
abstract: A device comprises first and second qubits, and a qubit coupler coupled between the first and second qubits. The second qubit comprises first and second modes with the first mode configured to store data. The qubit coupler comprises first and second modes, and operates in a first state or second state. In the first state, the first qubit is exchange coupled to the first mode of the qubit coupler, and the second mode of the second qubit is exchange coupled to the second mode of the qubit coupler, to suppress interaction between the first and second qubits. In the second state, the first qubit and the first mode of the second qubit are exchange coupled to both the first and second modes the qubit coupler, to enable interaction between the first and second qubits for an entanglement gate operation in response to a control signal applied to the qubit coupler.

title: Systems and methods for generating a single-index model tree
abstract: Systems, apparatuses, methods, and computer program products are disclosed for generating a single-index model (SIM) tree. An example method includes receiving a data set and a maximum tree depth. The example method further includes screening a set of variables from the data set to form split variables. The method may include, while maximum tree depth has not been reached, (i) generating a fast SIM estimation for nodes of a tree level, (ii) for each node, selecting a split point and split variable based on the fast SIM estimation, (iii) based on the selected split points and split variables, generating nodes for a next tree level, each including a subset of data, and (iv) repeating steps (i), (ii), and (iii). The method may include fitting a SIM for each leaf node at maximum tree depth based on a subset of the data set represented by the leaf node.

title: Stream quality enhancement
abstract: Aspects of the present disclosure relate to stream quality enhancement. A determination can be made that quality of an audio/video (A/V) stream being streamed to a first device falls below a quality threshold. A plurality of edge processing devices in an environment of the first device can be identified. Available computing resources of each of the edge processing devices can be determined. title: Determining future user actions using time-based featurization of clickstream data
abstract: Methods and apparatuses are described for determining future user actions using time-based featurization of clickstream data. A server captures clickstream data corresponding to web browsing sessions and converts the clickstream data into tokens by identifying each unique URL and parsing each unique URL into tokens. The server generates a frequency matrix based upon the tokens, and generates a latent feature vector for each URL in the session based upon the frequency matrix. The server merges the latent feature vectors and the clickstream data into an aggregate clickstream vector set for a user. The server assigns time-decayed weight values to each latent feature vector in the aggregate clickstream vector set. The server combines the time-decayed latent feature vectors to generate a clickstream embedding for the user, and executes a machine learning model using the clickstream embedding to generate one or more predicted actions of the user.

title: Multi-view image analysis using neural networks

If supervised data is also available then the network parameters can further be updated using the supervised loss.

title: Unsupervised reinforcement learning method and apparatus based on Wasserstein distance
abstract: The present disclosure discloses an unsupervised reinforcement learning method and apparatus based on Wasserstein distance. title: Neural animation layering for synthesizing martial arts movements
abstract: In some embodiments, the dynamic animation generation system can provide a deep learning framework to produce a large variety of martial arts movements in a controllable manner from unstructured motion capture data. title: Systolic multiply delayed accumulate processor architecture
abstract: Systems and methods are provided to perform multiplication-delayed-addition operations in a systolic array to increase clock speeds, reduce circuit area, and/or reduce dynamic power consumption. Each processing element in the systolic array can have a pipeline configured to perform a multiplication during a first systolic interval and to perform an accumulation during a second systolic interval. A skip detection circuit can be used to skip one or more of the multiplication, storing in the delay register, and the addition during skip conditions for improved energy efficiency.

title: Tracking systems with electronic devices and tags
abstract: An electronic device may include wireless communications circuitry that receives location information from tags that are coupled to different items. The electronic device may keep track of the different items using the tags. The electronic device may include control circuitry that analyzes historical tracking data from the tags to identify patterns and relationships between the tags. The control circuitry may generate rules based on the historical tracking data, such as rules regarding acceptable ranges between tagged items and acceptable ranges between tagged items and the electronic device. The control circuitry may determine when to provide real-time location information and other notifications for a tagged item based on the historical tracking data.

title: Application functionality testing, resiliency testing, chaos testing, and performance testing in a single platform
abstract: A network system to provide testing, resiliency, chaos and performance testing in a single tool that operates on cloud-based applications in real time. When applications are deployed on a cloud environment, the applications must be validated based on functional aspects, performance aspects, resiliency aspects, and test-code coverage ratio aspects. The system combines all these validations in a single package. The system provides a rich set of modules for functional validations, which can be combined as nodes to allow applications to be quickly validated for functionality. The extensible model of the same functional modules may also be used for performance testing. The system also provides resiliency and chaos testing mechanisms that push the applications into a constant state of perturbation. The system does so by detecting the application code and modifying the code at runtime to inject perturbation. The system monitors the recovery of the system from the testing.

abstract: Methods and apparatuses are described for automatic refinement of intent classification for virtual assistant applications. A computing device creates utterance groups comprising messages. title: Loss-aware replication of neural network layers
abstract: Some embodiments provide a method that receives a network with trained floating-point weight values. The network includes layers of nodes, each of which computes an output value based on input values and trained weight values. To replace a first layer of the trained network in a modified network with quantized weight values, the method defines multiple replica layers. Each replica layer includes nodes that correspond to nodes of the first layer, has a different set of allowed quantized weight values, and receives the same input values from a previous layer of the modified network such that groups of corresponding nodes from the replica layers operate correspondingly to the first layer. The method trains the quantized weight values of the modified network using a loss function with terms that account for effect on the loss function due to the quantization and for interactions between corresponding weight values of the replica layers.

title: Providing human-interpretable explanation for model-detected anomalies
abstract: An anomaly detection system is disclosed capable of reporting anomalous processes or hosts in a computer network using machine learning models trained using unsupervised training techniques. In embodiments, the system assigns observed processes to a set of process categories based on the file system path of the program executed by the process. The system extracts a feature vector for each process or host from the observation records and applies the machine learning models to the feature vectors to determine an outlier metric each process or host. The processes or hosts with the highest outlier metrics are reported as detected anomalies to be further examined by security analysts. In embodiments, the machine learnings models may be periodically retrained based on new observation records using unsupervised machine learning techniques. Accordingly, the system allows the models to learn from newly observed data without requiring the new data to be manually labeled by humans.

title: User-aided signal line-of-sight (los) machine learning classifier
abstract: Machine learning techniques can be used to mitigate multipath in a GNSS receiver that includes a first trained model that provides extra path length (EPL) corrections in the GNSS receiver. The first trained model can be updated using an updated and trained model from one or more assistance servers that are in communication with the GNSS receiver. The GNSS receiver can provide, for a particular computed position and time, extracted features from received GNSS signals to the one or more assistance servers. The assistance servers can then use the extracted features and a source of true EPL corrections (e.g., from a 3D building map database for the particular computed position and time) to train a server model. The server model, once trained to a desired level of accuracy, can be transmitted to the GNSS receiver to replace the first trained model. The server model can be compared to the first trained model to verify it can provide more accurate EPL corrections than the first trained model. The server model and the source of true EPL corrections can be specific for a geographic region, so different regions have different server models based on the corresponding sources of true EPL corrections.
