title: Information processing device, information processing method, and information processing computer program product
abstract: An information processing device  10 A includes an acquisition unit  40 A, a first action-value-function specifying unit  40 B, a second action-value-function specifying unit  40 C, and an action determination unit  40 D. The acquisition unit  40 A acquires a current state of a mobile robot  20  as an exemplary device. The first action-value-function specifying unit  40 B has functioning of learning a first inference model by reinforcement learning, and specifies a first action-value-function of the mobile robot  20  based on the current state and the first inference model. title: Low power hardware architecture for handling accumulation overflows in a convolution operation
abstract: In a low power hardware architecture for handling accumulation overflows in a convolver unit, an accumulator of the convolver unit computes a running total by successively summing dot products from a dot product computation module during an accumulation cycle. In response to the running total overflowing the maximum or minimum value of a data storage element, the accumulator transmits an overflow indicator to a controller and sets its output equal to a positive or negative overflow value. In turn, the controller disables the dot product computation module by clock gating, clamping one of its inputs to zero and/or holding its inputs to constant values. At the end of the accumulation cycle, the output of the accumulator is sampled. In response to a clear signal being asserted, the dot product computation module is enabled, and the running total is set to zero for the start of the next accumulation cycle.

title: Microwave photonic quantum processor
abstract: A quantum processor is provided according to one embodiment of the present invention. The quantum processor uses propagating microwave photons as flying qubits, encoded in a dual-rail configuration. The dual-rail configuration is characterised by the fact that one photon encodes a qubit, and one photon at most is present in a transmission line. The quantum processor comprises single-qubit gates and two-qubit gates for performing state operations on the qubits. The single-qubit gates comprise directional couplers and phase shifters, while the two-qubit gates comprise electronic circuits including LC oscillators and Josephson junctions. The quantum processor further comprises a single microwave photon generation circuit and a microwave photon detector circuit.

title: Providing Fairness in Fine-Tuning of Pre-Trained Language Models
abstract: Bias in a language model generated through fine tuning of a pre-trained language model may be mitigated, whether the bias may be incorporated in the pre-trained language model or in fine-tuning data. A pre-trained language model may be fine-tuned using downstream training data. Prior to tuning, elements within the downstream data may be identified that either match or serve as proxies for one or more identity elements associated with training bias sensitivity. Proxy elements may be identified using an analysis of distributions of the downstream elements and distributions of identity elements. Once the elements are identified, instances of the identified elements may be replaced in the downstream data with one or more masking element to generate masked downstream data. A fine-tuned language model with reduced bias may then be generated from the pre-trained language model by tuning the pre-trained language model using the masked downstream data.

title: Method and apparatus for machine learning using a quantum system
abstract: A method for machine learning using a quantum system is provided. A neural network is associated with the quantum system. abstract: The invention discloses an energy-efficient sample selection method based on sample complexity, which performs sample selection on the raw data sets through two stages of inter-class sampling and intra-class sampling, the object is to select representative samples from large-scale data sets, thereby reducing the number of samples used for model training and achieving the object of lightweight training. title: Metafaas architecture for training on serverless instances
abstract: Hardly any work in literature attempts employing Function-as-a-Service (FaaS) or serverless architecture to accelerate the training or re-training process of meta-learning architectures. Embodiments of the present disclosure provide a method and system for meta learning using distributed training on serverless architecture. The system, interchangeably referred to as MetaFaaS, is a meta-learning based scalable architecture using serverless distributed setup. Hierarchical nature of gradient based architectures is leveraged to facilitate distributed training on the serverless architecture. Further, a compute-efficient architecture, efficient Adaptive Learning of hyperparameters for Fast Adaptation (eALFA) for meta-learning is provided. The serverless architecture based training of models during meta learning enables unlimited scalability and reduction of training time by using optimal number of serverless instances. An analytical model for gradient based meta learning architectures that predicts training time required for the number of FaaS instances is provided which further enables estimating the cost incurred during training models in meta-learning.

title: Systems and methods for motion estimation and view prediction
abstract: Described herein are systems, methods, and instrumentalities associated with estimating the motions of multiple 3D points in a scene and predicting a view of scene based on the estimated motions. The tasks may be accomplished using one or more machine-learning (ML) models. A first ML model may be used to predict motion-embedding features for a temporal state of a scene, based on motion-embedding features for previous states. A second ML model may be used to predict a motion field representing displacement or deformation of the multiple 3D points from a source time to a target time. Then, a third ML model may be used to predict respective image properties of the 3D points based on their updated locations at the target time and/or a viewing direction. An image of the scene at the target time may then be generated based on the predicted image properties of the 3D points.

title: Method and system for automatic driving data collection and closed-loop management
abstract: Provided are a method and system for automatic driving data collection and closed-loop management. The method includes: obtaining vehicle driving data; preprocessing the vehicle driving data; obtaining incremental data by filtering, through a pre-trained neural network based on a predetermined filtering rule, the preprocessed vehicle driving data; and storing the incremental data or transmitting the incremental data to a cloud. The method can effectively filter high-value incremental data, thereby reducing requirements for data storage volume and/or data transmission bandwidth of the system. The system of the present disclosure can be post-mounted or pre-mounted on a vehicle, and is independent of specific vehicle type of the vehicle. In addition, it is not necessary for the vehicle to be equipped with real-value systems such as high-cost laser radars, which greatly improves use convenience of the system and facilitates rapid and large-scale application.

title: AUTOMATED ITERATIVE PREDICTIVE MODELING COMPUTING PLATFORM
abstract: Aspects of the disclosure relate to an automated iterative predictive modeling computing platform that iteratively requests additional data from external data sources to iteratively generate a more accurate insurance premium estimation. In some instances, the automated iterative predictive modeling computing platform may generate an insurance premium estimation using affordable insurance data and using estimated data in place of missing data. If the insurance premium estimation does not meet predefined confidence thresholds, the automated iterative predictive modeling computing platform may retrieve additional data that is more expensive but also has a likelihood to generate a more accurate insurance premium estimation. This process may be repeated using different data sets from different external data sources until a sufficiently accurate insurance premium estimate is generated by the automated iterative predictive modeling computing platform.

title: SYSTEMS AND METHODS FOR IMAGE RENDERING
abstract: Described herein is a computing system for rendering images. The computing system comprises a processing unit, a neural rendering unit, and a memory coupled to the processing unit and the neural rendering unit. The processing unit is configured to retrieve data with which to render an image from a first region of the memory. The processing unit rasterizes the data to determine at least spatial coordinates and directions of pixels of the image. The processing unit writes the rasterized data to a second region of the memory. The neural rendering unit is configured to retrieve the rasterized data from the second region of the memory. The neural rendering unit determines, based on the rasterized data, through a machine learning model, color and intensity values of the pixels of the image. The neural rendering unit writes the color and intensity values of the pixels to a third region of the memory.

title: SYSTEM FOR RECOGNIZING ENVIRONMENT SITUATION AND NOTIFYING OF BEHAVIOR BY USING ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE-BASED ENVIRONMENT SENSOR
abstract: The present invention relates to a technology developed through a task entitled "Advancing situation-recognizing AI learning by using environment-sensing IoT-combined sensor system" under a project (CY201023) for supporting post-COVID specialized artificial intelligence techno business, 2020, by Seoul Business Agency, Seoul. Disclosed are a system and a method for recognizing an environment situation and notifying of a behavior by using an artificial intelligence-based environment sensor. The system for recognizing an environment situation and notifying of a behavior by using an artificial intelligence-based environment sensor according to the present invention recognizes the situation of indoor contamination and recommends a behavior notification appropriate therefor from environment sensing values measured by using multiple environment sensors, on the basis of a learning model. To this end, the system comprises: multiple environment sensors for measuring environment data with regard to an indoor space or an outdoor space positioned adjacent to the indoor space; a device installed in the indoor space to control the temperature, humidity, and ventilation of the indoor space; a service server for collecting indoor and outdoor environment data measured through the multiple environment sensors; and an AI server for constructing a learning model on the basis of indoor environment data and outdoor environment data collected from the service server, user preferences, housing data regarding housing types, and behavior data, recognizing the indoor situation regarding the environment data through the learning model, and recommending a behavior notification appropriate therefor.

title: METHOD AND APPARATUS FOR PROCESSING FOOT INFORMATION
abstract: The present invention relates to a method and apparatus for processing foot information, which recommend the type and size of shoes on the basis of 3D scanning of the foot. The method for processing foot information, according to an embodiment of the present invention, is executed by a processor of the apparatus for processing foot information, and may comprise the steps of: generating an initial 3D model of the foot on the basis of a plurality of foot images obtained by photographing the foot from various angles; generating an intermediate 3D model in which the ground and noise have been removed from the initial 3D model; generating a final 3D model having a normal foot shape by restoring a portion of the foot, which has been removed together with the ground when generating the intermediate 3D model; and calculating foot-related information from the final 3D model, and recommending shoes.

title: USER EXPERIENCE MODELING SYSTEM
abstract: Time-series data and domain knowledge rules governing interpretation of the time-series data in building a semiotic model of a user are accessed. An experience event is extracted from the time-series data based on the rules. A triadic data structure is generated based on the event to include an object element, a sign element, and an interpretant element. The interpretant element is determined based on an observation associated with the rules. An object of interest that appears in the environment of the user during the experience event is identified based on the time-series data. The object element of the triadic data structure is determined based on the object of interest. The triadic data structure is added to the semiotic model as a hypothesis. Once validated, the triadic data structure represents an interpretive habit of the user.

abstract: The present invention provides solution to the above-mentioned problem in the art by providing a system and a method for efficiently providing personalized content recommendations across multiple domains containing distinct types of contents. The present invention provides numerous improvements over existing systems. The present invention is effective for organizations where business interests span multiple domains. Recommendations are not limited to a single domain. Rather, user events from different domains can be leveraged to make recommendations in any of these domains. abstract: Data encodable polymers, including nucleic polymers, for data storage and related methods are described. Generally, a nucleic acid polymer can have chemically modifiable structures iteratively repeated along the polymer. The chemically modifiable structures can be modified to encode data. A data encoding device can have a spatial resolution that modifies a string of contiguous chemically modifiable structures to yield a cluster of modified structures. Various methods can be utilized to generate a data encodable nucleic acid polymer. Various methods can be utilized to encode a data encodable nucleic acid polymer. Various methods of decoding can be utilized to decode an encoded nucleic acid or other polymer.

title: METHODS AND SYSTEMS FOR AI-BASED LOAD BALANCING OF PROCESSING RESOURCES IN DISTRIBUTED ENVIRONMENTS
abstract: Systems and method are provided for load balancing in distributed networks. A computing device uses historical resource allocation data associated with a service deployed within a distributed network to train a machine-learning model configured to generate a threshold processing load usable to determine when processing resources allocated to a service within a particular distributed network are to be increased. An autoscaler of the computing device may instantiate a first quantity of partitions within a processing node of the particular distributed network. The computing device may execute the machine-learning model using a load value associated with the first quantity of partitions to generate a threshold processing load. Upon receiving an updated load value that is greater than the threshold process load, the autoscaler may instantiate a second quantity of partitions and, in response, modify the autoscaler based on the updated load value.

title: LATENCY-AWARE NEURAL NETWORK PRUNING AND APPLICATIONS THEREOF
abstract: A neural architecture search (NAS) system generates a machine-trained model that satisfies specified real-time latency objectives by selecting among a collection of layer-wise sparse candidate models. In operation, the NAS system selects a parent model from among the candidate models. The NAS system then identifies a particular layer of the parent model, and then determines how the layer is to be mutated, to yield a child model. The NAS system calculates a reward score for the child model based on its latency and accuracy. The NAS system then uses reinforcement learning to update the trainable logic used to perform the mutating based on the reward score. The NAS system repeats the above process a plurality of times. An online application system can use the machine-trained model eventually produced by the NAS system to deliver real-time responses to user queries.

title: METHODS AND SYSTEMS FOR DETECTING CAUSES OF OBSERVED OUTLIER DATA
abstract: A method for automatically detecting causes of outlier data-event scenarios. A plurality of linksets of an ontological model are instantiated in an in-memory neural network. The instantiated linksets are a tailored array of interconnected index tables that defines the ontological relationship between potential causes, parameters, data-event attributes corresponding to the parameters, and neutrosophic rules corresponding to the potential causes and the parameters. Data-events are indexed so as to generate an index class that links each indexed data-event to the instantiated data-event attributes corresponding to the instantiated parameters via corresponding attribute values of the indexed data-events. The index class is supplemented with additional data-event attributes corresponding to repeating attribute values of the indexed data-events. The index class is neutrosophically analyzed according to the neutrosophic rules of the instantiated linkset, so as to detect whether certain combinations of data-event attributes are likely caused by the potential causes.

title: QUANTUM CODE WITH SIMPLER PAIRWISE CHECKS
abstract: A method and apparatus for performing quantum error correction using an automorphism code related to the honeycomb code. The automorphism code is based on Kramers-Wannier (KW) duality. For embodiments on a hexagonal lattice using three repeated time steps, 1/3 of the pixels are active in a given time steps. In a given time step r, a KW circuit is applied to plaquettes labeled r mod 3, transferring quantum information from the active qubits at the beginning to a new set of active qubits at the end of the time step. Each of the three plaquette types is associated with one stabilizer either given by a product of six Z operators or three X operators. The KW circuit maps the product of X operators to the product of Z operators and vice-versa. The stabilizer group of the superlattice toric code changes every round.

title: NEURAL NETWORK ARCHITECTURE FOR MOVEMENT ANALYSIS
abstract: A video is segmented into a plurality of sequences corresponding to different facial states performed by a patient in the video. For each sequence, displacement of a plurality of groups of landmarks of a face of the patient is tracked, to obtain, for each group of the plurality of groups, one or more displacement measures characterizing positions of the landmarks of the group. The one or more displacement measures corresponding to each group are provided into a corresponding neural network, to obtain a landmark feature. The neural networks corresponding to each group are different from one another. A sequence score for the sequence is determined based on a plurality of landmark features corresponding to the groups. A plurality of sequence scores are provided into a machine learning component, to obtain a patient score. A disease state of the patient is determined based on the patient score.

title: IMPROVED PARTICLE SWARM ALGORITHM-BASED STEPPED CARBON EMISSION TRADING MECHANISM PARAMETER OPTIMIZATION METHOD
abstract: The present invention provides an improved particle swarm algorithm-based stepped carbon emission trading mechanism parameter optimization method. The method comprises: first obtaining park comprehensive energy system information and operation data, then establishing a park comprehensive energy system equipment model and constraints, and establishing a stepped carbon emission trading model; encapsulating a low-carbon optimization scheduling process of a park comprehensive energy system into a fitness function, wherein the input quantity of the function is a carbon emission trading mechanism parameter, and the output quantity of the function is the carbon emission of the system; and finally, for the fitness function, introducing an improved particle swarm algorithm for optimization, and outputting result information after the optimization based on the algorithm. By means of analysis of examples, the present invention verifies the effectiveness and rationality of the model and the method fully exploiting the functions of a stepped carbon emission trading mechanism in a park comprehensive energy system, providing a solution for reasonably and effectively formulating stepped carbon emission trading mechanism parameters in the park comprehensive energy system.

title: FRICTIONLESS PAYMENT SYSTEM
abstract: Disclosed are various embodiments for frictionless payment. A computing device obtains a document with native format transaction data from a merchant device, and determines a bill based at least in part on the native format transaction data and a trained predictive model. The computing device determines payment methods available for payment of the bill via a client device. The computing device generates a network page that can cause payment of the bill to be initiated by one of the payment methods that is unassociated with a user providing payment card information or personal information to the merchant, and transmit an indication to the merchant device that the bill was paid.

abstract: Methods of early real-time detection or prediction of aspiration faults in an automated diagnostic analysis system include an artificial intelligence algorithm configured to use either cluster analysis or probabilistic graphical modeling based on an aspiration pressure measurement signal waveform. Aspiration faults may include short-volume aspiration and unwanted gel pick-up. Apparatus for early real-time detection or prediction of aspiration faults are provided as are other aspects.

title: Gaussian information source lossy compression method
abstract: The invention relates to a Gaussian information source lossy compression method. The method comprises the following steps: representing a Gaussian information source as a floating-point number sequence; taking a floating-point number as likelihood information, dividing a likelihood information sequence according to the stage number of the multi-stage coding structure, and inputting a belief propagation algorithm with the multi-stage coding structure to obtain a quantization result; performing information bit extraction on the quantization result by using a check matrix of the information source LDPC code to obtain an information bit sequence; sending the information bit sequence to a decoder through a channel with additive Gaussian white noise; after the decoder receives the information bit sequence, linear decoding recovery is realized by using a generation matrix of the information source LDPC code; and inputting the recovered sequence into a pre-trained convolutional neural network model to realize the reconstruction of the floating-point number sequence. The method has the characteristics of small data compression distortion, simple equipment implementation and low application complexity.

title: Method for generating video description based on Transform network
abstract: The invention provides a method for generating video description based on a transformer network, which comprises the following steps of: extracting video frames, namely extracting the video frames by using an LPIPS similarity score; feature extraction: extracting video frame image features by using a ResNet-152 network, and extracting motion features of video frames by using an I3D network; feature coding: coding the image features and the action features by using a transform network to obtain visual information codes; the semantic network is used for obtaining semantic information codes from the visual information codes through a semantic network module; feature decoding: decoding the semantic information codes and the visual information codes by using a decoder part of a Transform model; and finally, generating video description content. title: Cross-theme composition automatic evaluation method and system based on paired double-layer adversarial alignment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of natural language processing, and discloses a cross-theme composition automatic evaluation method and system based on paired double-layer adversarial alignment. The method comprises the steps of inputting text data of a to-be-evaluated composition into a trained cross-theme composition automatic evaluation model, and outputting an evaluation result; the trained cross-theme composition automatic evaluation model is obtained by training different theme compositions with known evaluation results; in the training stage, the trained model extracts composition representations of each pair of source theme composition and target theme composition, the two composition representations are mapped into a feature space, and alignment operation is executed on feature distribution of theme levels of the two composition representations in the feature space; meanwhile, performing execution operation on the feature distribution of the two composition representation category levels in the feature space; and adopting consistency constraint to carry out minimization constraint on differences among outputs of all classifiers. According to the invention, the consistency and stability of scoring results are improved.

title: Dynamic collaborative optimization method and system for multi-target scheduling of water engineering
abstract: The invention discloses a water engineering multi-target scheduling dynamic collaborative optimization method and system, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, building a multi-target collaborative optimization scheduling model which takes the maximization of the water supply benefit, the power generation benefit, the ecological benefit, the sediment transport benefit and the like generated by the water engineering as a scheduling target, and adding constraint conditions to the optimization scheduling model; s2, initializing a dynamic collaborative search algorithm; s3, iteratively operating the dynamic collaborative search algorithm; s4, calling an individual update strategy of the dynamic collaborative search algorithm; and S5, outputting and optimizing a non-inferior scheduling scheme set. The dynamic collaborative optimization method and system for multi-target scheduling of the water engineering have the advantages of being high in global optimization capacity, low in model calculation cost, uniform in non-inferior scheduling scheme distribution, capable of greatly improving comprehensive benefits and the like, and a more efficient technology is provided for the multi-target scheduling problem of the complex water engineering.

title: Food quality detection method, equipment, system and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a food quality detection method, equipment, a system and a storage medium. title: Method and system for measuring moisture content of human tissue, electronic equipment and medium
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of magnetic resonance imaging, and aims to provide a human tissue moisture content measuring method and system, electronic equipment and a medium. According to the invention, the moisture content of human tissues can be accurately measured, and the interference of a radio frequency field B1 + and a receiving field B1-on a moisture content distribution diagram can be well eliminated. Specifically, a Helmholtz equation is adopted as assistance, a neural network technology is combined, and MR signals are processed through a physical coupling deep learning neural network, so that the moisture content of the human tissue can be accurately and rapidly measured, and a large amount of label data is not needed to train the network. In the process, the Helmholtz equation is introduced to serve as a regularization item, distribution of the receiving field B1-can be better processed, and therefore the problems that in the MRI scanning process, field distribution is not uniform, and removal is not easy to achieve through a traditional algorithm are solved.

title: Monocrystalline silicon growth visual detection method, device and equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a monocrystalline silicon growth visual detection method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and is applied to the technical field of defect detection, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a picture shot in the growth process of monocrystalline silicon; inputting the picture into a pre-trained deep learning network, judging whether a ridge line exists in an area above a bright band in the picture and whether the bright band is incomplete through the deep learning network, and taking a judgment result as a first result; judging whether the bright band in the picture is incomplete or not based on a boundary line detection model, and taking a judgment result as a second result; and determining the growth state of the monocrystalline silicon in combination with the first result and the second result. A deep learning network is combined with a traditional boundary line detection model, whether a ridge exists or not and whether the ridge causes bright band incompleteness or not are judged through two steps based on a shot picture during judgment, and the growth state of monocrystalline silicon is judged through two steps, so that the growth state of the monocrystalline silicon can be accurately determined.

title: Design method of armored vehicle smoke exhaust injection structure
abstract: The invention discloses a design method of a smoke exhaust injection structure of an armored vehicle. According to the method, a smoke exhaust injection structure design method is introduced, and an iterative method is adopted for calculation aiming at the smoke exhaust injection structure, so that the purposes of greatly reducing the smoke exhaust temperature and further weakening the infrared radiation of the smoke exhaust are achieved.

title: Pedestrian re-recognition method based on gait analysis
abstract: The invention discloses a pedestrian re-recognition method based on gait analysis. The pedestrian re-recognition method comprises the following steps: acquiring a gait data set; the gait data set is input into a pre-constructed bidirectional parallel network at least composed of a spatial convolutional network and a time cycle network, spatial gait features and time gait features are extracted respectively, and the time cycle network adopts a time scoring strategy based on a gated cycle unit; evaluating the image quality of each frame in the network branches and modifying the frame sequence weight to obtain frame-level features after time enhancement, so that the time cycle network extracts time gait features based on the frame-level features after time enhancement; and fusing the space gait features and the time gait features to obtain a pedestrian re-recognition result. Compared with an existing method, the pedestrian re-recognition method based on gait analysis has the advantages that the recognition rate is higher under the cross view angle and scene conditions, better performance is shown in pedestrian recognition, and the effectiveness and robustness of pedestrian recognition are improved.

title: Composite material structure damage monitoring method, device, medium and equipment
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of composite material structure health monitoring, in particular to a composite material structure damage monitoring method and device, a medium and equipment. title: Micro-grid client side flexible load resource interactive operation optimization method and device
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a micro-grid client side flexible load resource interactive operation optimization method and device. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a client-side flexible load model; constructing a target function and a constraint condition of the client side flexible load model; determining a weight value of each objective function by adopting an analytic hierarchy process; and solving the client-side flexible load model by using an improved grey wolf optimization algorithm to obtain an optimized wind power output value, an optimized photovoltaic power output value and an optimized power value of the pumped storage unit. title: Multi-task self-allocation and scheduling artificial intelligence chip architecture scheme
abstract: The invention discloses an implementation method and circuit for an artificial intelligence chip, and the method comprises the steps: the circuit comprises one or more calculation arrays, each calculation array comprises a plurality of calculation units, one part of each calculation unit is a calculation unit for executing a training task, and the other part of each calculation unit is a calculation unit for executing a reasoning task; the other part is a super computing unit; the super computing unit disclosed by the invention can flexibly switch self task types and executed task sequences according to task and configuration requirements, that is, a first reasoning task is executed in a first time period, a second training task is executed in a second time period, and the first reasoning task and the second reasoning task belong to different neural network models. Application such as reinforcement learning can be better supported; furthermore, the super computing unit can flexibly switch a task sequence executed by the super computing unit according to task and configuration requirements; furthermore, the super computing unit internally comprises precision data conversion, so that real-time computing precision including reconfigurable adjustment of training precision and reasoning precision is realized; furthermore, the super computing unit internally comprises two-way propagation and one-way propagation switching, so that real-time conversion of the direction of data transmission and flexible switching of computing tasks are realized; according to the method, different reasoning tasks, training tasks and training reasoning synchronization tasks can be carried out in the current computing equipment, and flexible self-distribution and self-adjustment can be carried out.

title: Method and system for judging deicing jump state of power transmission line based on online monitoring
abstract: The invention discloses a power transmission line deicing jump state judgment method and system based on online monitoring, and relates to the technical field of power transmission line online monitoring, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the front recognition of the deicing jump of a power transmission line through a ground wire icing state AI recognition model; carrying out ice layer thickness calculation, and carrying out span threshold analysis; and judging the starting and stopping states of the tripping jump of the power transmission line. According to the power transmission line deicing jump state judgment method based on online monitoring, the starting threshold value is flexibly changed according to the span, the accuracy and timeliness of deicing jump monitoring are improved, and therefore power transmission line damage, potential power supply interruption risks and excessive energy consumption caused by deicing jump are reduced. The starting and stopping states of the power transmission line tripping jump are judged, it is ensured that measures are taken in time when the deicing jump occurs, meanwhile, unnecessary energy consumption is reduced after the deicing jump is finished, and the overall efficiency of the system is improved.

abstract: The invention discloses a medical care equipment control method, system and equipment based on face recognition and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of medical care. abstract: The invention discloses a financial service quantity sequence value determination method and device, and electronic equipment, and relates to the field of financial science and technology, and the method comprises the steps: decomposing each service quantity driving sequence into different frequency domain spaces, obtaining an intrinsic mode function, carrying out the coding operation of the intrinsic mode function in a combined attention layer of each encoder, and obtaining an intrinsic mode value of each group of encoders; and combining the coding hidden state information of the previous moment with the intrinsic mode function by adopting an LSTM unit, outputting the hidden state of the current moment, updating the hidden state of the current moment according to the mode parameter of the current moment to obtain a hidden state matrix of the current moment, and in a time attention layer of a decoder, outputting the hidden state matrix of the current moment. title: Motor performance evaluation method based on vector analysis
abstract: The invention discloses a motor performance evaluation method based on vector analysis. The evaluation method comprises the following steps: establishing a detection three-dimensional coordinate system by taking a motor rotating speed n, motor stable working time t and motor working temperature rise s as coordinate axes; setting the rotating speed n of the motor, the stable working time t of the motor and the working temperature rise s of the motor as uniform subdivision by adopting a unification formula; the motor is powered on and rotates to enter a working state, a plurality of detection time nodes are set for detection, and a plurality of detection points are calibrated in a detection three-dimensional coordinate system according to the specific numerical values of the motor rotating speed n, the motor stable working time t and the motor working temperature rise s; establishing a plurality of detection vectors E by taking the original point of the three-dimensional coordinate system as a starting point and the detection point as an end point, and respectively calculating the length and direction of each detection vector to form a detection set Q (E (l, d)); and carrying out operation quantization on the detection vectors in the detection set by adopting a deviation function, and carrying out quantitative evaluation on the performance of the motor according to the regression of the detection vectors.

abstract: The invention discloses a self-service retail robot control system based on a laser radar and particle swarm optimization. title: Self-adaptive distributed power data anomaly detection model construction method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive distributed power data anomaly detection model construction method and system. The method comprises the following steps: initializing a global model through a central server; the client performs two rounds of gradient updating on the global model by using local power data and uploads the updated global model to the central server; the central server performs weighted average on all the uploaded data to obtain a new global model; after a preset communication round number or a convergence condition is reached, each client performs gradient updating by using a new global model locally to obtain a personalized model of the client, and performs anomaly detection on the power data by using the personalized model; and after the federation training is finished, the client performs fine tuning on the intra-group model of the client and the local power data to generate a personalized model. According to the invention, local model training is carried out on the distributed client, model aggregation is carried out on the central server, and efficient, reliable and safe power data anomaly detection is realized in a distributed environment.

abstract: The invention discloses an emotion recognition method and device, a nonvolatile storage medium and electronic equipment. abstract: The invention provides a defect detection apparatus, a defect detection method, and a computer readable storage medium. title: Method for measuring gas content and saturation of rock and soil medium and evaluating disaster pregnancy and disaster reduction based on mesoscopic model construction
abstract: The invention relates to a rock and soil medium gas content and saturation measurement and disaster pregnancy and reduction evaluation method based on mesoscopic model construction. The assembled non-metal rock-soil body CT scanning mold is used for loading and scanning a granular rock-soil body sample, so that artifact interference is reduced. A CT scanning mold, a base body and pores are accurately identified by using the gray value difference, and then liquid and air are accurately identified according to the difference of CT values in the pores. Deep learning is carried out through a neural network, a three-dimensional complex pore network model is established, the gas content zeta can be calculated based on the ratio of the gas phase volume VQ in a three-dimensional mesoscopic model to the total volume VK of pores in a rock-soil body sample, and the saturation degree Sr can be calculated based on the ratio of the liquid phase volume VY to the total volume VZ of the rock-soil body sample. Importing the constructed rock-soil body model into numerical calculation and analysis software or manufacturing completely same test samples in batches at high precision by adopting a 3D printing means, and setting calculation and analysis working conditions according to evaluation requirements. And finally, evaluating the disaster-pregnant and disaster-causing influence effects of the gas content and the saturation on the rock-soil body and the grouting disaster reduction effect by integrating a numerical simulation calculation result and a physical model test result. The method has the characteristics of no damage to the sample, high test precision, visible water (gas)-containing area, high secondary development utilization rate and the like.

title: Radar target identification method based on two-dimensional multichannel adaptive weighted convolutional neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a radar target recognition method based on a two-dimensional multi-channel adaptive weighted convolutional neural network, and the method comprises the steps: inputting two-dimensional data, enabling the two-dimensional data to pass through three channels, carrying out the addition of extracted features, carrying out the global average pooling and global maximum pooling parallel processing, adding obtained feature vectors, carrying out the extraction of the feature vectors, and carrying out the recognition of a radar target. title: Distributed energy system double-layer operation optimization method based on improved chaos optimization algorithm
abstract: According to the invention, a double-layer optimization framework is established, so that the optimal configuration of the solar energy and heat energy storage coupling combined cooling heating and power system is obtained. The outer layer takes the component size as a decision variable, and optimizes the annual economic benefit, the annual carbon dioxide emission and the annual primary energy consumption of the system; and the inner layer takes the equipment output as a decision variable to optimize the operation and maintenance cost. A large hotel is taken as a case for research. The optimization result shows that the proposed double-layer optimization model can realize the optimal configuration scheme and scheduling strategy of the hybrid CCHP. Compared with a rule-based multi-objective single-layer optimization model, the maximum improvement rates of the proposed double-layer optimization model in the aspects of economy, energy and environmental performance are 30.63%, 37.94% and 38.16% respectively. Compared with a rule-based single-target single-layer optimization model, the maximum improvement amplitudes of the proposed double-layer optimization model in the aspects of economy, energy and environmental performance are 34.95%, 35.81% and 37.55% respectively. In addition, thermal energy storage (TES) can greatly improve the optimal performance of the double-layer optimization model.

title: Graph neural network interpretation method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a graph neural network interpretation method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: firstly finding out important nodes in an input graph through a mask mode, enabling the generated discrete nodes to have the structure information of the input graph through a comparison recovery mode, and then generating a sub-graph for the generated discrete nodes. abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, and provides a commodity recommendation method and device based on a recommendation model and electronic equipment. abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a homomorphic implementation method of a nonlinear activation function ReLU. abstract: The invention discloses an image classification method based on a discrete wavelet domain Transform. title: Semiconductor defect detection model training method and semiconductor defect detection method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of semiconductors, and discloses a semiconductor defect detection model training method and a semiconductor defect detection method.The method comprises the steps that an external field modulation luminous intensity distribution image, a sample spectrum image and a fluorescence lifetime image of a semiconductor sample are obtained; fusing the external field modulation luminous intensity distribution image, the sample spectrum image and the fluorescence lifetime image to generate a combined image of the semiconductor sample; carrying out positioning segmentation on the combined image, and identifying to obtain a defect area and a type in the combined image; and performing model training based on the defect area and category label corresponding to the semiconductor sample and the defect area and category in the combined image obtained through identification to obtain a semiconductor defect detection model. abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of image processing, and particularly discloses a method for classifying images with unseen classes and noise labels in online stream data. title: Random string classification for detecting suspicious network activity
abstract: The computing system is configured to train a machine learning model for detecting suspicious network activity based on the training data set. The training of the machine learning model may be supervised training or unsupervised training. The training data set includes a plurality of character strings. For each character string of the plurality of character strings, the computing system extracts one or more N-grams sub-character strings, where N is a natural number equal to or greater than 2. The computing system then determines a probability that each N-gram substring can occur in the string. When the machine learning model is executed, it is configured to classify whether a given character string contained in the network communication is a random character string. In response to classifying a given character string as a random character string, an alert is generated at a particular computing system to which the network communication is directed.

abstract: The invention relates to a human body small airway compliance assessment method and system based on OCT imaging, and the method comprises the steps: collecting different stages of airway lumen image sets through employing Lightlab C7XR OCT equipment under different pressure gradients, and measuring the lumen area of each stage of airway under different gradients; the average value of the pipe cavity area of each stage of air passage under each gradient is the final air passage pipe cavity area; calculating airway pressure values under different pressure gradients, matching the airway pressure values with the airway lumen area, performing fitting to determine a regression coefficient to obtain the compliance of each stage of airway, and dividing the compliance by the baseline airway lumen area to obtain the specific compliance of each stage of airway. title: Electro-optical in-situ nondestructive testing method and system for micron-sized defects of metal component
abstract: The invention discloses an electro-optical in-situ nondestructive testing method for micron-sized defects of a metal component, and belongs to the technical field of metal nondestructive testing. The detection system is composed of a bidirectional pulse current generator, an optical magnification lens, a high-resolution thermal infrared imager, a depth camera and a work station. According to the invention, the problems of positioning and quantification of online detection of tiny defects on the surface of a complex component are solved while the efficiency is considered.

title: Lightning arrester resistive current prediction method and system based on VMD-MVO-ESN combination
abstract: The invention discloses a lightning arrester resistive current prediction method and system based on VMD-MVO-ESN combination. abstract: The invention discloses a large-span arch bridge service state evaluation method and system, and relates to the technical field of arch bridges, and the method comprises the steps: firstly obtaining the actual measurement real response of bridge displacement caused by the load of a bridge-crossing vehicle under an operation condition, and then recognizing the load of the bridge-crossing vehicle in real time through a load recognition algorithm according to the actual measurement real response; according to the actual arch axis shape of the large-span arch bridge, the theoretical limit response of the large-span arch bridge under the bridge crossing vehicle load is calculated, and finally the service state of the large-span arch bridge is evaluated through the envelope comparison between the actual measurement real response and the theoretical limit response. abstract: The invention discloses a high-speed rail overhead line system dropper defect grading detection method through a deep learning method, and relates to the technical field of computers. abstract: The invention discloses a rolling bearing early-stage fault monitoring method based on an attention-enhanced memory residual shrinkage network, and the method comprises the steps: designing a memory unit to extract a hidden time sequence dependence relation in an early-stage operation stage signal of a rolling bearing, and improving the discrimination capability of weak features; a multi-scale parallel convolution kernel is set in a residual block to perform multi-scale representation on the depth features, and meanwhile, a channel attention mechanism and a space attention mechanism are integrated to select information, important for a target task, in the depth features; a smooth soft threshold function based on attention guidance is designed and serves as a nonlinear activation layer of the model, and it is ensured that near-zero weak effective features are reserved while noise-related information in a bearing signal is adaptively eliminated in the feature extraction process of the model. title: Linear neuron circuit and pulse output method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a linear neuron circuit and a pulse output method thereof. The circuit comprises an input circuit, a clamping circuit, a current mirror, a current discharge circuit and a shaping circuit, and the input circuit comprises a plurality of N-type transistors and is used for generating currents of different magnitudes; the clamping circuit is used for stabilizing the drain end of an N-type transistor in the input circuit at a voltage value, so that each transistor outputs a stable and same current value in an on state; the current mirror is used for copying current generated by the input circuit and sending the current to the current bleeder circuit; when the voltage on a capacitor in the current discharge circuit is accumulated to a certain value under the action of current, the circuit correspondingly outputs a pulse; the shaping circuit is used for shaping pulse output. According to the circuit structure, linear rapid pulse output can be achieved, the working mechanism of biological neurons is simulated, and the circuit structure is compatible with a standard integrated circuit technology.

abstract: The invention provides a traffic flow prediction method and device based on double wavelet decomposition. title: Method based on dynamic blasting lumpiness monitoring and reverse blasting parameter optimization
abstract: The invention discloses a method based on dynamic blasting lumpiness monitoring and reverse blasting parameter optimization. The method comprises the steps that a blasting pile picture of a certain mine is collected; marking the ore blocks in the picture by using software and generating a marking file; the algorithm is improved, a network layer is added, and the detection rate of small ores is increased; training by using the image data; identifying the new muck pile image by using the trained model to obtain a marker box with an ore image; an image in the mark box is extracted, and the extracted image is segmented by calling a large model or watershed segmentation is carried out to obtain an ore contour so as to calculate the plane size; obtaining a muck pile image by using a depth camera and obtaining distance data from the camera to the muck pile at the same time, and calculating the actual size of the ore according to a similar triangle rule; counting the number of ore blocks in each diameter interval to obtain a lumpiness distribution rate; according to the method, intelligent identification of blasting lumpiness and practicability, accuracy and real-time performance of lumpiness analysis are realized; the economic benefit is improved.

title: Writing method, system and equipment based on generative text large model and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a writing method, system and equipment based on a generative text large model and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: collecting field-related data for a specific industry and preprocessing the field-related data; selecting a generative text large model, carrying out fine tuning training by utilizing a general corpus of industrial special text corpora and a fine tuning tool, and accelerating the model convergence speed by adopting a DeepSpeed training tool; performing evaluation, parameter adjustment and optimization on the trained generative text large model by using confusion and similarity indexes; generating a user template prompt by using a corresponding Prompt instruction; and on the basis of existing data input by the user and user template prompt, obtaining corresponding compiled text content through the generative text large model. The problems that writing based on a generative text large model is greatly limited in application in a specific professional field, and the fine tuning process is low in efficiency and unstable due to the fact that an effective Prompt instruction template or method is lacked for fine tuning requirements in the specific field are effectively solved.

title: Credit line information determination method and device
abstract: The invention provides a credit line information determination method and device, relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and can be used in the financial field or other technical fields. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a shot image of an animal to be identified in a farm; performing image recognition on whether the to-be-recognized animal in the shot image is a loan target animal based on a preset target animal recognition model; and determining the breeding number of the target animals in the farm according to an image recognition result, and determining credit line information of clients corresponding to the farm according to the breeding number. The device executes the method. According to the credit line information determination method and device provided by the embodiment of the invention, the credit line information can be efficiently and accurately determined.

title: Chinese text recognition method based on deep paradigm
abstract: The invention discloses a Chinese text recognition method based on a deep paradigm. The method mainly comprises two parts: a paradigm query stage and a paradigm reordering stage. The example query stage is mainly used for predicting a recognition result and positioning the position of each character on an image, and meanwhile, a training set is used for building an example library, and the example library comprises global features and local features of each character; in the case reordering stage, a more accurate result is obtained through retrieval and reordering in the case library mainly aiming at the condition of recognition errors in the case query stage, and recognition errors of characters with similar shapes are corrected. Through the combination of the two stages, the accuracy and efficiency of Chinese text recognition are successfully improved, and a powerful solution is contributed to the technical development of the Chinese recognition field.

abstract: The invention provides an animation image generation method based on a variational auto-encoder and related equipment, and the method comprises the steps: setting an auxiliary feature extraction layer in a first convolution submodule of a decoder module, obtaining weight distribution, and enabling the weight distribution to be used for carrying out matrix dot multiplication on a feature matrix after convolution through a conventional convolution layer; the obtained feature matrix enhances the accurate decoding of the image information; an adaptive hybrid algorithm and a reordering attention algorithm are integrated in the third convolution sub-module, a difficult sample is generated from a feature extraction result output by the previous convolution sub-module through the adaptive hybrid algorithm, and according to a linear combination proportion of the feature extraction result output by the previous convolution sub-module in the difficult sample, the difficult sample is extracted; reducing the distance between the difficult sample and the input initial animation picture in the feature space to control the generation range of the feature map; and a feature extraction result is subjected to access operation by utilizing a static random access memory in a convolution process through a reordering attention algorithm, so that the rate of generating the cartoon image is improved.

abstract: The invention discloses a lane line fitting model training method, and a lane line prediction method and device. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a picture of a training sample; inputting the picture of the training sample into a preset semantic segmentation model and at least one preset lane line detection model; matching candidate key points through a semantic segmentation model and a lane line detection model; fitting a first fitting equation based on the candidate key points; and according to the first fitting equation and the data of the candidate key points, generating training data, and training a preset network model by using the training data to obtain a lane line fitting model. title: Variable forgetting rate circuit based on memristor
abstract: The invention discloses a variable forgetting rate circuit based on a memristor. The variable forgetting rate circuit comprises a neuron module, a synaptic module and a forgetting voltage control module, the neuron module comprises a food neuron NF, an auditory neuron NR, more than one logic gate and a salivary neuron NS, and the food neuron NF and the auditory neuron NR are respectively connected with each logic gate; the logic gate selects the corresponding synaptic module or forgetting voltage control module by judging the activation state of the food neuron NF and the auditory neuron NR, and the synaptic module and the forgetting voltage control module output voltage by changing the resistance values of the memristors M1 and M2. According to the variable forgetting rate circuit based on the memristor, not only can the learning and three forgetting functions be realized, but also the forgetting rate can be correspondingly changed according to different stimulation intervals of unconditional stimulation on organisms.

title: Three-dimensional point cloud geometric structured modeling method and system based on quadric surface
abstract: In the prior art, a method using a single geometric model cannot effectively represent a three-dimensional scene with a complex geometric structure; in order to solve the problems that in the prior art, a characterization method mixing multiple geometric models is limited by the complexity of a geometric parameter model, the modeling process is tedious and the accuracy cannot be ensured, the invention discloses a quadric surface-based three-dimensional point cloud geometric structured modeling method and system, the point-level features of a three-dimensional point cloud are learned through a deep neural network, and the accuracy of the three-dimensional point cloud is improved. And performing three-dimensional instance segmentation according to the point-level features by using a clustering method, and performing re-fitting on each three-dimensional instance of which the outer points are removed by using a quadric surface model, thereby realizing unified representation of geometric elements of the three-dimensional scene model. According to the method, 17 three-dimensional geometric primitives such as points, straight lines, planes, cylindrical surfaces and spheres can be uniformly and concisely represented by quadric surface model parameterization, and concisely and compactly structured modeling of a complex and dense three-dimensional scene is realized.

abstract: The invention discloses a vegetable soybean early herbicide stress prediction method, system and device based on hyperspectrum and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of agricultural monitoring, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining hyperspectral images of vegetable soybean leaves under herbicides with different concentrations, carrying out spectral data extraction, and constructing a training set and a test set; constructing a prediction model based on the one-dimensional convolutional neural network, and training and testing the prediction model by using the training set and the test set; and predicting the early herbicide stress of the vegetable soybeans by using the trained prediction model to obtain a prediction result. title: Unmanned aerial vehicle following shot method based on SLAM algorithm
abstract: The invention provides an unmanned aerial vehicle following shot method based on an SLAM algorithm, and the method comprises the steps: firstly obtaining the parameters of an unmanned aerial vehicle and a real-time flight image, carrying out the preprocessing, obtaining the current position of the unmanned aerial vehicle and the coverage range of a camera based on the preprocessed flight image, completing the image recognition, and locking a following shot target; then, flight data of the unmanned aerial vehicle are obtained, graph optimization of SLAM is carried out according to the flight data based on an SLAM algorithm, environmental features are extracted by using a convolutional neural network, and the precision of the SLAM algorithm is improved; a tracking algorithm is constructed according to the real-time flight data of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and a following shot target is tracked in real time and adapts to environmental changes; and finally, sending the motion trail of the following shot target and the adjusted interface layout adjusted according to the historical operation to the user terminal for display, and receiving confirmation information of the user terminal. According to the method, the problems that object movement cannot be tracked in real time and complex environment changes are difficult to adapt in fixed camera position follow-up shooting are solved, and the precision of multi-target follow-up shooting is further improved.

title: Meteorological element forecasting method and system based on machine learning
abstract: The invention discloses a meteorological element forecasting method and system based on machine learning. title: Consumption financial content recommendation method and device, equipment, medium and program product
abstract: The invention provides a consumer financial content recommendation method which can be applied to the fields of big data and artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps of obtaining historical behavior commodities and candidate commodities of a target user in response to a request of accessing a life server by the target user; inputting the historical behavior commodities into a pre-trained commodity encoder to obtain a first vector sequence of the historical behavior commodities, and inputting the first vector sequence into a pre-trained user encoder to obtain a first user vector representation of the target user; inputting each candidate commodity into a commodity encoder to obtain a second vector sequence of the candidate commodities; calculating a dot product of the first user vector representation and the second vector sequence to obtain a predicted purchase rate of each candidate commodity by the target user; and recommending the candidate commodities to the target user based on the predicted purchase rate. The invention further provides a consumer financial content recommendation device and equipment, a storage medium and a program product.

title: Node adaptive learning graph attention neural network traffic flow prediction method
abstract: The invention discloses a node adaptive learning graph attention neural network traffic flow prediction method, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, carrying out the preprocessing of a traffic flow data set, and dividing the data set into a training set and a test set; s2, performing deep representation on the data by using node adaptive learning, and learning dynamic association between nodes; s3, dynamically capturing spatial dependence by using a node adaptive learning graph attention network; s4, capturing local space-time correlation by using a gating cycle unit, and capturing long-time dependence of each space node in a time dimension by using a Transform layer; and S5, performing prediction output by using a full-connection neural network as a prediction layer. According to the invention, the traffic flow data Euclidean data are converted into non-Euclidean data and a graphic structure, which is more in line with the traffic scene; node adaptive learning, a GAT layer, a GRU layer and a Transform layer are used for capturing time correlation and space correlation of traffic data, and the prediction performance of the model is improved.

abstract: The invention provides a text generation method and a training method and device of a text generation model, and relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to the fields of natural language processing, deep learning, reinforcement learning and the like. abstract: The invention discloses a real-time DNN reasoning acceleration method based on end-side cooperation, and belongs to the technical field of edge intelligence. title: Three-dimensional human body reconstruction method and system based on local point cloud geometric information

title: Cable fault detection method and device and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a cable fault detection method and device and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of cable fault detection. The method comprises the following steps: injecting equal-amplitude detection harmonics of which the frequency linearly changes along with time into a to-be-detected cable, and respectively collecting a current response signal and a voltage response signal in the to-be-detected cable through a current transformer and a voltage transformer which are arranged at the input end of the to-be-detected cable; a current response frequency spectrum and a voltage response frequency spectrum are extracted from the current response signal and the voltage response signal through short-time Fourier transform, an input impedance frequency spectrum is obtained according to the current response frequency spectrum and the voltage response frequency spectrum, and an imaginary part of the input impedance frequency spectrum is obtained; the imaginary part of the input impedance frequency spectrum, the input impedance amplitude frequency spectrum and the input impedance phase frequency spectrum are normalized and then input into a pre-trained cable fault detection model for fault positioning detection, and spatial features of impedance about the position are obtained from the input impedance amplitude frequency spectrum and the input impedance phase frequency spectrum through spatial feature extraction network simulation integral transformation; and the positioning precision is improved.

title: Complex scene personnel re-identification method based on multi-modal fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a complex scene personnel re-identification method based on multi-modal fusion, and the method comprises the steps: employing a fusion mechanism, and carrying out the fusion of RGB color features extracted by employing a classification token and depth related features extracted by a depth perception convolutional neural network through a multi-modal fusion token. A multi-modal ternary loss function is introduced, the distance between matching pairs is minimized in a multi-modal feature space, and meanwhile, the distance between non-matching pairs is maximized. By using the method provided by the invention, the performance of the personnel re-identification method in a challenging real scene (illumination dramatic change, complex background, target shielding and large visual angle change) can be effectively improved, and the personnel re-identification method is enabled to be more stable.

title: Party history knowledge base construction method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a party history knowledge base construction method and device, equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The scheme comprises the steps of obtaining and constructing a party history data set; enhancing the party history data set by using an LLM model, and dividing the enhanced data into a first enhanced data set and a second enhanced data set; processing part of the first enhanced data by using the BRAT to obtain a manually annotated data set; performing supervised learning on the manual annotation data by using the BERT model to obtain fine-tuned BERT, and annotating the remaining unannotated first enhanced data by using the fine-tuned BERT to obtain a final annotation data set; training BERT and DREEAM models by using the final annotation data, and respectively inputting the second enhanced data set into the trained BERT and DREEAM models to obtain an entity data set and a relational data set; and constructing the party history knowledge graph according to the two data sets. According to the scheme, the problems that in the prior art, when a knowledge graph is constructed, text enhancement is insufficient in authenticity and deviates from an original label, generated data is lack of compactness, and training data labeling efficiency is low are solved.

title: Mountain torrent disaster probability early warning method based on machine learning
abstract: The invention discloses a mountain torrent disaster probability early warning method based on machine learning, and belongs to the field of mountain torrent disaster early warning, and the method comprises the steps: building and training a PSO-SVM model according to a support vector machine SVM and a particle swarm optimization algorithm PSO, carrying out the prediction of a drainage basin needing early warning through the PSO-SVM model, obtaining the prediction classification and prediction probability of mountain torrent disasters, and carrying out the early warning of the mountain torrent disasters. And the evaluation probability threshold value of the mountain torrent disaster is optimized, and finally a mountain torrent disaster probability early warning result is obtained. According to the method, the particle swarm optimization PSO is used for optimizing the SVM model, the quality of real-time mountain torrent early warning can be improved by quantifying potential mountain torrent disaster occurrence risks through meteorological and hydrological data, meanwhile, the probability threshold value is optimized, the accuracy and stability of mountain torrent disaster early warning are improved, the method has the low missing report rate and empty report rate, and the method is suitable for popularization and application. abstract: The invention discloses a training method for a depth map model during a complete test based on node homogeneity characteristics, and the method comprises the following steps: 1, a pre-training stage: training model parameters through employing source data and a main task loss function, and obtaining a pre-training classification model; step 2, calculating a homogeneity score of each edge; step 3, performing data enhancement based on homogeneity to obtain an enhanced graph; 4, comparative learning: obtaining a positive sample from the enhanced graph, and optimizing the selected sample through comparative learning, and 5, parameter updating: giving target data, updating parameters of the pre-training classification model through comparative learning in the step 4, and obtaining a training model during testing; and step 6, carrying out model selection based on homogeneity. abstract: The invention discloses a sorghum lodging identification method based on a remote sensing image, and the method comprises the following steps: employing two stages of unmanned plane visible light remote sensing images, carrying out the sampling statistics and classification of normal sorghum and sorghum regions with different lodging degrees, extracting the features of sorghum lodging images of different types of sample points, and obtaining a sorghum lodging image; based on the sorghum lodging image, selecting sensitivity parameters of sorghum lodging; the method comprises the following steps: adopting improved ResNet and Effi-cientNetV2 as a sorghum lodging type detection model, and identifying and classifying different-degree lodging regions of sorghum based on sensitivity parameters of sorghum lodging; according to the invention, the accuracy of identifying the sorghum lodging phenomenon is improved, and the labor cost and time cost for identifying the sorghum lodging phenomenon are reduced, so that a user can treat and cure sorghum in time, and the quality and yield of the sorghum are ensured.

title: Fusion feature classification and identification method based on noise reduction underwater acoustic signals
abstract: The invention relates to a fusion feature classification and identification method based on noise reduction underwater acoustic signals, and belongs to the field of underwater acoustic signal processing. abstract: The invention provides an infrared ship target detection method based on task alignment learning. Comprising the following steps: acquiring infrared ship video images in different places and different scenes by operating a civil unmanned aerial vehicle for aerial photography; improvement is carried out on the basis of a YOLOX algorithm, and an infrared ship target detection model is constructed; training the infrared ship target detection model based on the infrared ship video image to obtain a completed infrared ship target detection model; and performing ship target detection according to the completed infrared ship target detection model. title: Farmland obstacle detection method for low computing resource equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a farmland obstacle detection method for low computing resource equipment. The farmland obstacle detection method comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting farmland image data; step 2, using an image synthesis method to synthesize the obstacles into the farmland image data to construct a farmland image target detection data set with the obstacles; 3, pre-training of knowledge distillation is carried out on an Image data set, and a large model is compressed into a lightweight model; step 4, taking the lightweight model as a backbone to adapt to an FPN component in the Mask R-CNN framework to form a detection model; 5, reading a farmland image target detection data set, and performing fine adjustment on the detection model in the constructed farmland data set with the obstacle by using data enhancement; and 6, deploying the trained model to agricultural equipment with low computing resources. In this way, a target detection data set with obstacles and a target detection model suitable for low-computing resource equipment can be obtained, and intelligent design of automatic obstacle detection of agricultural equipment is achieved.

title: Image content description method based on Vision Transform
abstract: The invention discloses an image content description method based on a Vision Transform (Vision Transform). Comprising the following steps: carrying out preprocessing of equal-ratio zooming and channel conversion on an input image; normalizing each channel of the input image; extracting image features by using a CNN network; embedding the feature map slices and carrying out two-dimensional position coding; a Vision Transform is used to encode the image information in a self-attention mode; using a target detection decoder to embed and apply cross attention to the image encoding information according to the query to generate image object information; stacking the image coding information and the image object information to generate image comprehensive information; gradually generating image description by using a character decoder according to the image comprehensive information and the right-shift description output; compared with an existing method, the method has better capturing capability on image detail content when image description is generated, and the generated description language is more accurate and smoother.
