title: Cascade hydropower station equipment fault emergency scheduling method and system
abstract: The invention provides a cascade hydropower station equipment fault emergency scheduling method and system. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical operation data and real-time operation data of each level of hydropower station in cascade hydropower stations; determining an important power flow section of each level of hydropower station in the power grid topology; carrying out equipment fault analysis and monitoring based on the important power flow section in combination with the real-time operation data and the power grid topology; calculating the power generation power loss of the fault hydropower station according to the fault analysis result of the equipment fault analysis monitoring; generating an initial emergency scheduling scheme of the cascade hydropower stations by combining the real-time operation data and the power generation power loss and adopting a genetic algorithm; predicting to obtain the maintenance recovery time when all the fault hydropower stations are recovered to the normal operation state; and combining the real-time operation data, the power generation power loss and the maintenance recovery time, and adopting a second-generation genetic algorithm to generate an optimal emergency scheduling scheme of the cascade hydropower stations. The method has the effect of safely and quickly carrying out real-time emergency scheduling.

title: Server fault prediction method and device
abstract: The invention discloses a server fault prediction method and device, and relates to the technical field of server monitoring. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a historical fault record in a first preset time period before prediction from a fault database of a server; acquiring second time sequence data corresponding to the running state of the server in a second preset time period before the prediction; determining a node association relationship based on the first time sequence data and the second time sequence data; constructing a heterogeneous graph comprising fault recording nodes and running state nodes according to the node association relationship; based on the graph embedding vector of the server, updating the weight of each edge between the fault record node and the running state node in the heterogeneous graph; and predicting the future fault condition of the server according to the updated heterogeneous graph. According to the method and the device, the technical effect of predicting the future fault condition of the server is realized.

title: Gearbox incremental fault diagnosis learning method based on adaptive distillation
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of fault diagnosis, in particular to a gearbox incremental fault diagnosis learning method based on adaptive distillation, and the method comprises the steps: collecting vibration signals of a gearbox in different fault states; obtaining a characteristic value after projection through a task stage 0 model; calculating a mean value of the similarities to obtain a feature value of a projection layer t in the task stage; constructing a loss function of the task stage t model; acquiring a characteristic value of the fault data through a task stage T; outputting a linear classification prediction result, and updating linear classifier parameters; and calculating the distance between the fault data and the class feature center of each type of playback sample, and obtaining a nearest neighbor classification prediction result. title: Oil-cooled electrically-driven rotor temperature prediction method and device, medium and vehicle control unit
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of automobiles, in particular to an oil-cooled electrically-driven rotor temperature prediction method and device, a medium and a vehicle control unit. title: Carbon flux prediction method based on whale algorithm optimization neural network
abstract: The invention provides a whale algorithm optimization neural network-based carbon flux prediction method. The method comprises the steps of obtaining observation data and future climate factor data, constructing downscaling prediction data based on the observation data and the future climate factor data, and constructing a data set based on the downscaling prediction data; dividing the data set into a training set and a test set, and performing data normalization processing; constructing a hybrid network framework based on a convolutional neural network and a bidirectional long-short term memory network; obtaining optimal parameters of the model based on a whale optimization algorithm; inputting the optimal parameters of the model into a hybrid network framework, and performing model training to generate a carbon flux prediction model; obtaining a prediction result based on the carbon flux prediction model; and carrying out reverse normalization processing on the prediction result. title: Association risk assessment method and device of entity
abstract: The invention provides an association risk assessment method and device of an entity, which can be used in the financial field or other technical fields. The method comprises the following steps: establishing an equity relation model graph according to equity information of each entity; obtaining a risk entity corresponding to the equity relation model graph according to each entity and a risk entity set included in the equity relation model graph; according to the risk entities corresponding to the equity relation model diagram and the equity relation model diagram, establishing a first risk structure diagram corresponding to each risk entity; according to the first risk structure chart corresponding to each risk entity, establishing a second risk structure chart corresponding to each risk entity; and performing associated risk assessment according to the first risk structure chart corresponding to each risk entity and the second risk structure chart corresponding to each risk entity. The device is used for executing the method. According to the entity association risk assessment method and device provided by the embodiment of the invention, the reliability of entity association risk analysis is improved.

title: Hyperspectral remote sensing image classification method and system based on attention second-order pooling
abstract: The invention discloses a hyperspectral remote sensing image classification method and system based on attention second-order pooling, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a first-order feature corresponding to each feature block in a hyperspectral remote sensing image, and obtaining a corresponding second-order pooling feature according to each first-order feature; calculating a space attention weight matrix corresponding to each feature block according to each first-order feature; obtaining an embedded feature corresponding to each feature block, and calculating a spectral attention weight matrix corresponding to each feature block; calculating a corresponding attention weight matrix according to the space attention weight matrix and the spectrum attention weight matrix corresponding to each feature block, and calculating a corresponding attention second-order pooling feature; and obtaining a final fusion vector according to each attention second-order pooling feature, and performing classification according to the final fusion vector to obtain a classification result. According to the invention, the classification accuracy of the hyperspectral remote sensing image is improved.

title: Infectious disease information monitoring and early warning system and method
abstract: The invention discloses an infectious disease information monitoring and early warning system and method, the system comprises a data information collection module, a data processing module, a disease evaluation and analysis module, an early warning monitoring module and a monitoring center platform, the data information collection module is connected to the data processing module, the data processing module is connected to the disease evaluation and analysis module, and the early warning monitoring module is connected to the early warning monitoring module. The disease evaluation and analysis module is connected to the early warning and monitoring module, and the early warning and monitoring module is connected to the monitoring center platform. The beneficial effects of the system are that the data information collection module, the data processing module, the disease assessment analysis module and the early warning monitoring module play an important role in infectious disease joint control, and through timely collection, analysis and processing of epidemic situation data, the severity and the propagation trend of epidemic situations can be accurately assessed, important reference is provided for decision makers, and the risk of infectious disease joint control is reduced. A decision maker is helped to take measures as soon as possible through an early warning and reminding function, and resources are allocated to cope with spreading of infectious diseases.

title: Intelligent fire-fighting spraying control system based on data mining
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of fire-fighting spraying control, in particular to an intelligent fire-fighting spraying control system based on data mining, which comprises a fire detection module, a risk analysis module, a data mining module, a control decision module, a spraying control module and a fire-fighting database. Fire detection is carried out on the target concave building, fire identification is carried out on the target concave building in real time, if the fire risk of the target concave building is identified, the fire spreading distance of a designated area corresponding to the target concave building is analyzed, a spraying control strategy is further generated, and accurate spraying is carried out on the designated area. According to the invention, the accuracy of spraying control is improved, meanwhile, long-time negative effects on public health and environmental protection are effectively reduced, effective control on fire behaviors is realized, excessive spraying on areas which are not affected by fire disasters is avoided, and potential damage to building structures is reduced.

title: Turbine optimization method for fuel cell based on BPNN NSGA II
abstract: The invention discloses a turbine optimization method for a fuel cell based on BPNN NSGA II for the first time, relates to the field of fuel cell cathode exhaust energy recovery, can quickly and accurately obtain the optimal geometric structure of a turbine, and comprises the following steps: determining turbine design parameters based on the cathode exhaust condition of the fuel cell; initial design and three-dimensional numerical simulation of the turboexpander are carried out; defining a specific problem of turbine optimization, and establishing an initial database based on Latin hypercube sampling and three-dimensional numerical simulation; and training a proxy model of a turbine optimization problem based on a BP artificial neural network, performing optimization calculation on turbine prediction performance in an optimization interval based on an NSGA II algorithm, and verifying the accuracy of a BPNN NSGA II coupling optimization result based on three-dimensional numerical simulation. A mixed flow angle is introduced into an optimization variable, the constraint between the rotor outlet blade tip radius and the inlet average radius is increased, and it is guaranteed that an optimization result has high performance within a wide range.

title: Rape space mapping method based on multi-source remote sensing data and machine learning
abstract: The invention provides a rape spatial mapping method based on multi-source remote sensing data and machine learning, which utilizes a remote sensing cloud computing platform to monitor and analyze spectrum and phenological characteristics of wide-range rape before and after a flowering period, and utilizes a phenology and machine learning method to realize overall monitoring of rape flowering phenological period based on multi-source environment variables. Oilseed rape flowering phenology priori is provided for a supervised classification algorithm; on the basis of the generated training samples, noise samples are automatically eliminated through a spectral angle mapping method, and rape large-range remote sensing space mapping of the whole to-be-detected area is achieved on a Google Earth engine remote sensing cloud computing platform by means of the obtained Landsat image. According to the method, remote sensing and environment variable data are coupled, the rape flowering phenology information estimation method based on multi-source data and a machine learning algorithm is provided, and the space-time limitation of a traditional field investigation method and a site recording method in the field of crop phenology monitoring is effectively broken through.

abstract: The invention provides a bottle cap detection method, device and equipment and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: collecting a bottle cap defect image, constructing a picture set, and marking the picture set; constructing an ST-YOLO detection model, training the ST-YOLO detection model by using the picture set until convergence, and obtaining a trained ST-YOLO detection model; wherein the ST-YOLO detection model comprises a convolutional layer used for extracting features, a CST module used for fusing global features and local features to generate a multi-scale feature map, a BiFPN network used for fusing multilayer features, and a classification layer used for classifying and regressing features output by the BiFPN network; and detecting a to-be-detected bottle cap image by adopting the trained ST-YOLO detection model to obtain a detection result, so as to solve the problem that the bottle cap detection effect cannot balance the detection precision and the real-time performance in the face of complex scenes, illumination changes and visual angle changes.

title: River channel abnormal floating object detection method based on self-similarity enhancement and intensive processing
abstract: The invention relates to a river channel abnormal floating object detection method based on self-similarity enhancement and intensive processing, and belongs to the technical field of image processing. Training samples are input into a feature extraction network to extract multi-layer features, the extracted multi-layer features are respectively input into a dense processing module to expand and correct a receptive field, then the features are input into a feature enhancement module to carry out self-similarity feature enhancement, the features are up-sampled to the size of an original image, channels are reduced to obtain a plurality of corresponding feature maps, and the feature maps are subjected to feature extraction; the feature maps and the feature maps spliced on the channels are compared with sample labels to calculate the total loss, and the network is trained. And inputting a test sample into the trained network, splicing several obtained feature maps on channels, reducing the channels to obtain output, and then taking Sigmoid to obtain a prediction map. According to the invention, the defects of misjudgment and missing detection of the model during detection of abnormal river channel floaters with small size or strong background interference or strong reflection on the water surface are effectively overcome.

title: Tobacco field pest control method and system based on big data
abstract: The invention relates to the field of pest control, in particular to a tobacco field pest control method and system based on big data. The method comprises the following steps: identifying a first abnormal tobacco picture and a normal tobacco picture from tobacco field remote sensing pictures through tobacco spectral characteristics; acquiring tobacco disease and insect pest data in the tobacco field area, and setting different colors for different disease and insect pest data; performing color fusion on the disease and insect pest data of different colors and the first abnormal tobacco picture, calculating disease and insect pest areas of the tobacco field region according to a fused second abnormal tobacco picture, and calculating a difference value of the disease and insect pest areas at adjacent first time points and a disease and insect pest area change rate; establishing a prediction model according to the difference value of the pest and disease damage area and the pest and disease damage change rate, predicting the pest and disease damage area of the tobacco field through the prediction model, calculating the pest and disease damage degree according to the pest and disease damage area and the total area of the tobacco field area, and calculating pest and disease damage resistance according to the pest and disease damage degree. Different countermeasures are taken according to the pest and disease damage degree and pest and disease damage drug resistance.

abstract: The invention provides a night human body out-of-bed posture alarm monitoring method, and relates to the technical field of image recognition. Comprising the steps of obtaining a night human body off-bed posture data set, constructing a lightweight self-attention LSA, constructing a pre-feedback network FFN, constructing a first-order converter unit OTU, constructing a second-order converter unit TTU, constructing a lightweight decoder LD, constructing a night human body off-bed posture detection model, training the night human body off-bed posture detection model and performing real-time detection. title: OFDM signal detection method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention provides an orthogonal frequency division multiplexing (OFDM) signal detection method based on deep learning, and solves the problem of low detection accuracy in a low signal-to-noise ratio scene. Comprising the following steps: collecting a signal sample when an OFDM signal exists and a noise sample when the OFDM signal does not exist as an original sample set, preprocessing the original sample set, and calculating to obtain an instantaneous amplitude and an instantaneous frequency; obtaining a training sample set by combining the existing or non-existing labels of the OFDM signals; initializing the convolutional neural network, and training the convolutional neural network by using the training sample set to obtain a trained neural network model based on signal detection; the method comprises the following steps: extracting a plurality of signal segments from a to-be-detected signal collected in real time, performing power normalization, extracting an IQ sequence, calculating to obtain the instantaneous amplitude and instantaneous frequency of each signal segment, and inputting the instantaneous amplitude and instantaneous frequency into a neural network model based on signal detection to obtain the confidence of each signal segment; a fusion confidence coefficient is calculated based on the confidence coefficient of each signal segment; and judging whether the signal to be detected has an OFDM signal detection result or not based on the fusion confidence coefficient.

title: Cliff garbage cleaning robot based on bird claw bionic mechanism
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of robots, and discloses a bird claw bionic mechanism based cliff garbage cleaning robot which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle, a camera device is arranged on one side of the top of the unmanned aerial vehicle, a bottom plate is arranged at the bottom end of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and two garbage cleaning mechanisms are symmetrically arranged on the two sides of the bottom of the bottom plate. The unmanned aerial vehicle body is used as an operation platform, the unmanned aerial vehicle can reach an area where human beings cannot work conveniently, images can be collected through a camera on the unmanned aerial vehicle, a target is captured, a garbage target is recognized in combination with a garbage detection recognition algorithm, and therefore the bionic bird claw can be used for grabbing garbage; the problem of garbage cleaning in special areas is solved.

title: Abnormal mechanical state detection method and device for on-load tap-changer
abstract: The invention provides a mechanical state anomaly detection method and device for an on-load tap-changer, and belongs to the field of state detection of power equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a vibration signal of the on-load tap-changer in a first preset time period; performing time-frequency analysis on the vibration signal to obtain a time-frequency image corresponding to the vibration signal; segmenting the time-frequency image into a plurality of superpixel blocks to obtain a time-frequency segmented image corresponding to the vibration signal; establishing a first graph structure corresponding to the vibration signal according to the distance between the superpixel blocks in the time-frequency segmentation image; and determining a mechanical state anomaly detection result of the on-load tap-changer based on the first graph structure and a second graph structure corresponding to the vibration signal of the on-load tap-changer in a second preset time period before the first preset time period. According to the invention, the mechanical state of the on-load tap-changer can be accurately detected.

title: Emotional reason pair extraction method based on machine question answering and joint coding
abstract: The invention discloses an emotional reason pair extraction method based on machine question answering and joint coding, which comprises the following steps: step S10: obtaining clauses and keywords of a target text, and carrying out BERT coding on the clauses to obtain implicit representations of the clauses in the text; using the keyword information to update the implicit representation of the clause to obtain a keyword semantic enhanced clause representation; s20, according to a preset probability threshold value and the semantically enhanced clause representation, extracting an emotion clause representation and a reason clause representation, and pairing the emotion clause representation and the reason clause representation to obtain a representation of an emotion reason clause pair; and S30, constructing a relational graph convolutional neural network by using the clause representation and the representation of the clause pair, and obtaining an emotion reason pair extraction result based on the relational graph convolutional neural network. title: Mechanical arm inverse kinematics solving method based on improved particle swarm optimization
abstract: The invention provides a mechanical arm inverse kinematics solving method based on an improved particle swarm optimization (IPSO). The mechanical arm inverse kinematics solving method comprises the following steps that 1, MDH parameters of a mechanical arm are determined according to the structure of the mechanical arm; 2, a forward kinematics model of the mechanical arm is deduced according to the MDH parameters; 3, a fitness function is defined, and the inverse kinematics model solving problem of the mechanical arm is converted into the optimization problem of solving the minimum value of the fitness function; and 4, solving the minimum value of the fitness function by adopting an improved particle swarm algorithm. According to the solving method provided by the invention, a method for selecting parameters such as inertia weight of a particle swarm algorithm is improved, some initial particles are randomly selected for variation, and the optimal particles after variation are selected to replace the initial particles; an improved particle swarm algorithm with particle diversity, adaptive inertia weight and asynchronous change learning factors is provided, the global search capability and the local search capability of the particle swarm algorithm are balanced, and the inverse kinematics problem of the mechanical arm is solved.

title: Multi-scale target detection method based on depth information scene graph generation
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-scale target detection method based on depth information scene graph generation. The method comprises the following steps of: 1, acquiring a Visual Genome data set; step 2, constructing a multi-modal scene graph generation network S fused with depth information, and introducing the depth information into a scene graph generation process to avoid interference of a visual dislocation effect on predicate prediction; and step 3, performing a scene graph generation experiment on the multi-modal scene graph generation network S fused with the depth information to obtain a scene graph generation task performance index of the network under the Visual Genome data set. title: Periodical literature metadata directory construction method, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention provides a periodical literature metadata directory construction method and device and a medium, and relates to the field of document image recognition, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a geological document image, and carrying out the preprocessing; based on a Cascade Mask RCNN model, a ConvNext model, a feature pyramid network and a region suggestion network, constructing a document image recognition model; training a document image recognition model through the preprocessed geological document image, and adjusting parameters of the document image recognition model; acquiring a geological document image to be identified, and performing target detection on the geological document image to be identified to obtain a regional mask image and category information; extracting text information in the regional mask image through an OCR technology and category information; and carrying out screening, filtering and label alignment on the extracted text information, and displaying the text information. title: Resource determination method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a resource determination method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining first resource feature information of target equipment at a t moment, the first resource feature information at least comprises equipment attribute information and resource consumption information comprising a space-time sequence identifier, and the first resource feature information comprises the equipment attribute information and the resource consumption information comprising the space-time sequence identifier; the space-time sequence identifier is used for determining time information and space information contained in the resource consumption information; based on the first resource feature information, determining second resource feature information of the target device at the t + n moment by using a target model; wherein t is a positive integer, and n is a positive integer; the target model at least comprises a spatial information processing sub-model and a time information processing sub-model, the second resource feature information at least comprises resource consumption information combining time information and spatial information, and the second resource feature information is at least used for resource management.

title: Three-dimensional image, three-dimensional video, monocular view and training data set generation method and device, storage medium and program product
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a three-dimensional image generation method, a three-dimensional video generation method, a three-dimensional view generation method, a three-dimensional video generation method, a single-eye view generation method, a training data set generation device, a storage medium and a program product. In the embodiment of the invention, a two-dimensional image is used as a monocular view, and another monocular view with a cavity area is rendered based on a three-dimensional scene corresponding to the two-dimensional image; performing hole repairing based on the attention mechanism to obtain another monocular view without a hole area; and synthesizing the two monocular views to obtain a three-dimensional image. Similarly, a three-dimensional video is generated based on the two-dimensional video. The three-dimensional image/video is generated based on the two-dimensional image/video without depending on professional 3D shooting equipment, so that the manufacturing cost of the three-dimensional image/video can be reduced, and large-scale production can be realized. Another monocular view is rendered based on a three-dimensional scene, so that a hole generated by human eye parallax is better simulated, and the three-dimensional effect is better improved; the cavity is repaired based on the attention mechanism, and the repaired view keeps high resolution.

title: Data erasing method and device
abstract: The invention provides a data erasing method and device. The data erasing method comprises the steps of generating a first teacher model and a second teacher model according to a deep learning model; calculating a first erasing gradient of the deep learning model and a first distillation gradient of the first teacher model according to the first teacher model and the deep learning model; projecting the first distillation gradient to a first erasing gradient direction of a deep learning model to obtain a first parallel distillation gradient of the deep learning model, and updating the deep learning model according to the first parallel distillation gradient to obtain an updated deep learning model; calculating a second distillation loss of the second teacher model according to the second teacher model and the updated deep learning model; and performing distillation training on the deep learning model according to the second distillation loss to obtain the deep learning model after data erasing. The problem that a deep learning model cannot erase sensitive data is solved.

title: Intelligent computing power calling management system and method based on data characteristics
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of scheduling management, and discloses an intelligent computing power calling management system and method based on data features. According to the method, historical task data are collected, a standard sample set is constructed, the historical task data in the standard sample set are preprocessed, data feature extraction is performed through a convolutional neural network based on the obtained preprocessed historical task data, and meanwhile, user demand task data are collected; extracting feature data of the user demand task data in real time through a convolutional neural network, matching the feature data with feature data of the preprocessed historical task data, predicting a task data calculation amount of the user demand task data, and performing computing power resource scheduling based on the predicted task data calculation amount of the user demand task data. And the efficiency and the real-time performance of intelligent computing power calling management are improved.

title: P-band burst signal starting point detection method
abstract: The invention discloses a method for detecting a starting point of a P-band burst signal. According to the method, firstly, a time-frequency graph of a burst signal is utilized to complete imaging construction, and signal front pilot frequency point energy distribution and noise energy distribution in an image have obvious difference; secondly, the network provided by the invention comprises a backbone network and a feature fusion network. In a backbone network, a receptive field is expanded by utilizing fast spatial pyramid pooling and a multilayer convolution structure, and high-level rich semantic features such as a spatial relationship between a preamble and noise in a signal time-frequency image are acquired in combination with a proposed RMS module; in a feature fusion network, a DenseBlock-based feature pyramid and path aggregation network cascade module is provided, signal leading high-level semantic features extracted from a backbone network and low-level information such as texture and contour of the signal leading high-level semantic features are fused in a multi-scale manner, and the detection accuracy of the burst signal starting point is improved.

title: Urban storage and drainage space optimization method and simulation system oriented to urban-water relationship
abstract: The invention discloses a city water relationship-oriented city storage and drainage space optimization method and a simulation system, particularly relates to the field of city water resource management and optimization, is used for solving the problems of low efficiency and poor coping capacity of a city storage and drainage system, and avoids the influence of short-term seasons on original data through a long and short-term memory network. The contribution of the reservoir in the scheduling network is analyzed, the comprehensive significance and mutual influence are analyzed and calculated in combination with a multi-layer network, and the importance of the reservoir is evaluated from multiple dimensions. And a high-pressure area reservoir is identified by adopting a clustering optimization method, and space optimization is carried out, so that the adjustment capability is enhanced, and the pressure of a high-load area is relieved. And the reliability of an optimization result is checked by combining a self-service method and Monte Carlo simulation, so that the stability and the consistency of a high-influence area are ensured, and accidental judgment is avoided. Accurate regulation and control of the urban storage and drainage system are realized, the resource scheduling efficiency is improved, the stability and sustainability of urban water resource management are ensured, and a scientific and effective optimization scheme is provided.

title: Intelligent building air conditioning system control method
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent building air-conditioning system control method, which belongs to the field of building air-conditioning control methods, and comprises the following steps: providing an HVAC control preset value for a calibrated building digital model according to a preset control algorithm; inputting local weather state information to the calibrated building digital model, performing simulation by the building digital model according to the plan and the local weather state information, and providing temperature and humidity feedback data to a control algorithm; the control algorithm checks whether a thermal comfort standard is met or not according to the received temperature and humidity feedback data, and if yes, the HVAC set point plan does not need to be modified; if not, the HVAC setpoint plan is modified according to the thermal comfort threshold and then sent to the HVAC control system; the HVAC control system begins to operate according to an HVAC setpoint plan after receiving the plan. According to the method, the crowd position in the building can be predicted, so that the air conditioning device is accurately controlled, and the aim of saving energy of the building is achieved.

title: Table item searching method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a table item searching method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing, the table item searching method comprises the following steps: obtaining to-be-searched first information; processing the first information by adopting a cuckoo hash algorithm, and determining a target position for searching the first information for the first time from a data table; determining whether the target position contains the first information; if yes, searching for the first information is ended; and if not, determining the maximum number of iterations corresponding to the target position, and continuing to search the first information from the data table by adopting the cuckoo hash algorithm until the number of lookup times reaches the maximum number of iterations. By applying the scheme provided by the embodiment of the invention, high-efficiency table look-up can be realized.

abstract: The invention discloses a financial risk data identification method and device, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of data processing, and the method comprises the steps: determining a preset first weight, a preset second weight, a data set corresponding to a to-be-trained model, and a preset model evaluation index; dividing the data set into a training set and a test set according to a K-fold cross validation method, and performing weighted calculation on evaluation indexes of the training set and the test set by using the first weight and the second weight based on a Bayesian parameter adjustment method and a preset model training function so as to obtain corresponding function values during training; and determining a maximum target function value from the plurality of function values, and obtaining a target model based on the model parameter corresponding to the target function value, so as to identify the financial small sample data to be identified by using the target model, and obtaining a risk data identification result. title: Medical image fusion method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a medical image fusion method and device based on deep learning, equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: S1, obtaining a to-be-fused original medical image for a target object, and carrying out the preprocessing of the original medical image, and obtaining the enhanced medical image data; s2, performing depth information extraction on the enhanced medical image data to obtain a depth feature information graph containing preliminary feature information; s3, extracting multi-scale complementary information from the depth feature information graph to obtain a fused feature information graph; and S4, inputting the fusion feature information graph into a convolution reconstruction module to obtain a final visual fusion grayscale image. title: Panchromatic sharpening method based on super-resolution reconstruction task auxiliary feature extraction
abstract: The invention relates to a panchromatic sharpening method based on super-resolution reconstruction task auxiliary feature extraction, and belongs to the field of remote sensing image processing. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a multi-stage PAN feature extraction module and a multi-stage LRMS super-division module, and respectively inputting two types of preprocessed image data into corresponding modules; constructing a multi-stage feature fusion module, fusing image features from the PAN feature extraction module and the LRMS super-resolution module, and constructing a feature interaction relationship between modules of different images; and constructing two reconstruction modules with the same structure but not shared parameters, respectively reconstructing and recovering the output features of the panchromatic sharpening task and the super-resolution reconstruction task, and generating a super-resolution MS image and a high-resolution multispectral HRMS image. According to the method, extra constraints are provided for the panchromatic sharpening task by introducing the super-resolution task, the network module is encouraged to have higher feature extraction capability, and the performance of the panchromatic sharpening task is improved.

abstract: The invention provides a data set construction method and apparatus, a computer device and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an original driving scene data set; detecting each original image in the original driving scene data set by using a pre-trained image quality evaluation model to obtain first quality evaluation information of each original image, and constructing a first data set based on the original images and the first quality evaluation information; training an image quality evaluation model by using the first data set to obtain a target image quality evaluation model; and detecting the amplified image associated with each original image in the first data set by using the target image quality evaluation model to obtain second quality evaluation information of each amplified image, and updating the first data set by using the amplified images and the second quality evaluation information to obtain a second data set. title: Image category prediction processing method for field generalization based on feature decoupling and category center matching
abstract: The invention discloses a feature decoupling and class center matching-based field generalization image class prediction processing method. The method comprises the following steps of: for a to-be-processed image, acquiring a field generalization data set corresponding to the to-be-processed image; performing text decoupling on texts in the field generalization data set; image decoupling is carried out on images in the field generalization data set; and constructing a class center memory, obtaining a domain-related prediction probability by using the class center memory, obtaining a domain-independent prediction probability through calculation, carrying out weighted summation on the domain-related prediction probability and the domain-independent prediction probability to obtain a prediction probability of a total category of the to-be-processed image, and outputting the prediction probability. According to the method, the class center memory is constructed, the prediction probability related to the field is obtained, the prediction probability related to the field is combined with the prediction probability unrelated to the field, the overall prediction probability is obtained, and the prediction probability of the overall class of the to-be-processed image is greatly improved.

title: Image information assisted three-dimensional object detection method
abstract: The invention provides a three-dimensional object detection method assisted by image information. The three-dimensional object detection method comprises the following steps of 1, performing feature extraction on a point cloud containing a to-be-detected three-dimensional object and a corresponding image; 2, fusing the features of the point cloud and the image based on a block self-attention mechanism to obtain a fused multi-modal feature; 3, generating a foreground point mask based on the fused multi-modal features, and carrying out the multi-scale feature extraction of the emphasized foreground according to the foreground point mask to obtain feature maps of the point cloud under different resolutions; and step 4, generating a target detection proposal, namely interpolating the feature maps under different resolutions based on a three-nearest neighbor interpolation method, fusing the interpolated features with multi-modal features by using a multi-layer perceptron, and sending the fused features and multi-modal features to a two-stage detection module, thereby generating the target detection proposal and completing the image information-assisted three-dimensional object detection.

title: Method for extracting blood volume pulse wave form from face video based on IPPG technology
abstract: The invention provides a method for extracting a blood volume pulse wave form from a face video based on an IPPG technology, and belongs to the technical field of non-contact signal detection. The method comprises the following steps: S10, intercepting a face region frame sequence from a video containing a face, and carrying out face 3D modeling and face feature point capturing on the face region frame sequence; s20, selecting a proper region of interest according to the facial feature points, obtaining an RGB value frame sequence of the region, and obtaining a z-axis coordinate value frame sequence changing along with the frame sequence by using a 3D model of the human face; and S30, based on the RGB value frame sequence and the z-axis coordinate value frame sequence of the region of interest obtained in the S20, extracting a blood volume pulse wave form through an encoder-decoder neural network model. According to the invention, a deep learning network model of a time encoder-decoder is designed, a new method for extracting feature values from a face video is designed, and noise information containing motion artifacts caused by face movement is also extracted while a blood volume pulse wave signal is extracted. The signal-to-noise ratio of the signal initially input by the model is improved, and the accuracy of the blood volume pulse wave form is greatly improved. The method can be applied to the fields of human physiological signal measurement, biological recognition and the like.

title: Depression intensity identification method based on spatial-temporal feature integration and global-local feature fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a depression intensity identification method based on spatio-temporal feature integration and global-local feature fusion, and the method comprises the following steps: 1, constructing a global feature learning branch model, and inputting a human face global image sequence of a depression patient into the model to obtain human face global features; 2, constructing a local feature learning branch model, and inputting the eye region image sequence of the depression patient into the model to obtain local features; 3, constructing a human face global feature and local feature semantic correlation feature fusion module, calculating the correlation weight of the human face global feature and the local feature, and fusing the semantic consistency information of the global feature and the local feature to obtain a fused feature; and 4, inputting the fusion features into a full-connection layer, connecting the fusion features with the full-connection layer only containing one neuron, outputting a depression intensity score, and identifying depression intensity through the depression intensity score. The depression intensity identification method based on spatio-temporal feature integration and global-local feature fusion is reasonable and effective, and the accuracy of depression intensity identification can be effectively improved.

title: Copy number variation detection method based on neural network and improved particle swarm algorithm
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of deep learning, in particular to a copy number variation detection method based on a neural network and an improved particle swarm algorithm. The method comprises the steps that a to-be-detected sample is input into a neural network model optimized based on an improved particle swarm algorithm, and the neural network model determines the difference value of the occurrence rate between a sequencing sample and a reference genome, the GC content, the base quality, the correlation between adjacent sites of the genome and the number of repeated read segments in the bin range; calculating a copy number variation state probability value of the to-be-tested sample, wherein the improved particle swarm algorithm comprises three different updating strategies; obtaining a plurality of copy number variation state probability values output by the neural network model; and selecting the target copy number variation state corresponding to the maximum probability value as the current sample copy number state of the to-be-detected sample. The objective of the invention is to solve the problem of how to improve the detection efficiency of copy number variation by using deep learning.

abstract: The invention provides a UPQC-based power distribution network operation optimization method and device, and relates to the technical field of power grids. title: Method and system for preparing gradient coating by combining synchronous arc surfacing and cold spraying
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of coating composite preparation, and discloses a method and a system for preparing a gradient coating by compounding synchronous arc surfacing and cold spraying. title: Non-contact conductive film material sheet resistance simplification test method based on artificial intelligence
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of sheet resistance testing, in particular to a non-contact conductive film material sheet resistance simplified testing method based on artificial intelligence. Based on a non-contact testing method commonly used in the field of electromagnetic wave absorbing materials, a reflection loss curve of a conventional wave absorbing structure Salisbury screen formed by a film material and a substrate is tested, and meanwhile, an artificial intelligence model is controlled by a program to predict reflection loss of wave absorbing structures of Salisbury screens with different sheet resistances. And continuously adjusting the sheet resistance and gradually reducing the range to fit the reflection loss curve obtained by the test, and finally carrying out backstepping to obtain the sheet resistance of the membrane material. According to the invention, a series of problems existing in a contact test of a traditional four-probe method can be fundamentally solved; the method has the advantages of high operation speed and high efficiency, can give full play to the generalization ability of artificial intelligence, and can obtain the sheet resistance of the conductive film material within or even outside the training range only through one-time training of the artificial intelligence model.

title: Data-driven quantum deep neural network prediction method of nanocomposite
abstract: The invention proposes a data-driven quantum deep neural network prediction method for a nanocomposite, and the method employs data driving to construct a database of a quantum deep neural network, improves the deep neural network through quantum calculation, applies the probability amplitude of quantum bits to the deep neural network, and achieves the prediction of the quantum deep neural network. The training process of the deep neural network represents the superposition of multiple states, and the weight updating of the deep neural network is realized by using a quantum revolving door, thereby realizing the optimization solution of a target. According to the data-driven quantum deep neural network prediction method, the electrical performance of the nano composite material doped with the nano filler is predicted through the data-driven quantum deep neural network. abstract: The invention provides a weak supervision character search method and device based on multi-granularity graph convolution and a medium. title: OFDM signal peak-to-average ratio suppression method oriented to WiFi (Wireless Fidelity)-7
abstract: The invention discloses a WiFi (Wireless Fidelity)-7-oriented OFDM (Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing) signal peak-to-average ratio suppression method, which mainly solves the problems of insufficient search precision and limited optimization capability when an optimal phase factor group is searched in the prior art. According to the implementation scheme, high-order quadrature amplitude modulation is carried out on an input binary bit stream to generate an original frequency domain sequence, and frequency domain partitioning is completed; after up-sampling is carried out on the frequency domain sub-blocks, inverse fast Fourier transform is carried out to generate time domain sub-blocks; randomly generating a plurality of phase information groups and iteratively updating the phase information groups; calculating a decision parameter Q and a decision parameter Temp with different definitions, and adopting different search strategies according to values of the decision parameters Q and Temp to iteratively update the phase information group; and selecting an optimal phase factor group from the iterated phase information group, and carrying out weighted summation on the optimal phase factor group and the time domain sub-blocks to obtain a signal after peak-to-average ratio suppression. According to the method, more excellent peak-to-average power ratio (PAPR) suppression gain can be obtained with limited computing resources, the computing complexity of an OFDM system is reduced, and the method can be used for a WiFi (Wireless Fidelity) indoor communication scene.

title: Non-line-of-sight building layout and target position joint estimation method, device and product
abstract: The invention discloses a non-line-of-sight building layout and target position joint estimation method, device and product, is applied to the technical field of non-line-of-sight detection, and aims to solve the problems that most of existing methods are based on target distance information, and when multiple targets exist in a scene, the existing methods cannot realize accurate positioning of the targets. The invention provides a non-line-of-sight building layout and target position joint estimation method based on multi-domain information. Firstly, according to a ray tracing criterion, a multi-target multi-path echo model in a non-line-of-sight scene is established; then, a path identification criterion is constructed based on the relation between the emergence angles and the incidence angles of different types of multipath signals; and finally, according to an identification result, building layout and target position estimation is realized by using the angle and distance information of the target. According to the invention, accurate estimation of the target position and the building layout can be realized in a non-line-of-sight scene, and high positioning accuracy can still be maintained in a low signal-to-noise ratio environment.

abstract: A wavelength parallel photon tensor nucleus is provided. Systems and methods are provided for generic matrix multiplication using wavelength parallel processing of photon tensor kernels. abstract: The invention discloses a user selection and resource optimization method for federated learning assisted by an unmanned aerial vehicle, and the method comprises the steps: building a target function for improving the training efficiency in consideration of the problem that the training efficiency of federated learning is low in actual deployment due to the heterogeneity of participating equipment in a network and limited communication resources; wherein the objective function is composed of communication time delay and calculation time delay when the user participates in training in each training round. abstract: The invention discloses an immune cell image segmentation method and system based on multi-instance learning. title: Tracing method, device and equipment for fusing digital watermarks and medium
abstract: The invention relates to a traceability method, device and equipment fused with a digital watermark and a medium, belongs to the technical field of anti-counterfeiting, and is used for solving the problems of low anti-counterfeiting capability and lower credibility of a traceability identification product in the prior art. According to the technical scheme, the method mainly comprises the steps of obtaining product information, taking the product information as a plaintext, and encrypting the plaintext through a random multiple digital signature technology to obtain a digital signature of the plaintext; acquiring an original image, and inputting the original image and the digital signature into a diffusion generation model of a fusion cross attention module to form a digital watermark image; performing loss simulation based on the digital watermark image to form a loss image set; inputting the lost image set into a digital watermark decoder for training, and extracting the digital signature from the digital watermark image through the trained digital watermark decoder; and verifying the digital signature.

title: Rock-fill dam deformation parameter multi-target dynamic inversion method
abstract: The invention discloses a rock-fill dam deformation parameter multi-target dynamic inversion method, which comprises the following steps: carrying out sensitivity analysis on an obtained parameter sample based on a constructed finite element rock-fill dam model to obtain a to-be-inverted parameter, and determining a value range of the to-be-inverted parameter; constructing a PCE agent model based on the value range of the to-be-inverted parameter; and based on the PCE proxy model and a multi-objective function established based on the rock-fill dam partition, introducing an MOGSA/D dynamic multi-objective algorithm for iterative optimization to obtain an inversion parameter. According to the method, the regional influence of material parameters on deformation, the global effect of the material parameters and the time-varying influence of the rock-fill dam are considered by applying a multi-target dynamic optimization algorithm, and multi-target dynamic inversion analysis is performed on the dam, so that the obtained inversion parameters are more reliable and reasonable.

title: Method and device for sea space data management through dynamic remote sensing monitoring
abstract: The invention discloses a method and device for sea space data management through dynamic remote sensing monitoring, and relates to the related field of marine disaster management, and the method comprises the steps: extracting a first historical sea disaster time sequence; time sequence characteristic analysis is carried out; when the disaster rate of the target sea area reaches a preset probability threshold value, sending a remote sensing monitoring instruction; activating the multi-remote sensing equipment to perform multi-source remote sensing feature monitoring to obtain a predetermined remote sensing time sequence; matching the first remote sensing resource and the first remote sensing environment at the first remote sensing time; taking a first coefficient obtained by weighting the first remote sensing resource by the variable coefficient as a weight, and adjusting the first remote sensing environment to obtain a first effective remote sensing environment; analyzing and verifying the target sea area disaster rate to obtain a target effective sea area disaster rate; and performing sea area regulation and control management. The technical problem that existing sea space data management is insufficient in the aspect of ecological environment and resource exploitation balance is solved, and the technical effect of achieving dynamic balance of the ecological environment and resource exploitation is achieved.

title: Image processing method, electronic device, storage medium and computer program product
abstract: The invention discloses an image processing method, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product, and relates to the technical field of large models and computers. The method comprises the steps that a target object image, a posture guiding image and a target text are acquired, the display content of the target object image at least comprises a designated part of a target object, and the target object image is used for guiding a to-be-generated target scene image to keep input features associated with the target object; the posture guide image is used for guiding a to-be-generated specified posture of the target object in the target scene image, and the target text is at least used for describing to-be-displayed specified content in the target scene image; and generating a target scene image based on the target object image, the posture guide image and the target text. title: Deep learning-based polyester fiber polymerization process intrinsic viscosity calculation method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of polyester fiber production, in particular to a polyester fiber polymerization process intrinsic viscosity calculation method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of establishing an LSTM neural network model, training, putting into use and correcting. According to the model, an enhancement gate is introduced into an initial LSTM, polyester fiber polymerization process technological parameters at historical moments are preprocessed and sorted into samples and serve as input values of the model, intrinsic viscosity true values at the historical moments are preprocessed and sorted into samples and serve as labels of the model, and prediction values are obtained by modeling each set of input values. Therefore, the prediction precision of the model is improved. According to the method, new gating is added to the model, the prediction precision of the model is improved, and the prediction precision is obviously more important for an offline system model in the field, so that the method can better guide production to a certain extent and has a great application prospect.

title: Regional power grid operation optimization method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a regional power grid operation optimization method and system. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a regional power grid operation optimization model; and solving the regional power grid operation optimization model based on a dual-intelligent algorithm cooperation strategy formed by an improved artificial bee colony algorithm and a self-adaptive Harris eagle algorithm to obtain a regional power grid operation optimization scheme. According to the method, a regional power grid operation optimization model is solved based on a double-intelligent algorithm cooperation strategy formed by an improved artificial bee colony algorithm and a self-adaptive Harris eagle algorithm, so that the search space can be effectively expanded, the algorithm is prevented from being caught in local optimum too early, and meanwhile, according to problem characteristics and dynamic information in the solving process, the algorithm can be effectively optimized. The algorithm strategy is adaptively adjusted, and high efficiency of the solving process and high precision of the result are realized.

title: Anti-seismic hysteresis pressure transmitter based on intelligent control
abstract: The invention discloses an anti-seismic hysteresis pressure transmitter based on intelligent control, and relates to the technical field of pressure transmitters, the anti-seismic hysteresis pressure transmitter comprises a display module, the display module is provided with a display screen and an external port, the bottom of the display module is fixedly connected with a control module, and the bottom of the control module is connected with an acquisition module; the control module collects a historical training data set in advance, and a machine learning model for predicting the frictional resistance applied by the control module to the acquisition module is trained based on the historical training data set; the acquisition module acquires pressure data, temperature data and a friction coefficient in real time, and predicts frictional resistance applied to the acquisition module by the control module by using a machine learning model based on the pressure data, the temperature data and the friction coefficient; the sliding displacement of the piston rod in the friction block is changed through friction resistance, the influence of the environment temperature of the anti-seismic hysteresis pressure transmitter is counteracted, and the accuracy of pressure data collected by the metal film piezoresistive piece is guaranteed.

title: Cloud task scheduling method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of automobiles, in particular to a cloud task scheduling method and device, equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a task set and a resource information set, clustering subtasks in the task set to obtain a task clustering set, and clustering resource information in the resource information set to obtain a resource information clustering set; performing clustering center coding on the sub-task clusters in the task cluster set to obtain task cluster center codes, and performing clustering center coding on the resource information clusters in the resource information cluster set to obtain resource information cluster center codes; calculating the difference degree between the task clustering center code and the resource information clustering center code, determining a resource information cluster corresponding to a task cluster corresponding to the task clustering center code based on the difference degree, and obtaining a cluster matching result; and processing the clustering matching result based on a preset ant colony optimization algorithm to obtain resource information corresponding to each subtask in the clustering matching result. The efficiency of cloud task scheduling can be improved.

title: Triple extraction method based on cross-layer bidirectional retention mechanism
abstract: The invention is applicable to the technical field of text sentiment analysis, and provides a triple extraction method based on a cross-layer bidirectional retention mechanism, which comprises the following steps of: S1, inputting a sentence; s2, learning word-level context representation of an input sentence through a BERT pre-training language model, performing two-dimensional modeling on the context representation, and converting the context representation into word vectors in a filling table for interaction; s3, inputting the word vectors into a word-level semantic analysis sub-module and a word pair-level extraction sub-module respectively; s4, inputting the output in the step S3 into an emotion recognition enhancement module for key extraction of aspect items and opinion items and recognition of overlapped emotion types; s5, combining the output of the step S3 and the output of the step S4 to predict a table filling result; and S6, ending the prediction, and displaying a final prediction triple result. According to the method, the triple extraction precision can be improved, and the recognition efficiency of the overlapped triple in the long paragraph can be greatly enhanced.

title: Lightweight high dynamic range image synthesis method based on parallel visual self-attention model
abstract: The invention provides a method for synthesizing a high-quality ghosting-free high-dynamic-range (HDR) image from a multi-exposure low-dynamic-range (LDR) image based on a parallel visual self-attention model. The method comprises the following steps: 1) firstly, extracting low-layer features from three input LDR images with different exposure values by using a convolutional layer and a space attention module; 2) segmenting the low-layer features into non-overlapping image blocks; and 3) sending the image to a parallel visual self-attention module, and effectively capturing features and information in the image. And 4) finally, synthesizing a final HDR image through a convolutional layer and an activation function. The parallel architecture of the model enables the network to become wider and deeper, and three LDR images with different exposures are synthesized into a high-quality ghosting-free HDR image through faster speed and fewer computing resources, so that the method is very suitable for being deployed on various edge devices.

title: Coding method for user track interest points
abstract: The invention relates to a user track coding technology, and discloses a user track interest point coding method, which comprises the following steps of: taking an interest point as input, and obtaining embedded representation of the input interest point by utilizing an interest point embedding matrix and based on a mapping relation between the interest point and the interest point embedding matrix; the interest point embedding matrixes are in one-to-one correspondence with interest points in an interest point set, and are obtained through pre-training based on sign-in data of a corresponding model training set by utilizing comparative learning and a relation distillation mode; the interest point set is a set composed of interest points contained in the sign-in data of the corresponding model training set. The problem of noise caused by mutual interference among factors during multi-factor fusion in an existing coding mode is solved. The method has good practicability in sign-in point coding in the fields of position service, intelligent traffic management, social media recommendation and the like.

title: Drilling parameter optimization method for increasing speed and efficiency
abstract: The invention discloses a drilling parameter optimization method for increasing speed and efficiency, and relates to the technical field of oil and gas well engineering. The method comprises the following steps: establishing a theoretical heat exchange amount model of a high-temperature and high-pressure stratum based on heat exchange amount of a stratum seepage field and heat generated by rock breaking of a drill bit; an actual heat exchange amount model of the high-temperature and high-pressure stratum is established based on well drilling actual measurement parameters; obtaining a heat error based on the theoretical heat exchange amount model and the actual heat exchange amount model; calculating the reliability of the heat error based on the influence of the drilling parameters on the heat error, and dividing the drilling parameters and the corresponding heat error into a training set and a to-be-optimized data set based on a reliability threshold; training the training set on the basis of an eagle optimization algorithm, outputting an optimal combination of the drilling parameters, and calculating the drilling parameters in the to-be-optimized data set on the basis of the optimal combination of the drilling parameters to obtain optimized drilling parameters. According to the method, the drilling parameter combination can be optimized, and the aim of increasing the drilling speed and efficiency of the deep high-ground-temperature-gradient stratum is achieved.

title: Image denoising method and device based on FFDNet and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of digital image processing, in particular to an FFDNet-based image denoising method and device and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps of: performing down-sampling operation on an original image to obtain a sub-picture, and adding random noise to the sub-picture to generate a tensor; secondly, taking the tensor as input, executing multiple times of convolution through a convolution network, and performing zero filling operation on a convolution result after each time of convolution; performing up-sampling operation on a result obtained after the last convolution and zero filling to obtain a processed image; performing difference description on the processed image and the original image, and updating parameters of the convolutional network according to the difference description; and finally, repeating the above method until a preset number of training times is reached, and obtaining an optimal parameter of the convolutional network. The denoising effect of the denoising convolutional network obtained by the method is far better than that of a traditional denoising algorithm; the denoising effect of the method is close to that of a DNCNN network, but detail and edge information can be reserved, and the defect that the DNCNN is poor in universality and flexibility is overcome.

title: Multi-source remote sensing data fusion classification method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a multi-source remote sensing data fusion classification method and device, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of image data processing. The method comprises the following steps: performing dynamic convolution feature extraction on a first image block of a first remote sensing image and a second image block of a second remote sensing image to obtain a first interaction feature and a second interaction feature; and performing feature fusion on the first interaction feature and the second interaction feature to obtain a first semantic feature, a second semantic feature and a fused semantic feature, inputting the first semantic feature, the second semantic feature and the fused semantic feature into a classifier for classification prediction, and obtaining a fused classification result according to three obtained classification results. Interaction features of remote sensing data of different data sources are obtained through a dynamic convolution feature extraction method. In the fusion stage, the advantages of the data sources are exerted based on the interaction features, and the fusion semantic features with the strong representation capacity are obtained. And result fusion is performed on classification results, so that the classification accuracy of the multi-source remote sensing data is further improved.

title: Method for binning three-generation metagenome by using overlap graph
abstract: The invention discloses a method for binning a three-generation metagenome by using an overlapping graph. The method comprises the following steps: constructing overlapping graph information of a metagenome Reads; constructing and fusing composition and coverage features; probability sampling is carried out on the whole data set; the extracted samples are clustered and marked; and performing binning by using the graph neural network to obtain a final binning result. Aiming at the current situation that relatively long original sequence information generated by a third-generation sequencing technology cannot be well extracted and combined with the characteristics of relatively long sequences, the invention provides a metagenome binning method depending on an overlap graph, the overlap graph is constructed through an approximate overlap region between the sequences, and a k-mer frequency vector is calculated, so that the metagenome binning efficiency is improved. Node degree information and k-mer frequency are subjected to feature fusion, and the method aims at solving the problems that at present, feature extraction is insufficient, a feature fusion mode is not standard, sample sampling is inaccurate, and consequently box separation result fluctuation is large.

title: Image sensor and operating method thereof
abstract: The invention relates to an image sensor and an operation method thereof. An image sensor includes: a plurality of column lines; a plurality of pixels coupled to the plurality of column lines and configured to output a plurality of pixel signals to the plurality of column lines in response to a first control signal; and a plurality of memory cells coupled to the plurality of column lines and configured to output a plurality of convolution signals in which the plurality of data signals are reflected in the plurality of pixel signals to the plurality of column lines in response to a second control signal.

title: Multi-modal imaging and detection system for oral cavity and tongue
abstract: The invention discloses an oral cavity tongue multi-mode imaging and detecting system. The imaging system comprises a common light path and three receiving and transmitting light paths. The three receiving and transmitting light paths are respectively an OCT receiving and transmitting light path, a Raman receiving and transmitting light path and a multispectral receiving and transmitting light path; the common light path comprises a first long-wave-pass dichroic light filter, a second long-wave-pass dichroic light filter, an X-Y scanning galvanometer and a focusing lens; according to the invention, two long-wave-pass dichroic optical filters are used to form three light branches of which the wavelength ranges are not intersected with each other; therefore, optical signals of OCT acquisition, Raman spectrum acquisition and multispectral spectrum acquisition are integrated in the same optical path, so that an OCT image, a Raman spectrum image and a multispectral image are acquired at the same time, and the efficiency of multimodal data acquisition is improved; and errors introduced in multiple times of repeated acquisition are eliminated, and the accuracy of multi-modal fusion identification is improved. And meanwhile, the image matching operation during multi-modal data fusion is also omitted.

title: Electrochemical polishing method and system for metal workpiece, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses an electrochemical polishing method and system for a metal workpiece, electronic equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps that the pressure value of a polishing wheel on the metal workpiece and the rotating speed of a motor or the rotating speed of the polishing wheel are obtained; according to the pressure value and the rotating speed, a reference current value is obtained through calculation based on a calculation model; and controlling a power supply to output the reference current value as a polishing current. title: Rapid virus screening and detecting method
abstract: The invention discloses a rapid virus screening and detecting method which comprises the following steps: acquiring user information and specific virus colloidal gold antibody detection image data acquired by a virus reagent detection box, and performing virus capture on a to-be-detected sample acquired in a public place by adopting a metamaterial substrate or immune globulin; and exciting the metamaterial substrate to generate near-field electromagnetic waves by adopting laser with a specific wave band, so that the captured virus generates a near-field enhanced Raman spectrum, and calling a whole genome sequence of the EBV according to an Epstein-Barr virus genome. In the technical scheme provided by the invention, a deep learning model is established according to the characteristic that the Raman spectrum of the coat protein of the novel coronavirus has obvious characteristics, and the virus of a sample to be detected is captured by adopting a metamaterial or immunoglobulin.
