title: 3D space sound source positioning method and device combined with audio and video signals
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, in particular to a 3D space sound source positioning method and device combining audio and video signals. The method comprises the following steps: extracting audio features of a speaker; extracting visual features of the speaker; constructing a DL network based on the SWAVF and the AVS3D; training a DL network based on the extraction results of the audio features and the visual features; inputting to-be-detected data to the trained DL network, and completing 3D space sound source positioning combined with audio and video signals; according to the invention, a visual-auditory combination mechanism is innovatively introduced, and audio features are supplemented by using visual features, so that the positioning accuracy in a complex sound field environment is greatly enhanced. Secondly, short-time Fourier transform (STFT) is used to carry out efficient preprocessing on the audio signals, and accurate capture of time-frequency domain characteristics of the audio is ensured.

title: Self-adaptive display method for SOC (State of Charge) of lithium battery
abstract: The invention discloses a self-adaptive display method of a lithium battery SOC (State of Charge). The method comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring lithium battery SOC data in each time period to form an original data sequence, inputting the original data sequence into a bp neural network model to obtain a prediction result of a display value of the lithium battery SOC at the current moment, and comparing the prediction result with an actual result to output a relative error proportion; s2, obtaining a display interval of the display value of the SOC of the lithium battery at the current moment by adopting a Markov chain; and S3, correcting the display interval of the Markov chain by using a particle swarm algorithm, and outputting a display result. The Markov chain is adopted to detect the current state of the lithium battery, self-adaptive lithium battery electric quantity display is carried out according to the state, the lithium battery electric quantity display precision can be greatly improved, meanwhile, the particle swarm optimization is adopted to carry out correction, and the battery electric quantity display precision can be further improved. And the user can more accurately know the current condition of the battery.

title: Business income prediction method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to a business income prediction method and device, equipment and a storage medium. Determining a macroscopic factor income predicted value based on the macroscopic factor, the macroscopic factor income predicted value being used for representing the income generated by the influence of the macroscopic factor, and the macroscopic factor being used for representing the factor influencing the business income of the store from the macroscopic perspective; an event factor income prediction value is determined based on the event factor, the event factor income prediction value is used for representing the income generated by the influence of the event factor, and the event factor is used for representing the event factor occurring in the store; and obtaining a business income prediction result based on the macroscopic factor income prediction value and the event factor income prediction value. title: Behavior tracking method for moving target
abstract: The invention discloses a behavior tracking method for a moving object in the technical field of graph phase information tracking processing, and aims to solve the technical problems of slow response and high environmental requirements in moving object recognition. The method comprises the following steps: capturing a field environment change according to an event stream and a timestamp, tracking a moving target so as to overcome environmental obstacles and identify an image of the moving target; time information and asynchronous updating characteristics in an event stream are supplemented through fusion of three-channel space-time events; a plurality of feature planes are extracted in multiple stages, so that the fused feature map has information of different depths; events with different polarities are respectively stored in different event channels, so that the situation of positive and negative polarity offset is avoided, information loss is prevented, and a fusion feature map is better used to track a moving target; a target detection model is adopted to obtain position parameters and size parameters of the moving target from the fusion feature map, a control instruction is formulated, and the method has the advantages of high precision, real-time performance, robustness, adaptability, expandability and the like.

title: Three-dimensional object matching, characterization and model training method, device and equipment
abstract: The invention relates to a three-dimensional object matching, characterization and model training method, device and equipment. Obtaining a graph structure corresponding to the three-dimensional object; the graph structure is obtained by taking each surface in a three-dimensional model of the three-dimensional object as a graph node and connecting the graph nodes corresponding to two surfaces adjacent to each line in the three-dimensional model by using edges; processing the graph structure by using a pre-trained graph neural network model to obtain graph representation of the three-dimensional object; and determining a target object matched with the three-dimensional object based on the graph representation. Therefore, by directly building the graph structure based on the three-dimensional model and carrying out object matching according to the graph structure, modeling with higher precision can be realized, and the accuracy of object matching is further improved.

abstract: The invention provides a neural network structure side channel attack method based on LSTM (Long Short Term Memory). abstract: The invention provides an icing fault prediction method and device for a fan blade, and relates to the technical field of fan fault monitoring. title: Data sharing scheme based on key feature extraction
abstract: The invention relates to a data sharing scheme based on key feature extraction. The scheme specifically comprises system modeling, wherein the scheme is composed of a plurality of data providers and a block chain platform; in the feature extraction stage, each data provider processes local data by using a variational auto-encoder (VAE), extracts robust features and calculates key features. In the primary sharing stage, each data provider carries out random noise processing, packaging and encryption on the extracted key features and then uploads the key features to a block chain platform. All parties then extract key features from the block chain to form a global shared feature set, and the global shared feature set is combined with local robust features to be used for subsequent federal learning tasks. And a federated learning stage: each party executes federated learning based on the feature set and the local features, and a unified machine learning model is trained in a distributed cooperative manner until the model is fitted or reaches a predetermined number of iterations. And when the model is updated each time, global parameters are encrypted and aggregated by adopting a homomorphic encryption technology, so that privacy security is ensured, and privacy leakage through reverse derivation of the model parameters is prevented.

title: Differential bee colony algorithm for cognitive agricultural Internet of Things resource allocation based on OFDMA radio frequency energy collection

abstract: The invention discloses an all-air autonomous cooperative computing method and system for an unmanned aerial vehicle group. The system can realize high-precision and low-delay onboard sensing data processing through autonomous cooperative computing of the unmanned aerial vehicle group. The system comprises an elastic efficient task scheduler, a lightweight accurate deep learning reasoning performance predictor and an inter-unmanned aerial vehicle reasoning data adaptive compressor. abstract: The invention discloses an efficient model training method and system based on data driving. title: Health state assessment and early warning method for pile foundation structure deformation
abstract: The invention discloses a health state evaluation and early warning method for deformation of a pile foundation structure, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the model training through a pile foundation data set through a BP neural network, so as to construct a pile foundation vulnerable point prediction model, and achieving the prediction of a pile foundation vulnerable point of an unknown pile foundation structure according to the pile foundation vulnerable point prediction model. The method can accurately predict the position of a breakable point influencing the pile foundation structure, constructs an analytic hierarchy process judgment matrix according to the predicted breakable point, obtains the weight ratio of the breakable point relative to the deformation of the pile foundation structure according to the analytic hierarchy process judgment matrix, and determines the position of the breakable point according to the weight ratio of the breakable point relative to the deformation of the pile foundation structure. According to the method, the pile foundation structure deformation early warning threshold value is calculated and obtained, risk evaluation of the pile foundation structure is quantitatively achieved, accurate evaluation and early warning of the health state of pile foundation structure deformation are achieved through the damage degree of the easily-damaged points of the pile foundation, labor consumption is greatly reduced, and the working efficiency is improved. title: Remote sensing image crop classification method considering global consistency and edge specificity
abstract: The invention discloses a remote sensing image crop classification method considering global consistency and edge specificity, and relates to the technical field of image processing, in which spectral domain feature learning is utilized to improve the capture capability of a deep learning network on complex features of crops, a Fourier transform strategy and an adaptive dynamic filter are adopted to construct an AFSF module, and the AFSF module is utilized to construct an AFSF model; a convolutional neural network FSEU-Net based on Fourier spectrum domain learning is designed, and the method comprises the steps of obtaining and preprocessing a high-time-resolution remote sensing image, making a crop sample set, training a convolutional neural network model and an adaptive dynamic filtering module, testing the model and outputting a crop classification result. title: Intraoperative nursing behavior recognition system based on computer vision
abstract: The invention relates to an intraoperative nursing behavior recognition system based on computer vision. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, deploying a multi-angle high-resolution camera in an operating room to collect video data including behaviors of surgeons and nursing personnel, and carrying out data labeling and classification through professional medical personnel; secondly, adopting a deep learning model including a convolutional neural network (CNN) or a recurrent neural network (RNN), performing nursing behavior recognition and classification in combination with a multi-task learning technology, and analyzing time sequence data in the video by using a long short-term memory (LSTM) network so as to recognize a time sequence mode of the behavior; further adopting a dynamic region extraction algorithm, adjusting the region of interest according to the dynamic change in the scene, and combining the local behavior characteristics with the global scene information; and finally, through behavior intention analysis and abnormal behavior detection, establishing a behavior prediction model, predicting a nursing behavior occurring next, and timely detecting an abnormal nursing behavior which is not consistent with a conventional operation process.

title: Real-time dance synchronous evaluation method and system based on attention mechanism
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and computer vision, in particular to a real-time dance synchronous evaluation method and system based on an attention mechanism, and the method comprises the following steps: obtaining a multi-view dance performance video; preprocessing the multi-view dance performance video to obtain a preprocessed video; detecting and tracking human body key points based on the preprocessed video to obtain a key point coordinate sequence; constructing and training a time sequence attention network based on the key point coordinate sequence; calculating a synchronization degree score by using a time sequence attention network; generating real-time feedback information according to the synchronization degree score; storing the synchronization degree score and the feedback information as historical data; analyzing historical data and generating long-term improvement suggestions; the real-time feedback information and the long-term improvement suggestions are fed back to the user for guiding subsequent dance training; updating the time sequence attention network according to subsequent training data of the user to realize continuous optimization; 95% of synchronization degree evaluation accuracy is realized, and the delay is reduced to 25ms.

title: Power system frequency stability control method based on dual-channel deep neural network
abstract: The invention discloses a power system frequency stability control method based on a dual-channel deep neural network. The method comprises the following steps: determining a possible fault setting set in a receiving end system; performing time domain simulation in a receiving end system; in an allowable range of normal operation of the receiving end system, combining various possible frequency stability control measures in the receiving end system to form a series of feasible control action sets; in actual operation of the power system, if active power shortage is caused by faults, characteristic quantity data of key nodes are collected in real time, action quantity data in a control action set are sequentially combined with the characteristic quantity data to be sent into a pre-trained regression neural network to predict the frequency of a receiving end system, and reliable control actions are screened out by taking the frequency as a standard; and performing secondary screening on all the reliable control actions to obtain the optimal frequency stable control action of the receiving end system under the current fault condition. The output frequency stability control action can effectively recover the frequency of the receiving end system.

abstract: The invention discloses a federated learning training method and system fused with a trusted execution environment, and the method comprises the steps: collecting and processing the data of three-level nodes in a safety environment of a management node through introducing the management node and utilizing the hardware protection characteristics of the TEE, and carrying out the training to generate an intermediate result; and an intermediate result is transmitted to the first-level coordination node, and the first-level coordination node summarizes and distributes the intermediate result to other second-level nodes, so that a joint modeling process is completed. title: Hydropower station reservoir flow prediction method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention relates to a hydropower station reservoir flow prediction method based on deep learning, and belongs to the technical field of computers. The method specifically relates to how to accurately predict the reservoir flow of a hydropower station in industrial production, so that an electric power management department can better regulate and control the operating power of a generator set, and the development goal of energy conservation and environmental protection is achieved. According to the method, flow data of a hydropower station in recent years are continuously sampled according to a period T, the sampled data comprise historical storage flow data, environmental data, rainfall forecast data and rainfall observation data of a telemetering station, the data are all time sequence data, then an LSTM network is established to carry out time sequence modeling on the LSTM network, the LSTM network has excellent time sequence prediction capability, and the time sequence prediction capability of the LSTM network is improved. And meanwhile, feature extraction is carried out on the input data by using CNN, so that high-dimensional features in the data can be better captured, and a model capable of accurately predicting the reservoir flow of the hydropower station is obtained after training and optimization are carried out on the high-dimensional features. The reservoir flow prediction capability of the hydropower station can be remarkably improved, so that the energy utilization rate and the environmental protection level are improved.

title: Method and device for determining transportation scheme of rail transit line
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a method and device for determining a transportation scheme of a rail transit line, and the method comprises the steps: determining a plurality of preliminary intersections of the rail transit line based on the passenger flow volume of the rail transit line in a research period and the train load factor of each of a plurality of turn-back stations, the starting point and the terminal point of each of the plurality of preliminary intersections are respectively a starting station, a terminal station and one and the other of a plurality of turn-back stations in the rail transit line; determining a plurality of target intersections from the plurality of preliminary intersections according to the train number, the train load factor and the running interval of the rail transit line; and for each of the plurality of target routes, determining a stop scheme of an intermediate station of each of the plurality of target routes based on a genetic algorithm so as to minimize the total travel time of the passengers. abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of large generative models, in particular to a self-adaptive teaching method based on a large generative model, and the method comprises the steps: collecting learning data of a plurality of targets in real time, calculating a difficulty value according to the learning data, and generating exercises corresponding to the difficulty, and the difficulty of generating exercises is adaptively adjusted according to the completion condition of the target. abstract: The invention relates to the field of switch cabinet partial discharge signal prediction, and provides a switch cabinet partial discharge phenomenon prediction method and device and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: collecting a partial discharge signal of a switch cabinet in real time, and obtaining a real-time partial discharge signal; acquiring environment data of the switch cabinet in real time to obtain real-time environment data; constructing a partial discharge phenomenon prediction model based on the long and short term memory network, wherein the partial discharge phenomenon prediction model is a prediction model of the partial discharge phenomenon of the switch cabinet; and inputting the real-time partial discharge signal of the switch cabinet and the real-time environment data into the partial discharge phenomenon prediction model to obtain a predicted partial discharge signal of the switch cabinet at the next moment, and determining a prediction result of the partial discharge phenomenon of the switch cabinet according to the predicted partial discharge signal. title: Water environment health multi-index system evaluation method for winter rivers in cold regions
abstract: The invention discloses a water environment health multi-index system evaluation method for a winter river in a cold region, and belongs to the technical field of water environment health management, and the method comprises the following steps: constructing a river water environment health evaluation index system; collecting index data of a river, dividing river water environment health grades, and performing same-level grade division on the indexes according to the river water environment health grades; respectively calculating the weight value of each index data from subjective and objective by adopting an analytic hierarchy process and a LightGBM model, and comprehensively optimizing the weight based on the game theory to obtain a combined weight; an improved matter-element extension model is combined with the combined weight, the correlation degree of river health is obtained, and the river water environment health evaluation grade is determined according to the correlation degree. title: Building outer wall crack detection method and system, medium and program product
abstract: The invention discloses a building outer wall crack detection method and system, a medium and a program product, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a to-be-detected building outer wall image, inputting the to-be-detected building outer wall image into a building outer wall crack detection model, and outputting a building outer wall crack detection result. The building outer wall crack detection model comprises an encoder and a decoder; the encoder adopts a VMama encoder and is used for extracting feature maps with different resolutions in four stages; and the decoder is constructed by using a visual state space block of VMamba and a convolutional neural network, a detail-guided gating fusion mechanism is introduced to fuse feature maps of different resolutions of each stage of the encoder and the decoder, and a crack detection result is obtained through a residual module and a classification head. According to the method, the calculation rate and the complete crack extraction capability are improved; a detail-guided gating fusion mechanism is introduced, so that coding features and decoding features from different stages can be better fused, and the detection precision and robustness of the building outer wall cracks are improved.

title: Depth maneuvering target tracking method based on target state space projection
abstract: The invention discloses a depth maneuvering target tracking method based on target state space projection, relates to the technical field of radars, and effectively solves the problem of inaccurate target position estimation during target tracking of a maneuvering target in the prior art. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring target track data of a radar after signal processing and data association, and converting target measurement data into multi-channel image data according to a sliding window mode; and inputting the multi-channel image data into the trained deep neural network to obtain an estimated position of the target in the image, thereby obtaining position estimation of the target in a specific space, and completing maneuvering target tracking. According to the method, performance loss caused by insufficient utilization of measurement noise distribution information is avoided, and the target tracking precision in a maneuvering target scene is effectively improved.

title: Phase-shifting transformer-considered day-ahead optimal scheduling method for double-layer power distribution network
abstract: The invention relates to a double-layer power distribution network day-ahead optimization scheduling method considering a phase-shifting transformer, and the method comprises the steps: collecting the operation data of a power distribution network, and carrying out the data preprocessing, and obtaining the operation sequence data of the power distribution network; deep learning is carried out according to the operation sequence data of the power distribution network, and distributed photovoltaic output is predicted; according to a distributed photovoltaic output prediction result, a double-layer optimization model is adopted to carry out power distribution network optimization scheduling, and an upper layer of the double-layer optimization model takes network loss minimization as a target and takes constraint conditions of a power distribution network system into consideration to carry out optimization scheduling; the lower layer of the double-layer optimization model takes the minimum sum of loop closing impact currents during reconstruction as a target, considers constraint conditions of a power distribution network system and constraint conditions of a phase-shifting transformer, and performs optimization scheduling; and performing day-ahead optimization scheduling of the power distribution network according to a scheduling result calculated by the double-layer optimization model. Compared with the prior art, the method has the advantages that the power distribution system under distributed photovoltaic large-scale access can operate more safely and stably, and the calculation speed is increased.

title: Generated video detection method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a generated video detection method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the discrete cosine transform processing of each frame of video image in a to-be-detected video, and determining each frame of video image after the discrete cosine transform processing; synchronously inputting the first feature of each frame of video image after discrete cosine transform processing and the first feature of each frame of video image into a detection network layer, and performing time domain branch processing on the first feature of each frame of video image, performing frequency domain branch processing on the first feature of each frame of video image after discrete cosine transform processing, fusing the time domain feature of each frame and the frequency domain feature of each frame, and outputting a fusion vector of each frame; and performing classification prediction processing on the fusion vector of each frame, and outputting whether the to-be-detected video is a generated video or not. abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of computers, and discloses a server performance detection method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining performance monitoring data, a system log, environment monitoring data and configuration information of a to-be-detected server; according to the performance monitoring data, the system log, the environment monitoring data and the configuration information, generating performance detection features of the to-be-detected server; according to semantic features and grammatical features of sub-words in the performance detection features, converting the sub-words in the performance detection features into embedded vectors to obtain a target embedded vector sequence corresponding to the performance detection features; and inputting the target embedded vector sequence into a target performance detection model, and determining a performance detection result of the to-be-detected server according to the target embedded vector sequence based on the target performance detection model. title: Unsupervised cross-domain user matching method based on embedding correction
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of social media data analysis, and relates to a preprocessing, feature extraction, classification and similarity calculation technology of user data, in particular to an unsupervised user identity association technology based on embedding correction. Comprising the following steps: S1, performing data preprocessing in manners of sorting, cleaning, conversion, normalization and the like; s2, based on a pre-training language model and a graph neural network technology, obtaining user multi-element single-attribute embedding; s3, performing feature fusion on different single-attribute embedding by using an attention mechanism; s4, multiple types of information are integrated at the same time in the aspects of a single platform and cross platforms to form multi-dimensional user discrimination features; s5, similar user pairs are constructed by using the user discriminative features, correlation information required in the correction process is trained and generated, and final user embedding is obtained; and S6, calculating an embedded vector cosine similarity between each pair of cross-platform users as a user matching score, and determining cross-network social network users according to the score.

title: Multi-label classification method based on depth fuzzy system
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-label classification method based on a depth fuzzy system, and belongs to the technical field of multi-label image classification algorithms. The method comprises the following steps: generating a fuzzy rule by adopting a WM method, and associating the rule with a feature and a label set; a layered depth model is constructed through a stacking generalization principle, and layer-by-layer stacking of the multi-label WM fuzzy system is achieved; in the training process, the fuzzy set membership degree is calculated to determine the rule weight, and the rule is optimized to process conflicts and redundancy; a downsampling strategy based on random grouping is used in the middle layer to reduce feature dimensions, and training efficiency is improved. Experimental results show that the method has excellent classification accuracy on high-dimensional features and label data sets; in addition, the model training process does not depend on gradient calculation, and is suitable for various data types.

title: Rockburst intensity grade evaluation method for optimizing BP neural network based on sparrow search algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a rockburst intensity grade evaluation method for optimizing a BP (Back Propagation) neural network model based on a sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA), and belongs to the technical field of underground engineering and geotechnical engineering. The method comprises the following steps: selecting rockburst evaluation input vectors, and constructing a rockburst intensity grade evaluation index system; rock burst project instance data are collected, the initial weight and threshold of the BP neural network are optimized by using a sparrow search algorithm, and the rock burst intensity level is predicted through input data by using the powerful nonlinear mapping capability of the neural network. According to the evaluation method, a complex nonlinear relation can be fitted to the maximum extent, the influence of subjective factors on a data result is reduced to a certain extent, and the evaluation method has a certain practical application value.

abstract: The invention discloses a corn optimal planting density construction method based on multi-source data, and belongs to the technical field of agricultural products.The corn optimal planting density construction method based on the multi-source data comprises the steps that corn density test data is obtained from a Chinese and English literature database through keyword retrieval, and the corn density test data is obtained; the method comprises the following steps: carrying out secondary fitting on density gradient and yield data, identifying and processing abnormal values in the data, finally screening an optimal planting density OPD data set, selecting a corresponding resolution data grid and a coordinate system thereof according to the size of a research area, carrying out sample point collection on soil and meteorological data, screening a collaborative variable related to the optimal planting density OPD, and finally, carrying out the optimal planting density OPD data set. abstract: The invention discloses a method and system for predicting CO2 miscible-phase oil displacement minimum miscible-phase pressure, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining oil reservoir crude oil data of a preset type, and making a data set; dividing the data set into a training sample and a test sample; training and learning to obtain a minimum miscible pressure prediction model of CO2 miscible oil displacement based on an adaptive fuzzy neural network and an ant colony evolutionary algorithm; and inputting the to-be-processed data into the prediction model to obtain a prediction result. title: Depth variation ultrasonic image speckle reduction method based on imaging model guidance
abstract: The invention discloses a depth variation ultrasonic image speckle reduction method based on imaging model guidance, which comprises the following steps of: (1) constructing a complete Bayesian model of ultrasonic image speckle reduction by utilizing a physical model of ultrasonic image imaging and statistical prior distribution of related parameters; and (2) on the basis of a variational inference principle, parameterizing noise variance and variational posteriori distribution of a noise-free image by using two deep convolutional networks respectively, and performing joint training optimization on the two deep networks through established evidence lower bound ELBO loss and image physical reconstruction loss, so that the pre-trained network can estimate the noise variance and infer a speckle subduction image at the same time. The method serves as a depth variation framework, has the physical interpretability of a model driving method, also has the universality and flexibility of a data driving method, and can obtain excellent ultrasonic speckle reduction performance.

abstract: The invention relates to an identification method for a two-dimensional drawing of a transformer substation, belongs to the technical field of image identification, and solves the problems of low identification accuracy and content missing of the existing two-dimensional drawing. title: Breast benign disease diagnosis system based on multi-modal data
abstract: The invention provides a mammary gland benign disease diagnosis system based on multi-modal data, a storage medium and electronic equipment, and relates to the field of computer-aided diagnosis. According to the method, the diagnosis information of the image and the text is effectively integrated, and the fused comprehensive feature vector is utilized to perform accurate classification diagnosis on the breast benign disease, so that doctors are helped to make accurate clinical decisions. The weighted fusion method provided by the invention not only improves the accuracy of diagnosis, but also ensures the high efficiency and reliability of the whole diagnosis process, and is suitable for clinical diagnosis application of benign breast diseases. The proposed two-stage large model processing flow combines the advantages of structured data generation and classification prediction, so that the diagnosis of the breast benign disease is more efficient and accurate. Besides, in combination with multiple deep learning technologies and attention mechanisms, the accuracy and robustness of image classification can be remarkably improved, misdiagnosis risks are reduced, and the method shows excellent potential in actual clinical application.

abstract: Systems and methods herein describe actuator control systems for controlling intelligently actuated temple ends of a pair of eyeglasses. title: Intelligent photovoltaic electrochemical sewage purification hydrogen production system
abstract: The invention relates to an intelligent photovoltaic electrochemical sewage purification and hydrogen production system, and provides an intelligent photovoltaic energy supply device for electrochemically degrading sewage and simultaneously producing hydrogen. The device converts solar energy into electric energy through the photovoltaic module to supply energy to the electrochemical electrolytic tank, and meanwhile, the back surface of the photovoltaic panel provides heat to promote reaction and improve hydrogen production without an external power supply. The electrolytic tank is composed of a cathode made of a carbon-based electrode material and an anode made of a transition metal oxide or a composite material thereof, and a catalyst ferrous sulfate is added to construct a coupling system. A control system of a reinforcement learning algorithm interacts with environmental factors and electrolytic tank states, controls photovoltaic output current to couple the optimal current density of electrolytic tank degradation reaction and hydrogen production reaction, and predicts sewage degradation efficiency and degradation energy consumption at the same time. And high-value byproducts are generated while pollutants are degraded, so that near-zero-energy-consumption and low-cost sewage treatment is realized.

title: Machine learning-based linearized drift moving physical equation solving method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of controllable nuclear fusion, and particularly discloses a method for solving a linearized drift movement physical equation based on machine learning, which comprises the following steps of: calculating the total collision frequency, drift frequency and rebound frequency of plasma to construct the linearized drift movement physical equation; the method comprises the following steps: acquiring coefficients of a linearized drift movement physiology equation as a training set, taking a solution of the linearized drift movement physiology equation as a label, training by using a machine learning model, and finally obtaining a machine learning solution model of the linearized drift movement physiology equation. According to the method, the machine learning solving model of the linear chemical drift physical equation is trained through machine learning, so that the parameters of the obtained linear drift physical equation can be directly input into the model in an experiment to obtain the solution of the linear drift physical equation, and the calculation process of the linear drift physical equation is simplified; and the calculation speed of solving the linearized drift movement physiology equation is improved.

title: Fault diagnosis method and device for rolling bearing
abstract: The invention discloses a fault diagnosis method and device for a rolling bearing, and relates to the field of rolling bearings, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the operation data of the rolling bearing; and processing the operation data based on a pre-trained diagnosis model to obtain the fault type of the rolling bearing. title: Magnetic field modeling method and device of electromagnetic navigation system, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses a magnetic field modeling method and device for a multi-electromagnet system, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and the method and device are applied to the electronic equipment, and specifically, the magnetic field intensity of a plurality of working points in a working area of the multi-electromagnet system under the excitation of input current is collected based on a three-dimensional Hall sensor array; obtaining a group of magnetic field three-dimensional information; and performing model training based on the input current and the three-dimensional magnetic field tensor B corresponding to the group of magnetic field three-dimensional information to obtain an electromagnetic field model. title: Oil and gas chemical wharf ship berthing scheduling method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of liquid wharf unloading automation, and particularly relates to an oil and gas chemical wharf ship berthing scheduling method which comprises the following steps: S1, obtaining port entering information of ships to enter a port within a plurality of time; s2, carrying out berth allocation according to the port entry information of the ship, the port water level information and the port berth information, and constructing a berth allocation model; and S3, solving the berth distribution model obtained in the step S2 to obtain the scheduling information of the ships to enter the port. The invention further provides an oil and gas chemical wharf ship berthing scheduling device. title: Clear sky bump probability prediction method based on NGboost algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a clear sky bumping probability prediction method based on an NGboost algorithm, and aims to improve the capability of capturing clear sky turbulence (CAT) of a model through the advantage of probability prediction of the NGboost algorithm. According to the method, a CAT diagnosis index is used as a feature vector, and a clear sky bumping strength probability prediction model based on natural gradient lifting is provided. abstract: The invention provides a small target detection method used in a foreground and background confusion scene. abstract: The invention discloses a time-varying workload scheduling method based on priority and resource awareness. abstract: The invention provides a cardiac magnetic resonance imaging artifact removal method and system based on phase circulation and deep learning. title: Gearbox fault diagnosis method, system, equipment and medium

abstract: The invention discloses a graph collaborative filtering curriculum recommendation method for quantifying preference degree and level penalty, which is used for improving the curriculum recommendation effect of an online learning platform and reducing the curriculum rate. abstract: The invention provides a class increment knowledge acquisition method based on a prototype network gating mechanism. abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of hot melt adhesives, in particular to an EVA hot melt adhesive production monitoring method and system.The method comprises the steps that firstly, environmental condition data and production process parameter data of an EVA hot melt adhesive production site are collected and processed, and EVA hot melt adhesive production data are obtained; then, carrying out relation learning on historical production data and EVA hot melt adhesive quality data, and constructing an EVA hot melt adhesive production stability monitoring model; thirdly, inputting EVA hot melt adhesive real-time production data into the stability monitoring model, and obtaining an EVA hot melt adhesive quality data prediction result through feature extraction and fusion; and finally, judging whether the current production condition is stable or not according to a prediction result, and monitoring and reminding. title: Coal mine feature image mask generation method based on learnable features and convolution kernel
abstract: The invention provides a coal mine feature image mask generation method based on learnable features and a convolution kernel, and relates to the technical field of coal mines. The method comprises the following steps: processing a feature image of a coal mine image by adopting depth separable convolution, generating a learnable mask, and obtaining a mask feature; applying iterative average pooling operation to generate a learnable convolution kernel; and performing convolution operation on the feature image by using the learnable convolution kernel, and performing element-by-element product by using the mask features to obtain a mask image corresponding to the coal mine image. According to the invention, the mask features used for background perception are generated, so that the influence of background interference can be greatly suppressed. And the convolution kernels related to the underground scene can be learned, a plurality of learnable convolution kernels are generated, and the underground scene priori is introduced while the locality of the convolution kernels is realized, so that the feature extraction effect is improved. And the mask features and the first feature map subjected to convolution kernel processing are aggregated, so that efficient background suppression can be performed on the coal mine image.

title: Water pump wear ring wear diagnosis and wear degree prediction method and device and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of mechanical fault diagnosis and computer artificial intelligence, in particular to a water pump wear ring wear diagnosis and wear degree prediction method and device and a storage medium. abstract: Wide area network link bandwidth monitoring is disclosed. title: BIT LINE READ CURRENT MIRRORING CIRCUIT FOR AN IN-MEMORY COMPUTE OPERATION WHERE SIMULTANEOUS ACCESS IS MADE TO PLURAL ROWS OF A STATIC RANDOM ACCESS MEMORY (SRAM)
abstract: An in-memory computation circuit includes a memory array with SRAM cells connected in rows by word lines and in columns by bit lines. A row controller circuit simultaneously actuates word lines in parallel for an in-memory compute operation. A column processing circuit includes a current mirroring circuit that mirrors the read current developed on each bit line in response to the simultaneous actuation to generate a decision output for the in-memory compute operation. A bias voltage for word line driver and a configuration of the current mirroring circuit to inhibit drop of a voltage on the bit line below a bit flip voltage during execution of the in-memory compute operation. The mirrored read current is integrated by an integration capacitor to generate an output voltage that is converted to a digital signal by an analog-to-digital converter circuit.

title: Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation Mannequin Based on Acoustic Recognition
abstract: The present invention relates to a mannequin for CPR training based on acoustic recognition. According to the present invention, the mannequin for CPR training comprises a sound generation device that generates sounds of a specific frequency and specific pattern depending on compression or expansion, a microphone that acquires the sound generated by the sound generating device, and a sound analysis device that acquires sound data collected through the microphone, converts the acquired sound data into a spectrogram, extracts analysis information about the depth, speed, and location of chest compressions from the spectrogram, and provides CPR feedback results in response to the extracted analysis information. In the way, according to the present invention, the sound generation device generates sounds of different patterns depending on the compression speed, and is suitable for CPR training because the device can recognize the generated sound and obtain accurate feedback on compression speed and depth. In addition, according to the present invention, since the mannequin device for CPR training does not include electronic equipment, the device can be manufactured at a low price, can be easily distributed without worrying about equipment maintenance or damage, and can easily acquire and process acoustic information using a microphone and an application.

abstract: The present disclosure relates to a resource allocation method and an apparatus using unsupervised learning in a wireless network. The method of allocating resources in a wireless network according to an embodiment of the present disclosure may comprise the steps of: classifying a plurality of subcarriers into K clusters using unsupervised learning, where K is an integer greater than or equal to 1; and allocating resources for each cluster based on a predefined optimization technique with respect to the K clusters. title: Deep Learning based Long-term/Short-Term Learning Analytics System in Online Learning Environment
abstract: A deep learning-based short-term and long-term learning analytics system in an online learning environment according to the present invention comprises: a lecture data collection module which collects lecture data on courses offered by schools from a learning server; a learning history data collection module which collects learning history data of learners who take the courses; a learning module which identifies the short-term and long-term learning patterns of the learners based on the learning history data; and a learning prediction module which generates learning prediction data of the learners by analyzing the lecture data and the short-term and long-term learning patterns. title: Method for Analyzing Carbon Emission Trading Mechanisms through Simulation Experiments
abstract: The present invention discloses a method for analyzing carbon emission trading mechanisms through simulation experiments, comprising the following steps: Step 1. Setting objectives; Step 2. Model learning; Step 3. Setting parameters; Step 4. Result analysis; Step 5. Ranking; Step 6. Experimentation; Step 7. Evaluation. In Step 1, before conducting the simulation experiment, objectives for emission reduction are set based on the experiment, studying the impact of different carbon emission limits on the market. In Step 2, an appropriate simulation experiment model is constructed based on the basic principles of carbon emission trading mechanisms and market mechanisms. During the construction of the simulation experiment model, machine learning algorithms are introduced to improve the model's predictive accuracy. The learning algorithm used is an adaptive learning algorithm. The present invention, by introducing learning algorithms, continuously updates and learns from the obtained experimental results, thereby facilitating the improvement of the accuracy of experimental outcomes.

title: Mark detection method and computer program
abstract: An encoding step and an image selection step are performed by a computer 20. In the encoding step, a plurality of partial images D2 of an object are input to a learned VAE model M, and the plurality of partial images D2 are encoded to a plurality of latent variables in a multi-dimensional latent space. In the image selection step, one or more partial images D2 that are likely to include an alignment mark are selected on the basis of a distribution of the plurality of latent variables in the latent space. Thus, a partial image that is likely to include an alignment mark is automatically detected by the computer 20 with the use of the VAE model M. This can lighten a burden on an operator who searches for an alignment mark.

title: Oligonucleotide assembly using electrically controlled hybridization
abstract: Electrically controlled hybridization is used to selectively assemble oligonucleotides on the surface of a microelectrode array. Controlled activation of individual electrodes in the microelectrode array attracts oligonucleotides in solution to specific regions of the array where they hybridize to other oligonucleotides anchored on the array. The oligonucleotides that hybridize may provide locations for subsequent oligonucleotides to hybridize. The active electrodes and the oligonucleotides in solution may be varied during each round of synthesis. This allows for multiple oligonucleotides each with different and specific sequences to be created in parallel. This is accomplished without the use of phosphoramidite chemical synthesis or template-independent DNA polymerase enzymatic synthesis. Oligonucleotides created with these techniques may be used to encode digital data. Fully assembled oligonucleotides may be separated from the array and sequenced, stored, or otherwise processed.

title: Training teacher machine learning models using lossless and lossy branches
abstract: Some embodiments of the present invention are directed to techniques for training teacher neural networks (TNNs) and student neural networks (SNNs). A training data set is received with a lossless set of data and a corresponding lossy set of data. Two branches of a TNN are established, with one branch trained using the lossless data (a lossless branch) and one trained using the lossy data (a lossy branch). Weights for the two branches are tied together. The lossy branch, now isolated from the lossless branch, generates a set of soft targets for initializing an SNN. These generated soft targets benefit from the training of lossless branch through the weights that were tied together between each branch, despite isolating the lossless branch from the lossy branch during soft-target generation.

title: Real-time feedback for efficient dialog processing
abstract: Techniques are described for improving the efficiency of dialog processing by prompting and processing user feedback substantially in real time. A dialog system receives speech input from a user and processes a first portion of the speech input to determine an initial discerned intent. The dialog system causes display of a visual indication of the initial discerned intent. The visual indication of the discerned intent is used to guide the dialog so that the user can correct or confirm the initial discerned intent in a natural fashion. If the initial discerned intent is inaccurate, the user can provide feedback correcting the dialog system, and the dialog system processes a second portion of the speech input to determine a modified discerned intent. Thus, the dialog system can use the feedback to correct misunderstandings on the fly.

title: Anomaly detection using RPCA and ICA
abstract: A computing device identifies an anomaly among a plurality of observation vectors. An observation vector is projected using a predefined orthogonal complement matrix. The predefined orthogonal complement matrix is determined from a decomposition of a low-rank matrix. The low-rank matrix is computed using a robust principal component analysis algorithm. The projected observation vector is multiplied by a predefined demixing matrix to define a demixed observation vector. The predefined demixing matrix is computed using an independent component analysis algorithm and the predefined orthogonal complement matrix. A detection statistic value is computed from the defined, demixed observation vector. When the computed detection statistic value is greater than or equal to a predefined anomaly threshold value, an indicator is output that the observation vector is an anomaly.

title: Iteratively trained machine learning models for evaluations of internal consistency
abstract: Disclosed is an approach for evaluating internal consistency of object classifications using machine learning modeling. In an example, models are iteratively trained, using supervised learning, on different majority segments (e.g., about 90%) of a dataset as training data segments. Trained models can be applied to the remaining data (e.g., about 10%) as test data segments to obtain, for each object, a predicted classification and a confidence score. Models in training iterations (e.g., 10 iterations) may be independently trained on substantially non-overlapping test data segments (with each iteration testing, e.g., about 10% of the dataset). When a model's predicted classification disagrees from a prior classification, and the confidence of the prediction is sufficiently high (indicating sufficiently strong disagreement), the object's prior classification may be revised. Training data, other than the data itself being evaluated for consistency, is not necessarily required.

abstract: A cooperative control method and system for electro-hydraulic hybrid braking of a middle-low speed maglev train is provided, which relates to the field of vehicle braking control. The method includes: denoising operation data of a middle-low speed maglev train; using a controlled autoregressive integrated moving average model as an electro-hydraulic hybrid braking process model for the middle-low speed maglev train, and processing denoised operation data by using a least square method to determine parameters in the controlled autoregressive integrated moving average model; establishing a generalized predictive control model with time lag compensation according to the controlled autoregressive integrated moving average model and a Smith predictor; and performing cooperative control on an electro-hydraulic hybrid braking process of the middle-low speed maglev train by using the generalized predictive control model with time lag compensation. A time lag in the electro-hydraulic hybrid braking process of the middle-low speed maglev train is reduced; control accuracy of the electro-hydraulic hybrid braking process of the middle-low speed maglev train is improved to a certain extent; and a speed tracking effect is improved.

title: Training network with batches of input instances
abstract: Some embodiments provide a method for training a machine-trained (MT) network that processes input data using network parameters. The method maps a set of input instances to a set of output values by propagating the set of input instances through the MT network. The set of input instances include input instances for each of multiple categories. The method selects multiple input instances as anchor instances. For each anchor instance, the method computes a loss function as a comparison between the output value for the anchor instance and each output value for an input instance in a different category than the anchor. The method computes a total loss function for the MT network as a sum of the loss function computed for each anchor instance. The method trains the network parameters using the computed total loss function.

title: Temporally encoded lattice surgery protocols for hybrid error detection and correction schemes
abstract: Techniques for performing temporally encoded lattice surgery (TELS) protocols to reduce space-time costs of lattice surgery measurements are disclosed. A given quantum algorithm may be represented using Pauli-based computation, and associated multi-qubit Pauli operators may be encoded into codewords of a given classical error-correcting code. A hybrid error detection and correction scheme may then be applied during a given TELS protocol in which classical error syndromes corresponding to errors with weights up to a certain weight limit may be corrected while other classical error syndromes corresponding to errors with higher weights may cause given lattice surgery measurements to be remeasured. The weight limit for the hybrid scheme may be chosen based, at least in part, on a number of codewords used, a size of a parallelizable Pauli set used to represent the quantum algorithm, and a distance parameter of the chosen classical error-correcting code.

abstract: Unique copies of an original document can be generated and provided to individual recipients. The unique copies can be used to identify the source of a document leak. The unique copies are generated by replacing terms within the original document with alternative terms. The alternative terms are determined using a first machine learning model that receives a term from the document and outputs the alternative terms. title: Lattice surgery techniques using twists
abstract: A technique for performing lattice surgery using twists is disclosed. Also, an error correcting code and decoder is provided that allows for error decoding of Pauli measurements performed in association with a lattice surgery operation. This allows for overall run-times of lattice surgery to be reduced. For example, some level of errors are tolerable, because they can be corrected, thus fewer measurement rounds (d m ) may be performed for a given round of Pauli measurements. Additionally, a temporal encoding of lattice surgery technique is provided, which may additionally or alternatively be used to shorten run times. Also, a quantum computer layout is provided, wherein the layout includes a core computing region and a cache region. Also, protocols for swapping logical qubits between the core and cache are provided.

abstract: A method of automated control of a microscope in cryogenic electron microscopy (cryo-EM), wherein the microscope is configured to collect high-magnification micrographs of particles suspended in vitreous ice. Based on the determination, control information is provided to automatically control the microscope to move to a next target for data collection.

abstract: Described is a system for Neuromorphic Adaptive Core (NeurACore) signal processor for ultra-wide instantaneous bandwidth denoising of a noisy signal. title: System and methods for upsampling of decompressed time-series data using a neural network
abstract: A system and methods for upsampling of decompressed time-series data after lossy compression using a neural network that integrates AI-based techniques to enhance compression quality. It incorporates a novel AI deblocking network composed of recurrent layers for feature extraction and a channel-wise transformer with attention to capture complex inter-channel dependencies. The model's outputs enable effective data reconstruction, achieving advanced compression while preserving crucial information for accurate analysis.

title: Automated sleep assistant
abstract: Systems, devices, and methods are provided for an automated sleep assistant. An automated sleep assistant may comprise an audio input device for capturing sounds and utterances made by a user while sleeping. Audio data may be collected and analyzed to identify sleep patterns indicative of an adverse sleep-related condition such as Obstructive Sleep Apnea (OSA). A pillow comprising a plurality of regions with one or more sensors, one or more inflatable air bladders, and one or more haptic feedback devices may be utilized. A base unit device physically connected to the pillow may determine one or more external forces that mitigate the adverse sleep-related condition and cause the pillow to apply the one or more external forces to the user, for example, by using a pump to inflate an air bladder to help the user's head lift or tip to a specific angle that opens his or her airway.

title: Automated generation of radar interference reduction training data for autonomous vehicle systems
abstract: Example embodiments relate to methods and systems for automated generation of radar interference reduction training data for autonomous vehicles. In an example, a computing device causes a radar unit to transmit radar signals in an environment of a vehicle. The computing device may include a model trained based on a labeled interferer dataset that represents interferer signals generated by an emitter located remote from the vehicle. The interferer signals are based on one or more radar signal parameter models. The computing device may use the model to determine whether received electromagnetic energy corresponds to transmitted radar signals or an interferer signal. Based on determining that the electromagnetic energy corresponds to the transmitted radar signals, the computing device may generate a representation of the environment of the vehicle using the electromagnetic energy.

title: Automated estimation of resources related to testing within a service provider network
abstract: This disclosure describes a test prediction service for predicting needed resources and associated costs for testing projects related to testing of new programs, services, etc., within a service provider network. The test prediction service uses a first machine learning model for predicting “hard costs” using data from a first data source that includes end-to-end test details such as associated resource and infrastructure use (costs) of the service provider network during previous end-to-end testing projects. A second machine learning model is used for predicting “soft costs” using data from a second data source that includes data, e.g., engineering headcount/hours spent developing the end-to-end testing and/or during previous end-to-end testing. The data is used to train the machine learning models. The test prediction service uses the trained machine learning models to generate estimated testing costs of new testing projects when a user enters project attributes for a new testing project.

abstract: A system for reconstructing a magnetic particle image based on adaptive optimization of regularization terms includes: a MPI device for scanning an imaging object to acquire a voltage response signal; a signal processor for constructing a system matrix; and a control processor for reconstructing the magnetic particle image based on an arbitrarily selected regularization term, inputting the reconstructed magnetic particle image to a regularization-term adaptive optimization neural network model for enhancement processing, taking the enhanced magnetic particle image as a first image, and calculating a loss value between the first image and an initial image to acquire a final reconstructed magnetic particle image. title: Semantic search and retrieval over encrypted vector space
abstract: A method and system for performing end-to-end encrypted semantic search and retrieval are disclosed. title: Method for detecting QRS complex of electrocardiogram signal, apparatus therefor, device and medium
abstract: A method for detecting a QRS complex of an electrocardiogram signal, an apparatus therefor, a device and a medium are provided. A QRS complex of an electrocardiogram signal is detected by a detection model including a DenseNet and a dual-channel Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM). Spatial feature information of the QRS complex in the electrocardiogram signal is learned through the DenseNet, and then the spatial feature learned by the DenseNet and the time sequence data are input into respective channels of the dual-channel LSTM, so that the dual-channel LSTM can fuse the spatial information and the time sequence information of the QRS complex in the electrocardiogram signal, thereby improving a segmentation effect of the model on features, and finally improving accuracy of detecting the QRS complex.

title: Livestock monitoring
abstract: This disclosure relates to a system for livestock monitoring. Animal monitoring devices, mounted on animals, collect accelerometer data of parts of the animals. The devices classify the accelerometer data into one of multiple animal behaviours, to create behaviour classification data. title: AUTOMATIC PARKINSONS DISEASE DETECTION BASED ON THE COMBINATION OF LONG-TERM ACOUSTIC FEATURES AND MEL FREQUENCY COEFFICIENTS (MFCCs)
abstract: A system, method, and non-transitory computer readable medium for discriminating between patients with neurodegenerative disease and healthy patients. The method includes obtaining a first plurality of voice signals from known healthy humans and known neurogenerative diseases humans, extracting long-term acoustic features of the first plurality of voice signals, extracting Mel frequency coefficients (MFCCs) from the first plurality of voice signals, creating a set A of short-term acoustic features based on the MFCCs, performing a backward stepwise selection to create a set B of long-term acoustic features and a set C, where set C includes the features of set B combined with the features of set A, creating a random forest classification model, obtaining a second plurality of voice signals from humans of undetermined health status, and applying the second plurality of voice signals against the random forest classification model to determine which patients are neurodegenerative diseased patients.

title: Artificial Intelligence Assisted Personal Training System, Personal Training Device and Control Device
abstract: A personal training system assisted by artificial intelligence (AI) has a personal training device and a control device. The personal training device includes a jacket and pants, and houses sensors at positions corresponding to a user's main muscle groups for monitoring the user's movement posture and muscle activity of the main muscle groups. The control device has a data preprocessing unit for processing detected-signal data of the sensors, a training analysis device for executing an AI algorithm to conduct fatigue analysis of the user's movement based on the user profile and the detected-signal data, and to make training load recommendations. The personal training system can simultaneously monitor posture, muscle activity and muscle fatigue in real time during the exercise; and use the AI algorithm to evaluate exercise performance and provide real-time feedbacks to improve the exercise and training efficiency, and reduce the risk of injury.

title: Failed temperature sensor detection and mitigation within data storage devices
abstract: Methods and apparatus for detecting a failed temperature sensor within a data storage device and for mitigating the loss of the sensor are provided. One such data storage device includes a non-volatile memory (NVM), a set of temperature sensors, and a processor coupled to the NVM and the temperature sensors. The processor is configured to detect failure of one of the temperature sensors and obtain temperature data from the other temperature sensors. The processor is further configured to estimate, based on the obtained temperature data, the temperature at the failed sensor, and then control at least one function of the data storage device based on the estimated temperature, such as controlling entry into a Read Only mode. In some examples, the processor estimates the temperature at the failed sensor or at various virtual sensor locations using pre-determined formulas having offsets and coefficients determined during an initial machine learning calibration procedure.

title: Relevance propagation of information in model analysis
abstract: A system includes a storage device, a processor, and an output device. The storage device is configured to store first results generated by perturbations of a structure, and store input parameters of a model of the structure. The processor is configured to generate results by exercising the model with the perturbations, and train a neural network to replicate the second results. The neural network includes input nodes and output nodes. A subset of the input nodes represent the input parameters. The output nodes represent the second results. The processor is further configured to run a propagation through the neural network as inverted from the output nodes to the input nodes to identify the input parameters that impact the second results, and generate gradient values that represent how the second results deviate from the first results. The output device is configured to present a gradient graph of the gradient values.

abstract: The present disclosure presents neural network learning systems and methods. Other methods and systems are also provided.

abstract: For computers to be able to make informed decisions (aka artificial intelligence), they must convert raw sensor data into an actionable information, using some form of ‘world model’. ‘Traditional’ algorithms use a human engineered model, tailored to the specific problem at hand. title: Verifying Neural Networks
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for verifying the transformational robustness of a neural network. Data is obtained representing a trained neural network, a set of algebraic constraints on the output of the network, and a range of inputs to the neural network over which the algebraic constraints are to be verified, such that the data defines a transformational robustness verification problem. A set of complementary constrains on the pre-activation of a node in the network are then determined such that for any input in the range of inputs, at least one of the complementary constraints is satisfied. A plurality of child verification problems are generated based on the transformational robustness verification problem and the set of complementary constraints. For each child verification problem, it is determined whether a counter-example to the child verification problem exists. Based on the determination of whether counter-examples to the child verification problems exist, it is determined whether the neural network is transformationally robust.

abstract: A discount service method carried out by a discount service device. title: Systems and methods for resilient recovery services from power failures
abstract: A data analytics for recovery, using granular and large-scale failure data from the distribution grid. A key characteristic of the data analytics is its generalizability. The data analysis applies to a large number (169) of failure events rather than one disruption. Further, a data driven recovery scaling law characterizes how recovery speed scales with respect to the severity of weather-induced failures from moderate to extreme. As data used are commonly available to most distribution system operators, the analytics is potentially applicable across the US and parts of the world.

abstract: Method for magnetic resonance imaging, MRI, comprising obtaining an image acquisition sequence comprising RF pulses and magnetic field gradients configured to encode spatial information in a part of an object; obtaining an acoustic noise cancelling signal corresponding to the obtained image acquisition sequence at a first position; generating the image acquisition sequence; wherein the magnetic fields gradients are generated by gradient coils configured for three orthogonal directions respectively; and converting, by an acoustic transducer, simultaneously with the image acquisition sequence, the predetermined noise cancelling signal to an acoustic noise cancelling signal at the first position. title: Identifying hotspots and coldspots in forecasted power consumption data in an it data center for workload scheduling
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for using historic input power periodic data from a server in an IT data center to train a machine learning (ML) model to obtain forecasted power consumption data of the server for a future time period. Time windows of hotspots or coldspots are then identified in the forecasted power consumption data, hotspots being defined as areas or regions of over-utilization in a time series data, and coldspots being defined as areas or regions of under-utilization in a time series data. The hotspots and coldspots are identified by calculating an exponential mean average (EMA) of the forecasted power consumption data, taking points above the EMA as hotspots and points below the EMA as coldspots. The identified hotspots and coldspots can be used to schedule workloads for a server or a data center, to more efficiently plan existing workloads, or to introduce new workloads at more optimal time periods.

title: Methods and systems for resolving root causes of performance problems with applications executing in a data center
abstract: Automated methods and systems for resolving potential root causes of performance problems with applications executing in a data center are described. The automated methods use machine learning to train an inference model that relates event types recorded in metrics, log messages, and traces of an application to values of a key performance indicator (“KPI”) of the application. The methods use the trained inference model to determine which of the event types are important event types that relate to performance of the application. In response to detecting a run-time performance problem in the KPI, the methods determine which of the important event has a higher probability of being the potential root cause of the performance problem. A graphical user interface displays an alert that identifies the application as having the run-time performance problem, identity of the important event types, and at least one recommendation for remedying the performance problem.

title: Lossless summarization
abstract: Systems, devices, and techniques are disclosed for lossless summarization. Data that including indications of whether a text summary generated by a machine learning system from an input document includes correct answers to questions about the input document may be received. Weights associated with the questions about the input document may be received. A first vector may be generated from the indications in the data. A second vector may be generated from the weights. A dot product of the first vector and the second vector may be determined. A ratio of a word count of the text summary to the word count of the input document may be determined. A score for the text summary based on the dot product and the ratio may be determined. The machine learning system may be adjusted based on the score.

title: Identity-aware data management
abstract: Systems and methods are provided for organizing communications of multiple communication services. Specifically, techniques are described for organizing data according to detected identities represented aggregate accounts across multiple communication services, as opposed to merely on the basis of accounts on such services. An identity-aware data management system is disclosed that can generate, on the basis of communications of a first party among multiple communication services, a reduced connection graph of the first party. The reduced connection graph of the first party can reflect second parties with whom the first party has communicated, each second party representing an aggregation of multiple accounts of a second party across communication services. The identity-aware data management system may then enable the first party to search, filter, or organize communications according to the reduced connection graph.

title: Masking compliance measurement system
abstract: A system is adapted to automatically evaluate compliance to data masking rules by a service provider. The system includes a processor and a non-transitory computer readable medium carrying instructions. The instructions include receiving a list of private data elements for which masking is required, and receiving a transcript of a particular interaction between the service provider and a customer, where the transcript includes data elements, at least of which is a private data element. The instructions also include analyzing the transcript with natural language processing to identify times or locations within where private data elements are recorded; determining, based on a set of compliance rules and the analyzed transcript, whether any private data element are unmasked at the identified times or locations; and, if a private data element is unmasked, issuing an output related to the unmasked private data elements.
