title: Marketing analysis method and system based on medium and long term electricity transaction
abstract: The invention discloses a marketing analysis method and system based on medium-and-long-term electricity transaction. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring historical electricity transaction related data of medium-and-long-term electricity transaction business; constructing a medium and long term electricity transaction marketing system; respectively extracting feature data of the historical power transaction related data, and training a medium and long term power transaction large model and a prediction model by using the corresponding feature data; inputting the historical power transaction related data into a medium and long term power transaction marketing system, outputting a prediction result of the medium and long term power transaction by using the trained prediction model, and inputting the prediction result and the historical power transaction related data into the trained medium and long term power transaction large model to output a decision transaction scheme; and optimizing the medium and long term power transaction large model according to the decision transaction scheme and the prediction result so as to optimize the decision transaction scheme based on the optimized model. According to the invention, the medium-and-long-term power transaction decision-making difficulty is greatly reduced.

title: Light-weight cross-medium high-speed small target detection method based on coordinate attention mechanism
abstract: The invention provides a lightweight cross-medium high-speed small target detection method based on a coordinate attention mechanism, and the method comprises the steps: building a cross-medium projectile water entry test system, capturing a projectile through a high-speed camera, and obtaining a projectile image; a series of data enhancement operations including blurring, affine transformation and overturning are carried out on an original image, a projectile image data set is expanded, and contrast-limited adaptive histogram equalization is carried out on the expanded data set. Constructing a target detection model composed of an input layer, a backbone network layer and a head layer; a coordinate attention mechanism is added to the head layer to improve the recognition precision of the projectile at the moment of entering water; part of common convolution in the network is replaced by deep separable convolution, and the network is lightened; and taking the picture of the projectile water entering process as the input of the target detection model, and generating a target detection result. According to the method, the detection precision of projectile entry into water is effectively improved, and a solution is provided for cross-medium high-speed small target detection.

title: Alga target detection method, system and device based on deep learning
abstract: The invention provides an algae target detection method, system and device based on deep learning, and relates to the field of computer vision environment monitoring, and the method mainly comprises the steps: collecting the image data of a water body through an image sensing device; splitting and preprocessing the image data according to a preset size; performing small target splitting and data enhancement on the training image data; based on the training image data, training the optimized YOLO target detection model; and performing target detection on the detected image data through the trained YOLO target detection model to obtain a detection result. According to the scheme, by introducing and optimizing a YOLO series algorithm, the automation degree and the detection precision of algae detection can be remarkably improved; according to the scheme, algae target detection and classification can be accurately and efficiently carried out in complex water backgrounds and various algae environments, and the false detection rate can be effectively reduced; the scheme is suitable for real-time monitoring and analysis scenes of a large-scale and complex water body environment.

title: Plant leaf disease detection method based on convolutional neural network
abstract: The invention is suitable for the technical field of plant disease detection, and particularly relates to a plant leaf disease detection method based on a convolutional neural network, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a plant planting region map; constructing a training data set based on the disease and pest database, constructing a convolutional neural network, and obtaining a disease and pest recognition model; and constructing a virtual boundary in a plane coordinate system, performing variation processing, performing light virtual reflection, determining the position of a sampling point, collecting a to-be-detected image at the sampling point, performing pre-screening, obtaining a pre-screened image, replacing invalid pixels, sending the image to a pest recognition model for recognition, and generating a recognition result. According to the method, the light propagation process is simulated in the virtual boundary by constructing the virtual boundary, so that the flight path of the unmanned aerial vehicle is simulated, the sampling points are extracted from the flight path, the randomness of the sampling points is ensured, and the data transmission quantity is greatly reduced and the data transmission efficiency is improved by performing hierarchical screening and transmission on the images.

title: Lane line prediction method, device, equipment and product
abstract: The invention discloses a lane line prediction method, device, equipment and product, and relates to the technical field of lane line detection, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining road real-time data under a low-illumination road condition, and generating a to-be-detected image based on the road real-time data; the to-be-detected image is input to a target detection network model, a target lane line detection result is obtained, and the target detection network model is used for enhancing image performance and optimizing lane line detection precision; and predicting the lane line based on the target lane line detection result. title: Intelligent parking management system based on 5G networking
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent parking management system based on 5G networking, and the system comprises a current state obtaining unit which is used for obtaining the state of an unoccupied parking space at the current moment and the state of an off-site environment outside a parking lot; the double-characteristic variable unit is used for taking the parking space state of the free parking space at the current moment and the off-site environment state outside the parking lot as double-characteristic variables; the vehicle label acquisition unit is used for acquiring a type label of a to-be-parked vehicle; the recommendation unit is used for inputting the type label of the to-be-parked vehicle and the double-feature variable into a preset parking management model to obtain a parking space recommendation set of the to-be-parked vehicle; wherein recommendation items of the parking space recommendation set are binary arrays containing parking space matching degrees and parking space numbers; according to the invention, the system can consider whether the parking space is occupied and the occupied duration at the same time by performing weighted optimization of the double-target task on the occupation state and the occupation duration of the parking space, so that the parking space with high matching degree can be recommended for drivers with different parking demands.

title: Node mode selection and beam forming method in cooperative sensing integrated scene
abstract: The invention discloses a node mode selection and beam forming method in a cooperative communication integrated scene, and belongs to the field of wireless communication. According to the method, the system efficiency can be improved, and the actual deployment of the cellular-free cooperative communication integrated system is promoted, so that the method has a certain actual value.

title: Coal mine geological disaster and environment early warning method based on multi-source monitoring data fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a coal mine geological disaster and environment early warning method based on multi-source monitoring data fusion. The method comprises the following steps: determining a mine water disaster early warning evaluation index, a mine pressure disaster early warning evaluation index and a geological environment evolution early warning index; a corresponding first early warning threshold value is set; data are acquired and preprocessed, and a mine water disaster early warning model, a mine pressure disaster early warning model and a geological environment evolution early warning model are established; collecting new data to carry out iterative optimization on the model, and correcting an early warning threshold value; and integrating the iteratively optimized models into an early warning index system library, collecting and fusing various monitoring system and production dynamic data of the mine, and inputting the data into the early warning index system library for coal mine geological disaster and environment early warning analysis. The method solves the problems that in the prior art, multi-source monitoring data cannot be fully fused, an early warning model lacks self-learning and optimization capabilities, and an early warning threshold cannot be dynamically adjusted along with the change of a mining environment.

title: Deep counterfeiting active detection method based on block chain and robust watermark enhancement

title: Rice early recognition method and device based on remote sensing data and time sequence model
abstract: The invention discloses a rice early recognition method and device based on remote sensing data and a time sequence model. The method comprises the following steps: S1, acquiring multi-source remote sensing data and auxiliary data; s2, preprocessing the multi-source remote sensing data and the auxiliary data; s3, constructing a sample set based on the preprocessed multi-source remote sensing data and auxiliary data; s4, constructing a DualMama model, and training the DualMama model on the basis of the sample set; and S5, inputting the multi-source remote sensing data and the auxiliary data obtained in the step S1 into the trained DualMama model to obtain a rice early recognition distribution diagram. According to the method, through the proposed DualMama model, the utilization efficiency of multi-source remote sensing data is remarkably improved, the problem of inconsistent feature dimensions is solved, the early recognition precision of the rice is greatly improved under the complex hill terrain, the F1 score of the rice category can reach 90% within two months before the rice growth period, and accurate early recognition of the rice is achieved.

title: Traditional Chinese medicine condition dynamic monitoring method and system based on big data time sequence analysis
abstract: The invention provides a traditional Chinese medicine condition dynamic monitoring method and system based on big data time sequence analysis, and the method comprises the steps: extracting the condition characteristics of a previous sample from a traditional Chinese medicine condition record data set of a patient, a node, and a performance symptom of a prediction sample patient, and carrying out the deep analysis of the data through a condition dynamic development prediction network. Precise and dynamic monitoring of traditional Chinese medicine disease development is achieved, the first confidence coefficient of the patient expression symptom of the node sample at the target time node can be determined, the second confidence coefficient of the patient expression symptom of the prediction sample at the future time node can also be predicted, and therefore the accuracy and perspectiveness of disease prediction are improved, and the disease prediction efficiency is improved. title: Dynamic multi-cluster management
abstract: A method of dynamic multi-cluster management may include sending a first request to a management service producer to create a set of clusters and train a machine learning model for one or more clusters in the set of clusters for a plurality of contexts. The method may also include sending a second request to the management service producer to dynamically monitor the set of clusters. The method may also include receiving, after at least one of the first request or the second request, a cluster report from the management service producer as a result of the creation of the set of clusters. abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of high-voltage signal acquisition, and provides a high-voltage acquisition method and system based on machine learning, and an automobile. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a first low voltage value and a second low voltage value acquired by a to-be-detected high voltage circuit on a positive line and a negative line through a high voltage acquisition circuit; based on the first low voltage value and the second low voltage value, determining a high voltage acquisition value of the to-be-tested high voltage circuit; inputting the high-voltage acquisition value into the trained machine learning model for correction, and outputting a corrected target high-voltage acquisition value by the machine learning model; and sending the target high-voltage acquisition value to the main control equipment. Compared with manual calibration and correction, the mode of correcting the high-voltage acquisition value through the machine learning model can save a lot of manpower and time, improve the acquisition efficiency, obtain more accurate acquisition values, solve the problem of large sampling value error in high-voltage acquisition, and improve the accuracy of high-voltage acquisition. title: Brain tumor MRI image segmentation method based on Swinin-PSAxialNet
abstract: The invention discloses a brain tumor MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) image segmentation method based on Swinin-PSAxialNet, and aims at accurate segmentation of brain tumor multi-mode nuclear magnetic resonance imaging. According to the algorithm, a novel PSAA feature extraction block based on the combination of AxialNet and Params sharing strategies is provided, and detail information and spatial feature information are obtained by adopting a multi-scale image fusion method. And Axis calculation is carried out by adopting three-dimensional channel k and q context sharing, so that a very good learning effect can be achieved with a relatively low calculation amount, and global feature information is rich. The network with high semantic aggregation performs modeling correlation on foreground and GT semantics, and further improves segmentation precision by performing soft aggregation on feature vectors. The invention further designs a method based on combination of double loss functions, and a more accurate discrimination standard is provided for the model. And the network can keep relatively low Params and FLOPs to achieve the optimal performance while ensuring the training precision.

title: Organic compound toxicity prediction method based on particle swarm optimization and ensemble learning
abstract: The invention discloses an organic compound toxicity prediction method based on particle swarm optimization and ensemble learning, and relates to the field of organic compound toxicity prediction, and the method comprises the following implementation steps: through setting an acquisition module and an integration module, collecting semi-lethal concentration data of aquatic organisms from an ECOTOX aquatic toxicity database, the real-time detection unit and the auxiliary tracking unit can detect volatilization of toxic organic compounds in real time, the monitoring module receives and processes information and transmits signals to the collection module through wireless transmission, and at the moment, the liquefaction forming unit cools volatile toxic compound gas in a cooling mode. The toxic organic compound gas is cooled and liquefied to form water drops, the cooled and liquefied toxic compound water drops fall into an original non-volatile compound through the vibration sliding-down unit, and the toxic organic compound is stirred and uniformly mixed again through the uniform mixing unit by adopting a mixing and stirring mechanism. The accuracy of toxicity data of the to-be-detected compound is ensured.

title: Intra-region photovoltaic power prediction method and system based on multivariable and spatio-temporal information
abstract: The invention discloses an intra-region photovoltaic power prediction method and system based on multivariable and spatio-temporal information, and the method comprises the following steps: collecting historical photovoltaic power data and meteorological data of a plurality of photovoltaic power stations, and carrying out the preprocessing of the data: decomposing the historical photovoltaic power data into a plurality of modes through feature mode decomposition; performing feature selection on the meteorological factor data through the maximum information coefficient, forming a multivariable input matrix with the plurality of modals, and dividing the multivariable input matrix into a training set and a test set; establishing an ETSform space-time model, and training the model by using the training set; the method comprises the following steps: improving a PID search algorithm by using a Halton sequence and a prying foraging strategy to obtain an improved PID search algorithm (IPSA); hyper-parameters such as the learning rate and the batch size of the ETSform model are optimized through IPSA; and predicting the photovoltaic power through the test set. According to the method, meteorological factors and time-space information are considered, the method is suitable for photovoltaic power stations of different areas and different scales, and high-precision prediction of the photovoltaic power is achieved.

title: Driving danger prediction method and device based on adaptive fuzzy neural network
abstract: The invention provides a driving danger prediction method and device based on an adaptive fuzzy neural network. The method comprises the steps that original variables used for reflecting the vehicle state are collected, dimension reduction processing is conducted on the original variables, and key variables are obtained; constructing a driving danger prediction model based on an adaptive fuzzy neural network; the genetic algorithm is utilized to optimize the preceding component parameters and the following component parameters of the driving danger prediction model, and the preceding component parameters are optimized according to the selection, crossover and mutation operation of the genetic algorithm, and the central position and the standard deviation of a membership function are optimized; the optimization of the consequent parameters comprises the step of optimizing linear combination parameters in the fuzzy inference rule; and inputting vehicle state data obtained in real time into the optimized driving danger prediction model, and outputting a driving danger value used for representing driving danger. According to the method, the model adaptability can be improved, the parameter optimization efficiency is improved, the accuracy of model prediction is improved, and accurate and real-time driving risk assessment is realized.

title: Multi-target optimization method for pressure and flow characteristics of CDC electromagnetic pilot overflow valve
abstract: The invention relates to a multi-target optimization method for pressure and flow characteristics of a CDC electromagnetic pilot overflow valve, and belongs to the technical field of automobile suspensions. The method comprises the following steps: (1) establishing a three-dimensional equivalent model of the CDC electromagnetic pilot overflow valve; (2) building a dynamic model according to the built three-dimensional equivalent model and a working principle; (3) building a hydraulic simulation model according to the kinetic model; (4) forming a training sample to train the neural network model; (5) initializing ant colony algorithm parameters; (6) starting ant colony algorithm iteration; (7) updating pheromones; (8) judging whether a termination condition is met or not; (9) outputting an optimal parameter combination and an optimized pressure-flow characteristic curve; and (10) determining the importance degree of the influence factors through a Pareto method. The ant colony algorithm and the annealing algorithm are combined, the local optimum problem is effectively avoided, and global convergence is accelerated.

abstract: The invention provides a sewer internal defect detection method and system based on YOLOv11 improvement, and the method achieves the dynamic weight fusion of multi-level features through a self-adaptive feature fusion module, and improves the detection capability of a model for small targets and complex backgrounds. title: Load trend prediction and optimization system based on big data
abstract: The invention discloses a load trend prediction and optimization system based on big data, and relates to the technical field of power grid management systems, and the system integrates a plurality of charging stations, a state grid power supply system and a renewable energy power station in a region. title: Three-dimensional route planning method based on bidirectional APF-RRT*- CPO algorithm
abstract: The invention relates to a three-dimensional track planning method based on a bidirectional APF-RRT *-CPO algorithm, and the method comprises the following steps: constructing a three-dimensional map, and creating two random trees T1 and T2; two-way search is adopted, sampling points are generated in the random trees T1 and T2 respectively, nodes closest to the sampling points are found respectively, and potential field force of the self-adaptive APF algorithm is utilized to guide generation of new nodes; rewiring is carried out, a nearest node connected with the rewiring is found, and nodes which do not collide are added into the random tree; connecting all nodes of the random tree to generate an initial track; and searching the shortest distance between the nodes by taking the track points of the initial track as the temporary starting point and terminal point, calculating a total cost function, and generating an optimal track according to the minimum cost position. title: Rolling bearing unsupervised domain adaptive fault diagnosis method based on two-stage joint feature alignment maximum classifier difference network
abstract: According to the rolling bearing unsupervised domain adaptive fault diagnosis method based on the two-stage joint feature alignment maximum classifier difference network, fault diagnosis of the rolling bearing under different working conditions is achieved. In the first stage, the transferability of the features is improved by using the maximum mean value difference index, and in the second stage, on the basis of ensuring the transferability of the features, the potential category information of the target domain is fully utilized, and the distinguishability of the fault features is improved by using the local maximum mean value difference index. abstract: The invention provides a neural network training method and device based on time self-erasing. title: Color image restoration method based on adaptive tensor rank completion
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of image restoration, and particularly relates to a color image restoration method based on adaptive tensor rank completion. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, processing a to-be-restored image to generate a reference image and a to-be-complemented high-order tensor; generating a plurality of candidate initial tensor ranks for the to-be-completed high-order tensor based on the Sobel sequence; thirdly, complementing the high-order tensor to be complemented based on the candidate initial tensor rank, and selecting the candidate initial tensor rank corresponding to the reconstructed image with the highest structural similarity with the reference image as an initial tensor rank; then, generating a plurality of first-order candidate tensor ranks, determining a first-order basic tensor rank, and performing variation on the first-order basic tensor rank to obtain a first-order variation tensor rank; reconstructing the high-order tensor to be complemented based on the first-order variation tensor rank to obtain a first-order optimal reconstructed high-order tensor; the to-be-completed high-order tensor is completed according to the first-order optimal reconstruction high-order tensor, and first iteration of the to-be-restored image is completed; and finally, performing repeated iteration on the to-be-restored image, complementing the to-be-complemented high-order tensor based on each order of optimal candidate tensor rank, and taking the reconstructed image with the highest structural similarity as the optimal restored image. According to the method, the low-rank property of the image can be better mined, the recovery effect is improved, and meanwhile, the overfitting problem caused by the unbalanced initial rank is solved.

abstract: The invention discloses a protein design method based on deep learning. title: Gas accident analysis system and method based on dynamic Bayesian network
abstract: The invention relates to a gas accident analysis system and method based on a dynamic Bayesian network. The method comprises the following steps: constructing a dynamic Bayesian network model; gas equipment operation state data and environment parameters are obtained; processing data, and performing gas accident risk assessment and accident evolution path analysis by using an inference algorithm; and generating an accident analysis result and outputting the accident analysis result through a visual tool. According to the gas accident analysis system and method based on the dynamic Bayesian network, multiple risk factors of a gas accident are comprehensively analyzed through the dynamic Bayesian network technology, the possibility of accident occurrence can be effectively predicted, the severity of the accident can be effectively evaluated, and reasonable prevention and response measures are put forward. Compared with a traditional risk assessment method, the method is higher in accuracy, real-time performance and flexibility, can provide more scientific safety management decision support for gas enterprises, remarkably improves the gas accident prevention and emergency processing capability, and has a wide application prospect.

title: Generative adversarial network-based power distribution network fault prediction and reconstruction optimization method
abstract: The invention discloses a power distribution network fault prediction and reconstruction optimization method based on a generative adversarial network. The method comprises the following steps: S1, collecting and preprocessing multi-modal operation data; s2, extracting topological features by using a graph neural network; s3, designing a mimicry fault model based on the generative adversarial network; s4, optimizing generative adversarial network training through variational inference; s5, capturing time sequence characteristics to train a fault prediction model; s6, analyzing a fault propagation path based on reinforcement learning; s7, sparse optimization is carried out to generate a reconstruction optimization scheme; and S8, the integrated modular system supports real-time processing. Through combination of the generative adversarial network and the optimization model, accurate prediction and efficient reconstruction optimization of power distribution network faults are realized, and the reliability and real-time response capability of power grid operation are improved.

title: Techniques for automatically tracking surgical procedures
abstract: Certain embodiments provide a method for performing an ophthalmic surgical procedure. The method includes taking and preparing pre-surgical data and intra-surgical data associated with an eye of a patient for further processing. In some embodiments, the method further includes integrating the pre-surgical data and the intra-surgical data to generate context-sensitive data for further processing. The method further includes classifying and annotating the pre-surgical data, the intra-surgical data, and the context-sensitive data. The method further includes extracting one or more actionable reasones from the pre-surgical data, the intra-surgical data, the context-sensitive data, and the classified and annotated data. The method further includes triggering one or more actions on the imaging system or surgical system based on the one or more actionable reasoning.

title: Intelligent file review and result pre-judgment method based on machine learning and application
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent file review and result pre-judgment method and application based on machine learning, and belongs to the technical field of file review, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a historical standard template file, analyzing the content in the historical standard template file through a natural language processing algorithm, carrying out the feature extraction of an analysis result through a regular matching algorithm, and obtaining a result of the historical standard template file. The method comprises the steps of obtaining standard file features, combining the standard file features with a machine learning algorithm for training, establishing a file review and judgment model, obtaining a to-be-recognized file, calculating the to-be-recognized file features by using the file review and judgment model, presetting a review and judgment threshold value, judging whether the to-be-recognized file is compliant or not according to a calculation result, and deploying an intelligent pre-judgment model. The result pre-judgment is performed on the non-compliant content in the file, and the modification suggestion is given according to the unfavorable result, so that the recognition processing capability of the file review judgment model is improved, the accuracy of file review is ensured, and whether the file meets the use requirement or not can be efficiently and accurately judged.

title: Random forest-based electric energy meter fault component identification method and device, computer equipment, readable storage medium and program product
abstract: The invention relates to an electric energy meter fault component identification method, device and equipment based on a random forest, a storage medium and a program product, and relates to the technical field of circuit fault diagnosis. By adopting the method, the fault detection efficiency and accuracy of the electric energy meter can be improved. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a broadband impedance spectrum of a live wire-null line port in a to-be-detected electric energy meter, and obtaining port impedance data of the live wire-null line port according to the broadband impedance spectrum; performing data cleaning and missing value filling on the port impedance data to obtain target port impedance data; according to the target port impedance data, fault element prediction is carried out on the to-be-detected electric energy meter through a random forest model, and prediction results generated by decision trees in the random forest model are obtained; and integrating the prediction results to obtain an integrated target prediction result, and according to the target prediction result, identifying a target fault element of the to-be-detected electric energy meter from the plurality of candidate fault elements.

abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a roadside sensing data quality real-time evaluation method based on a high-precision map, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining related data of a predetermined region, carrying out the preprocessing, and carrying out the feature extraction of the preprocessed data; performing quality evaluation on the trajectory data by using the feature extraction result to obtain an evaluation result; and comprehensively analyzing the evaluation result to obtain a quality analysis report, and feeding back a comprehensive analysis result to the roadside sensing system. According to the method, the perception data is compared with the dynamic data in the high-precision map from multiple dimensions, so that the accuracy and practicability of the evaluation result are improved; in addition, a real-time feedback mechanism is established, problems in the trajectory data are found and corrected in time, and continuous optimization of the roadside sensing system is promoted. title: Knowledge graph construction method and retrieval system based on chart image
abstract: The invention discloses a knowledge graph construction method based on chart images and a retrieval system. The method comprises the following steps of: 1, establishing a division system of entity types and semantic relationship types among entities in a chart image; 2, identifying a chart category of the chart image, extracting character information in the chart image, and dividing a plurality of entities in the chart image; and 3, establishing a semantic relationship among different entities, and establishing a knowledge graph according to the entities extracted from the chart image and the semantic relationship among the different entities. The invention provides a unified and explainable chart image representation method, which can effectively capture visual elements and semantic relationships in the chart image and support downstream tasks such as semantic perception chart retrieval and chart question and answer, thereby improving the ability of chart image analysis and application.

title: Pipeline evaluation method and device, computing equipment and machine readable storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a pipeline evaluation method and device, computing equipment and a machine readable storage medium, and belongs to the field of data analysis. The pipeline evaluation method comprises the following steps: dividing a target pipeline into a plurality of pipe sections; obtaining attribute parameters of each pipe section during operation; determining state parameters in all failure modes according to the attribute parameters of each pipe section; a Monte Carlo algorithm is adopted to determine the failure probability corresponding to each failure mode based on the state parameters in all the failure modes; and obtaining a reliability evaluation result of the target pipeline according to the failure probability corresponding to each failure mode. By dividing the pipeline into the multiple pipe sections and analyzing the reliability of the multiple pipe sections in the different failure modes, the reliability of the pipeline can be comprehensively evaluated, and then a more accurate pipeline reliability evaluation result is obtained. And the pipeline is maintained and overhauled according to a reliability evaluation result, so that long-term reliable operation of the pipeline is ensured.

abstract: The invention provides a simulation method and system for intelligent fusion and dynamic prediction of electronic warfare intelligence. According to the simulation method, electromagnetic signals are collected in real time through a multi-domain sensor, a dynamic adversarial network (DAN) is adopted for frequency spectrum matching and abnormal positioning, and interference data are eliminated in combination with space-time verification; constructing a semantic association map of radar, communication and geographic information, fusing time domain/space domain features through space-time attention, and dynamically allocating confidence to realize multi-source data fusion; predicting a threat evolution trend based on a space-time Transform, outputting a threat level, a threat type and a threat intention, and generating a dynamic situation map in combination with a mixed density network; an online incremental learning framework is adopted to adapt to a new signal mode, a prediction module is updated preferentially, and a multi-path distribution mechanism driven by edge-cloud collaborative optimization reinforcement learning is adopted to dynamically adjust the pushing priority, so that low-delay transmission of key threat intelligence is realized.

abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses a request processing method and device for a large language model. title: Hydraulic engineering tunnel construction safety assessment method
abstract: The invention discloses a water conservancy project tunnel construction safety assessment method. The method comprises the steps that monitoring data of a tunnel are collected, and a safety assessment level is marked; expansion of monitoring data is carried out through a historical iteration generative adversarial network; inputting the monitoring data into a feature extraction model to train the feature extraction model, wherein the feature extraction model is a full-connection neural network based on dynamic adaptive oscillation; inputting the monitoring data into a feature dimension reduction model to train the feature dimension reduction model, wherein the feature dimension reduction model is a self-encoding neural network based on feature refinement; inputting the monitoring data into a classifier for training a classifier model, wherein the classifier is a fractional order neural network based on dynamic pruning of a fractional rank; and processing and classifying in the trained feature extraction model, feature dimension reduction model and classifier model to obtain a classification result. According to the invention, the problem of poor generalization ability caused by insufficient data samples in the existing engineering construction safety assessment method is solved.

title: Hybrid network method for pubis symphysis and fetal head segmentation
abstract: The invention relates to a hybrid network method DSSAU-Net for pubis symphysis and fetal head segmentation, which is used for FH and PS segmentation. In each stage, a different number of dual sparse selection attention (DSSA) blocks are stacked to form a symmetric U-shaped encoder-decoder network architecture. For a given query, the DSSA is designed to explicitly perform one sparse token selection at the region and pixel levels, respectively, which facilitates further reduction of computational complexity while extracting the most relevant features. In order to compensate for information loss in the up-sampling process, jump connection with convolution is designed. In addition, a multi-scale feature fusion method is adopted to enrich global information and local information of the model. Results on a data set show that the medical image segmentation method can realize accurate and efficient medical image segmentation.

abstract: The invention discloses a method, a system and equipment for identifying internal defects of a steel billet and a medium. title: Abnormal data stream classification detection method and device based on unbalanced multi-instance learning
abstract: The invention discloses an abnormal data flow classification detection method and device based on unbalanced multi-instance learning, and relates to the technical field of network security. The method comprises the following steps: dividing network traffic into a positive packet set and a negative packet set; performing oversampling operation on all the positive packets in the positive packet set to obtain an expanded new positive packet set; carrying out undersampling operation on all the negative packets in the negative packet set to obtain a new reduced negative packet set; constructing a cost sensitive loss function based on the cost weight and the category weight; constructing a classifier according to the cost-sensitive loss function; training the classifier, and updating the cost weight of the classifier according to the missing report number and the false report number of each round of training; and identifying the network traffic by using the optimized classifier. According to the invention, the abnormal data flow in the network flow can be efficiently and accurately detected.

title: Indoor wireless positioning method based on RSSI hybrid filtering and GPRM
abstract: The invention discloses an indoor wireless positioning method based on RSSI (Received Signal Strength Indicator) hybrid filtering and GPRM (General Packet Radio Service), which comprises the following steps of: S10, carrying out hybrid filtering combined by an improved quartile method and Kalman filtering on collected RSSI data; s20, RSSI training data are obtained, a Gaussian process regression model is adopted to carry out distance curve fitting, and conversion from RSSI to a distance value is completed; and S30, optimizing the weighted least square algorithm through a particle swarm optimization algorithm and obtaining a final calculation result. According to the method, an improved quartile method is used for carrying out preliminary RSSI filtering, and RSSI data are smoothed through Kalman filtering. And the conversion from the RSSI to the distance is completed by introducing a Gaussian process regression model on the curve fitting of the distance. In the coordinate positioning stage, a weight matrix is introduced to carry out weighting processing, and a particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize a weight, so that the precision of a least square algorithm is improved.

title: Discriminator network for detecting out-of-run design domain scenarios
abstract: A method for detecting when a vehicle encounters an out-of-operation design domain (ODD) scene is provided. The method may include training a generative adversarial network (GAN) including a generator network and a discriminator network. A generator network may be trained to generate a composite scene. The discriminator network may be trained to discriminate between the real scene and the synthetic scene generated by the generator network. A trained discriminator network may be applied to detect when a vehicle encounters an out-of-operation design domain (ODD) scene. Some described methods also include controlling motion of the vehicle in response to an output of the trained discriminator network indicating that the vehicle is encountering an out-of-operation design domain (ODD) scene. A system and a computer program product are also provided.

title: Motion-induced heart rate variability prediction method based on random forest algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a motion-induced heart rate variability prediction method based on a random forest algorithm. According to the invention, accurate prediction and dynamic management of motion-induced heart rate variability are realized.

title: Photovoltaic cell panel surface color imaging device based on CIE and sRGB standards
abstract: The invention discloses a CIE and sRGB standard-based photovoltaic cell panel surface color imaging device, and relates to the field of color imaging, and the device comprises a to-be-detected photovoltaic cell panel, an illumination light source, a color camera, a standard chromaticity conversion model and an sRGB conversion model. The illumination light source irradiates the photovoltaic cell panel to be detected at a set angle; the color camera is used for shooting a color RGB image of a to-be-photovoltaic cell panel and a color RGB image of a calibration color sample; the standard chromaticity conversion model is used for converting a color RGB image of a to-be-photovoltaic cell panel and a color RGB image of a calibration color sample from an RGB space to a CIEXYZ standard space; and the sRGB conversion model is used for converting the image converted to the CIEXYZ standard space to a standard sRGB space. According to the invention, standardized and high-efficiency imaging of the surface color of the photovoltaic panel assembly can be realized.

title: Current energy-saving shunting automatic timing and metering system and device
abstract: The invention discloses a current energy-saving shunting automatic timing metering system and device, and the system comprises an energy-saving shunting module which comprises a main circuit and an energy-saving circuit which are connected in parallel, and achieves the dynamic switching of a current path through a semiconductor switch array; the timing module is integrated with a real-time clock unit, records the duration of the energy-saving mode and the duration of the non-energy-saving mode, and is synchronized with the operation cycle of the load; the metering module monitors and compares current, voltage and power parameters of the two paths in real time; the control module is used for triggering path switching according to a preset strategy or an external instruction based on the processor or the programmable logic device; the display module is integrated with an interactive display screen and displays energy consumption data in a non-energy-saving mode and an energy-saving mode in real time, energy-saving and non-energy-saving channels are dynamically switched, real-time monitoring and an intelligent decision algorithm are combined, the energy utilization efficiency is optimized, the remarkable energy-saving effect is achieved, and the refined energy consumption management requirement of an intelligent power grid is met.

abstract: The invention discloses a data storage equipment performance monitoring method and system, and relates to the technical field of storage equipment performance monitoring, and the method comprises the steps: calling historical working data from a database, carrying out the single-factor variance analysis, outputting a first analysis result, collecting performance index data, calculating descriptive statistic data, building a baseline, and building a first performance prediction model; according to the method, the influence of the load change on the equipment performance is analyzed and judged through the single-factor variance analysis, if the influence is obvious, a baseline and a performance prediction model are established, and performance index data are collected in real time for contrastive analysis. Meanwhile, equipment performance is monitored in real time, a monitoring strategy is dynamically adjusted according to real-time data and a historical trend, early warning accuracy is improved, a machine learning algorithm and an LOF technology are introduced, performance abnormity is recognized more effectively, and the false alarm rate and the missing report rate are reduced.

title: Conditional variation auto-encoder generative adversarial network fault diagnosis method
abstract: The invention discloses a conditional variation auto-encoder generative adversarial network fault diagnosis method, and belongs to the technical field of mechanical equipment fault diagnosis. The method comprises the following steps: S1, data preprocessing: converting a time domain vibration signal into an amplitude-frequency signal through Fourier transform, and dividing a data set into a training set and a test set; s2, sample generation: constructing a conditional variation auto-encoder generative adversarial network model to amplify a fault sample; s3, data expansion: inputting the signal samples in the training set into a conditional variation auto-encoder generative adversarial network model for training, after training is completed, performing sample generation on various faults by using label information, generating a set number of samples, and mixing the generated samples to a training sample; and S4, sample classification: inputting the training samples after data expansion into a first-layer wide convolution kernel deep convolutional neural network classification model for training, then carrying out fault classification on the signal samples in the test set, and identifying various fault signal samples by the first-layer wide convolution kernel deep convolutional neural network. According to the conditional variation auto-encoder generative adversarial network fault diagnosis method provided by the invention, on the basis of a conditional variation auto-encoder generative model, an adversarial learning framework of a conditional generative adversarial network is utilized to further improve the trueness and diversity of samples; and samples with higher quality and more similar and diversified fault sample space dimensions can be generated.

title: Video-to-game cross-scene emotion recognition system
abstract: A video-to-game cross-scene emotion recognition system comprises a converter module, a source domain discriminator, a feature extractor, a target domain discriminator and an emotion classifier, the converter module is based on electroencephalogram feature distribution of a source domain and a target domain, a source domain (target domain) converter converts input features into source domain (target domain) features, and the source domain (target domain) features are extracted from the source domain (target domain) features; finally, obtaining features containing source domain information and target domain information at the same time; the source domain discriminator judges whether the output of the source domain converter is a source domain feature according to the distribution of the source domain feature, so that the feature converted by the source domain converter meets the distribution of the source domain feature, and the feature extractor extracts the common information of the two domains according to the feature data which is output by the converter and contains the information of the source domain and the target domain at the same time; more accurate emotion features are obtained; the target domain discriminator judges whether the output of the target domain converter is a target domain feature or not according to the target domain feature distribution, so that the feature converted by the target domain converter meets the target domain feature distribution; the emotion classifier classifies the features according to emotions according to the features extracted by the feature extractor, and an emotion label corresponding to each electroencephalogram sample is obtained. According to the method, the influence of extra interference of a game scene on electroencephalogram features can be reduced, and emotion related features can be better captured.

title: Object model generation method, knowledge base construction method and device
abstract: The invention provides an object model generation method and device and a knowledge base construction method and device, and relates to the technical field of model generation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a user input instruction, and performing text embedding processing on the user input instruction to obtain a second vector; wherein the user input instruction refers to unstructured text data, and the second vector refers to a sparse vector in a high-dimensional space; according to the second vector, a plurality of third vectors are retrieved from a plurality of first vectors stored in a vector database, and a retrieval result is screened from standard data stored in a text database; and according to the user input instruction and the retrieval result, generating a target object model through a preset mixed prompt project and a preset large language model. title: Self-attention guidance anomaly generation method based on latent variable diffusion model
abstract: The invention discloses a self-attention guided anomaly generation method based on a latent variable diffusion model, and belongs to the technical field of computer vision. According to the method, reverse denoising diffusion processing is performed on random noise through a text-guided latent variable diffusion model so as to generate an image with specified content. In order to realize synchronous generation of normal-abnormal sample pairs, a de-noising network self-attention layer is utilized to accurately control generated normal sample images and abnormal sample images, so that the consistency of normal areas and the authenticity of the abnormal images are ensured. In addition, a corresponding abnormal mask is generated by comparing the feature difference between the generated normal sample and the abnormal sample. The method can be used for generating the abnormal sample and has a wide application prospect.

title: Acupuncture point positioning method and system based on image enhancement
abstract: The invention discloses an acupoint positioning method and system based on image enhancement, and belongs to the technical field of image processing, and the method comprises the steps of human body acupoint image collection, human body acupoint image enhancement, acupoint recognition model construction and acupoint positioning. title: High-toughness amino modified vinyl ester resin and preparation method thereof
abstract: The invention provides high-toughness amino modified vinyl ester resin and a preparation method thereof. The resin comprises a vinyl ester resin matrix, an amino modified component, a cross-linking agent, a catalyst, a solvent, a coupling agent and an antioxidant. The heat stability, the mechanical property and the anti-aging capacity of the resin are improved, and the resin adapts to severe environment conditions. Through combination of the neural network and the automatic control system, efficient optimization of the resin preparation process is realized, generation of by-products is reduced, and the yield is improved. The real-time monitoring and adjustment of the reaction process are realized, the reaction conditions and the resin quality are optimized, and the automation and the intelligence of the production process are brought. The utilization rate of the raw materials is optimized, energy consumption and waste generation are reduced, and the environment-friendly requirement is met. The resin is excellent in performance under the environment of high temperature, high corrosion and high mechanical load, has a wide application prospect, and is particularly suitable for the industrial field needing high heat resistance and long-term stability.

title: Airport runway adaptive background elimination system and method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of airport monitoring, and discloses an airport runway adaptive background elimination system and method, and the system comprises a signal collection module which is used for obtaining a real-time monitoring signal of an airport runway area; the multi-scale analysis module is used for carrying out multi-scale analysis on the signals to extract features of background clutters; the background estimation module is used for performing background estimation on the signals through a deep learning algorithm and generating background signals; the threshold adjusting module is used for dynamically adjusting the detection threshold of the target signal according to the background signal; and the filtering module is used for suppressing background clutters through a self-adaptive sliding filter and enhancing target signals. Through multi-module cooperative signal processing, a target signal can be effectively separated from a complex background environment, so that the target signal is accurately detected under runways made of different materials and changing weather conditions, and the problems of false alarm and missing detection caused by background interference in the prior art are avoided.

abstract: The invention discloses a special equipment operation fault detection method and device, and relates to the related field of data processing, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the dynamic sensing of special equipment, obtaining an operation dynamic data set of the special equipment, and synchronizing the operation dynamic data set to a long-short-term memory network, determining a plurality of fault influence factors, performing fault joint detection in combination with the equipment use scene parameter set, generating a first fault detection result, activating a fault probabilistic reasoning model, and performing fault reasoning in combination with the operation dynamic data set, and generating a second fault detection result and performing automatic comprehensive analysis and detection on the operation fault of the special equipment in combination with the first fault detection result. title: Multi-scale feature fusion robot water army detection method based on comparative learning
abstract: Under limited hardware resources, the detection accuracy can be effectively improved, the robustness of the model is improved, and a detection result indicating whether the current user is a water army user or a real user is generated. The invention relates to a multi-scale feature fusion robot water army detection method based on comparative learning. The method comprises the steps of user feature extraction, multi-scale feature fusion, comparative learning optimization and heterogeneous graph neural network classification decision. Firstly, difference data of real users and water army users on a social media platform are collected, and preliminary user features are obtained; thirdly, weight distribution is carried out on the features of different scales through a channel attention mechanism; then, designing positive and negative sample pairs, and enhancing the capturing capability of the model on fine feature differences by using comparative learning; and finally, training a heterogeneous graph neural network model, inputting a heterogeneous graph structure, and outputting a detection result that the user is a water army user or a real-time user, thereby effectively improving the detection accuracy and the model robustness, and accurately judging the identity of the user.

abstract: The invention discloses a scheduling method, device and equipment for a water pump unit and a storage medium. Historical operation data of a water supply system and operation condition data of the water pump unit are collected; according to the historical operation data, training a corresponding water supply demand prediction model, and predicting a water supply flow demand in a future time period through the trained water supply demand prediction model; physical characteristic information of the water pump unit is determined according to the operation condition data; establishing a multi-target mixed integer nonlinear programming model related to the scheduling of the water pump unit by taking the water supply flow demand and the operation limitation of the water pump unit as constraint conditions and taking the minimization of the power cost and the minimization of the equipment loss as optimization targets; and solving the multi-target mixed integer nonlinear programming model, and scheduling the water pump unit in a future time period according to a solving result. abstract: The invention provides an optimal scheduling method and system for a multi-region integrated energy system, and the method comprises the steps: enabling the integrated energy system of each region to be managed by a corresponding local agent, training a preset energy optimal scheduling model through the local agent based on a reinforcement learning idea, and obtaining a local optimization model; the local optimization model is updated according to the encryption parameter data packet of the neighbor intelligent agent and a double random matrix constructed based on the topological relation between the integrated energy systems, and the local optimization model of each local intelligent agent is updated after the local optimization model of each local intelligent agent is updated; and carrying out overall convergence evaluation on all the local optimization models, stopping cooperative training among the local intelligent agents when a preset optimization target is reached, and executing integrated energy system optimization scheduling of the corresponding region according to the local optimization model of each local intelligent agent. title: Three-dimensional human body posture estimation method based on multilevel dense posture generation
abstract: The invention provides a three-dimensional human body posture estimation method based on multi-level dense posture generation, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a two-dimensional human body posture which is a two-dimensional coordinate of a human body joint point; using an autoregressive attitude code element generation model to sequentially obtain an input attitude generation code element and a dense attitude generation code element according to a two-dimensional human body attitude in a sequence from a human body center articulation point to an edge articulation point; through a decoder, generating a first layer of dense attitude according to the dense attitude generation code elements, and generating a second layer of dense attitude according to the input attitude generation code elements and the dense attitude generation code elements; and splicing the two-dimensional human body posture, the first-layer dense posture and the second-layer dense posture, and inputting the spliced posture into Transform to obtain three-dimensional posture estimation. title: Regitive image steganography detection method and system and medium
abstract: The invention provides an adversarial image steganography detection method and system and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: inputting a carrier image, and calculating the gradient value of each pixel in the carrier image; sampling the carrier image to obtain a plurality of sub-images; calculating an average gradient value of each sub-image according to the gradient values, sorting the sub-images according to the average gradient values and grouping the sub-images in sequence to obtain a plurality of sub-image sets, and respectively selecting representative images from each sub-image set; extracting feature vectors of the carrier image and the representative image to form a target feature matrix; training a classifier according to the target feature matrix to obtain a target classifier, and performing steganography detection on the to-be-detected image through the target classifier; according to the method, the robustness and accuracy of the target classifier in the image steganography detection task are improved, the adversarial samples can be effectively detected and screened out, and the application of the security steganography detection technology is facilitated.

title: Vehicle driving data uploading method, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of vehicles, and provides a vehicle driving data uploading method, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the vehicle driving data of a target vehicle; predicting a vehicle accident occurrence probability of the target vehicle based on the vehicle driving data and a preset analysis model; and if it is determined that the vehicle accident occurrence probability meets the preset condition, historical driving data of the target vehicle within a preset duration before the current moment is obtained, and the historical driving data is uploaded to a cloud server. abstract: The invention relates to a video abstraction method based on global and local convolution attention mechanisms, which comprises the following steps: down-sampling a to-be-processed video file to obtain a video frame, performing feature extraction by using a convolutional neural network through the video frame to obtain a feature vector of the video frame, and forming a feature matrix of the to-be-processed video file; inputting the feature matrix into a global and local convolution attention mechanism model, and calculating an importance score of each frame of the video; acquiring a key frame index based on the importance score of each frame and a knapsack algorithm; and extracting key frames in the to-be-processed video file through the key frame index and forming a video abstract. title: Corn seed form classification method based on residual network model
abstract: According to the corn seed form classification method based on the residual network model, the residual network model is designed, input is allowed to be directly transmitted to a subsequent layer through jump connection, and the problem of gradient disappearance is avoided. A corn seed image sample is generated by combining active learning and a conditional generative adversarial network, and the problems of data imbalance and insufficient diversity are effectively solved. Dropout, an L2 regularization technology and an early stop method are combined, and the over-fitting risk of the classification model is reduced. And an RMSprop optimizer is used for dynamically adjusting the learning rate according to the change of the training process, so that an ideal optimization effect is achieved. title: Framework for synthesizing Fourier KAN obstacle certificate
abstract: The invention provides a framework for synthesizing a Fourier KAN obstacle certificate, and relates to the field of computer science and artificial intelligence. abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of slope monitoring, in particular to a slope monitoring method and system based on multi-parameter fusion, and the system comprises a multi-parameter slope monitoring module, a basic instability fusion evaluation module, an evolution instability fusion evaluation module and a comprehensive instability early warning module. title: Data analysis method and device based on magnetocardiogram
abstract: The invention provides a data analysis method and device based on a magnetic cardiogram. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring magnetic cardiogram data containing a plurality of channels; carrying out preprocessing on the magnetic cardiogram data; extracting characteristic indexes from the preprocessed magnetic cardiogram data; based on the extracted characteristic indexes, constructing and training a machine learning model for predicting a coronary artery stenosis part; and analyzing the new magnetocardiogram data by utilizing a machine learning model so as to judge whether coronary artery diseases and narrow blood vessel parts exist or not. title: Quantum security data processing method and system based on federal learning
abstract: The invention discloses a federated learning-based quantum security data processing method and a federated learning-based quantum security data processing system. According to the invention, federated learning and the quantum network are combined, so that in the working process of the system, key transmission is not limited by distance, global security is satisfied, and the method has high practical application value.

title: Video restoration tampering detection method based on noise residual error and average optical flow
abstract: The invention belongs to the field of multimedia content security, and particularly relates to a video restoration tampering detection method based on noise residual error and average optical flow, which comprises the following steps: S1, extracting noise of a video, a forward optical flow mode and a backward optical flow mode, acquiring the noise residual error based on the noise, and averaging the forward optical flow mode and the backward optical flow mode to obtain an average optical flow mode; s2, inputting the noise residual error and the average optical flow mode into an encoder which takes SegFormer as a backbone network, and generating a multi-scale feature; s3, performing intra-feature interaction on the generated noise residual multi-scale features and the average optical flow mode multi-scale features by using a decoder; s4, performing feature interaction on the interacted features through a multi-scale feature fusion module; and S5, combining all the features to obtain a final tampering positioning area of the deep repair video. The method aims at solving the problem that public security is threatened by malicious tampering on a video in an existing deep video restoration technology. Experimental results show that compared with an existing method, the method has better performance.

title: Point cloud segmentation method, point cloud segmentation device, equipment and computer storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a point cloud segmentation method, a point cloud segmentation device, point cloud segmentation equipment and a computer storage medium. The point cloud segmentation method comprises the following steps: acquiring original point cloud data; obtaining high-dimensional voxel point features of each data point in the original point cloud data; obtaining spatial voxel features by using the high-dimensional voxel point features belonging to the same voxel grid; transforming the space voxel features into aerial view features through dimension transformation; and performing point cloud segmentation prediction based on the aerial view features. Through the point cloud segmentation method, voxel division is performed on the point cloud data, so that data points of different heights and different categories are dispersed in different voxel grids, and then the voxels in the height direction and the feature channels are recombined, so that height information is reserved, and meanwhile, a low-time-consumption 2D convolutional network is conveniently used subsequently to perform a segmentation task.

title: Temperature control intelligent insole and control method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a temperature control intelligent insole and a control method thereof. The insole comprises a structure supporting layer, a heat dissipation layer, a temperature adjusting layer, a soaking layer buffer layer, a temperature sensor, a main control board and a power supply unit, wherein the temperature adjusting layer is formed by alternately arranging semiconductor coolers and heat preservation patches. The main control board monitors data in real time through the temperature sensor, the working state of the semiconductor cooler is dynamically adjusted by combining a PID algorithm and a temperature change rate control algorithm, and precise temperature control is achieved. The foot temperature and the change rate of a user are predicted based on a multi-modal neural network, and in combination with biomechanical models such as fat pad deformation, achilles tendon viscoelasticity and soft tissue fatigue accumulation under thermal stress, a constraint condition optimization temperature control curve is established, and the comfort and soft tissue performance are maximized. Through cooperation of multiple layers of materials and intelligent control, the problems that traditional temperature control shoes are uneven in heat dissipation, complex in structure and lagged in response are solved.

title: Attention mechanism fused relation extraction method
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of relation extraction in natural language processing, in particular to a relation extraction method fusing an attention mechanism. According to the method, natural language texts of sentences and relations are combined through a BERT encoder, the combined sentences are sent into the BERT encoder to be encoded, and combined codes are obtained; performing feature extraction by taking the joint code as input of an attention layer to obtain a feature code; the feature code is used as an input of a decoder and decoded. title: Discrete dynamic graph neural network link prediction method and system based on mask mechanism
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of link prediction, in particular to a discrete dynamic graph neural network link prediction method and system based on a mask mechanism. abstract: The invention provides a three-dimensional gravel aggregate generation method based on a generative adversarial network, which belongs to the technical field of three-dimensional object generation and comprises the steps of data processing, generator and discriminator construction, network training, sample generation and post-processing. title: Urban flood response toughness evaluation method and system based on HVEDR model
abstract: The invention discloses an urban flood response toughness evaluation method and system based on an HVEDR model, and the method comprises the steps: firstly constructing an HVEDR model through employing the evaluation dimensions of disaster-inducing performance, vulnerability, exposure, defensiveness and restoration, and then building a hierarchical structure model based on the HVEDR model according to flood disaster factors and the attribute relation between the flood disaster factors. title: Multi-port on-chip interconnection reliability analysis method
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of integrated circuits, and particularly relates to a multi-port on-chip interconnection reliability analysis method. According to the method, a key path of on-chip interconnection is evaluated by establishing a multi-port on-chip interconnection physical model; the delay change of a gate on a critical path under the action of an NBTI effect is estimated by calculating the port utilization rate according to the working load condition, and the service life of the multi-port on-chip interconnection is predicted, namely, the time of failure caused by the fact that the delay exceeds an allowable range after long-term working of the multi-port on-chip interconnection is estimated. When the influence of a reverse bias temperature instability (NBTI) effect on the service life of the circuit is evaluated, a physical implementation method of a regular layout multi-port on-chip interconnection data path is considered, and the port utilization rate is calculated according to a port access conflict probability model. According to the method, accurate critical path estimation is obtained through a physical model, and efficient analysis of the reliability of the multi-port on-chip interconnection is realized in combination with an efficient port utilization rate calculation method.

title: Full-integer hardware acceleration circuit of attention module in vision Transform
abstract: The invention discloses a full-integer hardware acceleration circuit of an attention module in a visual Transform, and belongs to the technical field of calculation, reckoning or counting. According to the accelerator, a hardware-friendly circuit design used for accelerating attention module calculation is provided for the full-integer reasoning requirement of a ViT model. The circuit comprises a PE array module used for matrix calculation, a Shiftmax module used for full-integer calculation of a Softmax function, an on-chip SRAM (Static Random Access Memory) cache module and a controller. The PE array module supports row or column combination output, the Shiftmax module uses a base number conversion and shift algorithm to replace traditional floating-point number calculation, and high reasoning precision can be kept. The circuit adopts a row data flow design, is matched with a multi-head self-attention mechanism, and can hide the calculation delay of a Softmax function. According to the method, the calculation delay and energy consumption of the attention module in the visual Transform are remarkably reduced, and the method is suitable for an efficient image recognition task of edge equipment.

abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of medical image analysis, and discloses an HER2 positive breast cancer auxiliary prediction method based on multi-modal data fusion. title: Body execution model action generation method and system based on large-scale diffusion coding and decoding
abstract: The invention provides a body execution model action generation method and system based on large-scale diffusion coding and decoding. The method comprises the following steps: step 1, preprocessing an original data set, including cleaning and denoising of data; 2, constructing a body execution model based on large-scale diffusion coding and decoding, and training the model by using the preprocessed data set; and step 3, generating an action track by using the trained model. title: Adaptive medical image reversible information hiding method based on adversarial lifting
abstract: The invention discloses a reversible information hiding method for a medical image based on adversarial promotion, which is used for hiding key information in the medical image. The method is composed of a predictor module and an embedder module. Firstly, a standardized file header and medical image data are extracted from a medical image in an original DICOM format, then the medical image is divided into low-resolution images by using a uniform sampling method, and after division is completed, the low-resolution images are input into a predictor module to be restored to obtain high-resolution images with the same size as the original image. title: Model service method and device and storage medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention provides a model service method and device and a storage medium. It is proposed to build a plurality of service instances deployed for the model service as a data transmission network. After the service instance receives the model calling request, whether model data needed by model loading exists in the local storage space or not can be inquired firstly, and if not, the needed model data can be remotely downloaded from other service instances on the basis of a data transmission network, and the downloaded model data is stored in the local storage space. Therefore, model data sharing can be realized based on the data transmission network established among the plurality of service instances, and the network transmission rate among the service instances in the data transmission network is far higher than the back-to-source downloading rate, so that even if the service instance does not have the model data required for loading locally, the service instance can not be loaded locally. Model data can also be downloaded remotely from other service instances. Therefore, the model loading efficiency can be effectively improved, so that the response efficiency to the model calling request is improved.
