title: Desulfurization wastewater electrodialysis-drying tower intelligent coupling system based on dynamic risk balance
abstract: The invention discloses a desulfurization wastewater electrodialysis-drying tower intelligent coupling system based on dynamic risk balance, which comprises an electrodialysis module, a drying tower module, a buffer regulation module and an intelligent control module, the intelligent control module monitors electrodialysis outlet parameters (such as concentrated water conductivity and temperature), buffer adjustment parameters (such as liquid level and flow) and drying tower inlet parameters (such as air inlet temperature and nozzle pressure difference) in real time, and calculates three-dimensional scaling risk indexes (including dynamic saturation index, critical scaling rate and accumulated risk factor) and comprehensive energy consumption of the system. On the basis of risk grade division, weight coefficients are dynamically adjusted through fuzzy logic, multi-objective optimization is conducted in combination with an improved NSGA-II algorithm, and the electrodialysis concentration multiplying power and the water treatment amount of a drying tower are dynamically adjusted. According to the invention, the concentration rate fluctuation is less than +/-3%, the energy consumption per ton of water is 6.8-7.3 kWh, the moisture content of the dried product is less than 1.5%, the scaling risk is effectively reduced, the equipment maintenance period is prolonged, and the economical efficiency and reliability of the system are improved.

abstract: The invention discloses a method for predicting the erosion rate of a control manifold of an offshore oil and gas exploration well. According to the well control manifold erosion rate prediction method provided by the invention, the maximum erosion rate of the well control manifold can be accurately predicted.

title: Data processing method and electronic equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a data processing method and electronic equipment, and relates to the technical field of computers, and the method comprises the steps: dividing a complete reasoning process of a request into at least one processing stage according to the number of layers of a current reasoning model, and determining a model layer of each stage; and determining a current processing stage, and executing pre-filling reasoning on the request by the corresponding model layer in the first processing node to obtain a key value cache. The second processing node carries out decoding reasoning on the key value cache to obtain the lexical element sequence of the current stage, meanwhile, a new current processing stage is determined, the pre-filling reasoning step and the decoding reasoning step are repeated until the lexical element sequences of all stages are obtained, and the lexical element sequences are spliced to obtain a final result. Therefore, the key value cache is stored and managed by taking the model layer as a unit, pipeline parallelism of three tasks of pre-filling reasoning, network transmission and decoding reasoning is realized, and the problems that computing resources are idle and TTFT is prolonged due to the fact that the key value cache is transmitted by taking the whole request as the unit are solved.

title: Question and answer system knowledge base shunting mechanism based on weighted polling algorithm
abstract: The invention discloses a question and answer system knowledge base shunting method based on a weighted polling algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence retrieval enhancement generation. In order to overcome the defects of a single knowledge base architecture of a traditional RAG system in the aspects of multi-source knowledge management, gray updating and load balancing, a cluster architecture comprising a main knowledge base, an auxiliary knowledge base and a test knowledge base is constructed, and intelligent flow distribution is achieved through a flow distribution controller. The system adopts a multi-dimensional weight calculation model, fuses a user role coefficient, a knowledge base state coefficient and a performance coefficient, and dynamically calculates the weight of each knowledge base according to a weight calculation formula; using a weighted polling algorithm to accurately distribute user requests; and automatically adjusting the weight of the knowledge base in the gray scale test period. The vector retrieval module converts questions into vectors to retrieve in a target library, and a result fusion engine resolves multi-library answer conflicts through weighted voting. After the method is applied, the update failure rate of the knowledge base is reduced from 25% to 5%, the question and answer accuracy is improved by 22%, and the response speed is improved by 40%.

title: Unmanned farm drainage and irrigation layout method and device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract: The embodiment of the invention discloses an unmanned farm drainage and irrigation layout method and device, electronic equipment and a medium. title: Cable external breakage risk detection method and system based on variational mode decomposition and Transform fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a cable external damage risk detection method and system based on variational mode decomposition and Transform fusion, and the method comprises the steps: setting a plurality of detection nodes on an underground cable, and collecting a vibration signal A of each detection node; preprocessing the vibration signal A to obtain an RMS signal ARMS; performing VMD (variational mode decomposition) on the ARMS to obtain an IMF feature vector Fk; inputting the multiple pieces of Fk and the direction information Dir into a multi-scale dynamic Transform model for training, and obtaining a multi-scale dynamic Transform mature model; and carrying out cable external damage risk grade division by using a multi-scale dynamic Transform mature model. abstract: The invention discloses a multitask motor imagery electroencephalogram decoding method based on federal learning, and belongs to the technical field of motor imagery brain-computer interfaces. In order to solve the problems that electroencephalogram data are high in isomerism and federated learning communication efficiency is low, a double-server federated learning framework and a knowledge distillation mixed communication method are designed and used for motor imagery electroencephalogram decoding. abstract: The invention discloses a multi-view fusion signal classification method based on evolutionary neural architecture search, and belongs to the technical field of signal classification. title: Hospital information system anomaly detection method based on space-time weighted graph reasoning network
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of information processing, in particular to a hospital information system anomaly detection method based on a space-time weighted graph reasoning network. Comprising the following steps: S1, defining a feature vector of each sensor; s2, constructing a sequence denoising receiving weighted key value module to obtain an MTS sequence vector and an attention weight vector; s3, obtaining an acceptance vector, and calculating a memory state embedded value of the sensor; s4, setting a target perception map adaptive aggregation module, and outputting a predicted value of the sensor at the next moment; s5, at the next moment, obtaining the true value of the sensor, subtracting the true value from the predicted value to obtain a difference value, setting a threshold value, when the difference value exceeds the threshold value, determining that abnormity exists at the moment, and otherwise, determining that no abnormity exists; and meanwhile, high precision, low delay and high reliability in anomaly detection of the multivariable time series of the Internet of Things are realized.

title: Multi-element energy storage multi-time scale coordinated scheduling method, system, equipment and medium
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system scheduling and optimization, and discloses a multi-element energy storage multi-time scale coordinated scheduling method, system and device and a medium, and the method comprises the steps: constructing a multi-element energy storage day-ahead scheduling optimization model; obtaining a day-ahead reference scheduling plan by solving the multi-element energy storage day-ahead scheduling optimization model; constructing a multi-element energy storage intra-day rolling scheduling optimization model; constructing a deep reinforcement learning optimization framework based on an attention mechanism; training the deep reinforcement learning optimization framework by using the historical operation data to obtain a trained deep reinforcement learning model; and based on the multi-element energy storage intra-day rolling scheduling optimization model, in combination with fixed parameters of a day-ahead reference scheduling plan, target parameters are optimized through a deep reinforcement learning model, and intra-day scheduling optimization is executed. According to the method, the advantages of multi-type energy storage can be fused, multi-time-scale scheduling is combined, the uncertainty is processed by utilizing reinforcement learning, and meanwhile, the key variable attention is improved so as to improve the decision-making precision.

title: Multi-mode integrated distribution network operation system based on image and sound information
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent management of a power distribution network, in particular to a multi-mode integrated distribution network operation system based on image and sound information, and aims to solve the problems that fault diagnosis, equipment characteristics and an operating environment cannot be accurately fused to construct a restoration map, and the restoration map cannot be accurately fused in the prior art. The problems that the cost, the time sequence and the stability of a repair strategy cannot be comprehensively evaluated in a multi-scene condition, a repair path with global optimality and actual performability is difficult to generate, and the efficiency and the economical efficiency of power distribution network recovery and the system reliability are reduced are solved. According to the method, fault diagnosis, equipment characteristics and an operation environment are fused through a distribution network self-evolution repair planning module, a repair map is dynamically constructed, a strategy is comprehensively evaluated among cost, time sequence and stability through a multi-scene game, and finally a repair path with global optimality and actual performability is generated. And the recovery efficiency, economy and system reliability of the power distribution network are remarkably improved.

title: Intelligent inflatable suit with lightweight sign detection warning system
abstract: The invention discloses an intelligent inflatable suit with a lightweight physical sign detection and warning system, and aims to solve the problems that existing inflatable game suits cannot detect and warn physical signs of a wearer, and certain potential safety hazards exist when the wearer wears the intelligent inflatable suit. According to the technical scheme, the inflatable suit comprises an inflatable suit body and a detection warning mechanism arranged inside the inflatable suit body, the detection warning mechanism comprises a control module, the control module comprises at least one processing chip and a connecting end, and the connecting end comprises a plurality of electric pins; the electrode tip is electrically connected with the control module and is used for being in contact with a preset position of a detected object so as to detect a physical sign signal; and the electrode base is electrically connected with the electrode tip and is used for fixing the detection electrode on the wearable equipment. According to the inflatable suit, the detection warning system is arranged on the inflatable suit body, the heart rate, pulse and body temperature of a monitored object are detected, warning is given out in time when abnormity occurs, and the safety performance of the inflatable suit is better when the inflatable suit is worn.

title: Multi-scene adaptive AGV scheduling management system and path planning method
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-scene adaptive AGV scheduling management system and a path planning method. Comprising a multi-scene perception and environment modeling module, a multi-AGV task scheduling and resource allocation module, a dynamic path planning and optimization module, a scene adaptive decision module, a multi-sensor fusion obstacle avoidance module, a heterogeneous communication and data synchronization module and a whole-process monitoring and fault diagnosis module. According to the invention, full-process adaptive control from environment modeling to decision optimization is realized. An SVM classification algorithm and dynamic matching degree calculation are adopted, so that the system can accurately identify characteristics of heterogeneous scenes such as warehousing, workshops and logistics hubs, and an optimal scheduling strategy is automatically switched; and a multi-dimensional cost function including path length, obstacle risk, smoothness and congestion degree is constructed, and seamless connection of global path pre-planning and local dynamic adjustment is realized.

title: Heterogeneous computing task mapping method based on reinforcement learning
abstract: The invention discloses a heterogeneous calculation task mapping method based on reinforcement learning, and particularly relates to the technical field of reinforcement learning, the method detects the CPU utilization rate and the task queue length in real time, dynamically screens hardware actions, calculates a memory bandwidth demand difference value, then implements double filtering, selects high-success-rate low-delay actions during resource conflicts, and finally performs task mapping. And identifying a key path and preferentially distributing low-delay hardware by an operation task dependency chain parameter, dynamically adjusting a weight based on a key path ratio, scaling an action space scale in combination with a load change rate, and finally selecting a highest reward estimated value to complete mapping. According to the method, response delay is remarkably reduced through a multi-stage cooperation mechanism, task accumulation is effectively controlled, key path execution time is compressed, burst load adaptive capacity is enhanced, resource utilization efficiency is improved, and stable and efficient task scheduling is achieved in a heterogeneous computing environment.

title: Multi-modal interaction and content generation method and system for intelligent photo album
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of man-machine interaction and intelligent content management, in particular to a multi-mode interaction and content generation method and system for an intelligent photo album. Comprising the steps of obtaining user interaction data and determining initial hotspot content; an attention mechanism model is adopted to calculate the association strength of the content subject type and the picture style feature, and a preference vector is obtained; extracting a preference vector change trend, adjusting an attenuation element weight, and generating an updated display priority sequence; determining a photo album content display sequence through the display priority sequence; acquiring real-time behavior feedback data, and optimizing the preference vector to obtain a refined interest model; making a recommendation strategy according to the interest model, and generating a photo album layout template; and generating a final output sequence according to the layout template, fusing the main body type and the picture style, and outputting a personalized photo album version. According to the invention, the personalized and intelligent level of photo album display is effectively improved.

title: KAN linear load flow calculation method for interpretable two-stage optimization
abstract: The invention discloses a KAN linear load flow calculation method based on interpretable two-stage optimization. The KAN linear load flow calculation method comprises the following steps: S1, constructing a training data set for load flow calculation; s2, based on the training data set, screening out a key feature subset for load flow calculation from all input features by using an attribution scoring mechanism of a KAN network; s3, optimizing structure hyper-parameters of the KAN network based on the key feature subset so as to determine an optimal network structure; s4, training to obtain a final KAN load flow calculation model; and S5, extracting a mathematical analytical expression for describing the relationship between the input characteristics and the load flow calculation result, and carrying out physical interpretation of load flow distribution based on the analytical expression. According to the KAN linear power flow calculation method based on interpretability two-stage optimization, high precision is guaranteed, and meanwhile, the problem of a black box existing in an existing data-driven power flow model is thoroughly solved.

abstract: The invention discloses a carbon emission optimization method and device based on multi-source data, equipment and a medium, and relates to the field of low-carbon emission reduction, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the multi-source data of a target city; screening out a first feature set related to carbon emission from the multi-source data; inputting the first feature set into a prediction network model to obtain a carbon emission prediction result; fusing scene parameters corresponding to different scenes with the first feature set, and inputting the fused scene parameters and the first feature set into the prediction network model to obtain carbon emission reference values in different scenes, the carbon emission reference values including carbon peak time, peak value and emission reduction rate; according to the carbon emission reference values in different scenes, combining an evaluation index system constructed by multiple subjects to obtain a multi-subject carbon emission evaluation result; and optimizing the carbon emission of the target city according to the carbon emission reference value and the carbon emission evaluation result. title: Shared electric vehicle using amount prediction method and device, electronic equipment and medium
abstract: The invention provides a shared electric vehicle use amount prediction method and device, electronic equipment and a medium, and belongs to the technical field of shared vehicles, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining to-be-predicted data, including the historical use amount of a shared electric vehicle, to-be-predicted time information and weather time sequence information corresponding to the to-be-predicted time, of a to-be-predicted region; inputting to-be-predicted data into the vehicle consumption prediction model to obtain predicted vehicle consumption output by the vehicle consumption prediction model; the vehicle consumption prediction model comprises a neural network used for carrying out weather feature extraction on weather time sequence information and a neural network used for carrying out comprehensive feature extraction on vehicle consumption and time information. The feature fusion layer is used for fusing the extracted weather features and the comprehensive features; and the neural network is used for predicting the vehicle usage amount based on the fused features. According to the method and the device, the historical vehicle usage amount is considered when the future vehicle usage amount is predicted, and the influence of the weather environment in the predicted time on the vehicle usage of the user is also considered, so that the vehicle usage amount prediction accuracy can be effectively improved.

title: Target hair style generation method and device, readable storage medium and program product
abstract: The invention relates to a target hair style generation method and device, a readable storage medium and a program product. The method comprises the following steps: performing bang elimination processing on first bang images of multiple bang styles to obtain a bang-free image; performing hair style feature processing on the no-bang image to obtain second bang images of multiple bang styles under the same identity; splicing the images without the bangs under the same identity and the second bang images of the multiple bang styles in pairs to obtain spliced images of the hair styles under the same identity; generating a first text prompt corresponding to the bang style; performing model training on the initial hair style generation model according to each hair style spliced image and the corresponding text prompt to obtain a hair style generation model for generating each bang style; and performing hair style feature processing on the to-be-processed image according to the second text prompt through the hair style generation model to obtain a target bang image corresponding to the second text prompt. By adopting the method, the generation effect of the bang hair style can be effectively improved.

title: Lightweight and efficient fine-grained pressure sand ground extraction method and device and medium
abstract: The invention provides a lightweight and efficient fine-grained pressure sand land extraction method and device, and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: collecting a high-resolution remote sensing image and constructing sample data; constructing a fine-grained pressure sand ground extraction network model, and performing training optimization on the extraction network model based on the sample data; the fine-grained pressure sand ground extraction network model comprises an encoder part and a decoder part; the encoder part adopts a lightweight backbone network and is used for extracting multi-level depth semantic and texture information from an input remote sensing image; the decoder part is provided with a progressive multi-stage feature aggregation module and a differentiable Canny edge enhancement module which are connected in series; and inputting a to-be-extracted remote sensing image into the trained network model, carrying out fine granularity extraction on the pressure sand land, and generating a high-precision pressure sand land segmentation result. According to the method, an effective solution is provided for large-range remote sensing intelligent interpretation of the sand pressing land and even other fine-grained ground objects with main body texture breakage and external boundary fuzzy characteristics.

title: Self-adaptive constant-speed rehabilitation training method based on tissue form and electrophysiological signal double feedback
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of rehabilitation medicine and intelligent rehabilitation engineering, and discloses a self-adaptive constant-speed rehabilitation training method based on tissue morphology and electrophysiological signal double feedback. According to the method, muscle group tissue morphology and electrophysiological signals are synchronously collected through high-resolution ultrasound and surface myoelectricity, and muscle structure-function joint representation is constructed through multi-modal time sequence alignment; an adaptive impedance adjusting model is used for dynamically generating individualized constant-speed training resistance, and a joint angular speed closed-loop feedback correction track is combined, so that it is ensured that the resistance is accurately matched with the muscle state under full-range constant-speed movement. Rehabilitation normal form transformation from experience driving to physiological feedback driving is achieved, and training accuracy, safety and individual suitability are improved.

title: Capacity configuration method, system and equipment of power supply system and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a capacity configuration method and system for a power supply system, equipment and a medium, and the method is characterized in that the method comprises the steps: obtaining load power data, illumination resource data, and equipment operation parameters of all equipment in the power supply system; inputting the load power data, the illumination resource data and the equipment operation parameters into a multi-objective optimization function to determine a multi-objective function value corresponding to each individual in the initial population through a multi-objective optimization algorithm, and performing non-dominated sorting and congestion degree calculation on the initial population by using the multi-objective function values, the method comprises the steps of calculating a plurality of devices in a power supply system, obtaining an initial non-dominated solution set based on a calculation result, determining a target non-dominated solution set until the initial non-dominated solution set meets a preset termination condition, determining a target capacity configuration scheme based on the target non-dominated solution set, and performing capacity configuration on the plurality of devices in the power supply system based on the target capacity configuration scheme. title: Cloud cluster automatic expansion method and system, and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of information, and provides a cloud cluster automatic expansion method and system and a storage medium. title: Grease injection quantity prediction method based on multiple parameters
abstract: The invention discloses a grease injection quantity prediction method based on multiple parameters, and the method comprises the following steps: 1, collecting multi-source data, and carrying out the preprocessing of the multi-source data; 2, constructing an initial feature matrix; mapping the high-dimensional features to a low-dimensional principal component space; the feature data with the highest correlation with the grease injection amount are screened out; 3, constructing a residual multi-head attention long-short-term memory network as a prediction model; 4, inputting the feature data screened in the step 2 into the trained prediction model to obtain the grease adding amount required by the bearing; 5, converting the predicted value into a specific control instruction; and step 6, continuously performing dynamic optimization and online learning. According to the invention, the bearing state, environment, structure and grease performance parameters are simultaneously incorporated into the grease injection quantity prediction model, so that the problem of large limitation of a single parameter model is solved; on-line learning and Bayesian optimization are introduced, so that the model can be adaptively adjusted along with the change of the equipment state.

title: Hierarchical strategy learning system for multi-agent confrontation optimization
abstract: The invention discloses a hierarchical strategy learning system for multi-agent confrontation optimization, particularly relates to the field of simulated confrontation, and is used for solving the problem that a reusable structured scheme is difficult to automatically generate from mass trajectory data in multi-round confrontation simulation. title: Task allocation method and device for unmanned aerial vehicle, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a task allocation method and device for an unmanned aerial vehicle, equipment and a storage medium. According to the specific implementation scheme, the method comprises the steps of obtaining a dynamic task set of to-be-launched tasks; wherein the dynamic task set comprises task execution information of a to-be-released task; under the condition that the tasks in the dynamic task set are changed, randomly distributing the tasks in the changed dynamic task set to each unmanned aerial vehicle, and generating a to-be-executed task list of each unmanned aerial vehicle; according to the to-be-executed task list of each unmanned aerial vehicle, task capability parameters of each unmanned aerial vehicle are determined; wherein the task capability parameters comprise at least two of the total task completion time, the battery capacity, the total task energy consumption and the priority of tasks executed by the unmanned aerial vehicle; and performing multi-target optimization on the task capability parameters by using a multi-target particle swarm optimization algorithm, and determining a task allocation sequence of the unmanned aerial vehicle. According to the technical scheme of the invention, the accuracy and stability of unmanned aerial vehicle launching can be effectively improved.

title: Multi-dimensional feature inversion and risk diagnosis method and system for coal-related industrial area
abstract: The invention discloses a coal-related industrial area multi-dimensional feature inversion and risk diagnosis method and system. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing a hierarchical multi-dimensional feature sample set serving macroscopic-microscopic-stress source three-level linkage; then, a cascade vision inversion strategy from coarse to fine is adopted; four types of coal-related sites including an open-air coal site, an underground coal site, a coal power site and a coal chemical field are judged according to the extracted ground feature combination and a multi-scheme fusion mechanism through a white box logical reasoning engine, and end-to-end black box recognition is decomposed into transparent traceable decisions; constructing a coal-related site multi-dimensional feature data cube containing physical attributes and environmental backgrounds; and finally, implementing dual-path risk quantification and prototype diagnosis based on the data cube, and decoupling a collaborative and event risk driving mechanism. According to the method, the problems of opaque decision-making process and single risk representation in the prior art are solved, and high-precision identification, total-factor filing and deep risk portraying of the coal-related industrial area are realized.

title: PCBA (Printed Circuit Board Assembly) processing method and system for improving strain displacement precision of medical color ultrasound equipment
abstract: The invention discloses a PCBA (Printed Circuit Board Assembly) processing method and system for improving strain displacement precision of medical color ultrasound equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring PCBA processing multi-dimensional original data; constructing a frequency domain characteristic decomposition displacement inversion model to invert an initial strain displacement state; determining electromagnetic interference key parameters by using a PCBA anti-interference electromagnetic simulation algorithm; establishing a random forest ultrasonic feature classification model to identify a strain displacement deviation type; pCBA processing parameters are adjusted according to the identification result; and related data are uploaded to a color Doppler ultrasound PCBA full-process MES tracing platform. Wherein the steps S3-S5 refine the simulation, classification and parameter adjustment process through multiple steps to ensure the technical landing. The system is implemented based on a multi-unit cooperation and support method. According to the method, through multi-model fusion and full-process data tracing, processing precision influence factors are comprehensively covered, deviation is accurately corrected, PCBA strain displacement precision is effectively improved, the requirements for imaging quality and diagnosis accuracy of medical color ultrasound equipment are met, and the method adapts to compliance and safety standards of the medical industry.

title: Power feedback control method of solid pulse laser
abstract: The invention provides a power feedback control method of a solid pulse laser, which comprises the following steps of: predicting the optimal working temperature of a crystal of the solid pulse laser according to the environment temperature by using a pre-trained interpolator, and providing a first predicted value to reduce the search range of the optimal working temperature of the crystal; and performing local search by taking the first predicted value as a baseline, and further determining an observation value (second predicted value) of the optimal working temperature of the crystal by performing local temperature scanning around the first predicted value. And the local error is compensated by combining the prior information (the first predicted value) and the real-time measurement data (the second predicted value), so that the prediction precision is remarkably improved.

abstract: The invention discloses a data processing method and related equipment thereof, which can reduce the calculation amount of a data processing process so as to reduce the cost of data processing. title: System, method, and program for evaluating performance of graph anti-rendering model using artificial intelligence
abstract: Disclosed are a system, a method, and a program for evaluating the performance of an artificial intelligence model that extracts chart information by derendering a chart. The system includes: a memory including: an AI model that decodes an image of a chart stored in a test set and outputs at least one data format including meta information or data information in the image of the chart; and a performance evaluation model that outputs a result of evaluating the performance of the AI model. And a processor that executes or trains the AI model and runs the performance evaluation model. abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of nuclear-grade SLM equipment fault diagnosis, and discloses a nuclear-grade SLM equipment fault diagnosis result credibility quantification method based on conformal prediction, and the method comprises the steps: carrying out the preprocessing of a nuclear-grade SLM equipment vibration signal, and constructing a training set, a calibration set and a test set which comprise distributed inner and outer samples; finely adjusting the fault diagnosis model through a feature separation loss function containing a separation loss item and an aggregation loss item; extracting a high-dimensional feature vector of the test sample and calculating a non-consistency measurement score; determining a class condition quantile threshold value and a label ranking threshold value of each class based on the calibration set; screening fault category labels meeting conditions to generate a prediction set; and outputting a diagnosis result credibility quantitative index. According to the method, the out-of-distribution samples can be accurately identified, the size of the rare sample prediction set under the unbalanced data is optimized, the coverage rate and the quantitative practicability are considered, and a reliable basis is provided for equipment maintenance decision making.

title: Industrial black box optimization method based on constraint decomposition and external knowledge gating
abstract: The invention discloses an industrial black box optimization method based on constraint decomposition and external knowledge gating, which aims at solving the problems of constraint processing fragmentation and external knowledge piling and generation stagnation in the prior art, and comprises the following steps: acquiring an industrial process parameter boundary, an evaluation budget and an interface contract containing equipment safety and resource consumption constraints; generating an initial candidate optimizer; based on the constraint and contract recombination code structure, forming a runnable skeleton; monitoring the number of iterations and performance indexes, and when a preset threshold is reached and the performance does not reach the standard, directionally retrieving external knowledge and injecting after duplicate removal; performing parallel evaluation based on a unified random seed; determining stagnation and triggering an exploration diversity mechanism based on continuous equal division and structural fingerprint detection; and iterating until convergence and periodically archiving the check points. According to the method, systematic code-level adaptation of industrial constraints, precise gating injection of external knowledge, efficient jump-out of generation stagnation and full-process reproducibility guarantee are realized.

title: Knowledge graph relation extraction method fusing syntactic structure and domain rule
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of natural language processing and mapping knowledge domain, and particularly discloses a mapping knowledge domain relation extraction method fusing a syntactic structure and a domain rule. The method aims at solving the problems of semantic understanding deviation and insufficient domain knowledge utilization in vertical domain relation extraction. The method comprises the steps that dependency syntactic analysis is conducted on a text, a syntactic dependency adjacency matrix is constructed, and meanwhile a rule adjacency matrix is generated based on domain rule base matching; carrying out weighted fusion and filtering on the two types of matrixes to obtain an enhanced adjacent matrix; inputting the matrix and a text vector into a graph convolutional network fused with a dependency type attention mechanism, and learning to obtain a node enhancement representation; and finally constructing an entity pair feature vector to finish relationship classification. Through explicit fusion of interpretable syntactic rules and domain priori, the accuracy and robustness of relation extraction in professional fields such as a power distribution network are improved. Experiments show that the model relation extraction F1 value reaches 86.07% and is improved by 1.31% compared with a baseline model with the optimal performance.

title: Markov chain-based station path anomaly detection method and device, and medium
abstract: The invention discloses a Markov chain-based station yard path anomaly detection method, which comprises the following steps of: S1, collecting an existing electronic railway station yard circuit diagram, and carrying out standardization processing to form a historical graph library; s2, for a to-be-detected new station yard circuit diagram, extracting sub-paths by using a sub-diagram mining method; s3, on the basis of the modeling idea of the Markov chain, the generation probability of the sub-paths is calculated; s4, collecting generation probability values of all sub-paths in the new station yard circuit diagram, and constructing an empirical probability distribution model; and S5, performing anomaly detection and positioning. According to the method, the occurrence rule of the local connection mode in the previous circuit diagram set is learned, so that the potential abnormal section in the newly designed electronic circuit diagram is accurately identified.

title: AI-based accurate matching method and system for flexible employment
abstract: The invention discloses an AI-based accurate matching method and system for flexible employment, and relates to the technical field of employment allocation. title: Multi-equipment linkage intelligent scheduling method and system for automobile disassembly production line
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent manufacturing, and discloses a multi-device linkage intelligent scheduling method and system for an automobile disassembly production line. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-source operation data to obtain an equipment load distribution matrix and a material flow vector; according to the equipment load distribution matrix and the material flow vector, using a particle swarm algorithm to obtain a task scheduling priority matrix and determining a linkage bottleneck area; outputting a task allocation scheme in the virtual simulation environment by using the deep reinforcement learning model; determining a congestion area according to the task allocation scheme and generating a path correction vector; scheduling available alternative equipment to execute load transfer to obtain a load adjustment parameter; and calculating a progress deviation vector according to the load adjustment parameter, and updating a multi-device cooperative operation parameter. According to the method, the problem of cascade imbalance caused by capacity difference of heterogeneous equipment in the disassembly production line can be solved.

title: Energy storage system energy management method and system based on machine learning
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of energy storage system management, and discloses an energy storage system energy management method and system based on machine learning. The method comprises the steps of performing sliding window extraction on energy storage system time sequence data to obtain a fusion time sequence feature set, inputting the fusion time sequence feature set into a long-short-term memory prediction network to obtain a demand prediction probability vector, calculating a probability difference value, setting a grading threshold value to obtain a credibility grading result, dynamically adjusting power distribution amplitude according to credibility, and obtaining a credibility grading result. And performing coupled calculation with the battery charge state and the power of the power grid to generate an energy dispatching instruction. According to the method, the problem that the charge and discharge power distribution amplitude cannot be dynamically adjusted according to the prediction reliability because the prediction uncertainty and the power scheduling decision are disjointed in the energy management of the energy storage system is solved, and the balance optimization of the safety and the economy is realized by establishing the quantitative mapping relationship between the prediction confidence and the power distribution coefficient.

abstract: The invention discloses a network traffic classification method based on dual-path noise gating MoEs, and solves the problems of low classification precision and insufficient robustness in the existing network traffic classification method. abstract: A method (600) includes receiving a sequence of encoder input frames (110) as input to an end-to-end model (200). title: Network threat detection based on threat context, threat change and/or influence state
abstract: Aspects described herein may relate to network threat detection based on threat context and/or threat changes. Network threat intelligence (CTI) data may be received from a CTI provider. Endpoint data indicative of evidence indicating that the endpoint is a network threat may be determined based on the CTI data. The endpoint data may be analyzed and/or compared to stored data associated with the endpoint. Analysis and/or comparison may be performed to determine whether evidence indicating that the endpoint is a network threat has changed. Based on any change, a treatment for the endpoint may be determined and sent. These treatments may alter the manner in which the device filters network traffic associated with the endpoint. An alternative to the default handling may be determined based on the effects of blocking potential legitimate network traffic to and/or from the endpoint. The machine learning model may assist in processing and analyzing CTI data, performing threat monitoring, and/or determining push including handling.

title: Multi-Agv cooperative scheduling system for realizing load balancing
abstract: The invention discloses a multi-AGV cooperative scheduling system for realizing load balancing. The multi-AGV cooperative scheduling system comprises a task management module, a state monitoring module, a load balancing scheduling module, an AGV cooperative scheduling module, an edge server optimization module, a task compression module, a task parallel processing module and a performance evaluation module. Global model parameters and a global anatomical structure diagram are initialized through a server; the server issues global model parameters and a global anatomical structure chart to each client; the client calculates detection loss based on the local data and performs feature enhancement on the local data; the technical problems that in the prior art, a traditional centralized or classical FL method is difficult to consider global performance and local adaptability at the same time and neglect topological priori between organ structures, so that the generalization ability of a model in complex structure recognition is limited, and deep fusion with medical knowledge is lacked are solved. The generalization ability of the model in a complex structure is improved, and deep fusion of the model and medical knowledge is enhanced.

title: Comprehensive information prospecting prediction method based on geological prototype
abstract: The invention provides a comprehensive information prospecting prediction method based on a geological prototype, which takes coal resources as a research object, is used for guiding exploration deployment, and comprises the following steps: firstly, constructing a coal metallogenic geological prototype, and obtaining and sorting geological structure data; the method comprises the following steps: firstly, carrying out geological prototype tectonic coal control relation identification, carrying out tectonic coal control type area division, carrying out coal metallogenic favorable area division, forming a prospecting prediction result and guiding exploration deployment, and finally, forming the prospecting prediction result according to the spatial distribution condition of a coal metallogenic favorable area. In conclusion, the method has the advantages that the project implementation path is clear, the prediction result is stable and reliable, the exploration deployment pertinence is high, and the resource input and utilization efficiency is high.

title: Bulk logistics optimization system and method based on digitization
abstract: The invention discloses a digitization-based bulk logistics optimization system and method, the system comprises an intelligent logistics control center, an Internet of Things data acquisition layer, a supply chain knowledge graph engine and a block chain credible evidence storage system, multi-modal logistics data are acquired through multi-protocol access, and after standardization processing, the data are stored in the block chain credible evidence storage system. And a Pareto optimal path solution set is generated by adopting a reinforcement learning algorithm, dynamic risk assessment and optimal scheduling are realized in combination with a graph neural network risk propagation model, and key information is stored and an intelligent contract is executed through a block chain alliance chain. According to the method, the problems of traditional logistics visualization limitation, path optimization lag and risk management and control deficiency are solved, full-link transparent management, dynamic adaptive optimization and prospective risk prevention and control are realized, the logistics efficiency is remarkably improved, the operation cost is reduced, and the method can be widely applied to bulk commodity cross-border trade logistics scenes.

title: Prediction method, device, equipment, medium and program product
abstract: The invention provides a prediction method which can be applied to the technical field of big data and the technical field of financial science and technology. The prediction method comprises the steps that in response to a received task for predicting a target user, respective multi-dimensional features of multiple candidate users and the relevancy between the feature of each dimension in the multi-dimensional features and the task are obtained, and the feature of each dimension is a time sequence feature obtained by collecting the user features of the corresponding dimension based on multiple moments; the multi-dimensional features and the relevancy of the multiple candidate users are input into a first model, target features of the multiple candidate users are obtained, and the first model is used for screening and combining the multi-dimensional features according to the change condition of the features of each dimension along with time and the relevancy; and inputting the respective target features of the plurality of candidate users into the second model to obtain a target user predicted from the plurality of candidate users. title: Knowledge mastery degree evaluation method based on electroencephalogram-vision fusion
abstract: The invention discloses a knowledge mastery degree evaluation method based on electroencephalogram-visual fusion, and belongs to the technical field of educational evaluation and artificial intelligence. The method comprises the steps that electroencephalogram signal data, visual behavior data and learning content data of a learner are synchronously collected, feature vectors of all modals are extracted, and a knowledge mastery degree evaluation result is obtained; the method comprises the steps of dynamically calculating the fusion weight of each modal based on real-time signal quality, inputting a fusion feature vector into a deep learning network model to output a knowledge mastery score and confidence, constructing and updating a personalized knowledge graph, and generating learning recommendation based on the knowledge graph. According to the method, the evaluation precision is remarkably improved through three-mode adaptive fusion, accurate positioning of the granularity of the knowledge points is realized, and long-term learning tracking and personalized recommendation are supported.

title: Large model target detection method and system based on dynamic feature enhancement and lightweight fine tuning
abstract: The invention discloses a target detection method and system of a large model based on dynamic feature enhancement and lightweight fine tuning, and the method comprises the steps: S1, obtaining a mixed training data set, and training a target detection base model; when a target detection base model is constructed, a dynamic feature enhancement module is embedded in a language decoder of a multi-mode large model, and a fine tuning module is introduced at a linear layer; when the target detection base model is trained, an encoder, a decoder and a bridging module of the multi-mode large model are frozen; s2, based on the target detection base model, freezing a backbone network and a dynamic feature enhancement module of the target detection base model, and activating a fine tuning module; acquiring field sample data, and performing lightweight training on the fine tuning module to obtain a target detection model; and S3, obtaining an input containing a to-be-detected image, inputting the input into the target detection model, and outputting the category and positioning information of the target. title: Building change online detection method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention discloses a building change online detection method based on deep learning, and relates to the technical field of data processing, target building information is determined, dynamic data are collected corresponding to a target building, and the dynamic data comprise building dynamic images and corresponding collection time; and setting an analysis platform, setting a mirror image layer corresponding to the target building in the analysis platform, and transmitting the dynamic data to the corresponding mirror image layer in the analysis platform for storage. And analyzing the dynamic data based on deep learning in the mirror image layer to obtain feature information, and comparing the feature information of the target building according to the acquisition time to obtain change information. title: Crop disease and insect pest image intelligent identification and grading processing method based on deep learning
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of agricultural informatization, and discloses a crop disease and insect pest image intelligent identification and grading processing method based on deep learning, which comprises the steps of multispectral image acquisition and adaptive preprocessing, multi-modal feature extraction and fusion, double-branch identification model processing, adaptive grading processing, and result output and feedback optimization. title: Smart classroom speech recognition method, system and device based on neural network, and medium
abstract: The invention relates to a smart classroom speech recognition method, system and device based on a neural network, and a medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring noisy voice data of a classroom environment and performing feature extraction to obtain a voice feature set; identifying a dominant classroom noise type through a noise classifier to obtain a noise type identifier; processing the voice feature set through convolution kernel configuration corresponding to the noise type identifier to obtain local precise features, and processing the local precise features through a multi-head self-attention mechanism to obtain key focusing features; based on a fusion weight corresponding to the noise type identifier, carrying out weighted summation on the local precise feature and the key focusing feature to generate a fusion feature; performing channel-level attention weight calculation on the fusion features and performing feature data screening to obtain lightweight optimization features; and inputting the lightweight optimization features into a classification decoder to obtain a speech recognition text result. The method can be adapted to a complex noise environment in a classroom, and the accuracy of speech recognition is improved.

title: Sewage treatment process recommendation method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a sewage treatment process recommendation method and system. The method comprises the following steps: S1, collecting and preprocessing project data; s2, process feature extraction and vectorization; s3, intelligently matching the candidate process schemes; s4, multi-index comprehensive evaluation and sorting; and S5, scheme optimization and dynamic updating. According to the method, the multi-dimensional data of the target project is converted into the computable feature vector, and the intelligent model trained based on the historical case library is utilized for matching, so that the candidate process scheme can be quickly and objectively generated, excessive dependence of a traditional method on personal experience is remarkably reduced, and recommendation efficiency and scientificity are improved; by introducing a multi-index comprehensive evaluation system, the scheme can be quantitatively compared and sorted from multiple aspects of technology, economy, stability, environment and the like, so that the decision-making process is more comprehensive and transparent; and a self-feedback and dynamic updating mechanism can continuously bring new successful cases into the knowledge base, so that the model is continuously evolved to adapt to new problems and new standards, thereby keeping the accuracy and advancement of recommendation for a long time.

title: Method and device for predicting restenosis risk after intravascular treatment of TARAS patient, storage medium and program product
abstract: The invention relates to a method and device for predicting the risk of restenosis after intravascular treatment of a TARAS patient, a storage medium and a program product. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring target preoperative clinical data and target iconography characteristics collected for a detection object; calculating a risk score based on the target preoperative clinical data and the target iconography features; the risk score is compared with a first threshold value, an auxiliary prediction result of the detection object is determined according to a comparison result, and the auxiliary prediction result is used for representing the restenosis risk of the detection object. The invention aims to provide a model for evaluating the post-PTA restenosis risk of a severe TARAS patient by using anatomical risk factors and other clinical risk factors, so that the risk of an intravascular treatment technology can be quantified, and the clinical popularization and application of the intravascular treatment technology can be promoted.

title: Cable storage environment monitoring method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract: The invention relates to a cable storage environment monitoring method and system based on artificial intelligence, and belongs to the technical field of cable storage management and intelligent monitoring. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring cable environment sampling data, constructing a cable storage monitoring matrix, extracting a constraint environment gradient of a cable edge storage state, and performing space mapping on environment monitoring information to obtain cable storage state parameters; constructing a cable storage abnormal environment detection model, and extracting storage environment characteristics of a cable storage environment; performing spatial reconstruction on the cable environment sampling data, simulating a state change track of the cable under different abnormal environment evolution conditions, and obtaining cable environment abnormity feedback; and mapping the abnormal environment parameters after spatial reconstruction into a virtual simulation environment, and performing cross validation on the cable abnormal environment detection information in combination with the cable environment abnormity feedback to generate a cable abnormal feature monitoring report.

title: Data acquisition system and data acquisition method for self-adaptive memory test
abstract: The invention provides a data acquisition system and a data acquisition method for self-adaptive memory testing, and belongs to the technical field of memory testing. The system comprises a test decision engine built in or connected with a memory test model and an uncertainty evaluation module, the model outputs a memory test strategy and analyzes a test result, and the evaluation module quantifies the confidence of the memory test strategy and identifies a test information demand gap; the dynamic acquisition controller is used for receiving the acquisition request sent by the test decision engine and analyzing the acquisition request into a hardware control instruction; the multi-mode sensor array is used for executing data acquisition of the memory according to the instruction; the edge feature extraction and compression module is used for processing the collected original data in real time and generating a test feature vector; and the data fusion and association database is used for receiving and storing the test feature vectors and uniformly marking timestamps and event tags for the test decision engine to call. According to the method, accurate tracing from logic errors to physical roots is realized, and the memory testing efficiency is improved.

title: Bunching device boundary identification method for DR image and network model training method thereof
abstract: The invention provides a beam splitter boundary identification method for a DR image and a network model training method thereof. The DR images collected by the detector are collected, the DR images are preprocessed to generate the DR original sample images, and the influence of image shooting factors on follow-up beam splitter boundary recognition can be effectively reduced through preprocessing. A generator in the generative adversarial network is used for outputting a DR generation sample image, and a DR image training data set is constructed based on a DR original sample image and the DR generation sample image, so that the cost of collecting a large number of DR original sample images can be saved. The deep learning network model at least comprises two different image segmentation loss functions, and through multi-objective optimization of a loss function space, gradient contribution of a simple background is reduced, so that the deep learning network model more efficiently learns the boundary of a beam splitter in a DR image, optimizes the coincidence rate of a prediction mask and a label, and inhibits voids and fractures.

title: Bridge side falling behavior sensing method and system suitable for low-quality visual conditions
abstract: The invention discloses a bridge side falling behavior sensing method and system suitable for low-quality visual conditions, and belongs to the technical field of behavior sensing. The method comprises the following steps: judging whether weak light and/or blur exists in a bridge side scene image according to a calculated TBV index of the bridge side scene image; the bridge side scene image with the weak light is input into the D2A-DCE model, the bridge side scene image with the blurring is input into the improved NAFNet model, the bridge side scene image with the weak light and the blurring is sequentially input into the D2A-DCE model and the improved NAFNet model, and a bridge side scene enhanced image is output; inputting the bridge side scene enhanced image into the improved CMFF model, and outputting a fusion feature map; and inputting the fusion feature map into a pre-constructed Bridge-SIDE Net model, and outputting a bridge side falling behavior sensing result. According to the invention, the problems of poor bridge side behavior identification accuracy, false report and missing report in an image quality degradation environment can be solved.

title: Automatic driving risk decision-making method and system based on monocular vision, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention relates to an automatic driving risk decision-making method and system based on monocular vision, computer equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining a to-be-processed image through a monocular camera, respectively extracting the semantic features and geometric state features of the image, and generating a semantic feature vector and a geometric state feature vector; and fusing the two features to obtain a fused feature vector. And constructing a risk decision model by adopting reinforcement learning, fusing the feature vector and the current vehicle state to form a reinforcement learning state, and outputting an initial decision after inputting the model. And in combination with a historical experience guide strategy, a prior guide weight is dynamically adjusted according to the uncertainty of the initial decision, a risk decision model is updated in combination with an optimization target and the prior guide weight, and a final decision is output by the updated model. According to the method, the risk modeling capability, the feature extraction capability and the risk decision accuracy of the monocular vision-based automatic driving technology in a complex traffic scene are improved.

title: Narrow-linewidth tunable dual-wavelength laser output system based on data driving
abstract: The invention relates to the technical field of solid lasers, and particularly provides a narrow-linewidth tunable dual-wavelength laser output system based on data driving, which comprises a pumping source, a resonant cavity, a data acquisition unit and a data receiving and driving device, a single gain medium, two F-P etalon and an F-P angle regulator are arranged in the resonant cavity, the inclination angles of the two F-P etalon are adjusted through an F-P angle adjuster so as to perform longitudinal mode selection and wavelength tuning on the output laser of the resonant cavity; a neural network screening model is arranged in the data receiving and driving device, the neural network screening model is used for learning the mapping relation between intracavity parameters and output laser optical parameters, and dual-wavelength simultaneous locking and line width prediction are achieved through dual-etalon collaborative mode selection and data driving of the neural network screening model. According to the invention, the complexity of the system is greatly simplified, and dual-wavelength, narrow-linewidth, high-stability, repeatable and automatic laser output regulation and control which cannot be achieved by a traditional architecture are realized functionally.

title: Step type magnetic lead screw power generation device and parameter optimization selection method thereof
abstract: The invention discloses a step type magnetic lead screw power generation device and a parameter optimization selection method thereof, the device comprises a V-shaped embedded step rotor, a spiral rotor damping modulation ring and a step stator which are coaxially arranged in sequence from inside to outside, and low-speed reciprocating motion of waves can be efficiently converted into electric energy. The parameter optimization method comprises the following steps: setting a to-be-optimized parameter and generating an initial population by using a Halton sequence; performance indexes are extracted through finite element simulation, and the fitness is calculated; on the basis of the nonlinear escape energy model, selecting an exploration or development mode of the Harris eagle algorithm to update parameters; and differential variation is introduced to enhance the search capability, and iterative optimization is carried out until an optimal parameter combination is obtained. According to the method, multi-parameter collaborative automatic optimization is realized, the air gap flux density, the thrust stability and the output efficiency of the power generation device are remarkably improved, and the defects that a traditional trial-and-error method is long in design period and prone to falling into local optimum are overcome.

title: Transverse wave time difference prediction method for deep carbonate rock fault control reservoir
abstract: The invention discloses a transverse wave time difference prediction method for a deep carbonatite fault control reservoir, and the method comprises the steps: dividing the reservoir into a fractured zone and a non-fractured zone through logging data from a geologic structure, and carrying out the prediction of the transverse wave time difference based on the characteristics that the logging parameters of the non-fractured zone are high in linear correlation and the logging parameters of the fractured zone are complex in correlation; a non-fracture zone prediction model and a fracture zone prediction model are constructed through multiple linear regression and an XGBoost algorithm, and the two models are combined to serve as a shear wave time difference prediction model of the deep carbonate rock fault control reservoir; and predicting the shear wave time difference through the shear wave time difference prediction model of the deep carbonate rock fault control reservoir according to the logging data of the shear wave time difference to be predicted. The method gives consideration to the calculation efficiency and precision, improves the accuracy on the basis of an original empirical formula, and has the advantages of low cost and high efficiency for predicting the shear wave time difference of the deep carbonate rock fault control reservoir.

title: Front-end integrated unit testing method, device, equipment, medium and program product
abstract: The invention provides a front-end integrated unit testing method, device and equipment, a medium and a program product, which can be applied to the technical field of unit testing. title: Tourism industry data processing method and device, equipment and storage medium
abstract: The invention provides a tourism data processing method and device, equipment and a storage medium, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining the state data of a to-be-predicted tourism index at a plurality of time points, and the influence data corresponding to a target future time point; the target future time point, the state data and the influence data are input into a pre-trained hybrid prediction model, and the hybrid prediction model integrates a trend prediction module, a period prediction module, an event influence prediction module and an external environment influence prediction module; cooperatively processing input through each prediction module in the hybrid prediction model, and correspondingly outputting a trend prediction component, a period prediction component, an event influence prediction component and an external environment influence prediction component at the target future time point; and fusing the obtained prediction components, and generating and outputting a prediction result. title: Double-moving-target defect detection method and system
abstract: The invention discloses a double-motion target defect detection method and system, and the method comprises the steps: collecting a clear frame image under a double-motion condition through an industrial camera and a synchronous stroboscope lamp which are carried on a first motion carrier; inputting the image into a defect detection model based on deep learning for real-time reasoning to identify defects; a position reference is provided for the detection process based on a plurality of RFID tags arranged on a motion path, and starting and stopping of a task and interval management of a detection result are controlled according to the position reference; and finally, associating a defect result in each detection interval with geographic position information, and uploading the defect result to a server through a wireless network for displaying and recording. According to the method, the technical problems of unclear image acquisition, insufficient detection precision and difficulty in realizing reliable positioning and automatic closed-loop management in long-distance detection in a dynamic industrial scene are solved, and high-reliability and traceable automatic defect detection is realized.

title: Image classification method and device based on comparative learning, and storage medium
abstract: The invention discloses an image classification method and device based on comparative learning, and a storage medium, and the method comprises the following steps: carrying out the enhancement processing of two different types of data for the same data, dividing an image sample through a convolution function of which the stride is smaller than kernel size, taking the obtained two feature sequences as different branches, and carrying out the segmentation of the two feature sequences through a convolution function of which the stride is smaller than kernel size; inputting into an SSWT double-branch encoder for extracting local features and global features to obtain output features of the SSWT double-branch encoder; enabling the output characteristics of the SSWT double-branch encoder to pass through a Predictor network structure based on a full connection layer to obtain a result; constructing a target recognition comparison loss function based on multiple features, and calculating the loss of the one-dimensional features obtained by the two branches; and in the test stage, predicting an image target category label by adopting a pre-trained weight. The method solves the problems that most target detection pre-training models are difficult in the overall network training process and large in parameter quantity in downstream tasks in order to improve the accuracy of image classification.

title: Cascade neural network image classification method supporting class incremental learning
abstract: The invention discloses a cascade neural network image classification method supporting class incremental learning, and belongs to the field of hatching egg intelligent detection, and the method comprises the following steps: S1, collecting a hatching egg candling image, and obtaining an initial two-stage data set and a new class data set; s2, constructing a cascade neural network model in which two stages of models are connected in series; s3, each level of model integrates a feature extractor, a feature expander and a recursive linear device module, and transfer learning is carried out on a self-built hatching egg data set; s4, when a category is newly added, on the basis of an analytic category incremental learning mechanism, completing new category knowledge acquisition by recursively updating the model weight, and meanwhile, retaining the original classification capability to realize efficient incremental updating of the model; and S5, preprocessing hatching egg images to be classified, inputting the images into the two-stage cascade neural network model, and outputting a hatching egg classification result. By adopting the method, the problem of insufficient fine granularity of hatching egg classification in a hatching factory is solved, and efficient and accurate classification of the hatching eggs and low-cost iteration of the model are realized.

title: Chemical industrial park explosion monitoring method and system based on time sequence modeling and large model
abstract: The invention provides a chemical industrial park explosion monitoring method and system based on time sequence modeling and a large model, and belongs to the technical field of intelligent safety monitoring of chemical industrial parks. The method comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring multiple paths of monitoring video streams through an image acquisition module; then, flame and smoke targets are detected in real time through a YOLO reasoning model, and the explosion feature recognition accuracy is further improved through an improved non-maximum suppression model and an explosion feature extraction model; secondly, through a neural network model, establishing a network long-term dependency relationship, and identifying explosion event probability distribution; thirdly, constructing an explosion scene through image processing; and finally, semantic understanding is carried out by calling a multi-modal large model, explosion confirmation, grade evaluation and comprehensive risk prediction are completed, and automatic alarm is carried out through an automatic early warning module.

title: Aggregate grading monitoring method and equipment integrating source binding and mobile monitoring
abstract: The invention discloses an aggregate grading monitoring method integrating source binding and mobile monitoring, and the method comprises the following steps: laying a unique RFID tag for each vehicle, and enabling the license plate number of the vehicle to be associated with an aggregate source; an RFID reader-writer and/or a camera device are/is arranged on a vehicle transportation path, so that the RFID reader-writer identifies the RFID tag of the passing vehicle and/or the camera device collects the passing image; a multi-target tracking and cross-camera device re-identification method based on a ByteTrack algorithm is adopted to continuously track the identity of the aggregate transport vehicle; collecting a surface image of a paving surface after the aggregate transport vehicle unloads, and obtaining a surface grading curve through the instance segmentation model; constructing a physical information neural network model, introducing a non-uniform coefficient and a curvature coefficient as physical constraints, and analyzing the internal three-dimensional gradation of the rockfill material through a surface gradation curve; and the whole-process grading data are integrated according to vehicle numbers. title: Gas detection wireless alarm method and system based on machine learning
abstract: The invention relates to a gas detection wireless alarm method and system based on machine learning. The method comprises the following steps: collecting gas data in an environment; when the hazardous gas concentration exceeds the standard or the oxygen content is insufficient, an uplink alarm signal is generated and synchronously sent to the data processing end and the mobile monitoring end; a machine learning trend prediction model is constructed, the machine learning trend prediction model is adopted to analyze the gas data, and the predicted risk level and risk probability are output; the data processing end generates a corresponding downlink alarm signal and synchronously sends the downlink alarm signal to the detection end and the mobile monitoring end; and triggering an audible and visual alarm of the mobile monitoring end to give an alarm, and calculating the position information of the detection end in real time. According to the invention, information of a dangerous environment where an operator is located can be fed back to a guardian in real time, so that the guardian can quickly start rescue or intervention measures, and accident risks are reduced. Accurate position information is synchronized to the mobile monitoring terminal, and rescue workers are guided to quickly position risk points and trapped persons, so that the rescue response time is shortened.

title: Automatic matching method and system for road congestion cause study and judgment and blockage relieving strategy
abstract: The invention belongs to the technical field of traffic management, and particularly discloses an automatic matching method and system for road congestion cause study and judgment and a congestion relieving strategy. The method disclosed by the invention comprises the following steps: firstly, acquiring and preprocessing multi-source traffic data, and establishing a congestion judgment index to carry out congestion state judgment on a road; thirdly, constructing a traffic knowledge graph, converting multi-source data into a structured knowledge network, performing cause tracing on a congested road section, and screening out congestion causes; then, establishing a multi-dimensional strategy library, automatically matching a blockage relieving strategy from the strategy library, and outputting and executing the matched blockage relieving strategy; and finally, performing closed-loop optimization on the knowledge graph, the matching model and the strategy library based on execution feedback data. According to the invention, the conversion of traffic control from static experience matching to dynamic intelligent adaptation is realized, and the accuracy and timeliness of traffic jam control are improved. The method can be widely applied to congestion treatment of traffic roads.
